````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Represents the functional role a node is AUTHORIZED to perform.
/// This is the "what" axis - what the node can do.
/// </summary>
public enum NodeRole {
    /// <summary>No defined role yet (initializing, unknown).</summary>
    None = 0,
    /// <summary>Authoritative for writes and coordination (primary/master).</summary>
    Leader = 1,
    /// <summary>Voting member that replicates data (secondary/replica).</summary>
    Follower = 2,
    /// <summary>Non-voting, read-scaling member (read replica).</summary>
    ReadOnly = 3,
    /// <summary>Administrative/orchestration only (not for client traffic).</summary>
    Manager = 4,
    /// <summary>Leader handing off authority (stepping down).</summary>
    Resigning = 5
}
````

````csharp
/// <summary>
/// Represents the node's synchronization HEALTH and operational progress.
/// This is the "how" axis - how the node is performing.
/// </summary>
public enum NodeStatus {
    /// <summary>Booting or discovering peers.</summary>
    Starting = 0,
    /// <summary>Catching up on logs (replicating data).</summary>
    Syncing = 1,
    /// <summary>Fully operational and current.</summary>
    Ready = 2,

    /// <summary>Graceful shutdown in progress.</summary>

}
````

## File: src/Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing/Picking/DefaultStrategy.cs
````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Routes writes to leader, reads to followers with round-robin.
/// Falls back to leader for reads if no followers available.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Zero-allocation: Uses simple loops with role priority scanning.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Read preference order: ReadOnly → Follower → Leader
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
public sealed class DefaultStrategy : IClusterNodePickingStrategy {
    /// <summary>Singleton instance with default write method prefixes.</summary>
    public static DefaultStrategy Instance { get; } = new();
    long _readOnlyIndex;
    long _followerIndex;
    long _leaderIndex;
    readonly string[] _writeMethodPrefixes;
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new default strategy with standard write method prefixes.
    /// </summary>
    public DefaultStrategy() : this("Append", "Delete", "Create", "Set", "Update", "Write", "Put", "Remove") { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new default strategy with custom write method prefixes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="writeMethodPrefixes">Prefixes that identify write methods.</param>
    public DefaultStrategy(params string[] writeMethodPrefixes) {
        _writeMethodPrefixes = writeMethodPrefixes;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public PickNodeResult Pick(in PickNodeContext context) {
        if (context.Nodes.Length == 0)
            return PickNodeResult.NoEligibleNodes();
        var method = ExtractMethodName(context.Request);
        var isWrite = IsWriteMethod(method);
        return isWrite ? PickForWrite(context) : PickForRead(context);
    }
    PickNodeResult PickForWrite(in PickNodeContext context) {
        var nodes = context.Nodes;
        // Simple loop - no LINQ allocation
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (nodes[i].Node.CanAcceptWrites)
                return PickNodeResult.ForNode(nodes[i]);
        }
        return PickNodeResult.NoLeader();
    }
    PickNodeResult PickForRead(in PickNodeContext context) {
        var nodes = context.Nodes;
        // Count nodes by role (single pass)
        int readOnlyCount = 0, followerCount = 0, leaderCount = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (!nodes[i].Node.CanServeReads)
                continue;
            switch (nodes[i].Node.Role) {
                case NodeRole.ReadOnly: readOnlyCount++; break;
                case NodeRole.Follower: followerCount++; break;
                case NodeRole.Leader:   leaderCount++;   break;
            }
        }
        // Prefer ReadOnly → Follower → Leader
        if (readOnlyCount > 0) {
            var targetIndex = (int)(Interlocked.Increment(ref _readOnlyIndex) % readOnlyCount);
            return FindNthByRole(nodes, NodeRole.ReadOnly, targetIndex);
        }
        if (followerCount > 0) {
            var targetIndex = (int)(Interlocked.Increment(ref _followerIndex) % followerCount);
            return FindNthByRole(nodes, NodeRole.Follower, targetIndex);
        }
        if (leaderCount > 0) {
            var targetIndex = (int)(Interlocked.Increment(ref _leaderIndex) % leaderCount);
            return FindNthByRole(nodes, NodeRole.Leader, targetIndex);
        }
        return PickNodeResult.NoEligibleNodes();
    }
    static PickNodeResult FindNthByRole(SubchannelNode[] nodes, NodeRole role, int targetIndex) {
        var count = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (nodes[i].Node.CanServeReads && nodes[i].Node.Role == role) {
                if (count == targetIndex)
                    return PickNodeResult.ForNode(nodes[i]);
                count++;
            }
        }
        return PickNodeResult.NoEligibleNodes(); // Shouldn't happen
    }
    bool IsWriteMethod(string method) {
        // Simple loop - no LINQ allocation
        for (var i = 0; i < _writeMethodPrefixes.Length; i++) {
            if (method.StartsWith(_writeMethodPrefixes[i], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    static string ExtractMethodName(HttpRequestMessage? request) =>
        request?.RequestUri?.Segments.LastOrDefault() ?? "";
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Routes all requests to the leader.
/// Use for strict consistency requirements.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Zero-allocation: Uses simple loop scan.
/// </remarks>
public sealed class LeaderOnlyStrategy : IClusterNodePickingStrategy {
    /// <summary>Singleton instance.</summary>
    public static LeaderOnlyStrategy Instance { get; } = new();
    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public PickNodeResult Pick(in PickNodeContext context) {
        var nodes = context.Nodes;
        // Simple loop - no LINQ allocation
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (nodes[i].Node.CanAcceptWrites)
                return PickNodeResult.ForNode(nodes[i]);
        }
        return PickNodeResult.NoLeader();
    }
}
````

## File: src/Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing/Picking/PickNodeResult.cs
````csharp
using Grpc.Core;
using Grpc.Net.Client.Balancer;
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Result of a node picking operation.
/// Wraps gRPC's PickResult with domain-specific factory methods.
/// </summary>
public readonly struct PickNodeResult {
    readonly Subchannel? _subchannel;
    readonly Status? _status;
    readonly PickNodeResultType _type;
    enum PickNodeResultType { Subchannel, Fail, Drop, Defer }
    // === Success ===
    /// <summary>Route to the specified subchannel.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult ForSubchannel(Subchannel subchannel) =>
        new(PickNodeResultType.Subchannel, subchannel, null);
    /// <summary>Route to the specified node's subchannel.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult ForNode(SubchannelNode node) =>
        ForSubchannel(node.Subchannel);
    // === Defer ===
    /// <summary>Wait for a new picker (topology refresh in progress).</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult Defer() =>
        new(PickNodeResultType.Defer, null, null);
    // === Drop ===
    /// <summary>Fail immediately, bypass retry policy.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult Drop(string reason) =>
        new(PickNodeResultType.Drop, null, new Status(StatusCode.Unavailable, reason));
    // === Domain-Specific Failures ===
    /// <summary>No leader available for write operations.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult NoLeader() =>
        Fail(StatusCode.Unavailable, "No leader available for write operations");
    /// <summary>No followers available for read operations.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult NoFollowers() =>
        Fail(StatusCode.Unavailable, "No followers available for read operations");
    /// <summary>No eligible nodes in cluster.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult NoEligibleNodes() =>
        Fail(StatusCode.Unavailable, "No eligible nodes in cluster");
    /// <summary>Cluster is not ready.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult ClusterNotReady() =>
        Fail(StatusCode.Unavailable, "Cluster is not ready");
    // === Generic Failures ===
    /// <summary>Fail with specified status code and message.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult Fail(StatusCode code, string message) =>
        new(PickNodeResultType.Fail, null, new Status(code, message));
    /// <summary>Fail with Unavailable status and specified message.</summary>
    public static PickNodeResult Fail(string message) =>
        Fail(StatusCode.Unavailable, message);
    // === Internal ===
    /// <summary>Convert to gRPC's PickResult.</summary>
    internal PickResult ToPickResult() => _type switch {
        PickNodeResultType.Subchannel => PickResult.ForSubchannel(_subchannel!),
        PickNodeResultType.Defer      => PickResult.ForQueue(),
        PickNodeResultType.Drop       => PickResult.ForDrop(_status!.Value),
        PickNodeResultType.Fail       => PickResult.ForFailure(_status!.Value),
        _                             => PickResult.ForFailure(new Status(StatusCode.Internal, "Invalid pick result"))
    };
    PickNodeResult(PickNodeResultType type, Subchannel? subchannel, Status? status) {
        _type = type;
        _subchannel = subchannel;
        _status = status;
    }
}
````

## File: src/Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing/Picking/RoundRobinStrategy.cs
````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Round-robin across all eligible nodes.
/// No read/write distinction.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Zero-allocation: Uses simple loop with modular indexing.
/// </remarks>
public sealed class RoundRobinStrategy : IClusterNodePickingStrategy {
    /// <summary>Singleton instance.</summary>
    public static RoundRobinStrategy Instance { get; } = new();
    long _index;
    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public PickNodeResult Pick(in PickNodeContext context) {
        var nodes = context.Nodes;
        // Count eligible nodes (single pass)
        var eligibleCount = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (nodes[i].Node.IsEligible)
                eligibleCount++;
        }
        if (eligibleCount == 0)
            return PickNodeResult.NoEligibleNodes();
        // Find the Nth eligible node
        var targetIndex = (int)(Interlocked.Increment(ref _index) % eligibleCount);
        var count = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++) {
            if (nodes[i].Node.IsEligible) {
                if (count == targetIndex)
                    return PickNodeResult.ForNode(nodes[i]);
                count++;
            }
        }
        return PickNodeResult.NoEligibleNodes(); // Shouldn't happen
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Threading.Channels;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Base class for polling-based topology discovery.
/// Subclasses implement <see cref="ReadAsync"/> to fetch current topology.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// This class handles the polling loop. Subclasses only need to implement
/// the single <see cref="ReadAsync"/> method for their specific protocol.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The source is responsible for querying topology from a given endpoint.
/// The <see cref="ClusterResolver"/> manages the "working set" of endpoints
/// (discovered nodes vs seeds fallback). See <c>reference-cluster-resolver-qa.md</c>.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
public abstract class PollingTopologySource : TopologySource {
    readonly TimeSpan _pollingInterval;
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new polling topology source.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pollingInterval">Interval between polls.</param>
    protected PollingTopologySource(TimeSpan pollingInterval) {
        if (pollingInterval <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(pollingInterval), "Must be positive");
        _pollingInterval = pollingInterval;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the current cluster topology.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">Discovery context.</param>
    /// <returns>Current topology snapshot.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Implement this method to perform protocol-specific discovery
    /// (e.g., gossip, DNS-SRV, health endpoints).
    /// </remarks>
    protected abstract ValueTask<ClusterTopology> ReadAsync(TopologyContext context);
    /// <inheritdoc/>
    protected internal sealed override async Task RunAsync(
        ChannelWriter<ClusterTopology> writer,
        TopologyContext context) {
        var ct = context.CancellationToken;
        while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
            try {
                var topology = await ReadAsync(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
                await writer.WriteAsync(topology, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) {
                context.Logger?.LogWarning(ex, "Topology read failed, retrying after interval");
            }
            try {
                await Task.Delay(_pollingInterval, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
                break;
            }
        }
        writer.TryComplete();
    }
}
````

## File: src/Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing/Sources/TopologySource.cs
````csharp
using System.Threading.Channels;
namespace Kurrent.Grpc.LoadBalancing;
/// <summary>
/// Base class for topology discovery sources.
/// Subclasses implement protocol-specific discovery logic.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// The topology source is responsible for:
/// <list type="number">
/// <item>Discovering cluster members via protocol-specific means</item>
/// <item>Mapping protocol state to <see cref="ClusterNode"/></item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The resolver owns the <see cref="ChannelWriter{T}"/> and passes it to
/// <see cref="RunAsync"/>. This decouples the producer from the consumer.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Node selection/picking is handled separately by <see cref="IClusterNodePickingStrategy"/>,
/// not by the topology source. This separation allows the same topology source to be
/// used with different picking strategies.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
public abstract class TopologySource {
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the topology discovery loop, writing updates to the channel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="writer">Channel writer for topology updates.</param>
    /// <param name="context">Discovery context with channel, seeds, cancellation.</param>
    /// <returns>Task that completes when discovery stops.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// This method should run continuously until cancelled, periodically
    /// (or reactively) writing new <see cref="ClusterTopology"/> snapshots.
    /// </remarks>
    protected internal abstract Task RunAsync(
        ChannelWriter<ClusterTopology> writer,
        TopologyContext context);
}
````

````csharp
using DuckDB.NET.Data;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
public static partial class DuckDBConnectionExtensions {
    extension(DuckDBConnection) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a builder for a DuckLake data lakehouse with default settings.
        /// </summary>
        public static DuckDBConnectionBuilder ForDuckLake() =>
            new DuckDBConnectionBuilder().ConfigureDuckLake(new DuckLakeOptions());
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a builder for a DuckLake data lakehouse with the specified metadata path.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="metadataPath">Path to the DuckLake metadata catalog.</param>
        public static DuckDBConnectionBuilder ForDuckLake(string metadataPath) {
            ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(metadataPath);
            return new DuckDBConnectionBuilder().ConfigureDuckLake(new DuckLakeOptions { MetadataPath = metadataPath });
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a builder for a DuckLake data lakehouse with custom configuration.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="configure">Action to configure DuckLake options.</param>
        public static DuckDBConnectionBuilder ForDuckLake(Action<DuckLakeOptionsBuilder> configure) {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
            var optionsBuilder = new DuckLakeOptionsBuilder();
            configure(optionsBuilder);
            var options = optionsBuilder.Build();
            return new DuckDBConnectionBuilder().ConfigureDuckLake(options);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using DuckDB.NET.Data;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Configures DuckLake options on a DuckDB connection using set_option calls.
/// </summary>
public sealed class DuckLakeConfigurator {
    readonly DuckDBConnection _connection;
    readonly string           _catalogName;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new DuckLake configurator.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connection">The DuckDB connection.</param>
    /// <param name="catalogName">The DuckLake catalog name (used in CALL statements).</param>
    public DuckLakeConfigurator(DuckDBConnection connection, string catalogName) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(connection);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(catalogName);
        _connection  = connection;
        _catalogName = catalogName;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies all configuration options from the given DuckLake options.
    /// </summary>
    public void Apply(DuckLakeOptions options) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        ApplyRetryOptions(options.Retry);
        ApplyGlobalSettings(options.GlobalSettings);
        foreach (var (schema, settings) in options.SchemaSettings)
            ApplySchemaSettings(schema, settings);
        foreach (var (table, settings) in options.TableSettings) {
            var (schema, tableName) = ParseTableName(table);
            ApplyTableSettings(schema, tableName, settings);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies all configuration options asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ApplyAsync(DuckLakeOptions options, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        await ApplyRetryOptionsAsync(options.Retry, ct);
        await ApplyGlobalSettingsAsync(options.GlobalSettings, ct);
        foreach (var (schema, settings) in options.SchemaSettings)
            await ApplySchemaSettingsAsync(schema, settings, ct);
        foreach (var (table, settings) in options.TableSettings) {
            var (schema, tableName) = ParseTableName(table);
            await ApplyTableSettingsAsync(schema, tableName, settings, ct);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies retry options using SET statements.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyRetryOptions(DuckLakeRetryOptions options) {
        foreach (var (key, value) in options.ToDictionary())
            ExecuteSet(key, value);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies retry options asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ApplyRetryOptionsAsync(DuckLakeRetryOptions options, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        foreach (var (key, value) in options.ToDictionary())
            await ExecuteSetAsync(key, value, ct);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies global scoped settings (includes parquet, file, data, and maintenance options).
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyGlobalSettings(DuckLakeScopedSettings settings) {
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            ExecuteSetOption(key, value);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies global scoped settings asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ApplyGlobalSettingsAsync(DuckLakeScopedSettings settings, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            await ExecuteSetOptionAsync(key, value, ct);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies schema-level settings.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplySchemaSettings(string schema, DuckLakeScopedSettings settings) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            ExecuteSetOption(schema, key, value);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies schema-level settings asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ApplySchemaSettingsAsync(string schema, DuckLakeScopedSettings settings, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            await ExecuteSetOptionAsync(schema, key, value, ct);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies table-level settings.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyTableSettings(string schema, string table, DuckLakeScopedSettings settings) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(table);
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            ExecuteSetOption(schema, table, key, value);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies table-level settings asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ApplyTableSettingsAsync(string schema, string table, DuckLakeScopedSettings settings, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(table);
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.ToDictionary())
            await ExecuteSetOptionAsync(schema, table, key, value, ct);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at global scope.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetOption(string option, string value) => ExecuteSetOption(option, value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at schema scope.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetOption(string schema, string option, string value) => ExecuteSetOption(schema, option, value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at table scope.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetOption(string schema, string table, string option, string value) => ExecuteSetOption(schema, table, option, value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at global scope asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public Task SetOptionAsync(string option, string value, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        ExecuteSetOptionAsync(option, value, ct);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at schema scope asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public Task SetOptionAsync(string schema, string option, string value, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        ExecuteSetOptionAsync(schema, option, value, ct);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a single option at table scope asynchronously.
    /// </summary>
    public Task SetOptionAsync(string schema, string table, string option, string value, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        ExecuteSetOptionAsync(schema, table, option, value, ct);
    // SET variable = value (for extension-level settings like ducklake_max_retry_count)
    void ExecuteSet(string variable, string value) {
        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"SET {variable} = {FormatValue(value)}";
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }
    async Task ExecuteSetAsync(string variable, string value, CancellationToken ct) {
        await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"SET {variable} = {FormatValue(value)}";
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }
    // CALL catalog.set_option('option', 'value') - global scope
    void ExecuteSetOption(string option, string value) {
        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }
    async Task ExecuteSetOptionAsync(string option, string value, CancellationToken ct) {
        await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }
    // CALL catalog.set_option('schema', 'option', 'value') - schema scope
    void ExecuteSetOption(string schema, string option, string value) {
        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(schema)}, {Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }
    async Task ExecuteSetOptionAsync(string schema, string option, string value, CancellationToken ct) {
        await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(schema)}, {Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }
    // CALL catalog.set_option('schema', 'table', 'option', 'value') - table scope
    void ExecuteSetOption(string schema, string table, string option, string value) {
        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(schema)}, {Literal(table)}, {Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }
    async Task ExecuteSetOptionAsync(string schema, string table, string option, string value, CancellationToken ct) {
        await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = $"CALL {Quote(_catalogName)}.set_option({Literal(schema)}, {Literal(table)}, {Literal(option)}, {Literal(value)})";
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct);
    }
    static string Quote(string identifier) => $"\"{identifier.Replace("\"", "\"\"")}\"";
    static string Literal(string value) => $"'{value.Replace("'", "''")}'";
    static string FormatValue(string value) {
        // Numbers don't need quotes
        if (double.TryParse(value, out _))
            return value;
        // Booleans
        if (value.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            value.Equals("false", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return value.ToLowerInvariant();
        return Literal(value);
    }
    static (string Schema, string Table) ParseTableName(string fullyQualifiedName) {
        var dotIndex = fullyQualifiedName.IndexOf('.');
        if (dotIndex < 0)
            return ("main", fullyQualifiedName);
        return (fullyQualifiedName[..dotIndex], fullyQualifiedName[(dotIndex + 1)..]);
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Specifies the catalog database type for DuckLake metadata storage.

public enum DuckLakeCatalogType {
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    DuckDB,
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    SQLite,
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    Postgres,

    MySQL

/// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// No compression.
    /// </summary>
    Uncompressed,
    /// <summary>
    /// Snappy compression (default, fast).
    /// </summary>
    Snappy,
    /// <summary>
    /// Gzip compression.
    /// </summary>
    Gzip,
    /// <summary>
    /// Zstandard compression (good balance of speed and ratio).

    Zstd,
    /// <summary>

    Brotli,
    /// <summary>
    /// LZ4 compression.
    /// </summary>
    Lz4,
    /// <summary>

    Lz4Raw
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Configuration options for DuckLake data lakehouse connections.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default DuckLake options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the path to the metadata catalog (file path or connection string).
    /// </summary>
    public string MetadataPath { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the catalog database type.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeCatalogType CatalogType { get; init; } = DuckLakeCatalogType.DuckDB;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets metadata-related options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeMetadataOptions Metadata { get; init; } = DuckLakeMetadataOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets data storage options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeDataOptions Data { get; init; } = DuckLakeDataOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to create the DuckLake if it does not exist. Default: true.
    /// </summary>
    public bool CreateIfNotExists { get; init; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to auto-migrate schema if required. Default: true.
    /// </summary>
    public bool MigrateIfRequired { get; init; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether the connection is read-only. Default: false.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ReadOnly { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets transaction retry options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeRetryOptions Retry { get; init; } = DuckLakeRetryOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the global settings applied to all tables.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettings GlobalSettings { get; init; } = DuckLakeScopedSettings.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets schema-specific settings. Key is the schema name.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings> SchemaSettings { get; init; } =
        new Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets table-specific settings. Key is the fully qualified table name (schema.table).
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings> TableSettings { get; init; } =
        new Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts all options to a dictionary of key-value settings.
    /// Includes metadata, data, behavior, retry, and maintenance options.
    /// </summary>
    public Dictionary<string, string> ToDictionary() {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        // Metadata options
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Metadata.Catalog))
            dict["metadata_catalog"] = Metadata.Catalog;
        if (Metadata.Schema != "main")
            dict["metadata_schema"] = Metadata.Schema;
        // Data options
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Data.Path))
            dict["data_path"] = Data.Path;
        if (!Data.OverridePath)
            dict["override_data_path"] = "false";
        if (Data.Encrypted)
            dict["encrypted"] = "true";
        if (Data.InliningRowLimit > 0)
            dict["data_inlining_row_limit"] = Data.InliningRowLimit.ToString();
        // Behavior options
        if (!CreateIfNotExists)
            dict["create_if_not_exists"] = "false";
        if (!MigrateIfRequired)
            dict["migrate_if_required"] = "false";
        if (ReadOnly)
            dict["read_only"] = "true";
        // Retry options
        if (Retry.MaxRetryCount != 10)
            dict["ducklake_max_retry_count"] = Retry.MaxRetryCount.ToString();
        if (Retry.RetryWaitMs != 100)
            dict["ducklake_retry_wait_ms"] = Retry.RetryWaitMs.ToString();
        if (Math.Abs(Retry.RetryBackoff - 1.5) > 0.001)
            dict["ducklake_retry_backoff"] = Retry.RetryBackoff.ToString("F2");
        // Global settings (includes parquet, file, maintenance options)
        foreach (var (key, value) in GlobalSettings.ToDictionary())
            dict[key] = value;
        return dict;
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Metadata configuration options for DuckLake.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeMetadataOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default metadata options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeMetadataOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the attached catalog database name. Default: auto-generated from DuckLake name.
    /// </summary>
    public string Catalog { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the schema for DuckLake tables. Default: "main".
    /// </summary>
    public string Schema { get; init; } = "main";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets additional parameters for the catalog server connection.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Parameters { get; init; } = new Dictionary<string, string>();
}
/// <summary>
/// Data storage options for DuckLake.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeDataOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default data options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeDataOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the path where data files (Parquet) are stored.
    /// Can be local path, s3://, az://, gs://, or r2://.
    /// </summary>
    public string Path { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to override the stored data path for this connection. Default: true.
    /// </summary>
    public bool OverridePath { get; init; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether data files should be encrypted. Default: false.
    /// </summary>
    public bool Encrypted { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the maximum rows to inline during insert operations. Default: 0 (disabled).
    /// </summary>
    public int InliningRowLimit { get; init; }
}
/// <summary>
/// Scoped settings for DuckLake that can be applied at global, schema, or table level.
/// More specific scopes override less specific ones.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeScopedSettings {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default scoped settings.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeScopedSettings Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets Parquet file configuration options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeParquetOptions Parquet { get; init; } = DuckLakeParquetOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets file output configuration options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeFileOptions File { get; init; } = DuckLakeFileOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the path where data files (Parquet) are stored for this scope.
    /// Can be local path, s3://, az://, gs://, or r2://. Empty means inherit from parent scope.
    /// </summary>
    public string DataPath { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the maximum rows to inline during insert operations. Zero means inherit from parent scope.
    /// </summary>
    public int DataInliningRowLimit { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to require explicit commit messages. Default: false.
    /// </summary>
    public bool RequireCommitMessage { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the minimum deletion fraction (0-1) that triggers file rewrite. Default: 0.95.
    /// </summary>
    public double RewriteDeleteThreshold { get; init; } = 0.95;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the age threshold for file removal during vacuum operations.
    /// Empty means not set. Example values: "7 days", "1 hour".
    /// </summary>
    public string DeleteOlderThan { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the age threshold for snapshot expiration.
    /// Empty means not set. Example values: "7 days", "1 hour".
    /// </summary>
    public string ExpireOlderThan { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the pre-defined schema name for compaction operations. Empty means not set.
    /// </summary>
    public string CompactionSchema { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the pre-defined table name for compaction operations. Empty means not set.
    /// </summary>
    public string CompactionTable { get; init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets additional settings as key-value pairs for options not exposed as typed properties.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Settings { get; init; } = new Dictionary<string, string>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts the settings to a dictionary for DuckLake configuration.
    /// </summary>
    public Dictionary<string, string> ToDictionary() {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        // Data options
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataPath))
            dict["data_path"] = DataPath;
        if (DataInliningRowLimit > 0)
            dict["data_inlining_row_limit"] = DataInliningRowLimit.ToString();
        // Parquet options
        if (Parquet.Compression != ParquetCompression.Snappy)
            dict["parquet_compression"] = Parquet.Compression.ToString().ToLowerInvariant();
        if (Parquet.CompressionLevel != 3)
            dict["parquet_compression_level"] = Parquet.CompressionLevel.ToString();
        if (Parquet.Version != 1)
            dict["parquet_version"] = Parquet.Version.ToString();
        if (Parquet.RowGroupSize != 122880)
            dict["parquet_row_group_size"] = Parquet.RowGroupSize.ToString();
        if (Parquet.RowGroupSizeBytes > 0)
            dict["parquet_row_group_size_bytes"] = Parquet.RowGroupSizeBytes.ToString();
        // File options
        if (File.TargetSize != "512MB")
            dict["target_file_size"] = File.TargetSize;
        if (!File.HivePattern)
            dict["hive_file_pattern"] = "false";
        if (File.Encrypted)
            dict["encrypted"] = "true";
        if (File.PerThreadOutput)
            dict["per_thread_output"] = "true";
        // Behavior options
        if (RequireCommitMessage)
            dict["require_commit_message"] = "true";
        if (Math.Abs(RewriteDeleteThreshold - 0.95) > 0.001)
            dict["rewrite_delete_threshold"] = RewriteDeleteThreshold.ToString("F2");
        // Maintenance options
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DeleteOlderThan))
            dict["delete_older_than"] = DeleteOlderThan;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ExpireOlderThan))
            dict["expire_older_than"] = ExpireOlderThan;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CompactionSchema))
            dict["compaction_schema"] = CompactionSchema;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CompactionTable))
            dict["compaction_table"] = CompactionTable;
        // Custom settings
        foreach (var (key, value) in Settings)
            dict[key] = value;
        return dict;
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Parquet file configuration options for DuckLake.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeParquetOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default Parquet options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeParquetOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the compression algorithm. Default: Snappy.
    /// </summary>
    public ParquetCompression Compression { get; init; } = ParquetCompression.Snappy;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the compression level. Default: 3.
    /// </summary>
    public int CompressionLevel { get; init; } = 3;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the Parquet format version. Default: 1.
    /// </summary>
    public int Version { get; init; } = 1;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the number of rows per row group. Default: 122880.
    /// </summary>
    public int RowGroupSize { get; init; } = 122880;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the byte-based row group size limit. Zero means not set.
    /// </summary>
    public long RowGroupSizeBytes { get; init; }
}
/// <summary>
/// File output configuration options for DuckLake.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeFileOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default file options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeFileOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the target size for data files. Default: "512MB".
    /// </summary>
    public string TargetSize { get; init; } = "512MB";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to use Hive-style partitioning folder structure. Default: true.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HivePattern { get; init; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether data files should be encrypted. Default: false.
    /// </summary>
    public bool Encrypted { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether to create separate output files per thread. Default: false.
    /// </summary>
    public bool PerThreadOutput { get; init; }
}
/// <summary>
/// Transaction retry configuration options for DuckLake.
/// These are applied via SET commands, not ATTACH parameters.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckLakeRetryOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default retry options.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckLakeRetryOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the maximum number of retry attempts for failed transactions. Default: 10.
    /// </summary>
    public int MaxRetryCount { get; init; } = 10;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the initial wait time in milliseconds between retries. Default: 100.
    /// </summary>
    public int RetryWaitMs { get; init; } = 100;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the backoff multiplier for exponential retry delays. Default: 1.5.
    /// </summary>
    public double RetryBackoff { get; init; } = 1.5;
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts to a dictionary of SET configuration options.
    /// Only includes non-default values.
    /// </summary>
    public Dictionary<string, string> ToDictionary() {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (MaxRetryCount != 10)
            dict["ducklake_max_retry_count"] = MaxRetryCount.ToString();
        if (RetryWaitMs != 100)
            dict["ducklake_retry_wait_ms"] = RetryWaitMs.ToString();
        if (Math.Abs(RetryBackoff - 1.5) > 0.001)
            dict["ducklake_retry_backoff"] = RetryBackoff.ToString("F2");
        return dict;
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Builds <see cref="DuckLakeOptions"/> instances using a fluent API.
/// </summary>
public sealed class DuckLakeOptionsBuilder {
    DuckLakeOptions _options = new();
    readonly Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings> _schemaSettings = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    readonly Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings> _tableSettings  = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the metadata catalog path (DuckDB file by default).
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder WithCatalog(string path) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path);
        _options = _options with { MetadataPath = path, CatalogType = DuckLakeCatalogType.DuckDB };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a SQLite catalog for metadata storage.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder WithSQLiteCatalog(string path) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path);
        _options = _options with { MetadataPath = path, CatalogType = DuckLakeCatalogType.SQLite };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a PostgreSQL catalog for metadata storage.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder WithPostgresCatalog(string connectionString) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString);
        _options = _options with { MetadataPath = connectionString, CatalogType = DuckLakeCatalogType.Postgres };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a MySQL catalog for metadata storage.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder WithMySqlCatalog(string connectionString) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString);
        _options = _options with { MetadataPath = connectionString, CatalogType = DuckLakeCatalogType.MySQL };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures metadata options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureMetadata(Action<DuckLakeMetadataOptionsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeMetadataOptionsBuilder(_options.Metadata);
        configure(builder);
        _options = _options with { Metadata = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures data storage options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureData(Action<DuckLakeDataOptionsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeDataOptionsBuilder(_options.Data);
        configure(builder);
        _options = _options with { Data = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the data path for Parquet files.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder WithDataPath(string path) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path);
        _options = _options with { Data = _options.Data with { Path = path } };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets whether to create the DuckLake if it does not exist.

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

        _options = _options with { MigrateIfRequired = enabled };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection as read-only.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder AsReadOnly() {
        _options = _options with { ReadOnly = true };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures retry options for transaction conflicts.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureRetry(Action<DuckLakeRetryOptionsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeRetryOptionsBuilder(_options.Retry);
        configure(builder);
        _options = _options with { Retry = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures global settings that apply to all tables.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureGlobal(Action<DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder(_options.GlobalSettings);
        configure(builder);
        _options = _options with { GlobalSettings = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures settings for a specific schema. Overrides global settings.
    /// Multiple calls for the same schema will build on existing settings.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureSchema(string schema, Action<DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var existing = _schemaSettings.GetValueOrDefault(schema, DuckLakeScopedSettings.Default);
        var builder  = new DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder(existing);
        configure(builder);
        _schemaSettings[schema] = builder.Build();
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures settings for a specific table. Overrides schema and global settings.
    /// Multiple calls for the same table will build on existing settings.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema name.</param>
    /// <param name="table">The table name.</param>
    /// <param name="configure">Action to configure table settings.</param>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureTable(string schema, string table, Action<DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(table);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var key      = $"{schema}.{table}";
        var existing = _tableSettings.GetValueOrDefault(key, DuckLakeScopedSettings.Default);
        var builder  = new DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder(existing);
        configure(builder);
        _tableSettings[key] = builder.Build();
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures settings for a specific table in the "main" schema.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="table">The table name.</param>
    /// <param name="configure">Action to configure table settings.</param>
    public DuckLakeOptionsBuilder ConfigureTable(string table, Action<DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder> configure) =>
        ConfigureTable("main", table, configure);
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds the DuckLake options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptions Build() =>
        _options with {
            SchemaSettings = _schemaSettings.Count > 0
                ? new Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings>(_schemaSettings, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                : _options.SchemaSettings,
            TableSettings = _tableSettings.Count > 0
                ? new Dictionary<string, DuckLakeScopedSettings>(_tableSettings, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                : _options.TableSettings
        };
}

/// <summary>
/// Builds <see cref="DuckLakeScopedSettings"/> for a specific scope (global, schema, or table).
/// </summary>
public sealed class DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder {
    DuckLakeScopedSettings _settings;
    readonly Dictionary<string, string> _customSettings = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new builder with default settings.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder() : this(DuckLakeScopedSettings.Default) { }
    internal DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder(DuckLakeScopedSettings settings) {
        _settings = settings;
        foreach (var (key, value) in settings.Settings)
            _customSettings[key] = value;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures Parquet file options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder ConfigureParquet(Action<DuckLakeParquetOptionsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeParquetOptionsBuilder(_settings.Parquet);
        configure(builder);
        _settings = _settings with { Parquet = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures file output options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder ConfigureFile(Action<DuckLakeFileOptionsBuilder> configure) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(configure);
        var builder = new DuckLakeFileOptionsBuilder(_settings.File);
        configure(builder);
        _settings = _settings with { File = builder.Build() };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets whether to require explicit commit messages.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder RequireCommitMessage(bool enabled = true) {
        _settings = _settings with { RequireCommitMessage = enabled };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the minimum deletion fraction (0-1) that triggers file rewrite.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithRewriteDeleteThreshold(double threshold) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(threshold, 0);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(threshold, 1);
        _settings = _settings with { RewriteDeleteThreshold = threshold };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the data path for Parquet files in this scope.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithDataPath(string path) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path);
        _settings = _settings with { DataPath = path };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the maximum rows to inline during insert operations.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithDataInliningRowLimit(int limit) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(limit);
        _settings = _settings with { DataInliningRowLimit = limit };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the age threshold for file removal during vacuum.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="interval">Interval string, e.g., "7 days", "1 hour", "30 minutes".</param>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithDeleteOlderThan(string interval) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(interval);
        _settings = _settings with { DeleteOlderThan = interval };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the age threshold for file removal during vacuum.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithDeleteOlderThan(TimeSpan interval) {
        _settings = _settings with { DeleteOlderThan = FormatInterval(interval) };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the age threshold for snapshot expiration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="interval">Interval string, e.g., "7 days", "1 hour", "30 minutes".</param>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithExpireOlderThan(string interval) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(interval);
        _settings = _settings with { ExpireOlderThan = interval };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the age threshold for snapshot expiration.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithExpireOlderThan(TimeSpan interval) {
        _settings = _settings with { ExpireOlderThan = FormatInterval(interval) };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the pre-defined schema for compaction operations.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithCompactionSchema(string schema) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        _settings = _settings with { CompactionSchema = schema };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the pre-defined table for compaction operations.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithCompactionTable(string table) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(table);
        _settings = _settings with { CompactionTable = table };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets both schema and table for compaction operations.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithCompactionTarget(string schema, string table) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(schema);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(table);
        _settings = _settings with { CompactionSchema = schema, CompactionTable = table };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a custom setting not exposed as a typed property.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeScopedSettingsBuilder WithSetting(string key, string value) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(key);
        _customSettings[key] = value;
        return this;
    }
    internal DuckLakeScopedSettings Build() =>
        _settings with {
            Settings = _customSettings.Count > 0
                ? new Dictionary<string, string>(_customSettings, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                : _settings.Settings
        };
    static string FormatInterval(TimeSpan interval) {
        if (interval.TotalDays >= 1 && Math.Abs(interval.TotalDays - Math.Floor(interval.TotalDays)) < 0.001)
            return $"{(int)interval.TotalDays} days";
        if (interval.TotalHours >= 1 && Math.Abs(interval.TotalHours - Math.Floor(interval.TotalHours)) < 0.001)
            return $"{(int)interval.TotalHours} hours";
        if (interval.TotalMinutes >= 1 && Math.Abs(interval.TotalMinutes - Math.Floor(interval.TotalMinutes)) < 0.001)
            return $"{(int)interval.TotalMinutes} minutes";
        return $"{(int)interval.TotalSeconds} seconds";
    }
}
````

````csharp
using DuckDB.NET.Data;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Entry point for creating DuckDB connections.
/// Use the static factory methods to create connection builders.
/// </summary>
public static partial class DuckDBConnectionExtensions {
    extension(DuckDBConnection) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets an in-memory connection options instance.
        /// </summary>
        public static DuckDBConnectionOptions Default => DuckDBConnectionOptions.Default;
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a builder for an in-memory database.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="shared">If true, creates a shared in-memory database accessible across connections.</param>
        public static DuckDBConnectionBuilder ForInMemory(bool shared = false) =>
            new DuckDBConnectionBuilder().ConfigureInMemory(shared);
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a builder for a file-based database.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="path">Path to the database file. Must have extension: .ddb, .db, .quack, or .duckdb</param>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when the path has an invalid extension.</exception>
        public static DuckDBConnectionBuilder ForDatabase(string path) =>
            new DuckDBConnectionBuilder().ConfigureFile(path);
        /// <summary>
        /// Parses a connection string into connection options.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="connectionString">The connection string to parse.</param>
        /// <param name="strict">If true, validates configuration keys against DuckDB's native configuration.</param>
        /// <exception cref="InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException">Thrown when the connection string is invalid.</exception>
        public static DuckDBConnectionOptions Parse(string connectionString, bool strict = false) =>
            DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.Parse(connectionString, strict);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Builds <see cref="DuckDBConnectionOptions"/> instances using a fluent API.
/// Use <see cref="DuckDBConnection"/> factory methods to create builders.
/// </summary>
public sealed class DuckDBConnectionBuilder {
    static readonly string[] AllowedFileExtensions = [".ddb", ".db", ".quack", ".duckdb"];
    DuckDBConnectionOptions _options = new();
    readonly Dictionary<string, string> _configuration = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    internal DuckDBConnectionBuilder ConfigureInMemory(bool shared) {
        _options = _options with {
            Type = DataSourceType.InMemory,
            DataSource = shared
                ? DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.InMemorySharedDataSource
                : DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.InMemoryDataSource
        };
        return this;
    }
    internal DuckDBConnectionBuilder ConfigureFile(string path) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path);
        ValidateDatabasePath(path);
        _options = _options with {
            Type = DataSourceType.File,
            DataSource = path
        };
        return this;
    }
    static void ValidateDatabasePath(string path) {
        var extension = Path.GetExtension(path);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(extension))
            throw new ArgumentException(
                $"Database path must have a file extension. Allowed: {string.Join(", ", AllowedFileExtensions)}",
                nameof(path)
            );
        if (!AllowedFileExtensions.Contains(extension, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new ArgumentException(
                $"Invalid database file extension '{extension}'. Allowed: {string.Join(", ", AllowedFileExtensions)}",
                nameof(path)
            );
    }
    internal DuckDBConnectionBuilder ConfigureMotherDuck(string database, string? token) {
        _options = _options with {
            Type = DataSourceType.MotherDuck,
            DataSource = string.IsNullOrEmpty(token)
                ? $"{DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.MotherDuckPrefix}{database}"
                : $"{DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.MotherDuckPrefix}{database}?motherduck_token={token}",
            MotherDuck = new MotherDuckOptions { Database = database, Token = token ?? "" }
        };
        return this;
    }
    internal DuckDBConnectionBuilder ConfigureDuckLake(DuckLakeOptions options) {
        _options = _options with {
            Type = DataSourceType.DuckLake,
            DataSource = $"{DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.DuckLakePrefix}{options.MetadataPath}",
            DuckLake = options
        };
        return this;
    }
    internal DuckDBConnectionBuilder ConfigureFrom(DuckDBConnectionOptions options) {
        _options = options;
        foreach (var (key, value) in options.Configuration)
            _configuration[key] = value;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets read-only access mode.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder AsReadOnly() {
        _options = _options with { IsReadOnly = true };
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyAccessMode] = "READ_ONLY";
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the number of threads.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithThreads(int threads) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(threads);
        _options = _options with { Threads = threads };
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyThreads] = threads.ToString();
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the max memory in megabytes.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithMaxMemory(long megabytes) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(megabytes);
        _options = _options with { MaxMemoryMB = megabytes };
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyMaxMemory] = DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.FormatMaxMemory(megabytes);
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the max memory using a size string (e.g., "8GB", "512MB", "1TB").
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithMaxMemory(string size) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(size);
        var megabytes = DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.ParseMaxMemory(size)
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid memory size format: '{size}'. Expected format: number followed by unit (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).", nameof(size));
        _options = _options with { MaxMemoryMB = megabytes };
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyMaxMemory] = size;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures logging.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="enabled">Whether logging is enabled.</param>
    /// <param name="level">The logging level.</param>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithLogging(bool enabled, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Warning) {
        _options = _options with { Logging = new DuckDBLoggingOptions { Enabled = enabled, Level = level } };
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyEnableLogging] = enabled ? "true" : "false";
        if (enabled) {
            var levelValue = level switch {
                LogLevel.Critical    => "CRITICAL",
                LogLevel.Error       => "ERROR",
                LogLevel.Warning     => "WARN",
                LogLevel.Information => "INFO",
                LogLevel.Debug       => "DEBUG",
                LogLevel.Trace       => "TRACE",
                _                    => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(level))
            };
            _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.KeyLoggingLevel] = levelValue;
        }
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a configuration option.
    /// Use this for any DuckDB configuration option not exposed as a typed method.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithConfiguration(string key, string value) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(key);
        _configuration[DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.NormalizeKey(key)] = value;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes a configuration option.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder WithoutConfiguration(string key) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(key);
        _configuration.Remove(DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.NormalizeKey(key));
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Clears all configuration options (keeps data source).
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionBuilder ClearConfiguration() {
        _configuration.Clear();
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds the connection options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="strict">If true, validates configuration keys against DuckDB's native configuration.</param>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException">Thrown when strict is true and configuration contains unknown keys.</exception>
    public DuckDBConnectionOptions Build(bool strict = false) {
        if (strict)
            ValidateKeys(_configuration.Keys);
        return _options with {
            Configuration = new Dictionary<string, string>(_configuration, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        };
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts to <see cref="DuckDBConnectionOptions"/>.
    /// Uses non-strict mode.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator DuckDBConnectionOptions(DuckDBConnectionBuilder builder) => builder.Build();
    static void ValidateKeys(IEnumerable<string> keys) {
        var invalidKeys = DuckDBNativeConfiguration.GetInvalidKeys(keys);
        if (invalidKeys.Count == 0)
            return;
        var invalidKey = invalidKeys[0];
        var suggestion = DuckDBNativeConfiguration.SuggestSimilar(invalidKey);
        throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException(
            suggestion is not null
                ? $"Unknown configuration key: '{invalidKey}'. Did you mean '{suggestion}'?"
                : $"Unknown configuration key: '{invalidKey}'."
        );
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Represents DuckDB connection configuration options.
/// Use <see cref="DuckDBConnection"/> factory methods to create instances.
/// </summary>
public readonly record struct DuckDBConnectionOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets an in-memory connection options instance.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckDBConnectionOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new in-memory DuckDB connection options instance.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBConnectionOptions() { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the data source type.
    /// </summary>
    public DataSourceType Type { get; init; } = DataSourceType.InMemory;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the data source path or identifier.
    /// </summary>
    public string DataSource { get; init; } = DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.InMemoryDataSource;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether the connection is read-only.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsReadOnly { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the number of threads. Zero means use DuckDB default.
    /// </summary>
    public int Threads { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the max memory in megabytes. Zero means use DuckDB default.
    /// </summary>
    public long MaxMemoryMB { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the logging configuration.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDBLoggingOptions Logging { get; init; } = DuckDBLoggingOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets MotherDuck-specific options.
    /// </summary>
    public MotherDuckOptions MotherDuck { get; init; } = MotherDuckOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets DuckLake-specific options.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckLakeOptions DuckLake { get; init; } = DuckLakeOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all configuration options as key-value pairs.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Configuration { get; init; } = new Dictionary<string, string>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether this is an in-memory database connection.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsInMemory => Type == DataSourceType.InMemory;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether this is a file-based database connection.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsFile => Type == DataSourceType.File;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether this is a MotherDuck cloud connection.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsMotherDuck => Type == DataSourceType.MotherDuck;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether this is a DuckLake connection.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsDuckLake => Type == DataSourceType.DuckLake;
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts the options to an ADO.NET-compatible connection string.
    /// </summary>
    public string ToConnectionString() => DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser.ToConnectionString(this);
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public override string ToString() => ToConnectionString();
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicit conversion to connection string.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator string(DuckDBConnectionOptions options) => options.ToConnectionString();
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicit conversion from builder.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator DuckDBConnectionOptions(DuckDBConnectionBuilder builder) => builder.Build();
}
````

````csharp
using System.Text;
using System.Web;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using static System.StringComparison;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Thrown when a DuckDB connection string is invalid.
/// </summary>
public sealed class InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException(string message) : Exception(message);
/// <summary>
/// Parses and serializes DuckDB connection options to/from connection strings.
/// </summary>
static class DuckDBConnectionOptionsParser {
    const char   Separator     = ';';
    const char   KeyValueSep   = '=';
    const string DataSourceKey = "DataSource";
    internal const string InMemoryDataSource       = ":memory:";
    internal const string InMemorySharedDataSource = ":memory:?cache=shared";
    internal const string MotherDuckPrefix         = "md:";
    internal const string DuckLakePrefix           = "ducklake:";
    internal const string KeyAccessMode    = "access_mode";
    internal const string KeyThreads       = "threads";
    internal const string KeyMaxMemory     = "max_memory";
    internal const string KeyEnableLogging = "enable_logging";
    internal const string KeyLoggingLevel  = "logging_level";
    static readonly Dictionary<string, string> KeyAliases = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) {
        ["worker_threads"] = KeyThreads,
        ["memory_limit"] = KeyMaxMemory,
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Parses a connection string into connection options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException">Thrown when the connection string is invalid.</exception>
    public static DuckDBConnectionOptions Parse(string connectionString, bool strict = false) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
            throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException("Connection string cannot be null or empty.");
        string? dataSource = null;
        var config = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var segment in connectionString.Split(Separator, StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) {
            var eqIndex = segment.IndexOf(KeyValueSep);
            if (eqIndex <= 0)
                throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException($"Invalid key-value pair: '{segment}'. Expected format: key=value");
            var key   = segment[..eqIndex].Trim();
            var value = segment[(eqIndex + 1)..].Trim();
            if (IsDataSourceKey(key)) {
                if (dataSource is not null)
                    throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException("Connection string contains multiple DataSource entries.");
                dataSource = value;
            }
            else {
                config[NormalizeKey(key)] = value;
            }
        }
        if (dataSource is null)
            throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException("Connection string must contain a DataSource entry.");
        if (strict)
            ValidateKeys(config.Keys);
        return Build(dataSource, config);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts connection options to a connection string.
    /// </summary>
    public static string ToConnectionString(DuckDBConnectionOptions options) {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.Append(DataSourceKey).Append(KeyValueSep).Append(options.DataSource);
        foreach (var (key, value) in options.Configuration)
            sb.Append(Separator).Append(key).Append(KeyValueSep).Append(value);
        return sb.ToString();
    }
    internal static string NormalizeKey(string key) =>
        KeyAliases.GetValueOrDefault(key, key);
    internal static string FormatMaxMemory(long megabytes) {
        return megabytes switch {
            >= 1024 * 1024 when megabytes % (1024 * 1024) == 0 => $"{megabytes / (1024 * 1024)}TB",
            >= 1024 when megabytes % 1024 == 0                 => $"{megabytes / 1024}GB",
            _                                                  => $"{megabytes}MB"
        };
    }
    static DataSourceType DetectType(string dataSource) {
        if (IsMotherDuck(dataSource)) return DataSourceType.MotherDuck;
        if (IsDuckLake(dataSource))   return DataSourceType.DuckLake;
        if (IsInMemory(dataSource))   return DataSourceType.InMemory;
        return DataSourceType.File;
    }
    static bool IsInMemory(string dataSource) =>
        dataSource.StartsWith(InMemoryDataSource, OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    static bool IsMotherDuck(string dataSource) =>
        dataSource.StartsWith(MotherDuckPrefix, OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    static bool IsDuckLake(string dataSource) =>
        dataSource.StartsWith(DuckLakePrefix, OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    static MotherDuckOptions ParseMotherDuckOptions(string dataSource) {
        if (!IsMotherDuck(dataSource))
            return MotherDuckOptions.Default;
        var database = ParseMotherDuckDatabase(dataSource);
        var token    = ParseMotherDuckToken(dataSource);
        return new MotherDuckOptions { Database = database, Token = token };
    }
    static string ParseMotherDuckDatabase(string dataSource) {
        var withoutPrefix = dataSource.AsSpan()[MotherDuckPrefix.Length..];
        var queryIndex    = withoutPrefix.IndexOf('?');
        return queryIndex >= 0
            ? withoutPrefix[..queryIndex].ToString()
            : withoutPrefix.ToString();
    }
    static string ParseMotherDuckToken(string dataSource) {
        var queryIndex = dataSource.IndexOf('?');
        if (queryIndex < 0)
            return "";
        var query  = dataSource[(queryIndex + 1)..];
        var parsed = HttpUtility.ParseQueryString(query);
        return parsed["motherduck_token"] ?? "";
    }
    static DuckLakeOptions ParseDuckLakeOptions(string dataSource) {
        if (!IsDuckLake(dataSource))
            return DuckLakeOptions.Default;
        var metadataPath = dataSource[DuckLakePrefix.Length..];
        return new DuckLakeOptions { MetadataPath = metadataPath };
    }
    static bool IsDataSourceKey(string key) =>
        key.Equals(DataSourceKey, OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        key.Equals("Data Source", OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    static void ValidateKeys(IEnumerable<string> keys) {
        var invalidKeys = DuckDBNativeConfiguration.GetInvalidKeys(keys);
        if (invalidKeys.Count == 0)
            return;
        var invalidKey = invalidKeys[0];
        var suggestion = DuckDBNativeConfiguration.SuggestSimilar(invalidKey);
        throw new InvalidDuckDbConnectionStringException(
            suggestion is not null
                ? $"Unknown configuration key: '{invalidKey}'. Did you mean '{suggestion}'?"
                : $"Unknown configuration key: '{invalidKey}'."
        );
    }
    static DuckDBConnectionOptions Build(string dataSource, Dictionary<string, string> config) {
        var type           = DetectType(dataSource);
        var loggingEnabled = ParseEnableLogging(config.GetValueOrDefault(KeyEnableLogging));
        var loggingLevel   = ParseLoggingLevel(config.GetValueOrDefault(KeyLoggingLevel));
        return new DuckDBConnectionOptions {
            Type          = type,
            DataSource    = dataSource,
            Configuration = config,
            IsReadOnly    = ParseIsReadOnly(config.GetValueOrDefault(KeyAccessMode)),
            Threads       = ParseThreads(config.GetValueOrDefault(KeyThreads)),
            MaxMemoryMB   = ParseMaxMemory(config.GetValueOrDefault(KeyMaxMemory)) ?? 0,
            Logging       = loggingEnabled ? new DuckDBLoggingOptions { Enabled = true, Level = loggingLevel } : DuckDBLoggingOptions.Default,
            MotherDuck    = ParseMotherDuckOptions(dataSource),
            DuckLake      = ParseDuckLakeOptions(dataSource)
        };
    }
    static bool ParseIsReadOnly(string? value) =>
        value?.ToUpperInvariant() is "READ_ONLY" or "READONLY";
    static int ParseThreads(string? value) =>
        int.TryParse(value, out var result) && result > 0 ? result : 0;
    internal static long? ParseMaxMemory(string? value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return null;
        var span = value.AsSpan().Trim();
        if (span.IsEmpty)
            return null;
        var unitStart = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < span.Length; i++) {
            if (!char.IsDigit(span[i]) && span[i] != '.') {
                unitStart = i;
                break;
            }
            if (i == span.Length - 1)
                unitStart = span.Length;
        }
        if (unitStart == 0)
            return null;
        var numberPart = span[..unitStart];
        var unitPart   = span[unitStart..].Trim();
        if (!double.TryParse(numberPart, out var number) || number < 0)
            return null;
        var multiplier = unitPart.ToString().ToUpperInvariant() switch {
            "B" or ""   => 1.0 / (1024 * 1024),
            "KB" or "K" => 1.0 / 1024,
            "MB" or "M" => 1.0,
            "GB" or "G" => 1024.0,
            "TB" or "T" => 1024.0 * 1024,
            _           => -1.0
        };
        if (multiplier < 0)
            return null;
        return (long)(number * multiplier);
    }
    static bool ParseEnableLogging(string? value) =>
        value?.ToLowerInvariant() is "true" or "1";
    static LogLevel ParseLoggingLevel(string? value) => value?.ToUpperInvariant() switch {
        "CRITICAL" => LogLevel.Critical,
        "ERROR"    => LogLevel.Error,
        "WARN"     => LogLevel.Warning,
        "INFO"     => LogLevel.Information,
        "DEBUG"    => LogLevel.Debug,
        "TRACE"    => LogLevel.Trace,
        _          => LogLevel.Warning
    };
}
````

````csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.DuckDB;
/// <summary>
/// Configuration options for DuckDB logging.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DuckDBLoggingOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default logging options with logging disabled.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DuckDBLoggingOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets whether logging is enabled.
    /// </summary>
    public bool Enabled { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the logging level.
    /// </summary>
    public LogLevel Level { get; init; } = LogLevel.Warning;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates logging options with logging enabled at the specified level.
    /// </summary>
    public static DuckDBLoggingOptions Enable(LogLevel level = LogLevel.Warning) =>
        new() { Enabled = true, Level = level };
}
````
