````csharp
namespace Talyn;
#region Receiver Contracts
/// <summary>
/// Receives and handles messages of type <typeparamref name="T"/> (fire-and-forget).
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type to receive.</typeparam>
/// <remarks>
/// Implement this interface for notification-style messages that don't require a response.
/// Use with <see cref="ITalynBus.TransmitAsync{T}(T,CancellationToken)"/> or
/// <see cref="ITalynMediator.InvokeAsync{T}"/>.
/// </remarks>
public interface IReceiver<in T> {
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles the received message.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">The message to handle.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">A cancellation token to cancel the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>A task that completes when handling is finished.</returns>
    ValueTask HandleAsync(T message, CancellationToken ct);
}
/// <summary>
/// Receives requests of type <typeparamref name="T"/> and returns responses of type <typeparamref name="TResponse"/>.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type to receive.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type to return.</typeparam>
/// <remarks>
/// Implement this interface for request/response patterns.
/// Use with <see cref="ITalynBus.BroadcastAsync{T,TResponse}(T,ExecutionMode?,CancellationToken)"/> or
/// <see cref="ITalynMediator.ScatterAsync{T,TResponse}"/>.
/// </remarks>
public interface IReceiver<in T, TResponse> {
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles the received request and returns a response.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">The request message to handle.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">A cancellation token to cancel the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>A task containing the response value.</returns>
    ValueTask<TResponse> HandleAsync(T message, CancellationToken ct);
}
#endregion
#region Handler Delegates
/// <summary>
/// Async message handler delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="message">The message to handle.</param>
/// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
public delegate ValueTask MessageHandler<in T>(T message, CancellationToken ct);
/// <summary>
/// Async message handler delegate with state (zero-allocation pattern).
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TState">The state type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="state">The state passed on each invocation.</param>
/// <param name="message">The message to handle.</param>
/// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
public delegate ValueTask MessageHandler<in TState, in T>(TState state, T message, CancellationToken ct);
/// <summary>
/// Sync message handler delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="message">The message to handle.</param>
public delegate void SyncMessageHandler<in T>(T message);
/// <summary>
/// Sync message handler delegate with state (zero-allocation pattern).
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TState">The state type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="state">The state passed on each invocation.</param>
/// <param name="message">The message to handle.</param>
public delegate void SyncMessageHandler<in TState, in T>(TState state, T message);
/// <summary>
/// Async request handler delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="message">The request message.</param>
/// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
public delegate ValueTask<TResponse> RequestHandler<in T, TResponse>(T message, CancellationToken ct);
/// <summary>
/// Async request handler delegate with state (zero-allocation pattern).
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TState">The state type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="state">The state passed on each invocation.</param>
/// <param name="message">The request message.</param>
/// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
public delegate ValueTask<TResponse> RequestHandler<in TState, in T, TResponse>(TState state, T message, CancellationToken ct);
/// <summary>
/// Sync request handler delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="message">The request message.</param>
public delegate TResponse SyncRequestHandler<in T, out TResponse>(T message);
/// <summary>
/// Sync request handler delegate with state (zero-allocation pattern).
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TState">The state type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="state">The state passed on each invocation.</param>
/// <param name="message">The request message.</param>
public delegate TResponse SyncRequestHandler<in TState, in T, out TResponse>(TState state, T message);
#endregion
#region Lambda Receiver Adapters
/// <summary>
/// Message receiver adapter wrapping a <see cref="MessageHandler{T}"/> delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="handler">The handler delegate.</param>
internal sealed class LambdaReceiver<T>(MessageHandler<T> handler) : IReceiver<T> {
    public ValueTask HandleAsync(T message, CancellationToken ct) => handler(message, ct);
}
/// <summary>
/// Request receiver adapter wrapping a <see cref="RequestHandler{T,TResponse}"/> delegate.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <param name="handler">The handler delegate.</param>
internal sealed class LambdaRequestReceiver<T, TResponse>(RequestHandler<T, TResponse> handler) : IReceiver<T, TResponse> {
    public ValueTask<TResponse> HandleAsync(T message, CancellationToken ct) => handler(message, ct);
}
#endregion

public static class TalynBusReceiverExtensions {
    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </remarks>
    public static ITalynBus WithReceiver<T, TResponse>(this ITalynBus bus, IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver) => bus.Connect(receiver);
    #region Lambda Receivers (Zero-Allocation with TState)
    /// <summary>
    /// Connects a lambda message handler with state (zero-allocation pattern).
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>

    /// <param name="handler">The handler delegate. Use <c>static</c> to ensure no closure allocation.</param>
    /// <returns>The bus instance for fluent chaining.</returns>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>

    public static ITalynBus Connect<T, TState>(

    ) => bus.Connect(new LambdaReceiver<T>((msg, ct) => handler(state, msg, ct)));
    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
namespace Talyn;
#region Receiver Entries
/// <summary>
/// Wrapper for a message receiver with disconnect detection and execution tracking.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// The <see cref="ExecutionLock"/> semaphore ensures that <see cref="ITalynBus.DisconnectAsync{T}"/>
/// can wait for any in-flight execution to complete before returning.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The <see cref="IsDisconnected"/> flag is set atomically when disconnect is called,
/// allowing the consumer to skip the receiver even if it was captured in a snapshot.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
internal sealed class ReceiverEntry<T> {
    /// <summary>
    /// Flag indicating the receiver has been disconnected and should be skipped.
    /// </summary>
    public volatile bool IsDisconnected;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new receiver entry.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to wrap.</param>
    public ReceiverEntry(IReceiver<T> receiver) => Receiver = receiver;
    /// <summary>
    /// The wrapped receiver instance.
    /// </summary>
    public IReceiver<T> Receiver { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Semaphore used to track active execution for <see cref="ITalynBus.DisconnectAsync{T}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public SemaphoreSlim ExecutionLock { get; } = new(1, 1);
}
/// <summary>
/// Wrapper for a request/response receiver with disconnect detection and execution tracking.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// The <see cref="ExecutionLock"/> semaphore ensures that <see cref="ITalynBus.DisconnectAsync{T,TResponse}"/>
/// can wait for any in-flight execution to complete before returning.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The <see cref="IsDisconnected"/> flag is set atomically when disconnect is called,
/// allowing the consumer to skip the receiver even if it was captured in a snapshot.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
internal sealed class ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse> {
    /// <summary>
    /// Flag indicating the receiver has been disconnected and should be skipped.
    /// </summary>
    public volatile bool IsDisconnected;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new receiver entry.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to wrap.</param>
    public ReceiverEntry(IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver) => Receiver = receiver;
    /// <summary>
    /// The wrapped receiver instance.
    /// </summary>
    public IReceiver<T, TResponse> Receiver { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Semaphore used to track active execution for <see cref="ITalynBus.DisconnectAsync{T,TResponse}"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public SemaphoreSlim ExecutionLock { get; } = new(1, 1);
}
#endregion
#region Registry Interfaces
/// <summary>
/// Read-only interface for resolving receiver entries from a source.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Implement this interface to provide additional receiver sources beyond DI and runtime connections.
/// The <see cref="TalynRegistry"/> accepts multiple resolvers and combines their results.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
internal interface IReceiverResolver {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets receiver entries for the specified message type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
    /// <returns>Receiver entries from this source.</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T>[] GetReceivers<T>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets receiver entries for the specified request/response types.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
    /// <returns>Receiver entries from this source.</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] GetReceivers<T, TResponse>();
}
/// <summary>
/// Registry for message and request receivers with support for multiple resolvers and runtime connections.
/// </summary>
internal interface ITalynRegistry : IAsyncDisposable {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all receiver entries for the specified message type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
    /// <returns>All receiver entries (from all resolvers and runtime connected).</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T>[] GetReceivers<T>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all receiver entries for the specified request/response types.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
    /// <returns>All receiver entries (from all resolvers and runtime connected).</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] GetReceivers<T, TResponse>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Connects a message receiver for runtime handling.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to connect.</param>
    void Connect<T>(IReceiver<T> receiver);
    /// <summary>
    /// Disconnects a previously connected message receiver.
    /// Sets the disconnect flag and removes from the registry.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The message type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to disconnect.</param>
    /// <returns>The entry that was disconnected, or null if not found.</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T>? Disconnect<T>(IReceiver<T> receiver);
    /// <summary>
    /// Connects a request receiver for runtime handling.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to connect.</param>
    void Connect<T, TResponse>(IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver);
    /// <summary>
    /// Disconnects a previously connected request receiver.
    /// Sets the disconnect flag and removes from the registry.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The request type.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResponse">The response type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="receiver">The receiver to disconnect.</param>
    /// <returns>The entry that was disconnected, or null if not found.</returns>
    ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>? Disconnect<T, TResponse>(IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver);
}
#endregion
#region Registry Implementations
/// <summary>
/// Resolver for DI-registered receivers with permanent caching.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Resolves receivers via <see cref="IServiceProvider.GetServices{T}"/> and caches them forever
/// (DI registrations don't change at runtime). Entries are wrapped in <see cref="ReceiverEntry{T}"/>
/// with <see cref="ReceiverEntry{T}.IsDisconnected"/> permanently false since DI receivers
/// cannot be disconnected.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
internal sealed class TalynContainerResolver : IReceiverResolver {
    readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, object> _cache = new();
    readonly IServiceProvider                   _provider;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a container registry with DI integration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="provider">The service provider for resolving DI-registered receivers.</param>
    public TalynContainerResolver(IServiceProvider provider) => _provider = provider;
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T>[] GetReceivers<T>() =>
        (ReceiverEntry<T>[])_cache.GetOrAdd(
            typeof(IReceiver<T>),
            static (_, sp) => sp.GetServices<IReceiver<T>>()
                .Select(static r => new ReceiverEntry<T>(r))
                .ToArray(),
            _provider
        );
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] GetReceivers<T, TResponse>() =>
        (ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[])_cache.GetOrAdd(
            typeof(IReceiver<T, TResponse>),
            static (_, sp) => sp.GetServices<IReceiver<T, TResponse>>()
                .Select(static r => new ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>(r))
                .ToArray(),
            _provider
        );
}
/// <summary>
/// Main registry combining runtime connections with optional external resolvers.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// This registry serves as both the runtime storage for <see cref="Connect{T}"/>/<see cref="Disconnect{T}"/>
/// operations and the aggregator for external <see cref="IReceiverResolver"/> sources.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Runtime receivers:</b> Stored internally with disconnect detection and execution tracking
/// via <see cref="ReceiverEntry{T}"/>. Cache is invalidated on Connect/Disconnect.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>External resolvers:</b> Combined with runtime receivers. Resolver results are cached
/// per-resolver and combined lazily.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
internal sealed class TalynRegistry : ITalynRegistry {
    readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, object>                 _combinedCache = new();
    readonly IReceiverResolver[]                                _resolvers;
    readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, ImmutableArray<object>> _runtimeEntries = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a standalone registry without external resolvers.
    /// </summary>
    public TalynRegistry() : this([]) { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a registry with external resolvers.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="resolvers">External receiver resolvers (e.g., DI container).</param>
    public TalynRegistry(params IReceiverResolver[] resolvers) => _resolvers = resolvers;
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T>[] GetReceivers<T>() {
        var key = typeof(IReceiver<T>);
        // Return cached combined result if available
        if (_combinedCache.TryGetValue(key, out var cached) && cached is ReceiverEntry<T>[] arr)
            return arr;
        // Build combined result
        var result = BuildCombinedResult<T>();
        _combinedCache[key] = result;
        return result;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] GetReceivers<T, TResponse>() {
        var key = typeof(IReceiver<T, TResponse>);
        // Return cached combined result if available
        if (_combinedCache.TryGetValue(key, out var cached) && cached is ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] arr)
            return arr;
        // Build combined result
        var result = BuildCombinedResult<T, TResponse>();
        _combinedCache[key] = result;
        return result;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Connect<T>(IReceiver<T> receiver) {
        var key   = typeof(IReceiver<T>);
        var entry = new ReceiverEntry<T>(receiver);
        _combinedCache.TryRemove(key, out _); // Invalidate cache
        _runtimeEntries.AddOrUpdate(
            key,
            _ => [entry],
            (_, existing) => existing.Add(entry)
        );
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T>? Disconnect<T>(IReceiver<T> receiver) {
        var               key               = typeof(IReceiver<T>);
        ReceiverEntry<T>? disconnectedEntry = null;
        _combinedCache.TryRemove(key, out _); // Invalidate cache
        _runtimeEntries.AddOrUpdate(
            key,
            _ => ImmutableArray<object>.Empty,
            (_, existing) => {
                // Find and mark the entry as disconnected
                foreach (var obj in existing)
                    if (obj is ReceiverEntry<T> entry && ReferenceEquals(entry.Receiver, receiver)) {
                        entry.IsDisconnected = true; // Signal to consumer to skip
                        disconnectedEntry    = entry;
                        break;
                    }
                // Remove from the array
                return existing.RemoveAll(obj =>
                                              obj is ReceiverEntry<T> e && ReferenceEquals(e.Receiver, receiver)
                );
            }
        );
        return disconnectedEntry;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Connect<T, TResponse>(IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver) {
        var key   = typeof(IReceiver<T, TResponse>);
        var entry = new ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>(receiver);
        _combinedCache.TryRemove(key, out _); // Invalidate cache
        _runtimeEntries.AddOrUpdate(
            key,
            _ => ImmutableArray.Create<object>(entry),
            (_, existing) => existing.Add(entry)
        );
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>? Disconnect<T, TResponse>(IReceiver<T, TResponse> receiver) {
        var                          key               = typeof(IReceiver<T, TResponse>);
        ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>? disconnectedEntry = null;
        _combinedCache.TryRemove(key, out _); // Invalidate cache
        _runtimeEntries.AddOrUpdate(
            key,
            _ => ImmutableArray<object>.Empty,
            (_, existing) => {
                // Find and mark the entry as disconnected
                foreach (var obj in existing)
                    if (obj is ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse> entry && ReferenceEquals(entry.Receiver, receiver)) {
                        entry.IsDisconnected = true; // Signal to consumer to skip
                        disconnectedEntry    = entry;
                        break;
                    }
                // Remove from the array
                return existing.RemoveAll(obj =>
                                              obj is ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse> e && ReferenceEquals(e.Receiver, receiver)
                );
            }
        );
        return disconnectedEntry;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        Clear();
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
    ReceiverEntry<T>[] BuildCombinedResult<T>() {
        var key = typeof(IReceiver<T>);
        // Get runtime entries
        var runtimeEntries = _runtimeEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var list)
            ? list.OfType<ReceiverEntry<T>>().ToArray()
            : [];
        // If no resolvers, return runtime only
        if (_resolvers.Length == 0)
            return runtimeEntries;
        // Combine resolver results
        var totalCount = runtimeEntries.Length;
        foreach (var resolver in _resolvers)
            totalCount += resolver.GetReceivers<T>().Length;
        if (totalCount == 0)
            return [];
        if (totalCount == runtimeEntries.Length)
            return runtimeEntries;
        var combined = new ReceiverEntry<T>[totalCount];
        var offset   = 0;
        // Add resolver entries first (they're typically DI singletons)
        foreach (var resolver in _resolvers) {
            var resolverEntries = resolver.GetReceivers<T>();
            resolverEntries.CopyTo(combined, offset);
            offset += resolverEntries.Length;
        }
        // Add runtime entries last
        runtimeEntries.CopyTo(combined, offset);
        return combined;
    }
    ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[] BuildCombinedResult<T, TResponse>() {
        var key = typeof(IReceiver<T, TResponse>);
        // Get runtime entries
        var runtimeEntries = _runtimeEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var list)
            ? list.OfType<ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>>().ToArray()
            : [];
        // If no resolvers, return runtime only
        if (_resolvers.Length == 0)
            return runtimeEntries;
        // Combine resolver results
        var totalCount = runtimeEntries.Length;
        foreach (var resolver in _resolvers)
            totalCount += resolver.GetReceivers<T, TResponse>().Length;
        if (totalCount == 0)
            return [];
        if (totalCount == runtimeEntries.Length)
            return runtimeEntries;
        var combined = new ReceiverEntry<T, TResponse>[totalCount];
        var offset   = 0;
        // Add resolver entries first (they're typically DI singletons)
        foreach (var resolver in _resolvers) {
            var resolverEntries = resolver.GetReceivers<T, TResponse>();
            resolverEntries.CopyTo(combined, offset);
            offset += resolverEntries.Length;
        }
        // Add runtime entries last
        runtimeEntries.CopyTo(combined, offset);
        return combined;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Clears all runtime connections.
    /// </summary>
    public void Clear() {
        _runtimeEntries.Clear();
        _combinedCache.Clear();
    }
}
#endregion
````

````csharp
/// <summary>

[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct CheckpointState() {
    /// <summary>
    /// Currently tracked positions.
    /// </summary>
    public ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> TrackedPositions { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Last checkpoint barrier info.
    /// </summary>
    public CheckpointBarrierInfo LastBarrier { get; init; } = CheckpointBarrierInfo.Unspecified;
    /// <summary>
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
/// <summary>
/// Tracks positions.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// <b>IMPORTANT:</b> Returned spans are valid only until the next mutating operation.
/// This tracker is NOT thread-safe and is designed for single-threaded partition processing.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
public interface IPositionTracker : IDisposable {
    /// <summary>
    /// Currently tracked positions.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// The returned span is valid until the next mutating operation on this tracker.
    /// </remarks>
    ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> Positions { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Last flushed position.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Returns the last position from the most recent flush operation.
    /// Returns <see cref="RecordPosition.Unset"/> if no flush has occurred.
    /// </remarks>
    RecordPosition LastFlushedPosition { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Last barrier position up to which positions have been flushed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The barrier position is the position passed to <see cref="FlushUpTo"/>,
    /// which may or may not be a tracked position.
    /// All positions less than or equal to the barrier are flushed.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Returns <see cref="RecordPosition.Unset"/> if no <see cref="FlushUpTo"/> has occurred.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    RecordPosition LastBarrierPosition { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Tracks a position for later flushing.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="position">
    /// The position to track. Cannot be <see cref="RecordPosition.Unset"/>
    /// and must be greater than <see cref="LastFlushedPosition"/>.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The current count of tracked positions after adding this position.
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">
    /// Thrown when position is <see cref="RecordPosition.Unset"/>.
    /// </exception>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">
    /// Thrown when position is less than or equal to <see cref="LastFlushedPosition"/>.
    /// </exception>
    int Track(RecordPosition position);
    // /// <summary>
    // /// Flushes all tracked positions.
    // /// </summary>
    // /// <returns>
    // /// A span containing all flushed positions.
    // /// </returns>
    // /// <remarks>
    // /// <para>
    // /// This should be called after a checkpoint is successfully committed.
    // /// </para>
    // /// <para>
    // /// After flushing, <see cref="Positions"/> will be empty and
    // /// <see cref="LastFlushedPosition"/> will be updated to the last position.
    // /// </para>
    // /// </remarks>
    // ReadOnlySpan<RecordPosition> Flush();
    /// <summary>
    /// Flushes tracked positions up to and including the specified barrier position.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="barrierPosition">
    /// The barrier position up to which to flush tracked positions.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A span containing the flushed positions.
    /// </returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The barrier position does not need to be a tracked position.
    /// All tracked positions less than or equal to the barrier will be flushed.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// After flushing:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><see cref="LastFlushedPosition"/> is updated to the last actually flushed position</item>
    /// <item><see cref="LastBarrierPosition"/> is updated to the specified barrier position</item>
    /// <item>Positions after the barrier remain tracked</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> FlushUpTo(RecordPosition barrierPosition);
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all tracked positions up to and including the specified position.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="position"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> PositionsUpTo(RecordPosition position);
}
````

````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
/// <summary>
/// High-performance position tracker using ArrayPool for single-threaded partition processing.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// This implementation is optimized for scenarios where each partition has a dedicated tracker
/// and positions arrive strictly in order. All read operations return spans into the internal
/// buffer with zero allocations.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>IMPORTANT:</b> Returned spans are valid only until the next mutating operation.
/// Callers must consume span data immediately. This tracker is NOT thread-safe.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The implementation uses a linear buffer with a compaction strategy. When the buffer runs
/// out of space, it first attempts to compact by moving elements to the front. If compaction
/// is insufficient, it grows the buffer using ArrayPool.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed class PositionTracker : IPositionTracker {
    const int DefaultCapacity = 4096;
    const int MinimumCapacity = 256;
    RecordPosition[] _buffer;
    int  _start;
    int  _count;
    bool _disposed;
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance with the default capacity of 4096 positions.
    /// </summary>
    public PositionTracker() : this(DefaultCapacity) { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance with the specified initial capacity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">The initial capacity. Must be at least 256.</param>
    public PositionTracker(int capacity) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(capacity, MinimumCapacity);
        _buffer = ArrayPool<RecordPosition>.Shared.Rent(capacity);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> Positions {
        get {
            ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
            return _count == 0
                ? ImmutableArray<RecordPosition>.Empty
                : [.._buffer.AsSpan(_start, _count)];
        }
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public RecordPosition LastFlushedPosition { get; private set; } = RecordPosition.Unset;
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public RecordPosition LastBarrierPosition { get; private set; } = RecordPosition.Unset;
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public int Track(RecordPosition position) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (position == RecordPosition.Unset)
            throw new ArgumentException("Position cannot be Unset", nameof(position));
        if (LastFlushedPosition != RecordPosition.Unset && position <= LastFlushedPosition)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Tracked position {position.LogPosition} must be greater than last flushed position {LastFlushedPosition.LogPosition}");
        EnsureCapacity();
        _buffer[_start + _count] = position;
        _count++;
        return _count;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> FlushUpTo(RecordPosition position) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        // Always update barrier position
        LastBarrierPosition = position;
        var positionsToFlush = PositionsUpTo(position);
        if (positionsToFlush.IsEmpty)
            return ImmutableArray<RecordPosition>.Empty;
        LastFlushedPosition = positionsToFlush[^1];
        _start += positionsToFlush.Length;
        _count -= positionsToFlush.Length;
        return positionsToFlush;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns all tracked positions up to and including the specified position.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="position">The upper bound position (inclusive).</param>
    /// <returns>An immutable array of positions up to the specified position.</returns>
    public ImmutableArray<RecordPosition> PositionsUpTo(RecordPosition position) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        var count = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < _count; i++) {
            if (_buffer[_start + i] > position)
                break;
            count = i + 1;
        }
        return count == 0
            ? ImmutableArray<RecordPosition>.Empty
            : [.._buffer.AsSpan(_start, count)];
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Ensures there is capacity for at least one more element.
    /// Compacts first if possible, then grows if needed.
    /// </summary>
    void EnsureCapacity() {
        if (_start + _count < _buffer.Length)
            return;
        // Try compaction first (move elements to front)
        if (_start > 0) {
            _buffer
                .AsSpan(_start, _count)
                .CopyTo(_buffer.AsSpan(0, _count));
            _start = 0;
            if (_count < _buffer.Length)
                return;
        }
        // Need to grow - rent a larger buffer
        var newCapacity = Math.Max(_buffer.Length * 2, _buffer.Length + 1024);
        var newBuffer = ArrayPool<RecordPosition>
            .Shared.Rent(newCapacity);
        _buffer.AsSpan(0, _count).CopyTo(newBuffer);
        ArrayPool<RecordPosition>
            .Shared.Return(_buffer);
        _buffer = newBuffer;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose() {
        if (_disposed)
            return;
        ArrayPool<RecordPosition>.Shared
            .Return(_buffer);
        _buffer   = [];
        _disposed = true;
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Processors/Checkpointing/WorkerCheckpointStore.cs
````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
/// <summary>
/// Worker checkpoint store implementation tied to a specific processor and worker instance.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Uses a single checkpoint stream per worker, and maintains the expected stream revision
/// internally for optimistic concurrency.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Applies document-sourcing where the latest event in the stream represents the current
/// checkpoint state.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed partial class WorkerCheckpointStore {
    readonly string        _processorId;
    readonly string        _workerId;
    readonly StreamsClient _client;
    readonly ILogger       _logger;
    readonly int           _maxCount;
    readonly StreamName    _stream;
    readonly TimeProvider  _time;
    ExpectedStreamState _expectedRevision = ExpectedStreamState.Any;
    volatile bool _isReady;
    public WorkerCheckpointStore(
        string processorId,
        string workerId,
        int maxCount,
        StreamsClient client,
        TimeProvider? time = null,
        ILogger<WorkerCheckpointStore>? logger = null
    ) {
        _processorId = processorId;
        _workerId    = workerId;
        _maxCount   = maxCount;
        _client     = client;
        _time       = time ?? TimeProvider.System;
        _logger     = logger ?? NullLogger<WorkerCheckpointStore>.Instance;
        _stream     = $"$processors/{processorId}/workers/{workerId}/checkpoints";
    }
    public async ValueTask<LogPosition> LoadLatestAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureReadyAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var record = await _client
            .ReadLastStreamRecord(_stream, skipDecoding: false, ct)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (record.Value is not WorkerCheckpoint checkpoint || checkpoint.Position.IsUnset) {
            LogNoCheckpointFound(_processorId, _workerId);
            return LogPosition.Unset;
        }
        _expectedRevision = record.FullPosition.StreamRevision;
        LogLoaded(_processorId, _workerId, checkpoint.Position, _expectedRevision);
        return checkpoint.Position;
    }
    public async ValueTask StoreAsync(LogPosition barrierId, LogPosition position, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureReadyAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (position.IsUnset)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot save an unset position as a checkpoint.");
        var state = new WorkerCheckpoint {
            BarrierId   = barrierId,
            Position    = position,
            ProcessorId = _processorId,
            WorkerId    = _workerId,
            Timestamp   = _time.GetUtcNow()
        };
        var request = AppendStreamRequest.New()
            .ForStream(_stream)
            .ExpectingRevision(_expectedRevision)
            .WithRecord(rec => rec
                .WithValue(state)
                .WithMetadata("processor_id", _processorId)
                .WithMetadata("worker_id", _workerId))
            .Build();
        var result = await _client.Append(request, ct)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        _expectedRevision = result.StreamRevision;
        LogStored(_processorId, _workerId, position, _expectedRevision);
    }
    async ValueTask EnsureReadyAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        if (_isReady)
            return;
        var info = await _client.GetStreamInfo(_stream, ct).UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (info == StreamInfo.None || !info.Metadata.HasMaxCount) {
            if (_maxCount <= 0)
                LogRetentionNotConfigured(_processorId, _workerId);
            else {
                await _client
                    .ConfigureStreamDataRetention(_stream, new() { MaxCount = _maxCount }, ct)
                    .UnwrapAsync()
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
                LogRetentionConfigured(_processorId, _workerId, _maxCount);
            }
        }
        _isReady = true;
        LogReady(_processorId, _workerId, _stream);
    }
    #region Logging
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Warning,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] Retention not configured, checkpoint stream will grow unbounded"
    )]
    partial void LogRetentionNotConfigured(string processorId, string workerId);
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Debug,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] Retention configured with MaxCount={MaxCount}"
    )]
    partial void LogRetentionConfigured(string processorId, string workerId, int maxCount);
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Debug,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] Ready on {Stream}"
    )]
    partial void LogReady(string processorId, string workerId, string stream);
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Debug,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] Loaded checkpoint @ {LogPosition}"
    )]
    partial void LogLoaded(string processorId, string workerId, ulong logPosition, long expectedRevision);
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Debug,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] Stored checkpoint @ {LogPosition}"
    )]
    partial void LogStored(string processorId, string workerId, ulong logPosition, long expectedRevision);
    [LoggerMessage(
        Level = LogLevel.Debug,
        Message = "[{ProcessorId}/{WorkerId}] No checkpoint found"
    )]
    partial void LogNoCheckpointFound(string processorId, string workerId);
    #endregion
    sealed record WorkerCheckpoint {
        /// <summary>
        /// The unique identifier for the checkpoint (barrier log position).
        /// </summary>
        public LogPosition BarrierId { get; init; } = LogPosition.Unset;
        /// <summary>
        /// The worker checkpoint position that was checkpointed.
        /// </summary>
        public LogPosition Position { get; init; } = LogPosition.Unset;
        /// <summary>
        /// UTC timestamp when the checkpoint was created.
        /// </summary>
        public DateTimeOffset Timestamp { get; init; } = DateTimeOffset.MinValue;
        /// <summary>
        /// The unique identifier for the processor.
        /// </summary>
        public string ProcessorId { get; init; } = "";
        /// <summary>
        /// Worker that created the checkpoint.
        /// </summary>
        public string WorkerId { get; init; } = "";
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
/// <summary>
/// Identifies what triggered a checkpoint.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Checkpoints can be triggered automatically by the server or manually by the user.
/// The trigger is recorded with the checkpoint for diagnostics and auditing.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public enum CheckpointTrigger {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified checkpoint trigger.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Barrier triggered on rebalancing events to ensure a consistent state across workers.
    /// </summary>
    Rebalance = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Time interval elapsed since the last checkpoint.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Triggered automatically by the server based on <see cref="CheckpointSettings.Interval"/>.
    /// This is the primary mechanism for regular checkpointing.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Frequency: Periodic (every interval milliseconds).</para>
    /// <para>Auto-deleted: Yes (subject to retention count).</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Interval = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// Record count threshold reached.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Triggered when <see cref="CheckpointSettings.Threshold"/> records have been processed
    /// since the last checkpoint. Useful for high-throughput scenarios where
    /// time-based intervals alone might result in too much data between checkpoints.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Frequency: Periodic (every N records).</para>
    /// <para>Auto-deleted: Yes (subject to retention count).</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Threshold = 3,
    /// <summary>
    /// Subscription caught up to end of log, transitioning to live mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Triggered exactly ONCE per processor lifecycle when the subscription
    /// finishes processing historical data and transitions to receiving live
    /// records. Only fires if the subscription started before the stream end
    /// (i.e., had historical data to process).
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// This ensures that after processing a potentially large historical backlog,
    /// the state is checkpointed before live processing begins. Prevents replaying
    /// the entire history if the worker crashes shortly after going live.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Frequency: Once per processor lifecycle (at catch-up completion).</para>
    /// <para>Auto-deleted: Yes (subject to retention count).</para>
    /// </remarks>
    CaughtUp = 4,
    /// <summary>
    /// Checkpoint triggered manually by the user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Triggered by an explicit API call to create a checkpoint, such as
    /// <c>Processor.CreateCheckpointAsync()</c>. Used for scenarios where
    /// the application needs to ensure a checkpoint at a specific point
    /// in processing, outside the automatic mechanisms.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Frequency: Manual (user-initiated).</para>
    /// <para>Auto-deleted: No (retained until explicitly deleted).</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Savepoint = 5,
    /// <summary>
    /// Server-side filter matched nothing for configured duration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Triggered when the server-side filter has not matched any records
    /// for the configured filter timeout period. This ensures checkpoints
    /// occur even when filtered streams have sparse matching records.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Frequency: Periodic (after filter idle timeout).</para>
    /// <para>Auto-deleted: Yes (subject to retention count).</para>
    /// </remarks>
    FilterTimeout = 6
}
/// <summary>
/// Reason why the worker is requesting disconnect.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum DisconnectReason {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified reason. For proto compatibility.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Graceful shutdown (SIGTERM, application stopping).
    /// </summary>
    Shutdown = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker encountered an error and needs to disconnect.
    /// </summary>
    Error = 2
}
/// <summary>
/// Reason why the relay disconnected the worker.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum DisconnectedReason {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified reason. For proto compatibility.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker requested graceful disconnect.
    /// </summary>
    Requested = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Server/relay is shutting down.
    /// </summary>
    ServerShutdown = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker failed to acknowledge checkpoint in time.
    /// </summary>
    CheckpointTimeout = 3,
    /// <summary>
    /// Protocol or processing error.
    /// </summary>
    Error = 4
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Variant;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
/// <summary>
/// Sent when partitions are assigned to this worker.
/// Worker MUST respond with <see cref="WorkAccepted"/> before relay sends records.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct WorkAssigned(
    ImmutableArray<int> Partitions,
    PartitionsAssignedReason Reason
);
/// <summary>
/// A batch of records to process.
/// Only sent after worker acknowledges with <see cref="WorkAccepted"/>.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct RecordsBatch(
    ImmutableArray<Record> Records
);
/// <summary>
/// Checkpoint barrier - worker must snapshot state and respond with <see cref="CheckpointComplete"/>.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct CheckpointBarrier(
    long CheckpointBarrierId,
    CheckpointTrigger Trigger,
    DateTimeOffset Timestamp
);
public readonly partial record struct GatewayMessage : IVariant<
    WorkAssigned,
    Record[],
    CheckpointBarrier> {
    internal static readonly GatewayMessage None = default;
}
/// <summary>
/// Raw (unbatched) message from PumpPump. Contains single Record or CheckpointBarrier.
/// Used internally before batching in StartRelay.
/// </summary>
readonly partial record struct RawGatewayMessage : IVariant<
    Record,
    CheckpointBarrier>;
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Variant;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
/// <summary>
/// Worker signals ready to receive records after <see cref="WorkAssigned"/>.
/// Relay MUST NOT send <see cref="RecordsBatch"/> until this is received.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct WorkAccepted; // maybe WorkerReady? or WorkerInitialized?
/// <summary>
/// Worker has completed checkpoint - positions are ready for persistence.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="CheckpointBarrierId">The barrier ID this checkpoint responds to.</param>
/// <param name="Positions">Partition to log position mapping.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct CheckpointComplete(
    LogPosition CheckpointBarrierId,
    ImmutableDictionary<int, LogPosition> Positions
);
/// <summary>
/// Worker requests disconnect.
/// For graceful shutdown, includes final positions so relay can persist without barrier round-trip.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="Reason">Why the worker is disconnecting.</param>
/// <param name="Positions">Optional: final checkpoint positions for graceful shutdown.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct Disconnect(
    DisconnectReason Reason,
    ImmutableDictionary<int, LogPosition> Positions
) {
    public LogPosition CheckpointBarrierId { get; } = Positions.IsEmpty ? LogPosition.Unset : Positions.Values.Max();
}
/// <summary>
/// The messages a worker can send to the server. Outbound from worker to relay.
/// </summary>
public readonly partial record struct WorkerMessage : IVariant<
    WorkAccepted,
    CheckpointComplete,
    Disconnect> {
    internal static readonly WorkerMessage None = default;
};
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Relay;
/// <summary>
/// Port interface for processor gateway implementations.
/// Creates worker sessions and handles outbound message processing.
/// <para>
/// Worker code never sees this interface - it only interacts with <see cref="IWorkerSession"/>.
/// </para>
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// <b>Implementations:</b>
/// </para>
/// <list type="bullet">
///   <item><description><c>LocalGateway</c> - Client-side simulation using StreamsClient (V2 Preview)</description></item>
///   <item><description><c>GrpcGateway</c> - Real server protocol (future)</description></item>
/// </list>
/// </remarks>
public interface IProcessorGateway : IAsyncDisposable {
    /// <summary>
    /// Establishes a bidirectional session with the gateway.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settings">The processor settings for this session.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns>A worker session for consuming messages and sending responses.</returns>
    ValueTask<IWorkerSession> ConnectAsync(ProcessorSettings settings, CancellationToken ct);
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles messages from worker (CheckpointComplete, Disconnect, etc.).
    /// Called by session's SendAsync delegation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">The message from the worker.</param>
    ValueTask SendAsync(WorkerMessage message);
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable PartialTypeWithSinglePart
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors;
/// <summary>
/// The StreamTemplate class represents a format for constructing,
/// parsing, and managing stream identifiers.
/// This class provides functionality for handling stream templates
/// with optional category-based organization.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public partial record StreamTemplate {
    public StreamTemplate(string format, char categorySeparator = '/') {
        Format   = format;
        Category = Format.Split('/', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }
    public string Format   { get; }
    public string Category { get; }
    public bool HasCategory => Category.Length > 0;
    public StreamName GetStream(string id) =>
        FormattableStringFactory.Create(Format, id).ToString();
    public StreamName GetStream(Guid id) =>
        GetStream(id.ToString());
    public static implicit operator StreamTemplate(StreamName _) => new(_.ToString());
    public static implicit operator StreamTemplate(string   _) => new(_);
    public static implicit operator string(StreamTemplate   _) => _.Format;
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Initial position at which the cursor will be set when subscribing.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Only used when:
/// <list type="bullet">
///   <item>Processor is created for the first time (no checkpoint exists)</item>
///   <item>All checkpoints have been deleted</item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Once a checkpoint exists, the processor always resumes from the last
/// checkpoint position, ignoring this setting.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public enum SubscriptionInitialPosition {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified initial position. The server will use the default behavior.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Start from current end of log (new records only).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The processor will only see records written AFTER it starts.
    /// Historical data is ignored.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Use when: You only care about new events, not historical data.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Latest = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Start from beginning of log (all records).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The processor will receive all historical records before
    /// transitioning to live processing (triggers <c>CaughtUp</c>).
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Use when: You need to process/replay all historical data.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Earliest = 2
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable InconsistentNaming
using static System.Text.Encoding;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Partitioning;
public delegate uint GenerateHash(string input);
public delegate uint GenerateHashFromBytes(ReadOnlySpan<byte> input);
/// <summary>
/// Provides a collection of hash generation utilities for both string and byte array inputs.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public static class HashGenerators {
    const uint DefaultSeed = 0;
    [PublicAPI]
    public static class FromBytes {
        public static GenerateHashFromBytes MurmurHash3 =>
            static input => HashDepot.MurmurHash3.Hash32(input, DefaultSeed);
        public static GenerateHashFromBytes XXHash =>
            static input => HashDepot.XXHash.Hash32(input);
    }
    [PublicAPI]
    public static class FromString {
        public static GenerateHash MurmurHash3 =>
            static input => FromBytes.MurmurHash3(UTF8.GetBytes(input));
        public static GenerateHash XXHash =>
            static input => FromBytes.XXHash(UTF8.GetBytes(input));
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Partitioning;
/// <summary>
/// Assigns partitions (key groups) to workers and computes partition movements during rebalancing.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Partitions provide a fixed intermediate layer between keys and workers. Keys are mapped to partitions
/// deterministically using <see cref="GetPartition"/>, and partitions are assigned to workers dynamically
/// using <see cref="AssignPartitions"/>.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// This design, inspired by Apache Flink's key groups, enables elastic scaling: when workers join or leave,
/// only partition assignments change—the key-to-partition mapping remains stable.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var assigner = new PartitionAssigner();
///
/// // Map a key to a partition (0 to maxParallelism-1)
/// int partition = assigner.GetPartition("customer-123", maxParallelism: 128);
///
/// // Assign partitions to workers
/// var assignments = assigner.AssignPartitions(
///     workerIds: ["worker-a", "worker-b", "worker-c"],
///     maxParallelism: 128
/// );
/// // Result: { "worker-a": [0..42], "worker-b": [43..85], "worker-c": [86..127] }
///
/// // When a worker joins, calculate movement
/// var newAssignments = assigner.AssignPartitions(
///     workerIds: ["worker-a", "worker-b", "worker-c", "worker-d"],
///     maxParallelism: 128
/// );
/// var movement = assigner.CalculateMovement(assignments, newAssignments);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IPartitionAssigner {
    /// <summary>
    /// Maps a partition key to a partition number using a deterministic hash function.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The partition key (e.g., stream ID, customer ID).</param>
    /// <param name="maxParallelism">The total number of partitions (1 to 32768).</param>
    /// <returns>A partition number in the range [0, maxParallelism).</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The same key always maps to the same partition for a given maxParallelism.
    /// This ensures state locality: all records with the same key are processed by the same worker.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Uses MurmurHash3 for deterministic, well-distributed hashing across partitions.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    int GetPartition(string key, int maxParallelism);
    /// <summary>
    /// Assigns partitions to workers using a balanced distribution algorithm.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="workerIds">The list of worker IDs to assign partitions to. Order is significant for determinism.</param>
    /// <param name="maxParallelism">The total number of partitions to distribute.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A dictionary mapping each worker ID to its assigned partition numbers.
    /// Partitions are assigned as contiguous ranges for efficiency.
    /// </returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Distribution is balanced: if partitions don't divide evenly, earlier workers in the list
    /// receive one extra partition each.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Example with 128 partitions and 3 workers:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    ///   <item>Worker A: 43 partitions (0-42)</item>
    ///   <item>Worker B: 43 partitions (43-85)</item>
    ///   <item>Worker C: 42 partitions (86-127)</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> AssignPartitions(
        IReadOnlyList<string> workerIds,
        int maxParallelism
    );
    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates which partitions moved between workers during a rebalance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="previousAssignment">The partition assignments before rebalancing.</param>
    /// <param name="newAssignment">The partition assignments after rebalancing.</param>
    /// <returns>Details of partition movements, gains, and losses per worker.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this to determine which workers need to transfer state during rebalancing.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    PartitionMovement CalculateMovement(
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> previousAssignment,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> newAssignment
    );
}
/// <summary>
/// Describes partition movements during a rebalance operation.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="Gains">Partitions gained by each worker (worker ID → partition numbers).</param>
/// <param name="Losses">Partitions lost by each worker (worker ID → partition numbers).</param>
/// <param name="Transfers">Partition transfers (from worker → to worker → partition numbers).</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct PartitionMovement(
    ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> Gains,
    ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> Losses,
    ImmutableArray<PartitionTransfer> Transfers
) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns true if no partitions moved during the rebalance.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsEmpty => Transfers.IsEmpty;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the total number of partitions that moved.
    /// </summary>
    public int TotalMoved => Transfers.Sum(t => t.Partitions.Length);
    /// <summary>
    /// Empty movement (no changes).
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly PartitionMovement None = new(
        ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>>.Empty,
        ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>>.Empty,
        []
    );
}
/// <summary>
/// Describes a transfer of partitions from one worker to another.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="FromWorker">The worker losing the partitions (null if partitions are new).</param>
/// <param name="ToWorker">The worker gaining the partitions (null if worker left).</param>
/// <param name="Partitions">The partition numbers being transferred.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct PartitionTransfer(
    string? FromWorker,
    string ToWorker,
    ImmutableArray<int> Partitions
);
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Processors/Partitioning/PartitionAssigner.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Partitioning;
/// <summary>
/// Assigns partitions (key groups) to workers and computes partition movements during rebalancing.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// This implementation follows the key group model used by Apache Flink for elastic scaling
/// of stateful stream processing. Partitions are distributed evenly across available workers
/// using contiguous ranges for efficiency.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// For key-to-partition mapping, use <see cref="PartitionCalculator"/> directly.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Thread Safety:</b> This class is thread-safe. All methods are pure functions with no shared state.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed class PartitionAssigner : IPartitionAssigner {
    readonly PartitionCalculator _calculator;
    /// <summary>
    /// Singleton instance using XXHash (default, fastest with excellent distribution).
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly PartitionAssigner Default = new(PartitionCalculator.Default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a partition assigner with a custom partition calculator.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="calculator">The partition calculator to use for key-to-partition mapping.</param>
    public PartitionAssigner(PartitionCalculator calculator) {
        _calculator = calculator ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(calculator));
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public int GetPartition(string key, int maxParallelism) =>
        _calculator.For(key, maxParallelism);
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> AssignPartitions(
        IReadOnlyList<string> workerIds,
        int maxParallelism
    ) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(workerIds);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(maxParallelism, 1);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(maxParallelism, 32768);
        if (workerIds.Count == 0)
            return ImmutableDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>>.Empty;
        var workerCount = workerIds.Count;
        var builder     = ImmutableDictionary.CreateBuilder<string, ImmutableArray<int>>();
        // Calculate base partitions per worker and remainder
        var basePartitions = maxParallelism / workerCount;
        var remainder      = maxParallelism % workerCount;
        var currentPartition = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < workerCount; i++) {
            // Earlier workers get one extra partition if there's a remainder
            var partitionCount = basePartitions + (i < remainder ? 1 : 0);
            // Create contiguous partition range for this worker
            var partitions = ImmutableArray.CreateBuilder<int>(partitionCount);
            for (var j = 0; j < partitionCount; j++) {
                partitions.Add(currentPartition++);
            }
            builder.Add(workerIds[i], partitions.MoveToImmutable());
        }
        return builder.ToImmutable();
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public PartitionMovement CalculateMovement(
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> previousAssignment,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ImmutableArray<int>> newAssignment
    ) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(previousAssignment);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(newAssignment);
        // Build reverse lookup: partition → worker (for previous assignment)
        var previousOwner = new Dictionary<int, string>();
        foreach (var (workerId, partitions) in previousAssignment) {
            foreach (var partition in partitions) {
                previousOwner[partition] = workerId;
            }
        }
        // Build reverse lookup: partition → worker (for new assignment)
        var newOwner = new Dictionary<int, string>();
        foreach (var (workerId, partitions) in newAssignment) {
            foreach (var partition in partitions) {
                newOwner[partition] = workerId;
            }
        }
        // Calculate gains, losses, and transfers
        var gains  = new Dictionary<string, List<int>>();
        var losses = new Dictionary<string, List<int>>();
        // Group transfers by (from, to) pair for efficient representation
        var transferGroups = new Dictionary<(string? from, string to), List<int>>();
        // Find all partitions in new assignment
        foreach (var (workerId, partitions) in newAssignment) {
            foreach (var partition in partitions) {
                if (!previousOwner.TryGetValue(partition, out var prevOwner) || prevOwner != workerId) {
                    // This partition is new to this worker
                    if (!gains.TryGetValue(workerId, out var gainList)) {
                        gainList        = [];
                        gains[workerId] = gainList;
                    }
                    gainList.Add(partition);
                    // Record the transfer
                    var key = (prevOwner, workerId);
                    if (!transferGroups.TryGetValue(key, out var transferList)) {
                        transferList        = [];
                        transferGroups[key] = transferList;
                    }
                    transferList.Add(partition);
                }
            }
        }
        // Find partitions lost (in previous but not in new for same worker)
        foreach (var (workerId, partitions) in previousAssignment) {
            foreach (var partition in partitions) {
                if (!newOwner.TryGetValue(partition, out var currentOwner) || currentOwner != workerId) {
                    // This partition was lost by this worker
                    if (!losses.TryGetValue(workerId, out var lossList)) {
                        lossList         = [];
                        losses[workerId] = lossList;
                    }
                    lossList.Add(partition);
                }
            }
        }
        // Convert to immutable structures
        var gainsImmutable = gains.ToImmutableDictionary(
            kvp => kvp.Key,
            kvp => kvp.Value.ToImmutableArray()
        );
        var lossesImmutable = losses.ToImmutableDictionary(
            kvp => kvp.Key,
            kvp => kvp.Value.ToImmutableArray()
        );
        var transfersImmutable = transferGroups
            .Select(kvp => new PartitionTransfer(kvp.Key.from, kvp.Key.to, kvp.Value.ToImmutableArray()))
            .ToImmutableArray();
        return new PartitionMovement(gainsImmutable, lossesImmutable, transfersImmutable);
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Processors/Partitioning/PartitionCalculator.cs
````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Text;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Processors.Partitioning;
/// <summary>
/// Calculates which partition a key belongs to using a deterministic hash function.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Partitions provide a fixed intermediate layer between keys and workers. Keys are mapped
/// to partitions deterministically, ensuring the same key always routes to the same partition.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Thread Safety:</b> This class is thread-safe. All methods are pure functions with no shared state.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var calculator = PartitionCalculator.Default;
///
/// // Calculate partition for keys (0 to maxParallelism-1)
/// int partition1 = calculator.For("customer-123", maxParallelism: 128);
/// int partition2 = calculator.For("order-456", maxParallelism: 128);
///
/// // Same key always maps to same partition
/// Debug.Assert(calculator.For("customer-123", 128) == partition1);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed class PartitionCalculator(GenerateHashFromBytes hashGenerator) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Stack allocation threshold - keys shorter than this use stackalloc (zero allocation).
    /// </summary>
    const int StackAllocThreshold = 256;
    /// <summary>
    /// Default instance using XXHash (fastest with excellent distribution).
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly PartitionCalculator Default = new(HashGenerators.FromBytes.XXHash);
    /// <summary>
    /// Instance using MurmurHash3 (industry standard used by Kafka, Flink, Cassandra).
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly PartitionCalculator MurmurHash3 = new(HashGenerators.FromBytes.MurmurHash3);
    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the partition number for a given key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The partition key (e.g., stream ID, customer ID).</param>
    /// <param name="maxParallelism">The total number of partitions (1 to 32768).</param>
    /// <returns>A partition number in the range [0, maxParallelism).</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The same key always maps to the same partition for a given maxParallelism.
    /// This ensures state locality: all records with the same key are processed by the same worker.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public int For(string key, int maxParallelism) {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(key);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(maxParallelism, 1);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(maxParallelism, 32768);
        var hash = ComputeHash(key, hashGenerator);
        return (int)(hash % maxParallelism);
        static uint ComputeHash(string key, GenerateHashFromBytes hashGenerator) {
            var maxByteCount = Encoding.UTF8.GetMaxByteCount(key.Length);
            // Fast path: stackalloc for small keys (zero allocation)
            if (maxByteCount <= StackAllocThreshold) {
                Span<byte> buffer = stackalloc byte[maxByteCount];
                var byteCount = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key, buffer);
                return hashGenerator(buffer[..byteCount]);
            }
            // Slow path: rent from pool for large keys
            var rentedBuffer = ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Rent(maxByteCount);
            try {
                var byteCount = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key, rentedBuffer);
                return hashGenerator(rentedBuffer.AsSpan(0, byteCount));
            }
            finally {
                ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.Return(rentedBuffer);
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the partition number for a given key (UTF-8 bytes).
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="keyBytes">The partition key as UTF-8 bytes.</param>
    /// <param name="maxParallelism">The total number of partitions (1 to 32768).</param>
    /// <returns>A partition number in the range [0, maxParallelism).</returns>
    public int For(ReadOnlySpan<byte> keyBytes, int maxParallelism) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(maxParallelism, 1);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(maxParallelism, 32768);
        var hash = hashGenerator(keyBytes);
        return (int)(hash % maxParallelism);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Structured key for identifying checkpoint blobs in storage.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Combines a processor identifier with a checkpoint identifier to form
/// a unique key for storing and retrieving state snapshots.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The string format is <c>processor-{ProcessorId}/checkpoint-{CheckpointId}</c>.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var key = new BlobKey("order-processor", 12345);
/// Console.WriteLine(key); // "processor-order-processor/checkpoint-12345"
///
/// // Parse from string
/// if (BlobKey.TryParse("processor-order-processor/checkpoint-12345", out var parsed)) {
///     Console.WriteLine(parsed.ProcessorId);   // "order-processor"
///     Console.WriteLine(parsed.CheckpointId);  // 12345
/// }
/// </code>
/// </example>
/// <param name="ProcessorId">The unique identifier of the processor.</param>
/// <param name="CheckpointId">The checkpoint sequence number.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct BlobKey(string ProcessorId, long CheckpointId) {
    const string ProcessorPrefix   = "processor-";
    const string CheckpointPrefix  = "/checkpoint-";
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the string representation of this blob key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A string in the format "processor-{ProcessorId}/checkpoint-{CheckpointId}".</returns>
    public override string ToString() => $"{ProcessorPrefix}{ProcessorId}{CheckpointPrefix}{CheckpointId}";
    /// <summary>
    /// Parses a string into a <see cref="BlobKey"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The string to parse.</param>
    /// <returns>The parsed <see cref="BlobKey"/>.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="FormatException">Thrown when the string format is invalid.</exception>
    public static BlobKey Parse(string key) {
        if (!TryParse(key, out var result))
            throw new FormatException($"Invalid blob key format: '{key}'. Expected format: 'processor-{{processorId}}/checkpoint-{{checkpointId}}'");
        return result;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Attempts to parse a string into a <see cref="BlobKey"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The string to parse.</param>
    /// <param name="result">When successful, contains the parsed <see cref="BlobKey"/>.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if parsing succeeded; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    public static bool TryParse(string key, [NotNullWhen(true)] out BlobKey result) {
        result = default;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
            return false;
        if (!key.StartsWith(ProcessorPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;
        var checkpointIndex = key.IndexOf(CheckpointPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (checkpointIndex < 0)
            return false;
        var processorId     = key[ProcessorPrefix.Length..checkpointIndex];
        var checkpointIdStr = key[(checkpointIndex + CheckpointPrefix.Length)..];
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(processorId))
            return false;
        if (!long.TryParse(checkpointIdStr, out var checkpointId))
            return false;
        result = new BlobKey(processorId, checkpointId);
        return true;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a blob key for the first checkpoint of a processor.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="processorId">The processor identifier.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="BlobKey"/> with checkpoint ID 0.</returns>
    public static BlobKey Initial(string processorId) => new(processorId, 0);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the next checkpoint key in sequence.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A new <see cref="BlobKey"/> with the checkpoint ID incremented by 1.</returns>
    public BlobKey Next() => this with { CheckpointId = CheckpointId + 1 };
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Metadata for a checkpoint blob stored in the blob store.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Contains information about a stored checkpoint snapshot including
/// size, creation time, content type, and which partitions are included.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var metadata = new BlobMetadata {
///     Size            = parquetBytes.Length,
///     CreatedAt       = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
///     PartitionRanges = [PartitionRange.FromTo(0, 127)],
///     Checksum        = ComputeChecksum(parquetBytes)
/// };
///
/// await blobStore.StoreAsync(blobKey, parquetBytes, metadata);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public record BlobMetadata {
    /// <summary>
    /// Size of the blob in bytes.
    /// </summary>
    public long Size { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// When the blob was created.
    /// </summary>
    public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// MIME type of the blob content.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> "application/x-parquet+gzip"</para>
    /// <para>
    /// Indicates compressed Parquet format used for state snapshots.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string ContentType { get; init; } = "application/x-parquet+gzip";
    /// <summary>
    /// Partition ranges included in this blob.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (all partitions)</para>
    /// <para>
    /// An empty array indicates the blob contains all partitions.
    /// Otherwise, contains the specific ranges included.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public PartitionRange[] PartitionRanges { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Optional checksum for data integrity verification.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// When present, can be used to verify blob integrity after retrieval.
    /// Typically a SHA-256 hash or similar.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string? Checksum { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this blob contains all partitions.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ContainsAllPartitions => PartitionRanges.Length == 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether this blob contains data for the specified partition.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partition">The partition number to check.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the blob contains data for this partition; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    public bool ContainsPartition(int partition) {
        if (ContainsAllPartitions)
            return true;
        foreach (var range in PartitionRanges) {
            if (range.Contains(partition))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}
````
