````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Interface for storing and retrieving checkpoint blobs.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// <b>Design Only:</b> This interface defines the contract for checkpoint blob storage.
/// Implementations may include local file storage, cloud storage (S3, Azure Blob, GCS),
/// or distributed storage systems.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The blob store is used by the processor framework to persist state snapshots
/// created by <see cref="ICheckpointStateStore"/>. Each checkpoint is stored as
/// a compressed Parquet file identified by a <see cref="BlobKey"/>.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Store a checkpoint
/// var blobKey  = new BlobKey(processorId, checkpointId);
/// var metadata = new BlobMetadata {
///     Size            = parquetBytes.Length,
///     CreatedAt       = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
///     PartitionRanges = [PartitionRange.FromTo(0, 127)]
/// };
///
/// await blobStore.StoreAsync(blobKey, parquetBytes, metadata);
///
/// // Retrieve a checkpoint
/// var retrieved = await blobStore.RetrieveAsync(blobKey);
/// if (retrieved.HasValue) {
///     await checkpointStore.RestoreAsync(retrieved.Value);
/// }
///
/// // List available checkpoints for a processor
/// var checkpoints = await blobStore.ListCheckpointsAsync(processorId);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IBlobStore : IAsyncDisposable {
    /// <summary>
    /// Stores a blob with the specified key and optional metadata.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The unique key identifying this blob.</param>
    /// <param name="data">The blob data to store.</param>
    /// <param name="metadata">Optional metadata describing the blob.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask StoreAsync(BlobKey key, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, BlobMetadata? metadata = null, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves a blob by its key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key of the blob to retrieve.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The blob data if found; otherwise, <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>?> RetrieveAsync(BlobKey key, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves metadata for a blob without downloading its content.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key of the blob.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The blob metadata if found; otherwise, <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<BlobMetadata?> GetMetadataAsync(BlobKey key, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes a blob.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key of the blob to delete.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask DeleteAsync(BlobKey key, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether a blob exists.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key of the blob to check.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the blob exists; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> ExistsAsync(BlobKey key, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Lists all checkpoint IDs for a processor.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Returns checkpoint IDs in ascending order.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="processorId">The processor identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An array of checkpoint IDs for the processor.</returns>
    ValueTask<long[]> ListCheckpointsAsync(string processorId, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

````csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using DuckDB.NET.Data;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// DuckDB-backed implementation of the state store.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides persistent state management using DuckDB as the storage backend.
/// State entries are stored as JSON in a single table with partition-based organization.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Storage Model:</b> Each state entry is stored with a partition, state type,
/// state key, entry key (for map/table), and JSON-serialized data.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Thread Safety:</b> This class is thread-safe for concurrent operations.
/// DuckDB handles internal locking for concurrent access.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Create an in-memory state store
/// await using var store = new DuckDbStateStore();
///
/// // Create a file-backed state store
/// await using var store = new DuckDbStateStore("Data Source=/path/to/state.db");
///
/// // Use the fluent API
/// await store.Value&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats").StoreAsync(new OrderStats { Count = 1 });
/// var stats = await store.GetValueAsync&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats");
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed class DuckDbStateStore : ICheckpointStateStore {
    const string ValueStateType = "value";
    const string MapStateType   = "map";
    const string TableStateType = "table";
    readonly DuckDBConnection     _connection;
    readonly JsonSerializerOptions _jsonOptions;
    readonly bool                 _ownsConnection;
    readonly SemaphoreSlim        _lock = new(1, 1);
    bool _disposed;
    bool _initialized;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new in-memory DuckDB state store.
    /// </summary>
    public DuckDbStateStore() : this("Data Source=:memory:") { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new DuckDB state store with the specified connection string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionString">
    /// The DuckDB connection string. Use "Data Source=:memory:" for in-memory storage
    /// or "Data Source=/path/to/file.db" for file-backed storage.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="jsonOptions">
    /// Optional JSON serializer options for state serialization.
    /// Defaults to case-insensitive property names with camelCase naming.
    /// </param>
    public DuckDbStateStore(string connectionString, JsonSerializerOptions? jsonOptions = null) {
        _connection     = new DuckDBConnection(connectionString);
        _ownsConnection = true;
        _jsonOptions    = jsonOptions ?? CreateDefaultJsonOptions();
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new DuckDB state store using an existing connection.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connection">An existing DuckDB connection. The store does not take ownership.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonOptions">
    /// Optional JSON serializer options for state serialization.
    /// Defaults to case-insensitive property names with camelCase naming.
    /// </param>
    public DuckDbStateStore(DuckDBConnection connection, JsonSerializerOptions? jsonOptions = null) {
        _connection     = connection;
        _ownsConnection = false;
        _jsonOptions    = jsonOptions ?? CreateDefaultJsonOptions();
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // IStateStore - Direct Access Shortcuts
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T?> GetValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, CancellationToken ct = default) where T : class {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await LoadValueAsync<T>(key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T> GetValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, T defaultValue, CancellationToken ct = default) where T : class {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await LoadValueAsync<T>(key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false) ?? defaultValue;
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // IStateStore - Fluent Builders
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Value<T>(StateKey key) where T : class =>
        new DuckDbValueStateBuilder<T>(this, key);
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IMapStateBuilder<TKey, TValue> Map<TKey, TValue>(StateKey key)
        where TKey : notnull
        where TValue : class =>
        throw new NotImplementedException("MapState is not yet implemented for DuckDB backend.");
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ITableStateBuilder<T> Table<T>(StateKey key) where T : class =>
        throw new NotImplementedException("TableState is not yet implemented for DuckDB backend.");
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // IStateStore - Global Operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask ClearAllAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = "DELETE FROM state_store";
            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ICheckpointStateStore - Snapshot Operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await ExportToParquetAsync(null, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var ranges = partitions.Select(PartitionRange.Single).ToArray();
        return await ExportToParquetAsync(ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await ExportToParquetAsync(ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ICheckpointStateStore - Restore Operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await ImportFromParquetAsync(data, null, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var ranges = partitions.Select(PartitionRange.Single).ToArray();
        await ImportFromParquetAsync(data, ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await ImportFromParquetAsync(data, ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // ICheckpointStateStore - Partition Management
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask ClearPartitionsAsync(int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var ranges = partitions.Select(PartitionRange.Single).ToArray();
        await ClearPartitionRangesAsync(ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask ClearPartitionsAsync(PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await ClearPartitionRangesAsync(ranges, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // IAsyncDisposable
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (_disposed)
            return;
        _disposed = true;
        _lock.Dispose();
        if (_ownsConnection)
            await _connection.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Internal Operations (used by builders)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Loads a value from the store.
    /// </summary>
    internal async ValueTask<T?> LoadValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, CancellationToken ct) where T : class {
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = """
                SELECT data FROM state_store
                WHERE partition = $partition AND state_type = $type AND state_key = $key AND entry_key = ''
                """;
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$partition", key.Partition));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$type", ValueStateType));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$key", key.Key));
            await using var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!await reader.ReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
                return null;
            var json = reader.GetString(0);
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, _jsonOptions);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Saves a value to the store.
    /// </summary>
    internal async ValueTask SaveValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, T value, CancellationToken ct) where T : class {
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var json     = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, _jsonOptions);
            var typeName = typeof(T).FullName ?? typeof(T).Name;
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = """
                INSERT INTO state_store (partition, state_type, state_key, entry_key, data, type_name, updated_at)
                VALUES ($partition, $type, $key, '', $data, $typeName, current_timestamp)
                ON CONFLICT (partition, state_type, state_key, entry_key)
                DO UPDATE SET data = $data, type_name = $typeName, updated_at = current_timestamp
                """;
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$partition", key.Partition));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$type", ValueStateType));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$key", key.Key));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$data", json));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$typeName", typeName));
            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes a value from the store.
    /// </summary>
    internal async ValueTask DeleteValueAsync(StateKey key, CancellationToken ct) {
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = """
                DELETE FROM state_store
                WHERE partition = $partition AND state_type = $type AND state_key = $key AND entry_key = ''
                """;
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$partition", key.Partition));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$type", ValueStateType));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$key", key.Key));
            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if a value exists in the store.
    /// </summary>
    internal async ValueTask<bool> ValueExistsAsync(StateKey key, CancellationToken ct) {
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = """
                SELECT 1 FROM state_store
                WHERE partition = $partition AND state_type = $type AND state_key = $key AND entry_key = ''
                LIMIT 1
                """;
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$partition", key.Partition));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$type", ValueStateType));
            cmd.Parameters.Add(new DuckDBParameter("$key", key.Key));
            await using var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return await reader.ReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Ensures the store is initialized before use.
    /// </summary>
    internal async ValueTask EnsureInitializedAsync(CancellationToken ct) {
        if (_initialized)
            return;
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            if (_initialized)
                return;
            if (_connection.State != System.Data.ConnectionState.Open)
                await _connection.OpenAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            await CreateSchemaAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            _initialized = true;
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Private Helpers
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    async ValueTask CreateSchemaAsync(CancellationToken ct) {
        await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText     = """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS state_store (
                partition   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
                state_type  VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
                state_key   VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
                entry_key   VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
                data        JSON        NOT NULL,
                type_name   VARCHAR     NOT NULL,
                updated_at  TIMESTAMP   DEFAULT current_timestamp,
                PRIMARY KEY (partition, state_type, state_key, entry_key)
            )
            """;
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    async ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> ExportToParquetAsync(PartitionRange[]? ranges, CancellationToken ct) {
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var tempFile = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"state_snapshot_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.parquet");
            try {
                await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
                if (ranges is null || ranges.Length == 0) {
                    cmd.CommandText = $"""
                        COPY state_store
                        TO '{tempFile}' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION GZIP)
                        """;
                }
                else {
                    var whereClause = BuildPartitionWhereClause(ranges);
                    cmd.CommandText = $"""
                        COPY (SELECT * FROM state_store WHERE {whereClause})
                        TO '{tempFile}' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION GZIP)
                        """;
                }
                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (!File.Exists(tempFile))
                    return ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty;
                return await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(tempFile, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            finally {
                if (File.Exists(tempFile))
                    File.Delete(tempFile);
            }
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    async ValueTask ImportFromParquetAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, PartitionRange[]? ranges, CancellationToken ct) {
        if (data.IsEmpty)
            return;
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var tempFile = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"state_restore_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.parquet");
            try {
                await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(tempFile, data.ToArray(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
                if (ranges is null || ranges.Length == 0) {
                    cmd.CommandText = $"""
                        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO state_store
                        SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{tempFile}')
                        """;
                }
                else {
                    var whereClause = BuildPartitionWhereClause(ranges);
                    cmd.CommandText = $"""
                        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO state_store
                        SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{tempFile}')
                        WHERE {whereClause}
                        """;
                }
                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            finally {
                if (File.Exists(tempFile))
                    File.Delete(tempFile);
            }
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    async ValueTask ClearPartitionRangesAsync(PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct) {
        if (ranges.Length == 0)
            return;
        await _lock.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var whereClause = BuildPartitionWhereClause(ranges);
            await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
            cmd.CommandText     = $"DELETE FROM state_store WHERE {whereClause}";
            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    static string BuildPartitionWhereClause(PartitionRange[] ranges) {
        var conditions = ranges.Select(r =>
            r.Start == r.End
                ? $"partition = {r.Start}"
                : $"partition BETWEEN {r.Start} AND {r.End}"
        );
        return string.Join(" OR ", conditions);
    }
    static JsonSerializerOptions CreateDefaultJsonOptions() => new() {
        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
        PropertyNamingPolicy        = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
        WriteIndented               = false
    };
}
````

````csharp
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Reflection;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// DuckDB-backed fluent builder for single-value state operations.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Implements the pipeline pattern where conditions and modifications are accumulated
/// and executed when a terminal method is called.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <typeparam name="T">The type of value stored in state. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
internal sealed class DuckDbValueStateBuilder<T> : IValueStateBuilder<T> where T : class {
    readonly DuckDbStateStore    _store;
    readonly StateKey            _key;
    readonly List<Func<T?, bool>> _conditions    = [];
    readonly List<Action<T>>     _modifications = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new value state builder.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="store">The backing state store.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The state key for this value.</param>
    internal DuckDbValueStateBuilder(DuckDbStateStore store, StateKey key) {
        _store = store;
        _key   = key;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public StateKey Key => _key;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Conditions (pipeline composition)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> When(Func<T?, bool> condition) {
        _conditions.Add(condition);
        return this;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Where(Func<T?, bool> condition) => When(condition);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Modifications (pipeline composition)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Set(Action<T> modifier) {
        _modifications.Add(modifier);
        return this;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Set<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField value) {
        var setter = CreateFieldSetter(field, value);
        _modifications.Add(setter);
        return this;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Increment<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField amount = default!)
        where TField : INumber<TField> {
        var getter = field.Compile();
        var setter = CreateFieldSetterFromExpression(field);
        // Default to 1 if amount is default
        var incrementBy = EqualityComparer<TField>.Default.Equals(amount, default!)
            ? TField.One
            : amount;
        _modifications.Add(obj => {
            var current = getter(obj);
            setter(obj, current + incrementBy);
        });
        return this;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public IValueStateBuilder<T> Decrement<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField amount = default!)
        where TField : INumber<TField> {
        var getter = field.Compile();
        var setter = CreateFieldSetterFromExpression(field);
        // Default to 1 if amount is default
        var decrementBy = EqualityComparer<TField>.Default.Equals(amount, default!)
            ? TField.One
            : amount;
        _modifications.Add(obj => {
            var current = getter(obj);
            setter(obj, current - decrementBy);
        });
        return this;
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Read
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T?> GetAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T> GetAsync(T defaultValue, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false) ?? defaultValue;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T> GetRequiredAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var value = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return value ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"State entry '{_key}' does not exist.");
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T?> GetOrCreateAsync(Func<T> factory, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var existing = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (existing is not null)
            return existing;
        var created = factory();
        await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, created, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return created;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<T?> GetOrCreateAsync(Func<ValueTask<T>> factory, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var existing = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (existing is not null)
            return existing;
        var created = await factory().ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, created, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return created;
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask<bool> ExistsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await _store.ValueExistsAsync(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Write
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask UpdateAsync(Action<T> modifier, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var current = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        // Create new instance if null (requires parameterless constructor)
        current ??= CreateInstance();
        modifier(current);
        await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, current, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask UpdateAsync(Func<T?, T?> transformer, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var current     = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var transformed = transformer(current);
        if (transformed is null) {
            await _store.DeleteValueAsync(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        else {
            await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, transformed, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask StoreAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var current = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        // Check all conditions
        if (!CheckConditions(current))
            return;
        // If no value and no modifications, nothing to do
        if (current is null && _modifications.Count == 0)
            return;
        // Create new instance if null (requires parameterless constructor)
        current ??= CreateInstance();
        // Apply all accumulated modifications
        ApplyModifications(current);
        // Save
        await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, current, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask StoreAsync(T value, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _store.SaveValueAsync(_key, value, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Delete
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask DeleteAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _store.DeleteValueAsync(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async ValueTask DeleteAsync(Func<T?, bool> condition, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        await _store.EnsureInitializedAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var current = await _store.LoadValueAsync<T>(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (condition(current))
            await _store.DeleteValueAsync(_key, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Private Helpers
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    bool CheckConditions(T? value) {
        foreach (var condition in _conditions) {
            if (!condition(value))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    void ApplyModifications(T value) {
        foreach (var modification in _modifications) {
            modification(value);
        }
    }
    static Action<T> CreateFieldSetter<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> fieldExpression, TField value) {
        var setter = CreateFieldSetterFromExpression(fieldExpression);
        return obj => setter(obj, value);
    }
    static Action<T, TField> CreateFieldSetterFromExpression<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> fieldExpression) {
        if (fieldExpression.Body is not MemberExpression memberExpr)
            throw new ArgumentException("Expression must be a property or field access.", nameof(fieldExpression));
        var memberInfo = memberExpr.Member;
        return memberInfo switch {
            PropertyInfo prop when prop.CanWrite => (obj, val) => prop.SetValue(obj, val),
            FieldInfo field                      => (obj, val) => field.SetValue(obj, val),
            PropertyInfo                         => throw new ArgumentException($"Property '{memberInfo.Name}' is read-only.", nameof(fieldExpression)),
            _                                    => throw new ArgumentException($"Member '{memberInfo.Name}' is not a property or field.", nameof(fieldExpression))
        };
    }
    static T CreateInstance() {
        try {
            return Activator.CreateInstance<T>();
        }
        catch (MissingMethodException) {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Type '{typeof(T).Name}' does not have a parameterless constructor. " +
                "Either provide an existing value or use a type with a parameterless constructor.");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Numerics;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for operations on a specific entry in a map state.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a composable API for reading, modifying, and deleting a single entry in a map.
/// Similar to <see cref="IValueStateBuilder{T}"/> but for map entries.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <typeparam name="TKey">The type of the map key.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TValue">The type of the map value. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Get or create entry
/// var customer = await state
///     .Map&lt;string, CustomerStats&gt;("customers")
///     .Entry(customerId)
///     .GetOrPutAsync(() =&gt; new CustomerStats { CustomerId = customerId });
///
/// // Update entry
/// await state
///     .Map&lt;string, CustomerStats&gt;("customers")
///     .Entry(customerId)
///     .UpdateAsync(c =&gt; c.OrderCount++);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue>
    where TKey : notnull
    where TValue : class {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the key of the entry being operated on.
    /// </summary>
    TKey EntryKey { get; }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Conditions
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a condition that must be satisfied for write operations to proceed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="condition">A predicate that receives the current value (may be null).</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue> When(Func<TValue?, bool> condition);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Modifications
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a modification action to apply to the entry value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="modifier">An action that modifies the value.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue> Set(Action<TValue> modifier);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a specific field to a value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to set.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value to set.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue> Set<TField>(Expression<Func<TValue, TField>> field, TField value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Increments a numeric field by the specified amount.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The numeric type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the numeric field to increment.</param>
    /// <param name="amount">The amount to add. Defaults to 1 if not specified.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue> Increment<TField>(Expression<Func<TValue, TField>> field, TField amount = default!)
        where TField : INumber<TField>;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Read
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the entry value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if the entry exists; otherwise, <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<TValue?> GetAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the entry value, returning a default if not found.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The value to return if the entry does not exist.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if it exists; otherwise, <paramref name="defaultValue"/>.</returns>
    ValueTask<TValue> GetAsync(TValue defaultValue, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the entry value, throwing if not found.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="KeyNotFoundException">Thrown when the entry does not exist.</exception>
    ValueTask<TValue> GetRequiredAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the entry value or creates it using the provided factory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// If the entry does not exist, the factory is invoked to create a new value,
    /// which is stored before being returned.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="factory">A function that creates the value if it does not exist.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The existing or newly created value.</returns>
    ValueTask<TValue?> GetOrPutAsync(Func<TValue> factory, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether the entry exists in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the entry exists; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> ContainsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Write
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds or updates the entry with the specified value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value to store.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask PutAsync(TValue value, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the entry only if it does not already exist.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value to store if the entry is absent.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the value was added; <c>false</c> if the entry already existed.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> PutIfAbsentAsync(TValue value, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the entry using the specified modifier action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="modifier">An action that modifies the value in-place.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask UpdateAsync(Action<TValue> modifier, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Stores the entry with all accumulated modifications applied.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask StoreAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Delete
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes the entry from the map and returns its value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The removed value, or <c>null</c> if the entry did not exist.</returns>
    ValueTask<TValue?> RemoveAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for map state operations (key-value dictionary per state key).
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a composable API for managing key-value pairs within a named map in the state store.
/// Use <see cref="Entry"/> to operate on individual entries or bulk methods for collection operations.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Map state is useful for scenarios like:
/// <list type="bullet">
/// <item>Customer-specific state indexed by customer ID</item>
/// <item>Session data indexed by session ID</item>
/// <item>Aggregations grouped by a key</item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <typeparam name="TKey">The type of keys in the map. Must not be null.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TValue">The type of values in the map. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Single entry operations
/// await state
///     .Map&lt;string, CustomerStats&gt;("customers")
///     .Entry(customerId)
///     .UpdateAsync(c =&gt; c.OrderCount++);
///
/// // Bulk iteration
/// await foreach (var entry in state.Map&lt;string, CustomerStats&gt;("customers").EntriesAsync()) {
///     Console.WriteLine($"{entry.Key}: {entry.Value.OrderCount} orders");
/// }
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IMapStateBuilder<TKey, TValue>
    where TKey : notnull
    where TValue : class {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the state key for this map.
    /// </summary>
    StateKey Key { get; }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Entry selection
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a builder for operating on a specific entry in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key of the entry to operate on.</param>
    /// <returns>An <see cref="IMapEntryBuilder{TKey,TValue}"/> for the specified entry.</returns>
    IMapEntryBuilder<TKey, TValue> Entry(TKey key);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Bulk filtering
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Filters the map entries based on the specified predicate.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The filter is applied to subsequent bulk read and delete operations.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="predicate">A function that returns true for entries to include.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IMapStateBuilder<TKey, TValue> Where(Func<TKey, TValue, bool> predicate);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Bulk read
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Asynchronously enumerates all keys in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of keys.</returns>
    IAsyncEnumerable<TKey> KeysAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Asynchronously enumerates all values in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of values.</returns>
    IAsyncEnumerable<TValue> ValuesAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Asynchronously enumerates all entries in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of key-value pairs.</returns>
    IAsyncEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>> EntriesAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether the map is empty.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the map contains no entries; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> IsEmptyAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the number of entries in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The count of entries in the map.</returns>
    ValueTask<long> CountAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Bulk write
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds or updates multiple entries in the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entries">The entries to add or update.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask PutAllAsync(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>> entries, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes all entries that match the current filter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// If <see cref="Where"/> was called, only matching entries are deleted.
    /// Otherwise, all entries are deleted.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entries deleted.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> DeleteAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes all entries from the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entries removed.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> ClearAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Processors/State/Results/UpsertResult.cs
````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Result of an upsert operation indicating how many records were inserted vs updated.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Upsert operations either insert new records or update existing ones based on
/// the primary key. This result type provides visibility into which action was taken.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var result = await stateStore
///     .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///     .UpsertAsync(order);
///
/// Console.WriteLine($"Inserted: {result.Inserted}, Updated: {result.Updated}");
/// </code>
/// </example>
/// <param name="Inserted">The number of records that were inserted.</param>
/// <param name="Updated">The number of records that were updated.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct UpsertResult(int Inserted, int Updated) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the total number of records affected by the upsert operation.
    /// </summary>
    public int Total => Inserted + Updated;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether any records were inserted.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasInserts => Inserted > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether any records were updated.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasUpdates => Updated > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a string representation of this upsert result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A string describing the insert and update counts.</returns>
    public override string ToString() => $"Inserted: {Inserted}, Updated: {Updated}";
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Result of a write operation indicating how many records were inserted, updated, and deleted.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides comprehensive visibility into complex write operations that may
/// perform multiple types of modifications in a single transaction.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// var result = await stateStore
///     .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///     .Where(o =&gt; o.Status == "expired")
///     .DeleteAsync();
///
/// Console.WriteLine($"Total affected: {result.Total}");
/// </code>
/// </example>
/// <param name="Inserted">The number of records that were inserted.</param>
/// <param name="Updated">The number of records that were updated.</param>
/// <param name="Deleted">The number of records that were deleted.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct WriteResult(int Inserted, int Updated, int Deleted) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the total number of records affected by the write operation.
    /// </summary>
    public int Total => Inserted + Updated + Deleted;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether any records were inserted.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasInserts => Inserted > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether any records were updated.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasUpdates => Updated > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether any records were deleted.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasDeletes => Deleted > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="WriteResult"/> representing only inserts.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="count">The number of records inserted.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="WriteResult"/> with only insert count set.</returns>
    public static WriteResult FromInserts(int count) => new(count, 0, 0);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="WriteResult"/> representing only updates.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="count">The number of records updated.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="WriteResult"/> with only update count set.</returns>
    public static WriteResult FromUpdates(int count) => new(0, count, 0);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="WriteResult"/> representing only deletes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="count">The number of records deleted.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="WriteResult"/> with only delete count set.</returns>
    public static WriteResult FromDeletes(int count) => new(0, 0, count);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a string representation of this write result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A string describing the insert, update, and delete counts.</returns>
    public override string ToString() =>
        $"Inserted: {Inserted}, Updated: {Updated}, Deleted: {Deleted}";
}
````

````csharp
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Numerics;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for SQL-like table state operations.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a LINQ-style method chain API for querying and modifying tabular data.
/// Data is stored as JSON in the underlying database.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Schema setup</b> (typically in OnInitialize):
/// <see cref="WithIndex{TField}"/>, <see cref="EnsureCreatedAsync"/>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Query building</b> (pipeline composition):
/// <see cref="Where"/>, <see cref="Select{TResult}"/>, <see cref="OrderBy{TField}"/>,
/// <see cref="OrderByDescending{TField}"/>, <see cref="Take"/>, <see cref="Skip"/>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Terminal operations</b> (execute the query):
/// Read: <see cref="ToArrayAsync"/>, <see cref="FirstOrDefaultAsync"/>, etc.
/// Aggregates: <see cref="CountAsync"/>, <see cref="SumAsync{TField}"/>, etc.
/// Write: <see cref="InsertAsync"/>, <see cref="UpdateAsync"/>, <see cref="UpsertAsync(T,CancellationToken)"/>, <see cref="DeleteAsync"/>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Primary key convention</b> for upsert operations:
/// <list type="number">
/// <item>Property named "Id"</item>
/// <item>Property named "{TypeName}Id" (e.g., OrderId for Order)</item>
/// <item>Property named "{TypeName}_Id" (e.g., Order_Id)</item>
/// <item>Explicit via <see cref="UpsertAsync{TId}(T,Expression{Func{T,TId}},CancellationToken)"/></item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <typeparam name="T">The entity type. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Schema setup in OnInitialize
/// await ctx.State
///     .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///     .WithIndex(o =&gt; o.CustomerId)
///     .EnsureCreatedAsync();
///
/// // Query with filter, order, and limit
/// var topOrders = await ctx.State
///     .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///     .Where(o =&gt; o.CustomerId == customerId)
///     .OrderByDescending(o =&gt; o.Amount)
///     .Take(10)
///     .ToArrayAsync();
///
/// // Aggregates
/// var totalAmount = await ctx.State
///     .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///     .Where(o =&gt; o.Status == "completed")
///     .SumAsync(o =&gt; o.Amount);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface ITableStateBuilder<T> where T : class {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the state key for this table.
    /// </summary>
    StateKey Key { get; }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Schema setup (for OnInitialize)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Specifies a field to index for faster queries.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Indexes improve query performance for fields used in <see cref="Where"/> predicates.
    /// Call this method multiple times for multiple indexes.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field to index.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to index.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> WithIndex<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field);
    /// <summary>
    /// Ensures the table and its indexes are created.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Typically called once in the processor's <c>OnInitialize</c> method.
    /// Safe to call multiple times; existing tables and indexes are not recreated.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask EnsureCreatedAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Query building (LINQ-style, pipeline composition)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Filters the results based on the specified predicate.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="predicate">An expression that returns true for entities to include.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> Where(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate);
    /// <summary>
    /// Projects each entity into a new form.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the projected entity.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="selector">A projection expression.</param>
    /// <returns>A new builder for the projected type.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<TResult> Select<TResult>(Expression<Func<T, TResult>> selector) where TResult : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Orders the results by the specified field in ascending order.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field to order by.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to order by.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> OrderBy<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field);
    /// <summary>
    /// Orders the results by the specified field in descending order.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field to order by.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to order by.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> OrderByDescending<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field);
    /// <summary>
    /// Limits the number of results returned.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="count">The maximum number of entities to return.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> Take(int count);
    /// <summary>
    /// Skips the specified number of results.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="count">The number of entities to skip.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> Skip(int count);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Read
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Asynchronously enumerates all matching entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of entities.</returns>
    IAsyncEnumerable<T> ToAsyncEnumerable(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns all matching entities as an array.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An array of matching entities.</returns>
    ValueTask<T[]> ToArrayAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns all matching entities as a list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>A list of matching entities.</returns>
    ValueTask<List<T>> ToListAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the first matching entity or <c>null</c> if none match.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The first matching entity, or <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<T?> FirstOrDefaultAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the first matching entity, throwing if none match.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The first matching entity.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">Thrown when no entities match.</exception>
    ValueTask<T> FirstAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the only matching entity or <c>null</c> if none match.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The single matching entity, or <c>null</c>.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">Thrown when more than one entity matches.</exception>
    ValueTask<T?> SingleOrDefaultAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Aggregates
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the count of matching entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of matching entities.</returns>
    ValueTask<long> CountAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether any entities match the current query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if any entities match; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> AnyAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Computes the sum of a numeric field.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The numeric type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to sum.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The sum of the field values.</returns>
    ValueTask<TField> SumAsync<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, CancellationToken ct = default)
        where TField : INumber<TField>;
    /// <summary>
    /// Finds the maximum value of a field.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The maximum value, or <c>null</c> if no entities match.</returns>
    ValueTask<TField?> MaxAsync<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Finds the minimum value of a field.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The minimum value, or <c>null</c> if no entities match.</returns>
    ValueTask<TField?> MinAsync<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Computes the average of a numeric field.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The numeric type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to average.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The average of the field values.</returns>
    ValueTask<double> AverageAsync<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, CancellationToken ct = default)
        where TField : INumber<TField>;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Write (return affected counts)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts a new entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity to insert.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entities inserted (1 on success, 0 on failure).</returns>
    ValueTask<int> InsertAsync(T entity, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts multiple entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entities">The entities to insert.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entities inserted.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> InsertAllAsync(IEnumerable<T> entities, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Updates all matching entities using the specified modifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="modifier">An action that modifies each entity.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entities updated.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> UpdateAsync(Action<T> modifier, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts or updates an entity using the primary key convention.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Uses the primary key convention to determine whether to insert or update:
    /// <list type="number">
    /// <item>Property named "Id"</item>
    /// <item>Property named "{TypeName}Id" (e.g., OrderId for Order)</item>
    /// <item>Property named "{TypeName}_Id" (e.g., Order_Id)</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity to upsert.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>Result indicating whether the entity was inserted or updated.</returns>
    ValueTask<UpsertResult> UpsertAsync(T entity, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts or updates an entity using an explicit key selector.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TId">The type of the key.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity to upsert.</param>
    /// <param name="keySelector">Expression identifying the key property.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>Result indicating whether the entity was inserted or updated.</returns>
    ValueTask<UpsertResult> UpsertAsync<TId>(T entity, Expression<Func<T, TId>> keySelector, CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Delete (return affected counts)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes all matching entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entities deleted.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> DeleteAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes all entities from the table.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of entities removed.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> TruncateAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Raw SQL (escape hatch)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes a raw SQL query and returns the results.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this as an escape hatch for complex queries not supported by the fluent API.
    /// The SQL should be compatible with the underlying database (DuckDB).
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type to deserialize results into.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="sql">The SQL query to execute.</param>
    /// <param name="parameters">Optional parameters for the query.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>An array of query results.</returns>
    ValueTask<TResult[]> QueryAsync<TResult>(string sql, object? parameters = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        where TResult : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes a raw SQL command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this as an escape hatch for complex operations not supported by the fluent API.
    /// The SQL should be compatible with the underlying database (DuckDB).
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="sql">The SQL command to execute.</param>
    /// <param name="parameters">Optional parameters for the command.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The number of rows affected.</returns>
    ValueTask<int> ExecuteAsync(string sql, object? parameters = null, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````
