````csharp
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Numerics;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for single-value state operations.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a composable API for reading, modifying, and deleting single values in the state store.
/// Operations are composed using pipeline methods and executed when a terminal method is called.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Pipeline methods</b> (return builder for chaining):
/// <see cref="When"/>, <see cref="Where"/>, <see cref="Set(Action{T})"/>,
/// <see cref="Increment{TField}"/>, <see cref="Decrement{TField}"/>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Terminal methods</b> (execute the pipeline):
/// <see cref="GetAsync"/>, <see cref="UpdateAsync(Action{T}, CancellationToken)"/>,
/// <see cref="StoreAsync(CancellationToken)"/>, <see cref="DeleteAsync(CancellationToken)"/>
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <typeparam name="T">The type of value stored in state. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Simple get
/// var stats = await state.Value&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats").GetAsync();
///
/// // Fluent update with condition
/// await state
///     .Value&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats")
///     .When(s =&gt; s?.Count &gt; 0)
///     .Increment(s =&gt; s.Count)
///     .StoreAsync();
///
/// // Update with action
/// await state
///     .Value&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats")
///     .UpdateAsync(s =&gt; {
///         s.Count++;
///         s.Total += order.Amount;
///     });
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IValueStateBuilder<T> where T : class {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the state key for this builder.
    /// </summary>
    StateKey Key { get; }
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Conditions (pipeline composition)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a condition that must be satisfied for write operations to proceed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The condition is evaluated against the current value before applying modifications.
    /// If the condition returns <c>false</c>, write operations are skipped.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="condition">A predicate that receives the current value (may be null).</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> When(Func<T?, bool> condition);
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a filter condition for write operations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Alias for <see cref="When"/> for LINQ-style API consistency.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="condition">A predicate that receives the current value (may be null).</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Where(Func<T?, bool> condition);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Modifications (pipeline composition - accumulated until terminal)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a modification action to apply to the value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Modifications are accumulated and applied in order when a terminal write method is called.
    /// The action receives the current value and can modify it in-place.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="modifier">An action that modifies the value.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Set(Action<T> modifier);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets a specific field to a value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Uses expression trees to identify the field to set.
    /// Modifications are accumulated and applied when a terminal write method is called.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the field to set.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value to set.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Set<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Increments a numeric field by the specified amount.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Uses expression trees to identify the field to increment.
    /// If <paramref name="amount"/> is not specified, increments by 1.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The numeric type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the numeric field to increment.</param>
    /// <param name="amount">The amount to add. Defaults to 1 if not specified.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Increment<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField amount = default!)
        where TField : INumber<TField>;
    /// <summary>
    /// Decrements a numeric field by the specified amount.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Uses expression trees to identify the field to decrement.
    /// If <paramref name="amount"/> is not specified, decrements by 1.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TField">The numeric type of the field.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="field">Expression identifying the numeric field to decrement.</param>
    /// <param name="amount">The amount to subtract. Defaults to 1 if not specified.</param>
    /// <returns>This builder for method chaining.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Decrement<TField>(Expression<Func<T, TField>> field, TField amount = default!)
        where TField : INumber<TField>;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Read
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the current value from state.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if it exists; otherwise, <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<T?> GetAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the current value from state, returning a default if not found.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The value to return if the state entry does not exist.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if it exists; otherwise, <paramref name="defaultValue"/>.</returns>
    ValueTask<T> GetAsync(T defaultValue, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the current value from state, throwing if not found.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">Thrown when the state entry does not exist.</exception>
    ValueTask<T> GetRequiredAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the current value or creates it using the provided factory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// If the value does not exist, the factory is invoked to create a new value,
    /// which is stored before being returned.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="factory">A function that creates the value if it does not exist.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The existing or newly created value.</returns>
    ValueTask<T?> GetOrCreateAsync(Func<T> factory, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the current value or creates it using the provided async factory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// If the value does not exist, the factory is invoked to create a new value,
    /// which is stored before being returned.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="factory">An async function that creates the value if it does not exist.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The existing or newly created value.</returns>
    ValueTask<T?> GetOrCreateAsync(Func<ValueTask<T>> factory, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether the value exists in state.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the value exists; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<bool> ExistsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Write (executes pipeline: get → apply transforms → store)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the value using the specified modifier action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Retrieves the current value, applies the modifier, and stores the result.
    /// If the value does not exist and a default can be created, it is created first.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="modifier">An action that modifies the value in-place.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask UpdateAsync(Action<T> modifier, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the value using the specified transformer function.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Retrieves the current value, applies the transformer, and stores the result.
    /// The transformer can return <c>null</c> to delete the value.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="transformer">A function that transforms the value.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask UpdateAsync(Func<T?, T?> transformer, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Stores the value with all accumulated modifications applied.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Executes the pipeline: retrieves the current value, applies all accumulated
    /// modifications from <see cref="Set(Action{T})"/>, <see cref="Increment{TField}"/>, etc.,
    /// checks conditions from <see cref="When"/>, and stores the result.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask StoreAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Stores the specified value, replacing any existing value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value to store.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask StoreAsync(T value, CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Terminal: Delete
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the value from state.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask DeleteAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the value from state if the condition is satisfied.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="condition">A predicate that determines whether to delete.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask DeleteAsync(Func<T?, bool> condition, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Framework-internal interface extending <see cref="IStateStore"/> with checkpoint operations.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// <b>Framework Use Only:</b> This interface is not intended for user code.
/// Users should interact with the <see cref="IStateStore"/> interface.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Provides checkpoint lifecycle operations for the processor framework:
/// <list type="bullet">
/// <item><see cref="SnapshotAsync(CancellationToken)"/> - Create state snapshots as compressed Parquet</item>
/// <item><see cref="RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory{byte},CancellationToken)"/> - Restore state from Parquet snapshots</item>
/// <item><see cref="ClearPartitionsAsync(int[],CancellationToken)"/> - Clear state for lost partitions</item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Framework usage during checkpoint
/// var checkpointStore = (ICheckpointStateStore)stateStore;
///
/// // Snapshot assigned partitions
/// var parquetBytes = await checkpointStore.SnapshotAsync(assignedPartitions);
/// await blobStore.StoreAsync(new BlobKey(processorId, checkpointId), parquetBytes);
///
/// // Restore on restart
/// var downloaded = await blobStore.RetrieveAsync(blobKey);
/// if (downloaded.HasValue)
///     await checkpointStore.RestoreAsync(downloaded.Value, partitions);
///
/// // Clear on partition loss
/// await checkpointStore.ClearPartitionsAsync(lostPartitions);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface ICheckpointStateStore : IStateStore, IAsyncDisposable {
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Snapshot operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a snapshot of all state as compressed Parquet bytes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>Compressed Parquet bytes representing the state snapshot.</returns>
    ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a snapshot of state for specified partitions.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partitions">The partition numbers to include in the snapshot.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>Compressed Parquet bytes representing the state snapshot.</returns>
    ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a snapshot of state for specified partition ranges.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ranges">The partition ranges to include in the snapshot.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>Compressed Parquet bytes representing the state snapshot.</returns>
    ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> SnapshotAsync(PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Restore operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Restores all state from compressed Parquet bytes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="data">The compressed Parquet bytes from a previous snapshot.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Restores state for specified partitions from compressed Parquet bytes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Only state for the specified partitions is restored from the snapshot.
    /// Other partitions in the snapshot data are ignored.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="data">The compressed Parquet bytes from a previous snapshot.</param>
    /// <param name="partitions">The partition numbers to restore.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Restores state for specified partition ranges from compressed Parquet bytes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Only state for the specified partition ranges is restored from the snapshot.
    /// Other partitions in the snapshot data are ignored.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="data">The compressed Parquet bytes from a previous snapshot.</param>
    /// <param name="ranges">The partition ranges to restore.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask RestoreAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default);
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Partition management
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Clears state for specified partitions.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Called during rebalancing when partitions are lost to another worker.
    /// Removes all state entries for the specified partitions.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="partitions">The partition numbers to clear.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask ClearPartitionsAsync(int[] partitions, CancellationToken ct = default);
    /// <summary>
    /// Clears state for specified partition ranges.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Called during rebalancing when partitions are lost to another worker.
    /// Removes all state entries for the specified partition ranges.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="ranges">The partition ranges to clear.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask ClearPartitionsAsync(PartitionRange[] ranges, CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Entry point for state management operations in record processors.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides access to three types of state inspired by Apache Flink's state model:
/// <list type="bullet">
/// <item><see cref="Value{T}"/> - Single value per key (most common)</item>
/// <item><see cref="Map{TKey,TValue}"/> - Key-value dictionary per state key</item>
/// <item><see cref="Table{T}"/> - SQL-like operations with JSON storage</item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// State keys support implicit conversion from strings (using partition 0) and from
/// <c>(int, string)</c> tuples for explicit partition specification.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Global vs Local State:</b> The <see cref="StateKey"/> provides logical addressing.
/// Whether state is shared globally or local to each worker depends on the backend
/// implementation (e.g., MotherDuck for shared, local DuckDB for isolated).
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// class OrderProcessor : IRecordProcessor {
///     public async ValueTask ProcessRecords(ProcessRecordsContext ctx) {
///         foreach (var record in ctx.Records) {
///             var order = record.GetData&lt;OrderPlaced&gt;();
///
///             // Direct value access (shortcut)
///             var stats = await ctx.State.GetValueAsync&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats");
///
///             // Fluent value operations
///             await ctx.State
///                 .Value&lt;OrderStats&gt;("stats")
///                 .UpdateAsync(s =&gt; s.Count++);
///
///             // Map operations
///             await ctx.State
///                 .Map&lt;string, CustomerStats&gt;("customers")
///                 .Entry(order.CustomerId)
///                 .UpdateAsync(c =&gt; c.OrderCount++);
///
///             // Table operations
///             var topOrders = await ctx.State
///                 .Table&lt;Order&gt;("orders")
///                 .Where(o =&gt; o.CustomerId == order.CustomerId)
///                 .OrderByDescending(o =&gt; o.Amount)
///                 .Take(10)
///                 .ToArrayAsync();
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IStateStore  {
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Direct access shortcuts
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Directly retrieves a value from state.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Shortcut for <c>Value&lt;T&gt;(key).GetAsync()</c>.
    /// Use for simple read operations where fluent API is not needed.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of value to retrieve.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="key">The state key. Supports implicit conversion from string.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if it exists; otherwise, <c>null</c>.</returns>
    ValueTask<T?> GetValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, CancellationToken ct = default) where T : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Directly retrieves a value from state, returning a default if not found.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Shortcut for <c>Value&lt;T&gt;(key).GetAsync(defaultValue)</c>.
    /// Use for simple read operations where fluent API is not needed.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of value to retrieve.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="key">The state key. Supports implicit conversion from string.</param>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The value to return if not found.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    /// <returns>The value if it exists; otherwise, <paramref name="defaultValue"/>.</returns>
    ValueTask<T> GetValueAsync<T>(StateKey key, T defaultValue, CancellationToken ct = default) where T : class;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Fluent builders
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a fluent builder for single-value state operations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Value state is appropriate for storing a single object per key, such as:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>Aggregation results</item>
    /// <item>Configuration settings</item>
    /// <item>Session state</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of value to store.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="key">The state key. Supports implicit conversion from string.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="IValueStateBuilder{T}"/> for fluent operations.</returns>
    IValueStateBuilder<T> Value<T>(StateKey key) where T : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a fluent builder for map state operations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Map state is appropriate for storing key-value pairs per state key, such as:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>Customer data indexed by customer ID</item>
    /// <item>Session data indexed by session ID</item>
    /// <item>Lookup tables</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TKey">The type of map keys. Must not be null.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TValue">The type of map values. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="key">The state key. Supports implicit conversion from string.</param>
    /// <returns>An <see cref="IMapStateBuilder{TKey,TValue}"/> for fluent operations.</returns>
    IMapStateBuilder<TKey, TValue> Map<TKey, TValue>(StateKey key) where TKey : notnull where TValue : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a fluent builder for SQL-like table operations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Table state is appropriate for complex querying and aggregation, such as:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>Event logs with filtering and ordering</item>
    /// <item>Analytics data with aggregations</item>
    /// <item>Complex queries across multiple fields</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Data is stored as JSON and can be indexed for performance.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The entity type. Must be a reference type.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="key">The state key. Supports implicit conversion from string.</param>
    /// <returns>An <see cref="ITableStateBuilder{T}"/> for fluent operations.</returns>
    ITableStateBuilder<T> Table<T>(StateKey key) where T : class;
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Global operations
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    /// <summary>
    /// Clears all state from the store.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// <b>Warning:</b> This operation is destructive and cannot be undone.
    /// Use with caution.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token for the operation.</param>
    ValueTask ClearAllAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Represents a contiguous range of partitions.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Used for efficient specification of partition ranges in snapshot and restore operations.
/// Both <see cref="Start"/> and <see cref="End"/> are inclusive.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Single partition
/// var single = PartitionRange.Single(5);
///
/// // Range of partitions (0-9 inclusive)
/// var range = PartitionRange.FromTo(0, 9);
///
/// // Check if partition is in range
/// if (range.Contains(7)) { ... }
/// </code>
/// </example>
/// <param name="Start">The starting partition number (inclusive).</param>
/// <param name="End">The ending partition number (inclusive).</param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct PartitionRange(int Start, int End) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a range containing only a single partition.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partition">The partition number.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="PartitionRange"/> containing only the specified partition.</returns>
    public static PartitionRange Single(int partition) => new(partition, partition);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a range from a starting partition to an ending partition (inclusive).
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="start">The starting partition number (inclusive).</param>
    /// <param name="end">The ending partition number (inclusive).</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="PartitionRange"/> spanning from start to end.</returns>
    public static PartitionRange FromTo(int start, int end) => new(start, end);
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether this range contains the specified partition.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partition">The partition number to check.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the partition is within this range; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    public bool Contains(int partition) => partition >= Start && partition <= End;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the total number of partitions in this range.
    /// </summary>
    public int Count => End - Start + 1;
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a string representation of this partition range.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A string in the format "[Start-End]" or "[Partition]" for single partitions.</returns>
    public override string ToString() => Start == End ? $"[{Start}]" : $"[{Start}-{End}]";
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
/// <summary>
/// Represents a key for accessing state in the state store.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// StateKey combines a partition identifier with a string key to provide
/// logical addressing for state entries. The partition is a logical grouping
/// concept - whether state is global or local depends on the backend implementation.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Supports implicit conversion from <see cref="string"/> (uses partition 0)
/// and from <c>(int, string)</c> tuples for convenient usage.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Implicit conversion from string (partition 0)
/// StateKey key1 = "my-state";
///
/// // Implicit conversion from tuple
/// StateKey key2 = (5, "partition-state");
///
/// // Explicit construction
/// var key3 = new StateKey(10, "explicit-key");
/// </code>
/// </example>
/// <param name="Partition">
/// The partition identifier for this key.
/// Partition 0 is typically used for non-partitioned state.
/// </param>
/// <param name="Key">
/// The string key that uniquely identifies the state within its partition.
/// </param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct StateKey(int Partition, string Key) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a string to a <see cref="StateKey"/> with partition 0.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The string key to convert.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="StateKey"/> with the specified key and partition 0.</returns>
    public static implicit operator StateKey(string key) => new(0, key);
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a tuple of (partition, key) to a <see cref="StateKey"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="t">The tuple containing partition identifier and key.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="StateKey"/> with the specified partition and key.</returns>
    public static implicit operator StateKey((int partition, string key) t) => new(t.partition, t.key);
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a string representation of this key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// For partition 0, returns just the key. For other partitions,
    /// returns the format "partition:key".
    /// </remarks>
    /// <returns>A string representation of this state key.</returns>
    public override string ToString() => Partition == 0 ? Key : $"{Partition}:{Key}";
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Defines the interface for processing records from a processor.
/// Implement this interface to receive callbacks during the processing lifecycle.
/// <para>
/// All methods except <see cref="ProcessRecords"/> have default implementations
/// that do nothing, allowing you to override only the methods you need.
/// </para>
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// All lifecycle methods are informational. The SDK handles checkpointing,
/// state management, and coordination automatically.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Minimal implementation - only ProcessRecords is required
/// class MinimalProcessor : IRecordProcessor {
///     public ValueTask ProcessRecords(ProcessRecordsContext ctx) {
///         foreach (var record in ctx.Records)
///             Console.WriteLine(record.Schema.Name);
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
/// }
///
/// // Full implementation with lifecycle handling
/// class FullProcessor : IRecordProcessor {
///     public ValueTask OnInitialize(InitializationContext ctx) {
///         Console.WriteLine($"Starting: {ctx.Info.ProcessorId}");
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
///
///     public ValueTask ProcessRecords(ProcessRecordsContext ctx) {
///         // Process records...
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
///
///     public ValueTask OnCheckpoint(CheckpointContext ctx) {
///         Console.WriteLine($"Checkpoint {ctx.CheckpointId} triggered by {ctx.Trigger}");
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
///
///     public ValueTask OnPartitionsAssigned(PartitionsAssignedContext ctx) {
///         Console.WriteLine($"Partitions: {ctx.Partitions.Count}");
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
///
///     public ValueTask OnShutdown(ShutdownContext ctx) {
///         if (ctx.Reason == ShutdownReason.Error)
///             Console.WriteLine($"Error: {ctx.Error}");
///         else
///             Console.WriteLine($"Done: {ctx.Metrics.TotalRecordsProcessed} records");
///         return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
///     }
/// }
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IRecordProcessor {
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when the processor starts, before any records are processed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// Context containing processor information, settings, and cancellation token.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="ValueTask"/> representing the asynchronous operation.</returns>
    ValueTask OnInitialize(InitializationContext context) => ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when partition assignment changes (informational).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The SDK handles state transfer automatically.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// Context containing the partition assignment and cancellation token.
    /// </param>
    ValueTask OnPartitionsAssigned(PartitionsAssignedContext context) => ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when records are available for processing.
    /// <remarks>
    /// This is the only method that must be implemented.
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// Context containing the batch of records and cancellation token.
    /// </param>
    ValueTask ProcessRecords(ProcessRecordsContext context);
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when a checkpoint occurs (informational).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The SDK handles state snapshots and uploads automatically.
    /// Use <see cref="CheckpointContext.Trigger"/> to determine why the checkpoint was triggered.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// Context containing the checkpoint information and cancellation token.
    /// </param>
    ValueTask OnCheckpoint(CheckpointContext context) => ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when processing stops, regardless of reason.
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This method is invoked at the end of the processing lifecycle, allowing for cleanup.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Check <see cref="ShutdownContext.Reason"/> to determine why processing stopped.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// Context containing the shutdown reason, final metrics, checkpoint state,
    /// error (if any), and cancellation token.
    /// </param>
    ValueTask OnShutdown(ShutdownContext context) => ValueTask.CompletedTask;
}
/// <summary>
/// Context provided when a record processor is initialized (before Connect).
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Use this for setup: logging, connections, caches, configuration validation.
/// Note: Partitions and CheckpointId are not available before Connect.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <param name="Info">The worker information for this processing instance.</param>
/// <param name="Settings">The processor settings used for this operation.</param>
/// <param name="CancellationToken">Token to observe for cancellation requests.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public record InitializationContext(
    WorkerSessionInfo Info,
    ProcessorSettings Settings,
    CancellationToken CancellationToken
);
/// <summary>
/// Context provided when records are available for processing.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public record ProcessRecordsContext(
    IReadOnlyList<Record> Records,
    CancellationToken CancellationToken
) {
    /// <summary>
    /// Stops processing by throwing an OperationCanceledException.
    /// </summary>
    public void StopProcessing() => throw new OperationCanceledException("Processing stopped by user request.");
}
/// <summary>
/// Context provided when a checkpoint occurs (informational).
/// </summary>
/// <param name="CheckpointId">The unique identifier for this checkpoint.</param>
/// <param name="Trigger">What triggered this checkpoint.</param>
/// <param name="CancellationToken">Token to observe for cancellation requests.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public record CheckpointContext(
    long CheckpointId,
    CheckpointTrigger Trigger,
    CancellationToken CancellationToken
);
/// <summary>
/// Context provided when partition assignment changes (informational).
/// </summary>
/// <param name="Info">Worker identification.</param>
/// <param name="Partitions">Currently assigned partitions.</param>
/// <param name="Reason">Why the assignment changed.</param>
/// <param name="CancellationToken">Token to observe for cancellation requests.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public record PartitionsAssignedContext(
    WorkerSessionInfo Info,
    IReadOnlyList<int> Partitions,
    PartitionsAssignedReason Reason,
    CancellationToken CancellationToken
);
/// <summary>
/// Why partition assignment changed.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum PartitionsAssignedReason {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified reason. For proto compatibility.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// First assignment on connect.
    /// </summary>
    Initial = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Another worker joined, we lost some partitions.
    /// </summary>
    WorkerJoined = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// Another worker left, we gained some partitions.
    /// </summary>
    WorkerLeft = 3,
    /// <summary>
    /// Manual rebalance triggered.
    /// </summary>
    Rebalance = 4
}
/// <summary>
/// Context provided when processing stops, regardless of reason.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="Info">The processing instance information.</param>
/// <param name="Metrics">Metrics about the processing operation.</param>
/// <param name="Reason">Why processing stopped (Completed, Cancelled, Error).</param>
/// <param name="CheckpointState">The final checkpoint state at shutdown.</param>
/// <param name="Error">The error that caused shutdown, or null if not an error.</param>
[PublicAPI]
public record ShutdownContext(
    WorkerSessionInfo Info,
    SessionMetrics Metrics,
    ShutdownReason Reason,
    CheckpointState CheckpointState,
    ProcessError? Error
) {
    public static ShutdownContext From(
        WorkerSessionInfo info,
        SessionMetrics metrics,
        CheckpointState checkpointState,
        Exception? exception = null
    ) {
        return exception switch {
            null                       => new(info, metrics, ShutdownReason.Completed, checkpointState, null),
            OperationCanceledException => new(info, metrics, ShutdownReason.Cancelled, checkpointState, null),
            _                          => new(info, metrics, ShutdownReason.Error, checkpointState, exception)
        };
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Metrics about the processing operation.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="TotalRecordsProcessed">
/// The total number of records processed during the operation.
/// </param>
/// <param name="TotalBatchesProcessed">
/// The total number of batches processed during the operation.
/// </param>
/// <param name="TotalProcessingTime">
/// The total time spent processing records.
/// </param>
/// <param name="RecordsPerSecond">
/// The average number of records processed per second.
/// </param>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct SessionMetrics(long TotalRecordsProcessed, long TotalBatchesProcessed, TimeSpan TotalProcessingTime, double RecordsPerSecond) {
    public static readonly SessionMetrics Empty = new(0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero, 0);
    public static SessionMetrics From(long totalRecords, long totalBatches, long startTimestamp) {
        var totalProcessingTime = TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(startTimestamp);
        var recordsPerSecond = totalProcessingTime.TotalSeconds > 0
            ? totalRecords / totalProcessingTime.TotalSeconds
            : 0;
        return new SessionMetrics(totalRecords, totalBatches, totalProcessingTime, recordsPerSecond);
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Why processing stopped.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum ShutdownReason {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified reason. For proto compatibility.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Processing completed successfully (reached end of stream if bounded).
    /// </summary>
    Completed = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Processing was cancelled either by user request or server-side timeout.
    /// </summary>
    Cancelled = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// An error occurred during processing.
    /// </summary>
    Error = 3
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for configuring processor execution.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a fluent API for configuring processing options, client options, and
/// processor instances before executing the processing operation with <see cref="RunAsync"/>.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Start with <see cref="KurrentProcessors.Create(IRecordProcessor)"/> or
/// <see cref="KurrentProcessors.Create(IRecordProcessorFactory)"/> to create a builder instance.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Simple fire-and-forget
/// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
///
/// // With processor factory and full configuration
/// await KurrentProcessors.Create(processorFactory)
///     .WithClient("kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113?tls=true", opts => opts with {
///         Resilience = KurrentClientResilienceOptions.HighAvailability
///     })
///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
///     .WithFilter(RecordFilter.ByStream("orders"))
///     .WithInitialPosition(SubscriptionInitialPosition.Earliest)
///     .WithBatching(new BatchingSettings { MaxSize = 200, Timeout = 1000 })
///     .WithBufferCapacity(5000)
///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
///
/// // Advanced: Get worker for runtime access
/// var worker = KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
///     .Build();
///
/// Console.WriteLine($"State: {worker.State}");
/// await worker.RunAsync(stoppingToken);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public sealed class KurrentProcessorBuilder {
    internal KurrentProcessorBuilder(IRecordProcessorFactory processorFactory) {
        GetProcessor = () => {
            try {
                return processorFactory.CreateProcessor();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) {
                throw new FailedToCreateWorkerException(ex);
            }
        };
        ProcessorSettings  = new ProcessorSettings();
        GetClientOptions   = () => new KurrentClientOptions();
    }
    Func<IRecordProcessor>     GetProcessor       { get; set; }
    ProcessorSettings          ProcessorSettings  { get; set; }
    KurrentClient?             ProvidedClient     { get; set; }
    Func<KurrentClientOptions> GetClientOptions   { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection string and configures client options in a single call.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionString">
    /// KurrentDB connection string (e.g., "kurrentdb://localhost:2113" or "kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113?tls=true").
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="configure">Function to configure client options derived from the connection string.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The configure function receives the options parsed from the connection string, allowing
    /// modifications to the connection-derived settings.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// This method invalidates any previously provided client instance.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// .WithClient("kurrentdb://localhost:2113", opts => opts with {
    ///     Resilience = KurrentClientResilienceOptions.HighAvailability
    /// })
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithClient(string connectionString, Func<KurrentClientOptions, KurrentClientOptions> configure) {
        GetClientOptions = () => configure(KurrentClientOptions.Parse(connectionString));
        ProvidedClient   = null;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets pre-configured client options for connecting to KurrentDB.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">The pre-configured client options.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This method invalidates any previously provided client instance.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithClient(KurrentClientOptions options) {
        GetClientOptions = () => options;
        ProvidedClient   = null;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Uses an existing KurrentClient instance for processing.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client instance to use.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// When using a provided client instance, the runner will NOT dispose it after processing completes.
    /// The caller is responsible for the client's lifecycle.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// This method invalidates any previously configured client options via <see cref="ConnectTo"/> or
    /// <see cref="WithClient(string, Func{KurrentClientOptions, KurrentClientOptions})"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder UseClient(KurrentClient client) {
        GetClientOptions = () => client.Options;
        ProvidedClient   = client;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection string for connecting to KurrentDB.
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Any previously set client options will be overridden, and any provided client
    /// instance will be ignored.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionString">
    /// KurrentDB connection string (e.g., "kurrentdb://localhost:2113" or "kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113?tls=true").
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder ConnectTo(string connectionString) => WithClient(connectionString, options => options);
    /// <summary>
    /// Enables checkpointing for resumable processing with the specified processor ID.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="processorId">The processor group name for checkpoint storage.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Checkpointing enables resumable processing by persisting progress to KurrentDB.
    /// When the processor restarts, it resumes from the last committed checkpoint rather
    /// than reprocessing from the beginning.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// <b>Processor Groups:</b> Multiple workers with the same processor ID share checkpoints,
    /// enabling coordinated processing across instances.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
    ///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
    ///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
    ///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithProcessorId(string processorId) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { ProcessorId = processorId };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the unique identifier for this worker instance within the processor group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="workerId">The worker identifier.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Used for checkpoint attribution. For sticky partition assignment,
    /// use a consistent identifier like <see cref="Environment.MachineName"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// <b>Note:</b> Only used when <see cref="WithProcessorId"/> is also called.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
    ///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
    ///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
    ///     .WithWorkerId(Environment.MachineName)
    ///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithWorkerId(string workerId) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { WorkerId = workerId };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the maximum number of partitions (key groups) for parallel processing.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="maxParallelism">Maximum parallelism (1-32768, default: 128).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Determines the upper bound for parallel processing.
    /// Similar to Flink's <c>setMaxParallelism()</c>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithMaxParallelism(int maxParallelism) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { MaxParallelism = maxParallelism };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the record filter for processing using an <see cref="IRecordFilter"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="filter">The filter to apply to records.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Filters reduce data transfer and processing overhead by targeting specific streams,
    /// schemas, or metadata properties.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// .WithFilter(RecordFilter.ByStream("orders"))
    /// .WithFilter(RecordFilter.ByStreamPrefix("tenant-"))
    /// .WithFilter(RecordFilter.BySchema("OrderPlaced"))
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithFilter(IRecordFilter filter) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with {
            Subscription = ProcessorSettings.Subscription with { Filter = filter }
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the filter expression string for server-side filtering.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="filterExpression">Filter expression (e.g., <c>"$all"</c>, <c>"stream_id LIKE 'orders-%'"</c>).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this for configuration-based filtering. For programmatic filtering,
    /// prefer <see cref="WithFilter(IRecordFilter)"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// .WithFilterExpression("stream_id LIKE 'orders-%'")
    /// .WithFilterExpression("category = 'orders'")
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithFilterExpression(string filterExpression) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with {
            Subscription = ProcessorSettings.Subscription with { FilterExpression = filterExpression }
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the path to extract partition key from records.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="selector">Path expression (e.g., <c>"stream_id"</c>, <c>"data.customer_id"</c>).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Required when <see cref="WithMaxParallelism"/> > 1.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithPartitionKeySelector(string selector) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with {
            Subscription = ProcessorSettings.Subscription with { PartitionKeySelector = selector }
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the initial position for processing when no checkpoint exists.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="position">The initial position (Earliest or Latest).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This setting only applies when there is no stored checkpoint.
    /// Use <see cref="WithStartPosition"/> to override any existing checkpoint.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithInitialPosition(SubscriptionInitialPosition position) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with {
            Subscription = ProcessorSettings.Subscription with { InitialPosition = position }
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Forces processing to start from a specific position, ignoring any checkpoint.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="position">The log position to start from.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// When set, any existing checkpoint will be ignored and processing will begin from
    /// the specified position.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithStartPosition(long position) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with {
            Subscription = ProcessorSettings.Subscription with { StartPosition = position }
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures record batching for processing.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settings">The batching configuration.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Batching controls how records are grouped before delivery to the processor.
    /// Smaller batches reduce latency; larger batches improve throughput.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// .WithBatching(new BatchingSettings { MaxSize = 200, Timeout = 1000 })
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithBatching(BatchingSettings settings) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { Batching = settings };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures checkpoint settings for fault tolerance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settings">The checkpoint configuration.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Checkpoints enable recovery from failures by periodically saving progress.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// .WithCheckpoint(new CheckpointSettings { Interval = 60000, Threshold = 5000 })
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithCheckpoint(CheckpointSettings settings) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { Checkpoint = settings };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the buffer capacity for record buffering.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">Buffer capacity in records (default: 1000, max: 10000).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Larger buffers improve throughput but increase memory usage.
    /// The buffer capacity should be at least as large as the batch size.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithBufferCapacity(int capacity) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { BufferCapacity = capacity };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Skips record deserialization for raw byte access.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="skip">True to skip decoding (default: true when called).</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use when processing metadata only or with custom deserialization.
    /// Reduces CPU usage in high-throughput scenarios.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder WithSkipDecoding(bool skip = true) {
        ProcessorSettings = ProcessorSettings with { SkipDecoding = skip };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides full control over processor settings.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configure">Function to configure processor settings.</param>
    /// <returns>The runner instance for method chaining.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this method for advanced processing configuration that isn't covered
    /// by the individual property methods.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentProcessorBuilder ConfigureProcessing(Func<ProcessorSettings, ProcessorSettings> configure) {
        ProcessorSettings = configure(ProcessorSettings);
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds a processor worker for runtime access and control.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>An <see cref="IProcessorWorker"/> instance for monitoring and control.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use this method when you need access to worker state, metrics, or checkpoints during execution.
    /// The returned worker must be started with <see cref="IProcessorWorker.RunAsync"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// var worker = KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
    ///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
    ///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
    ///     .Build();
    ///
    /// Console.WriteLine($"State: {worker.State}");
    /// await worker.RunAsync(stoppingToken);
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public IProcessorWorker Build() {
        var options = GetClientOptions();
        var client  = ProvidedClient ?? new KurrentClient(options);
        // return new KurrentProcessorWorker(client, GetProcessor(), ProcessorSettings, options.LoggerFactory);
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the processor as a fire-and-forget operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="stoppingToken">Token to request cancellation of processing.</param>
    /// <returns>A task that completes when processing finishes or is cancelled.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This is the simplest way to run a processor. For runtime access to metrics
    /// and state, use <see cref="Build"/> instead.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public async ValueTask RunAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken = default) {
        await using var worker = Build();
        await worker.RunAsync(worker.Settings, stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using Grpc.Net.Client.Balancer;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Relay;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// State of the processor worker.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum ProcessorWorkerState {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified state. For proto compatibility.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker is initializing (connecting, loading state).
    /// </summary>
    Initializing = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker is running and processing records.
    /// </summary>
    Running = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker is stopping (graceful shutdown in progress).
    /// </summary>
    Stopping = 3,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker has stopped normally.
    /// </summary>
    Stopped = 4,
    /// <summary>
    /// Worker has failed due to an error.
    /// </summary>
    Failed = 5
}
/// <summary>
/// Represents a running processor worker instance with runtime access to state and metrics.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IProcessorWorker : IAsyncDisposable {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unique identifier of the processor being executed.
    /// </summary>
    string ProcessorId { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The unique identifier of this worker instance.
    /// Could have been automatically generated if not provided in settings.
    /// </summary>
    string WorkerId { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Unique session ID for this processing run.
    /// Empty GUID if not started.
    /// </summary>
    Guid SessionId { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Settings used by this worker.
    /// </summary>
    ProcessorSettings Settings { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Current state of the processor worker.
    /// </summary>
    ProcessorWorkerState State { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Current checkpoint information for the processor worker.
    /// Includes last checkpointed positions, pending checkpoints, etc.
    /// </summary>
    CheckpointState Checkpoints { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Runtime metrics for the processing session.
    /// Includes records processed, processing rate, latency, etc.
    /// </summary>
    SessionMetrics Metrics { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the processor worker asynchronously until cancellation is requested.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settings">The processor settings to use.</param>
    /// <param name="stoppingToken">Token to request cancellation of processing.</param>
    Task RunAsync(ProcessorSettings settings, CancellationToken stoppingToken);
}
/// <summary>
/// Entry point for the Processors feature. Creates and runs processor workers.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a fluent API for configuring and executing record processors.
/// Use <see cref="Create(IRecordProcessor)"/> or <see cref="Create(IRecordProcessorFactory)"/>
/// to start building a processor configuration.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// // Simple fire-and-forget
/// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
///     .WithFilter(RecordFilter.ByStream("orders"))
///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
///
/// // Advanced: Get worker for runtime access
/// var worker = KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
///     .Build();
///
/// Console.WriteLine($"State: {worker.State}");
/// await worker.RunAsync(stoppingToken);
/// </code>
/// </example>
[PublicAPI]
public static class KurrentProcessors {
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a builder for the specified processor factory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="processorFactory">Factory to create processor instances.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="KurrentProcessorBuilder"/> for fluent configuration.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Use a factory when you need a new processor instance for each processing operation,
    /// such as when the processor maintains state or requires dependency injection.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessorFactory(logger))
    ///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
    ///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
    ///     .WithFilter(RecordFilter.ByStream("orders"))
    ///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public static KurrentProcessorBuilder Create(IRecordProcessorFactory processorFactory) => new(processorFactory);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a builder for the specified processor instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="processor">The record processor to run.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="KurrentProcessorBuilder"/> for fluent configuration.</returns>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// await KurrentProcessors.Create(new MyProcessor())
    ///     .ConnectTo("kurrentdb://localhost:2113")
    ///     .WithProcessorId("order-processor")
    ///     .RunAsync(stoppingToken);
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public static KurrentProcessorBuilder Create(IRecordProcessor processor) => Create(new PassthroughRecordProcessorFactory(processor));
}

class SafeRecordProcessor(IRecordProcessor inner) : IRecordProcessor {
    public async ValueTask OnInitialize(InitializationContext context) {
        try {
            await inner.OnInitialize(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException) {
            throw new InitializeException(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask ProcessRecords(ProcessRecordsContext context) {
        try {
            await inner.ProcessRecords(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException) {
            throw new ProcessRecordsException(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask OnCheckpoint(CheckpointContext context) {
        try {
            await inner.OnCheckpoint(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException) {
            throw new CheckpointException(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask OnPartitionsAssigned(PartitionsAssignedContext context) {
        try {
            await inner.OnPartitionsAssigned(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException) {
            throw new PartitionsAssignedException(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask OnShutdown(ShutdownContext context) {
        try {
            await inner.OnShutdown(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            throw new ShutdownException(ex);
        }
    }
}
sealed class KurrentProcessorWorker {
    readonly KurrentClient    _client;
    readonly IPositionTracker _tracker;
    readonly bool             _ownsClient;
    readonly IRecordProcessor _processor;
    readonly ILoggerFactory   _loggerFactory;
    long _startTimestamp;
    long _totalBatches;
    long _totalRecords;
    public KurrentProcessorWorker(KurrentClient client, IRecordProcessor processor, ProcessorSettings settings, ILoggerFactory loggerFactory) {
        _client        = client;
        _processor     = processor;
        _loggerFactory = loggerFactory;
        Settings       = settings;
        _ownsClient    = !client.Shared;
        _tracker       = new PositionTracker();
    }
    public string ProcessorId => Settings.ProcessorId;
    public string WorkerId    => Settings.WorkerId;
    public ProcessorSettings    Settings    { get; private set; }
    public ProcessorWorkerState State       { get; private set; } = ProcessorWorkerState.Unspecified;
    public CheckpointState      Checkpoints { get; private set; } = new();
    public SessionMetrics       Metrics     { get; private set; } = SessionMetrics.Empty;
    public async Task RunAsync(ProcessorSettings settings, CancellationToken stoppingToken) {
        _startTimestamp = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
        _totalRecords   = 0;
        _totalBatches   = 0;
        // var session = _client.Streams.StartProcess(settings);
        // Create checkpoint store for LocalRelay
        var checkpointStore = new WorkerCheckpointStore(
            processorId: settings.ProcessorId,
            workerId: settings.WorkerId,
            maxCount: settings.Checkpoint.RetentionCount,
            client: _client.Streams,
            time: TimeProvider.System,
            logger: _loggerFactory.CreateLogger<WorkerCheckpointStore>()
        );
        // Create LocalRelay for V2 Preview
        // var relay = new LocalGateway(_client.Streams, checkpointStore);
        IWorkerSession? session = null;
        try {
            State   = ProcessorWorkerState.Initializing;
            // session = await relay.ConnectAsync(Settings, stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            // Process messages from relay
            await foreach (var message in session.WithCancellation(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false)) {
                await message
                    .SwitchAsync(
                        evt => HandleWorkAssigned(evt, session, stoppingToken),
                        evt => HandleRecords(evt, session, stoppingToken),
                        evt => HandleCheckpointBarrier(evt, session, stoppingToken)
                    )
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            // Normal completion
            await HandleShutdown(session).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
            await HandleShutdown(session).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            await HandleShutdown(session, ex).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            if (session is not null)
                await session.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            // await relay.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (_ownsClient)
            await _client.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    async ValueTask HandleWorkAssigned(WorkAssigned assigned, IWorkerSession session, CancellationToken ct) {
        // Call OnInitialize first
        var initCtx = new InitializationContext(
            new WorkerSessionInfo(session.SessionId, session.WorkerId, session.ProcessorId),
            Settings,
            ct
        );
        await _processor.OnInitialize(initCtx).ConfigureAwait(false);
        // Notify partitions assigned
        var partitionsCtx = new PartitionsAssignedContext(
            new WorkerSessionInfo(session.SessionId, session.WorkerId, session.ProcessorId),
            assigned.Partitions.ToArray(),
            assigned.Reason,
            ct
        );
        await _processor.OnPartitionsAssigned(partitionsCtx).ConfigureAwait(false);
        // Signal ready to receive records
        State = ProcessorWorkerState.Running;
        await session.SendAsync(new WorkAccepted(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    async ValueTask HandleRecords(Record[] records, IWorkerSession session, CancellationToken ct) {
        var ctx = new ProcessRecordsContext(records, ct);
        await _processor.ProcessRecords(ctx).ConfigureAwait(false);
        _tracker.Track(records[^1].FullPosition);
        _totalRecords += records.Length;
        _totalBatches++;
    }
    async ValueTask HandleCheckpointBarrier(CheckpointBarrier barrier, IWorkerSession session,  CancellationToken ct) {
        // Get positions to checkpoint
        var positions = _tracker.Positions;
        if (positions.Length > 0) {
            // Build positions map (partition → position)
            var builder = ImmutableDictionary.CreateBuilder<int, LogPosition>();
            builder.Add(0, positions[^1].LogPosition);// V2 Preview uses single partition
            var positionsMap = builder.ToImmutable();
            // Flush tracker
            _tracker.FlushUpTo(positions[^1]);
            // Send checkpoint complete to relay (relay will persist)
            await session.SendAsync(new CheckpointComplete(barrier.CheckpointBarrierId, positionsMap), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        // Update checkpoint progress
        Checkpoints = new CheckpointState {
            TrackedPositions = _tracker.Positions
        };
        // Notify processor
        var ctx = new CheckpointContext(barrier.CheckpointBarrierId, barrier.Trigger, ct);
        await _processor.OnCheckpoint(ctx).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    async ValueTask HandleShutdown(IWorkerSession? session = null, Exception? ex = null) {
        State = ex is null ? ProcessorWorkerState.Stopped : State = ProcessorWorkerState.Failed;
        var metrics = SessionMetrics.From(_totalRecords, _totalBatches, _startTimestamp);
        var ctx = session is not null
            ? ShutdownContext.From(
                new WorkerSessionInfo(session.SessionId, session.WorkerId, session.ProcessorId),
                metrics,
                Checkpoints,
                ex
            )
            : ShutdownContext.From(
                new WorkerSessionInfo(session.SessionId, session.WorkerId, session.ProcessorId),
                metrics,
                Checkpoints,
                ex
            );
        await _processor.OnShutdown(ctx).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    // async ValueTask HandleDisconnected(IWorkerSession session, Disconnected disconnected) {
    //     var reason = disconnected.Reason switch {
    //         DisconnectedReason.Requested         => ShutdownReason.Completed,
    //         DisconnectedReason.ServerShutdown    => ShutdownReason.Cancelled,
    //         DisconnectedReason.CheckpointTimeout => ShutdownReason.Error,
    //         DisconnectedReason.Error             => ShutdownReason.Error,
    //         _                                    => ShutdownReason.Completed
    //     };
    //
    //     State = reason == ShutdownReason.Error ? ProcessorWorkerState.Failed : ProcessorWorkerState.Stopped;
    //
    //     var metrics = SessionMetrics.From(_totalRecords, _totalBatches, _startTimestamp);

    //     );

}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Configuration settings for a processor.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public record ProcessorSettings {

    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> High</para>

    /// <summary>

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // Client-only settings (local behavior, not sent to server)

    /// <summary>

    /// </remarks>
    public CheckpointFailurePolicy FailurePolicy { get; init; } = CheckpointFailurePolicy.Continue;
}
/// <summary>
/// Defines what happens when a checkpoint fails.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// A checkpoint fails if any worker doesn't acknowledge within the timeout.
/// The timed-out worker is always disconnected regardless of this policy.
/// This setting controls what happens to the OTHER workers.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public enum CheckpointFailurePolicy {
    /// <summary>
    /// Unspecified failure policy. The server will use the default behavior.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// Abort this checkpoint, continue processing.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// <list type="bullet">
    ///   <item>The checkpoint is marked as failed</item>
    ///   <item>Other workers continue processing from last successful checkpoint</item>
    ///   <item>Failed worker's partitions are reassigned to remaining workers</item>
    ///   <item>Next checkpoint triggers normally on interval/threshold</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Use when: High availability is priority, some data loss acceptable.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Continue = 1,
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>

    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>Use when: Data consistency is critical, prefer downtime over data loss.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    FailProcessor = 2
````

````csharp
#pragma warning disable CS8524 // The switch expression does not handle some values of its input type (it is not exhaustive) involving an unnamed enum value.
using System.Collections;
using Google.Protobuf.Collections;
using Google.Protobuf.WellKnownTypes;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
[PublicAPI]
static class RecordPropertiesMapper {
    public static Metadata MapToMetadata(this MapField<string, Value> source) =>
        source.Aggregate(
            new Metadata(),
            (seed, entry) => seed.With(entry.Key, MapToMetadataValue(entry.Value)));
    public static object? MapToMetadataValue(this Value source) {
        return source.KindCase switch {
            Value.KindOneofCase.NullValue   => null,
            Value.KindOneofCase.None        => null,
            Value.KindOneofCase.StringValue => source.StringValue,
            Value.KindOneofCase.BoolValue   => source.BoolValue,
            Value.KindOneofCase.NumberValue => source.NumberValue,
            Value.KindOneofCase.StructValue => source.StructValue.Fields.MapToMetadata(),
            Value.KindOneofCase.ListValue   => source.ListValue.Values.Select(MapToMetadataValue)
        };
    }
    public static MapField<string, Value> MapToMapField(this Metadata source) =>
        source.Aggregate(new MapField<string, Value>(), (seed, entry) => {
            seed.Add(entry.Key, MapToValue(entry.Value));
            return seed;
        });
    public record ValueMappingOptions(bool ConvertBytes = false);
    /// <summary>
    /// This is tricky, because we need to map a lot of different types to a protobuf value
    /// The main challenge is to decide what to do with byte arrays. We can either treat them as strings (base64) or as lists of numbers.
    /// By default we treat them as strings, but if the flag is set to true, we convert them to lists of numbers.
    /// Need to figure this out properly even with numbers, because protobuf only supports double as number type.
    /// perhaps we can go lazy with a try/catch around map to value and if it fails we convert to string?
    /// </summary>
    public static Value MapToValue(this object? source, bool treatByteArrayAsString = false) {
        if (source.IsNumber())
            return new Value { NumberValue = Convert.ToDouble(source) };
        // somehow I need to check if the source is somesort of collection or enumerableso I can map them to a list value
        if (source is IEnumerable and not string and not byte[] and not Metadata) {
            var values = ((IEnumerable)source).Cast<object?>()
                .Select(val => MapToValue(val, treatByteArrayAsString));
            return new Value { ListValue = new ListValue { Values = { values } } };
        }
        return source switch {
            null       => new Value { NullValue   = NullValue.NullValue },
            string x   => new Value { StringValue = x },
            bool x     => new Value { BoolValue   = x },
            // Metadata x => new Value { StructValue = new Struct { Fields = { x.MapToMapField() } } },
            // ReadOnlyMemory<byte> x => new Value { StringValue = Convert.ToBase64String(x.Span) },
            // Memory<byte> x         => new Value { StringValue = Convert.ToBase64String(x.Span) },
            // ArraySegment<byte> x   => new Value { StringValue = Convert.ToBase64String(x.Array ?? x.ToArray()) },
            // byte[] x               => new Value { StringValue = Convert.ToBase64String(x) },
            _ => new Value { StringValue = source.ToString() }
        };
    }
    static bool IsNumber(this object? obj) =>
        obj is int or double or float or decimal or long or short or byte or sbyte or ushort or uint or ulong;
    //
    // static bool TryConvertToDouble(this object? obj, out double number) {
````

````csharp
#pragma warning disable CS8524 // The switch expression does not handle some values of its input type (it is not exhaustive) involving an unnamed enum value.
````
