````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Checkpoints;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V1;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V2.Streams;
using Contracts = KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
static class StreamsClientV1Mapper {
    static readonly Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ControlOption       DefaultControlOption       = new() { Compatibility = 1 };
    static readonly Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.SubscriptionOptions DefaultSubscriptionOptions = new();
    static readonly Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.UUIDOption          DefaultUuidOptions         = new();
    static readonly Empty                                                     DefaultEmpty               = new();
    internal static class Requests {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to delete a stream at the specified revision.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.DeleteReq CreateDeleteRequest(StreamName stream, StreamRevision revision) {
            var req = new Contracts.DeleteReq { Options = new() { StreamIdentifier = stream.Value } };
            return revision == StreamRevision.Unset
                ? req.With(x => x.Options.StreamExists = DefaultEmpty)
                : req.With(x => x.Options.Revision = (ulong)revision.Value);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to tombstone a stream at the specified revision.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.TombstoneReq CreateTombstoneRequest(StreamName stream, StreamRevision revision) {
            var req = new Contracts.TombstoneReq { Options = new() { StreamIdentifier = stream.Value } };
            return revision == StreamRevision.Unset
                ? req.With(x => x.Options.StreamExists = DefaultEmpty)
                : req.With(x => x.Options.Revision = (ulong)revision.Value);
        }
        /// <summary>
        ///  Creates a request to read a single record from the log at the specified position, resolving links if necessary.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.ReadReq CreateInspectRecordRequest(LogPosition position) {
            return new Contracts.ReadReq { Options = new() {
                UuidOption    = DefaultUuidOptions,
                ControlOption = DefaultControlOption,
                NoFilter      = DefaultEmpty,
                Count         = 1,
                ResolveLinks  = true,
                All           = ConvertToAllOptions(position),
                ReadDirection = position == LogPosition.Latest
                    ? Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Backwards
                    : Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Forwards,
            }};
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to read the edge record from a stream in the specified direction.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.ReadReq CreateReadStreamEdgeRequest(StreamName stream, ReadDirection direction) {
            return new Contracts.ReadReq { Options = new() {
                UuidOption    = DefaultUuidOptions,
                ControlOption = DefaultControlOption,
                NoFilter      = DefaultEmpty,
                Count         = 1,
                ReadDirection = direction switch {
                    ReadDirection.Backwards => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Backwards,
                    ReadDirection.Forwards  => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Forwards,
                },
                Stream = ConvertToStreamOptions(stream, start: direction switch {
                    ReadDirection.Backwards => StreamRevision.Max,
                    ReadDirection.Forwards  => StreamRevision.Min,
                }),
            }};
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to read log records based on the provided options.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.ReadReq CreateReadLogRequest(ReadOptions options) {
            var req = new Contracts.ReadReq { Options = new() {
                UuidOption    = DefaultUuidOptions,
                ControlOption = DefaultControlOption,
                ReadDirection = options.Direction switch {
                    ReadDirection.Backwards => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Backwards,
                    ReadDirection.Forwards  => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Forwards,
                },
                All   = ConvertToAllOptions(options.Start),
                Count = (ulong)options.MaxRecords
            }};
            var filterOptions = ConvertToFilterOptions(options.Filter, options.Heartbeat);
            if (filterOptions is not null)
                req.Options.Filter = filterOptions;
            else
                req.Options.NoFilter = DefaultEmpty;
            return req;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to read records from a specific stream based on the provided options.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.ReadReq CreateReadStreamRequest(ReadStreamOptions options) {
            var req = new Contracts.ReadReq { Options = new() {
                UuidOption    = DefaultUuidOptions,
                ControlOption = DefaultControlOption,
                ReadDirection = options.Direction switch {
                    ReadDirection.Backwards => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Backwards,
                    ReadDirection.Forwards  => Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Forwards,
                },
                Stream = ConvertToStreamOptions(options.Stream, options.Start),
                Count  = (ulong)options.MaxRecords
            }};
            var filterOptions = ConvertToFilterOptions(options.Filter, options.Heartbeat);
            if (filterOptions is not null)
                req.Options.Filter = filterOptions;
            else
                req.Options.NoFilter = DefaultEmpty;
            return req;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a request to subscribe to records based on the provided processing options.
        /// </summary>
        public static Contracts.ReadReq CreateSubscriptionRequest(ProcessorSettings options) {
            var req = new Contracts.ReadReq { Options = new Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options {
                Subscription  = DefaultSubscriptionOptions,
                UuidOption    = DefaultUuidOptions,
                ControlOption = DefaultControlOption,
                ReadDirection = Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.ReadDirection.Forwards
            }};
            var subscription = options.Subscription;
            var heartbeat    = new HeartbeatOptions(true, options.Checkpoint.Threshold);
            // Convert StartPosition (long) to the appropriate position type
            var logPosition = subscription.StartPosition switch {
                0 when subscription.InitialPosition == SubscriptionInitialPosition.Earliest => LogPosition.Earliest,
                0 when subscription.InitialPosition == SubscriptionInitialPosition.Latest   => LogPosition.Latest,
                0                                                                           => LogPosition.Earliest,
                _                                                                           => LogPosition.From(subscription.StartPosition)
            };
            var streamRevision = subscription.StartPosition switch {
                0 => StreamRevision.Min,
                _ => StreamRevision.From(subscription.StartPosition)
            };
            if (subscription.Filter == RecordFilter.None)
                req.Options.NoFilter = DefaultEmpty;
            else if (subscription.Filter.TargetStream != StreamName.None && subscription.Filter.TargetStream != StreamName.All)
                req.Options.Stream = ConvertToStreamOptions(subscription.Filter.TargetStream, streamRevision);
            else {
                req.Options.All    = ConvertToAllOptions(logPosition);
                req.Options.Filter = ConvertToFilterOptions(subscription.Filter, heartbeat);
            }
            return req;
        }
        static Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.AllOptions ConvertToAllOptions(LogPosition start) =>
            start switch {
                _ when start == LogPosition.Latest   => new() { End      = DefaultEmpty },
                _ when start == LogPosition.Earliest => new() { Start    = DefaultEmpty },
                _                                    => new() { Position = new() { CommitPosition = start, PreparePosition = start } }
            };
        static Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.StreamOptions ConvertToStreamOptions(StreamName stream, StreamRevision start) =>
            start switch {
                _ when start == StreamRevision.Max => new() { StreamIdentifier = stream.Value, End      = DefaultEmpty },
                _ when start == StreamRevision.Min => new() { StreamIdentifier = stream.Value, Start    = DefaultEmpty },
                _                                  => new() { StreamIdentifier = stream.Value, Revision = (ulong)start.Value }
            };
        static Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.FilterOptions? ConvertToFilterOptions(IRecordFilter filter, HeartbeatOptions heartbeat) {
            Contracts.ReadReq.Types.Options.Types.FilterOptions? options = filter switch {
                StreamFilter f => new() { StreamIdentifier = new() { Regex = f.Expression } },
                SchemaFilter f => new() { EventType        = new() { Regex = f.Expression } },
                ExpressionFilter { ServerFilter: StreamFilter f } => new()  { StreamIdentifier = new() { Regex = f.Expression } },
                ExpressionFilter { ServerFilter: SchemaFilter f } => new () { EventType        = new() { Regex = f.Expression } },
                _ => null
            };
            if (options is null)
                return null;
            options.Max = (uint)heartbeat.RecordsThreshold;
            options.CheckpointIntervalMultiplier = 1;
            return options;
        }
    }
    public static Heartbeat MapToHeartbeat(this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.Checkpoint checkpoint, SequenceId sequenceId) {
        var position  = LogPosition.From((long)checkpoint.CommitPosition);
        var timestamp = checkpoint.Timestamp.ToDateTimeOffset();
        return Heartbeat.CreateCheckpoint(position, timestamp);
    }
    public static Heartbeat MapToHeartbeat(this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.CaughtUp caughtUp, SequenceId sequenceId) {
        var position  = caughtUp.Position is not null ? LogPosition.From((long)caughtUp.Position.CommitPosition) : LogPosition.Unset;
        var revision  = caughtUp.HasStreamRevision ? StreamRevision.From(caughtUp.StreamRevision) : StreamRevision.Unset;
        var timestamp = caughtUp.Timestamp.ToDateTimeOffset();
        return Heartbeat.CreateCaughtUp(position, revision, timestamp);
    }
    public static Heartbeat MapToHeartbeat(this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.FellBehind fellBehind, SequenceId sequenceId) {
        var position  = fellBehind.Position is not null ? LogPosition.From((long)fellBehind.Position.CommitPosition) : LogPosition.Unset;
        var revision  = fellBehind.HasStreamRevision ? StreamRevision.From(fellBehind.StreamRevision) : StreamRevision.Unset;
        var timestamp = fellBehind.Timestamp.ToDateTimeOffset();
        return Heartbeat.CreateFellBehind(position, revision, timestamp);
    }
    public static CheckpointBarrier MapToBarrier(this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.Checkpoint checkpoint, SequenceId sequenceId) {
        var position  = LogPosition.From((long)checkpoint.CommitPosition);
        var timestamp = checkpoint.Timestamp.ToDateTimeOffset();
        return new CheckpointBarrier(position, CheckpointTrigger.FilterTimeout, timestamp);
    }
    public static CheckpointBarrier MapToBarrier(this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.CaughtUp caughtUp, SequenceId sequenceId) {
        var position  = caughtUp.Position is not null ? LogPosition.From((long)caughtUp.Position.CommitPosition) : LogPosition.Unset;
        var revision  = caughtUp.HasStreamRevision ? StreamRevision.From(caughtUp.StreamRevision) : StreamRevision.Unset;
        var timestamp = caughtUp.Timestamp.ToDateTimeOffset();
       if (position == StreamRevision.Unset)
           throw new InvalidOperationException("Remember, without a position, we cannot create a checkpoint barrier!!! Revision: " + revision);
        return new CheckpointBarrier(position, CheckpointTrigger.CaughtUp, timestamp);
    }
    public static LogPosition MapToLogPosition(this Contracts.DeleteResp.Types.Position? position) =>
        position switch {
            null => LogPosition.Unset,
            _    => LogPosition.From((long)position.CommitPosition)
        };
    public static LogPosition MapToLogPosition(this Contracts.TombstoneResp.Types.Position? position) =>
        position switch {
            null => LogPosition.Unset,
            _    => LogPosition.From((long)position.CommitPosition)
        };
    public static async ValueTask<Record> MapToRecordAsync(
        this Contracts.ReadResp.Types.ReadEvent readEvent,
        SequenceId sequenceId,
        ISchemaSerializerProvider serializerProvider,
        IMetadataDecoder metadataDecoder,
        SchemaRegistryPolicy registryPolicy,
        bool skipDecoding = false,
        CancellationToken ct = default
    ) {
        var recordedEvent = readEvent.Event;
        // first parse all info
        var stream    = StreamName.From(recordedEvent.StreamIdentifier);
        var recordId  = Uuid.FromDto(recordedEvent.Id).ToGuid();
        var revision  = StreamRevision.From((long)recordedEvent.StreamRevision);
        var position  = LogPosition.From((long)recordedEvent.CommitPosition);
        var data      = recordedEvent.Data.Memory;
        var timestamp = Convert.ToInt64(recordedEvent.Metadata[Constants.Metadata.Created]).FromTicksSinceEpoch();
        // for v1 this is super weird because we have schema info in metadata
        // not needed anymore specially in v2 where we have schema as a first class concept
        var schemaFormat = recordedEvent.Metadata[Constants.Metadata.ContentType].GetSchemaDataFormat(); // it will always be json or octet-stream
        var schemaName   = SchemaName.From(recordedEvent.Metadata[Constants.Metadata.Type]);
        var metadata = await metadataDecoder
            .Decode(recordedEvent.CustomMetadata.Memory, new MetadataDecoderContext(stream, schemaName, schemaFormat))
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        var schema = metadata.ExtractSchemaInfo();
        var link = readEvent.Link is { } linkEvent
            ? new Link {
                Name     = linkEvent.Metadata[Constants.Metadata.Type],
                Position = (long)linkEvent.CommitPosition,
                Revision = (long)linkEvent.StreamRevision,
                Stream   = StreamName.From(linkEvent.StreamIdentifier!),
            }
            : Link.None;
        var indexRevision = readEvent.HasCommitPosition
            ? StreamRevision.From((long)readEvent.CommitPosition)
            : link.Revision == StreamRevision.Unset ? revision : link.Revision;
        // create a decoder
        IRecordDecoder decoder = new RecordDecoder(serializerProvider, registryPolicy);
        // and we are done
        var record = new Record(decoder) {
            Id             = recordId,
            Stream         = stream,
            StreamRevision = revision,
            Position       = position,
            Sequence       = sequenceId,
            Timestamp      = timestamp,
            Data           = data,
            Metadata       = metadata,
            Schema         = schema,
            // what? not sure...
            Link           = link,
            IndexRevision  = indexRevision
        };
        // now decode the record if required
        if (!skipDecoding)
            await record.TryDecode(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return record;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Represents a heartbeat message providing information about the state or progress of processing.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="Type">
/// The type of the heartbeat, indicating the nature of the event (e.g., checkpoint or caught-up).
/// </param>
/// <param name="Position">
/// The position in the stream or sequence associated with this heartbeat.
/// </param>
/// <param name="Timestamp">
/// The timestamp indicating when this heartbeat was generated.
/// </param>
[PublicAPI]
[method: SetsRequiredMembers]
public readonly record struct Heartbeat(HeartbeatType Type, LogPosition Position, StreamRevision StreamRevision, DateTimeOffset Timestamp) {
	public static readonly Heartbeat None = new(HeartbeatType.Unspecified, LogPosition.Unset, StreamRevision.Unset, DateTimeOffset.MinValue);
    // temporary until I fix it...
    public RecordPosition RecordPosition => HasPosition ? RecordPosition.FromLogPosition(Position) : RecordPosition.Unset;
	/// <summary>
	/// The type of the heartbeat, representing the nature of the event
	/// (e.g. indicating whether it is a checkpoint or a caught-up event).
	/// </summary>
	public required HeartbeatType Type { get; init; } = Type;
	/// <summary>
	/// The position in the stream or sequence associated with this heartbeat.
	/// This indicates the progress or location of the event in the processing sequence.
	/// </summary>
	public required LogPosition Position { get; init; } = Position;
	/// <summary>
	/// Represents a specific point in the stream or sequence.
	/// </summary>
	public required StreamRevision StreamRevision { get; init; } = StreamRevision;
	/// <summary>
	/// The timestamp indicating when this heartbeat message was generated.
	/// </summary>
	public required DateTimeOffset Timestamp { get; init; } = Timestamp;
	/// <summary>
	/// Determines whether the heartbeat indicates a checkpoint event,
	/// signifying a specific milestone or save point in the processing sequence.
	/// </summary>
	public bool IsCheckpoint => Type == HeartbeatType.Checkpoint;
	/// <summary>
	/// Indicates whether the heartbeat represents a "CaughtUp" event, signalling that processing is up to date
	/// with the current state of the stream or sequence.
	/// </summary>
	public bool IsCaughtUp => Type == HeartbeatType.CaughtUp;
	/// <summary>
	/// Indicates whether the heartbeat represents a "fell behind" event,
	/// meaning the process is no longer caught up with the expected stream position.
	/// </summary>
	public bool IsFellBehind => Type == HeartbeatType.FellBehind;
	public bool HasPosition => Position != LogPosition.Unset;
	public bool HasStreamRevision => StreamRevision != StreamRevision.Unset;
	public override string ToString() =>
		$"Heartbeat {{ Type = {Type}, Position = {Position}, StreamRevision = {StreamRevision}, Timestamp = {Timestamp:O} }}";
	public static Heartbeat CreateCheckpoint(LogPosition position, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.Checkpoint, position, StreamRevision.Unset, timestamp);
	public static Heartbeat CreateCaughtUp(LogPosition position, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.CaughtUp, position, StreamRevision.Unset,  timestamp);
	public static Heartbeat CreateFellBehind(LogPosition position, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.FellBehind, position, StreamRevision.Unset,  timestamp);
	public static Heartbeat CreateCheckpoint(LogPosition position, StreamRevision streamRevision, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.Checkpoint, position, streamRevision, timestamp);
	public static Heartbeat CreateCaughtUp(LogPosition position, StreamRevision streamRevision, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.CaughtUp, position, streamRevision, timestamp);
	public static Heartbeat CreateFellBehind(LogPosition position, StreamRevision streamRevision, DateTimeOffset timestamp) =>
		new(HeartbeatType.FellBehind, position, streamRevision, timestamp);
}
/// <summary>
/// Represents the type of heartbeat message.
/// A heartbeat indicates progress or a significant event in a sequence of operations.
/// </summary>
public enum HeartbeatType {
    Unspecified = 0,
    Checkpoint  = 1,
    CaughtUp    = 2,
    FellBehind  = 3,
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Represents the name of an index in KurrentDB.
/// </summary>
public readonly record struct IndexName {
    /// <summary>
    /// Represents an empty or unset index name.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly IndexName None = new("");
    internal IndexName(string value) => Value = value;
    /// <summary>
    /// The index name value.
    /// </summary>
    public string Value { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the index name as a string.
    /// </summary>
    public override string ToString() => Value;
    public static IndexName Parse(string? value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            InvalidIndexNameException.Throw("Index name cannot be null or whitespace.");
        if (!value.StartsWith(StreamName.IndexStreamsPrefix))
            InvalidIndexNameException.Throw($"Index name must start with '{StreamName.IndexStreamsPrefix}'.");
        return new(value);
    }
    public static implicit operator IndexName(string _) => Parse(_);
    public static implicit operator string(IndexName _) => _.ToString();
}
/// <summary>
/// Exception thrown when a index name is invalid.
/// </summary>
public sealed class InvalidIndexNameException(string message, Exception? innerException = null)
    : Exception(message, innerException), IThrowableException<InvalidIndexNameException> {
    public static InvalidIndexNameException Create(string message, Exception? innerException) => new(message, innerException);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct Partition : IComparable<Partition>, IComparable {
    public static readonly Partition Any = new(-1);
    Partition(int value) => Value = value;
    public int Value { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether this partition is <see cref="Any"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsAny => this == Any;
    public static Partition From(int value) {
        if (value < 0 && value != Any.Value)
            InvalidPartitionException.Throw($"Partition must range from 0 to {int.MaxValue}, or be {Any.Value} for 'Any'.");
        return new(value);
    }
    public static implicit operator int(Partition _) => _.Value;
    public static implicit operator Partition(int _) => From(_);
    public override string ToString() => Value.ToString();
    #region . relational members .
    public int CompareTo(Partition other) => Value.CompareTo(other.Value);
    public int CompareTo(object? obj) {
        if (ReferenceEquals(null, obj)) return 1;
        return obj is Partition other
            ? CompareTo(other)
            : throw new ArgumentException($"Object must be of type {nameof(Partition)}");
    }
    public static bool operator <(Partition left, Partition right)  => left.CompareTo(right) < 0;
    public static bool operator >(Partition left, Partition right)  => left.CompareTo(right) > 0;
    public static bool operator <=(Partition left, Partition right) => left.CompareTo(right) <= 0;
    public static bool operator >=(Partition left, Partition right) => left.CompareTo(right) >= 0;
    #endregion
}
public sealed class InvalidPartitionException(string message, Exception? innerException = null)
    : Exception(message, innerException), IThrowableException<InvalidPartitionException> {
    public static InvalidPartitionException Create(string message, Exception? innerException) => new(message, innerException);
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
public abstract record ReadOptionsBase {
    /// <summary>Maximum number of records to read in this operation.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> long.MaxValue (unlimited)</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Medium</para>
    /// <para><b>Valid Range:</b> Minimum 1 record</para>
    /// <para>Use to implement "read first N records" scenarios and control resource usage.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public long MaxRecords { get; init; } = long.MaxValue;
    /// <summary>Number of records to buffer in memory during streaming read operations.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> 1000 records</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Medium</para>
    /// <para><b>Valid Range:</b> 1 to 10,000 records</para>
    /// <para>Controls backpressure. Larger buffers improve throughput but increase memory usage.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public int BufferCapacity { get; init; } = 1000;
    /// <summary>Record filtering criteria to apply during read operations.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> RecordFilter.None (no filtering)</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Medium</para>
    /// <para>Filters can target specific schemas, metadata properties, or custom predicates to reduce data transfer and processing overhead.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public IRecordFilter Filter { get; init; } = RecordFilter.None;
    /// <summary>Heartbeat configuration for long-running read operations.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> HeartbeatOptions.Disabled</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Medium</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public HeartbeatOptions Heartbeat { get; init; } = HeartbeatOptions.Disabled;
    /// <summary>Direction for reading records through the stream or log.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> ReadDirection.Forwards</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> High</para>
    /// <para>Forwards reads from the specified start position toward newer records. Backwards reads toward older records.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public ReadDirection Direction { get; init; } = ReadDirection.Forwards;
    /// <summary>Skip record data deserialization for performance-critical scenarios.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> false (decode records)</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Low</para>
    /// <para>When true, records are returned as raw bytes without deserialization, reducing CPU usage for metadata-only operations or custom deserialization.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public bool SkipDecoding { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Cancellation token for cooperative cancellation of read operations.</summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> CancellationToken.None</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> Medium</para>
    /// <para>Enables graceful shutdown and timeout handling in distributed systems and user-interactive scenarios.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public CancellationToken CancellationToken { get; init; } = CancellationToken.None;
    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the current options and throws exceptions for any invalid configurations.
    /// </summary>
    public virtual void EnsureValid() {
        if (Heartbeat.Enable) {
            ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(Heartbeat.RecordsThreshold, 1);
            ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(Heartbeat.RecordsThreshold, 10000);
        }
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(BufferCapacity, 1);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(BufferCapacity, 10000);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(MaxRecords, 1);
    }
}
[PublicAPI]
public record ReadOptions : ReadOptionsBase {
    /// <summary>
    /// Starting position for the read operation in either stream or global log context.
    /// </summary>
    public LogPosition Start { get; init; } = LogPosition.Latest;
}
[PublicAPI]
public record ReadStreamOptions : ReadOptionsBase {
    /// <summary>
    /// Name of the stream to read from.
    /// </summary>
    public StreamName Stream { get; init; } = StreamName.None;
    /// <summary>
````

````csharp
sealed class NoOpRecordDecoder : IRecordDecoder {

    public ValueTask<bool> Decode(Record record, CancellationToken ct) => ValueTask.FromResult(false);
}
sealed class RecordDecoder(ISchemaSerializerProvider serializerProvider, SchemaRegistryPolicy? registryPolicy = null) : IRecordDecoder {
	static readonly SchemaName LinkSchemaName = "$>";
	SchemaRegistryPolicy RegistryPolicy { get; } = registryPolicy ?? SchemaRegistryPolicy.NoRequirements;
	public async ValueTask<bool> Decode(Record record, CancellationToken ct) {
		if (record.IsDecoded)
			return true;
		if (record.Schema.SchemaName == LinkSchemaName) {
			record.Value = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(record.Data.Span);
			return true;
		}
        // we do not decode bytes - I wonder if we even need to have a bytes serializer at all
        // currently Deserialize would work and return the bytes as is, but that seems pointless.
        // because we do not want to copy data to value if its bytes.
        // full circle.
        if (record.Schema.SchemaFormat == SchemaDataFormat.Bytes)
            return false;
        var context = new SchemaSerializationContext {
			Stream               = record.Stream,
            RecordSchema         = record.Schema,
			SchemaRegistryPolicy = RegistryPolicy,
			CancellationToken    = ct
		};
        // the deserializer should not even return null.
        // either throws or returns a value or returns a result <T, Error>
        // why the fook would we allow nulls here ffs?!
		record.Value = await serializerProvider
			.GetSerializer(record.Schema.SchemaFormat)
			.Deserialize(record.Data, context)
			.ConfigureAwait(false)!;
        if (record.Value is not null)
            record.ValueType = record.Value.GetType();
        return true;
	}
}
````

````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Threading.Channels;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
using Kurrent.Variant;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Provides efficient batched reading of records.
/// Batches records by size and timeout, flushing immediately on heartbeats.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public record RecordBatchStream : IAsyncEnumerable<ReadRecordBatchResult>, IAsyncDisposable {
    readonly Lazy<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>> _lazyChannel;
    readonly int      _batchSize;
    readonly TimeSpan _timeout;
    long _totalRecordsRead;
    long _totalBatchesRead;
    int  _disposed;
    int  _enumeratorCreated;
    internal RecordBatchStream(Func<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>> channelFactory, int batchSize, TimeSpan timeout) {
        _lazyChannel = new Lazy<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>>(channelFactory);
        _batchSize   = batchSize;
        _timeout     = timeout;
    }
    internal RecordBatchStream(Func<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>> channelFactory, int batchSize, long timeout)
        : this(channelFactory, batchSize, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeout)) { }
    Channel<ReadRecordsResult> Channel => _lazyChannel.Value;
    public long TotalRecordsRead => Interlocked.Read(ref _totalRecordsRead);
    public long TotalBatchesRead => Interlocked.Read(ref _totalBatchesRead);
    /// <summary>
    /// The number of items currently queued for processing.
    /// </summary>
    public int QueuedMessages => _lazyChannel.IsValueCreated ? Channel.Reader.Count : 0;
    public virtual async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (!_lazyChannel.IsValueCreated || Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 1, 0) != 0)
            return;
        Channel.Writer.TryComplete();
        // wait for completion but don't propagate exceptions
        // errors should surface through enumeration, not dispose
        try {
            await Channel.Reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch {
            // swallow - exception was already propagated via GetAsyncEnumerator
        }
    }
    // works but needs to be optimized.
    public async IAsyncEnumerator<ReadRecordBatchResult> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 0, 0) == 1, this);
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _enumeratorCreated, 1, 0) == 1)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Records already enumerated.");
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            yield break;
        var reader = Channel.Reader;
        var buffer = ArrayPool<Record>.Shared.Rent(_batchSize);
        var count  = 0;
        try {
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var start = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
                while (count < _batchSize) {
                    var remainingTime = _timeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(start);
                    if (remainingTime <= TimeSpan.Zero) break;
                    var waitTask = reader.WaitToReadAsync(ct);
                    bool hasData;
                    if (waitTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                        hasData = waitTask.Result;
                    else
                        try {
                            hasData = await waitTask.AsTask()
                                .WaitAsync(remainingTime, ct)
                                .ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch (TimeoutException) {
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                            yield break;
                        }
                    if (!hasData) {
                        // channel completed - yield remaining
                        if (count > 0) {
                            yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                            Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                            Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                            // count =  0;
                        }
                        // propagate any exception from channel completion
                        try {
                            await reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                            // ignore cancellation
                        }
                        yield break;
                    }
                    // drain available items
                    while (count < _batchSize && reader.TryRead(out var message))
                        if (message.IsHeartbeat) {
                            // flush pending records, then yield heartbeat
                            if (count > 0) {
                                yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                                Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                                Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                                count = 0;
                            }
                            yield return message.AsHeartbeat;
                        }
                        else
                            buffer[count++] = message.AsRecord;
                }
                // yield batch on size/timeout
                if (count > 0) {
                    yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                    Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                    Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                    count =  0;
                }
            }
        }
        finally {
            ArrayPool<Record>.Shared.Return(buffer, true);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Represents the record's position in detail in the system.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// A log position uniquely and unambiguously identifies a record in the system.
/// Therefore, and when relevant, it can be used to obtain the record's stream
/// information.
/// <para />
/// This type encapsulates the details of a record's position in the system,
/// and allows it to be represented in different ways depending on the context.
/// * A record can be identified solely by its log position.
/// * A record can be identified by its stream and stream revision.
/// * A record can be identified by its stream, stream revision and partition.
/// <para />
/// A stream ID is a powerful identifier since it might contain multiple parts such as:
/// * Category
/// * Natural Partition Key Value or Entity ID
/// * Partition : "games-2077|001"
/// <para />
/// Stream ID, revision and partition are simply details associated with
/// that log position. In scenarios where only the log position is known or relevant,
/// the other properties can be left unset or set to their respective "none" values.
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct RecordPosition() : IComparable<RecordPosition>, IComparable {
    public static readonly RecordPosition Unset    = new();
    public static readonly RecordPosition Earliest = new() { LogPosition = LogPosition.Earliest };
    public static readonly RecordPosition Latest   = new() { LogPosition = LogPosition.Latest };
    public LogPosition LogPosition { get; init; } = LogPosition.Unset;
    /// <summary>
    /// The stream name. Use <see cref="StreamName.None"/> for log position only.
    /// </summary>
    public StreamName Stream { get; init; } = StreamName.None;
    /// <summary>
    /// The stream revision. Use <see cref="StreamRevision.Unset"/> if not applicable.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// A log position uniquely and unambiguously identifies a record in the system.
    /// Therefore, and when relevant, it can be used to obtain the record's stream information.
    /// <para />
    ///
    /// In a stream will always belong to a stream revision and a log position. Nonetheless,
    /// there are scenarios where only one of these values is known or relevant. In such cases,
    /// you can use <see cref="StreamRevision.Unset"/> or <see cref="LogPosition.Unset"/> to indicate
    /// that the respective value is not set or not applicable.
    /// </remarks>
    public StreamRevision StreamRevision { get; init; } = StreamRevision.Unset;
    public Partition      Partition      { get; init; } = Partition.Any;
    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether this position is <see cref="Unset"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsUnset => this == Unset;
    [Experimental("KNET0001")]
    internal StreamName StreamPartition =>
        Partition > Partition.Any
            ? $"{Stream}-{Partition.Value:0000}" : Stream;
    public override string ToString() {
        return Stream == StreamName.None
            ? $"@{LogPosition}"
            : Partition == Partition.Any
                ? $"{Stream} @{LogPosition}"
                : $"{Stream} [{Partition}] @{LogPosition}";
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a record position from a specific log position.
    /// This position can be used to read from the log directly or to obtain the record's stream information.
    /// </summary>
    public static RecordPosition FromLogPosition(LogPosition logPosition, Partition? partition = null) {
        if (logPosition == LogPosition.Unset)
            throw new ArgumentException("LogPosition cannot be Unset.", nameof(logPosition));
        return new RecordPosition {
            LogPosition = logPosition,
            Partition = partition ?? Partition.Any
        };
    }
    // /// <summary>
    // /// Creates a record position from a specific log position.
    // /// This position can be used to read from the log directly or to obtain the record's stream information.
    // /// </summary>
    // public static RecordPosition FromLogPosition(LogPosition logPosition) {
    //     if (logPosition == LogPosition.Unset)
    //         throw new ArgumentException("LogPosition cannot be Unset.", nameof(logPosition));
    //
    //     return new RecordPosition { LogPosition = logPosition };
    // }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a record position from a specific stream and stream revision, with an optional log position and partition.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// A record in a stream will always have both a stream revision and a log position. Nonetheless,
    /// there are scenarios where only one of these values is known or relevant. In such cases,
    /// you can use <see cref="StreamRevision.Unset"/> or <see cref="LogPosition.Unset"/> to indicate
    /// that the respective value is not set or not applicable.
    /// If the stream is not partitioned, use <see cref="Partition.Any"/> or omit the parameter.
    /// </remarks>
    public static RecordPosition FromStream(StreamName stream, StreamRevision revision, LogPosition? logPosition = null, Partition? partition = null) {
        if (stream == StreamName.None)
            throw new ArgumentException("Stream cannot be None.", nameof(stream));
        return new RecordPosition {
            Stream         = stream,
            StreamRevision = revision,
            Partition      = partition ?? Partition.Any,
            LogPosition    = logPosition ?? LogPosition.Unset
        };
    }
    public static RecordPosition FromStream(StreamName stream, LogPosition logPosition) {
        if (stream == StreamName.None)
            throw new ArgumentException("Stream cannot be None.", nameof(stream));
        if (logPosition == LogPosition.Unset)
            throw new ArgumentException("LogPosition cannot be Unset.", nameof(logPosition));
        return new RecordPosition {
            Stream         = stream,
            LogPosition    = logPosition
        };
    }
    #region . relational members .
    public int CompareTo(RecordPosition other) => LogPosition.CompareTo(other.LogPosition);
    public int CompareTo(object? obj) {
        if (ReferenceEquals(null, obj))
            return 1;
        return obj is RecordPosition other ? CompareTo(other) : throw new ArgumentException($"Object must be of type {nameof(RecordPosition)}");
    }
    public static bool operator <(RecordPosition left, RecordPosition right)  => left.CompareTo(right) < 0;
    public static bool operator >(RecordPosition left, RecordPosition right)  => left.CompareTo(right) > 0;
    public static bool operator <=(RecordPosition left, RecordPosition right) => left.CompareTo(right) <= 0;
    public static bool operator >=(RecordPosition left, RecordPosition right) => left.CompareTo(right) >= 0;
    #endregion
    public static implicit operator RecordPosition(LogPosition position) => FromLogPosition(position);
    public static implicit operator RecordPosition(long position)        => FromLogPosition(position);
    public static implicit operator long(RecordPosition position)        => position.LogPosition;
}
````

````csharp
using System.Threading.Channels;
using Kurrent.Variant;
using static System.Threading.Interlocked;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
[PublicAPI]
public record RecordStream : RecordStream<ReadRecordsResult> {
    protected internal RecordStream(Func<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>> channelFactory) : base(channelFactory) { }
}
[PublicAPI]
public record RecordStream<T> : IAsyncEnumerable<T>, IAsyncDisposable {
    int _disposed;
    int _enumeratorCreated;
    readonly Lazy<Channel<T>> _lazyChannel;
    protected internal RecordStream(Func<Channel<T>> channelFactory) =>
        _lazyChannel = new Lazy<Channel<T>>(channelFactory);
    Channel<T> Channel => _lazyChannel.Value;
    /// <summary>
    /// The number of items currently queued for processing
    /// </summary>
    public int QueuedMessages => _lazyChannel.IsValueCreated ? Channel.Reader.Count : 0;
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (!_lazyChannel.IsValueCreated || CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 1, 0) != 0)
            return;
        Channel.Writer.TryComplete();
        // wait for completion but don't propagate exceptions
        // errors should surface through enumeration, not dispose
        try {
            await Channel.Reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        } catch {
            // swallow - exception was already propagated via GetAsyncEnumerator
        }
    }
    public async IAsyncEnumerator<T> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 0, 0) == 1, this);
        if (CompareExchange(ref _enumeratorCreated, 1, 0) == 1)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Items already enumerated.");
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            yield break;
        var reader = Channel.Reader;
        while (true) {
            bool canRead;
            try {
                canRead = await reader.WaitToReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                yield break;
            }
            if (!canRead) {
                // propagate any exception from channel completion
                try {
                    await reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                    // ignore cancellation
                }
                yield break;
            }
            while (reader.TryRead(out var message))
                yield return message;
        }
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// The result of a read records operation, which can be either a <see cref="Record"/> or a <see cref="Heartbeat"/>.
/// </summary>
public readonly partial record struct ReadRecordsResult : IVariant<Record, Heartbeat> {

}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Surge.Transformers;
[PublicAPI]
public static class RedactionExtensions {
    public static Span<byte> Redact(this Span<byte> data) {
        data.Fill(0xFF);
        return data;
    }
    public static byte[] Redact(this byte[] data) =>
        Redact(data.AsSpan()).ToArray();
    public static ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Redact(this ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data) =>
        Redact(data.ToArray());
    public static Record Redact(this Record record) =>
        record with {
            Value      = null!,
            ValueType  = null!,
            Data       = record.Data.Redact(),
            IsRedacted = true
        };
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Specifies the data format for schema content.
/// </summary>
public enum SchemaDataFormat {
    /// <summary>
    /// The data format is not specified.
    /// </summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>
    /// The data is in JSON format.
    /// </summary>
    Json = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// The data is in Protocol Buffers format.
    /// </summary>
    Protobuf = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// The data is in Avro format.
    /// </summary>
    Avro = 3,
    /// <summary>
    /// The data is in raw bytes format.
    /// </summary>
    Bytes = 4
}
/// <summary>
/// Provides extension methods for the <see cref="SchemaDataFormat"/> enum.
/// </summary>
static class SchemaDataFormatExtensions {
	const string JsonContentType     = "application/json";
	const string ProtobufContentType = "application/vnd.google.protobuf";
	const string AvroContentType     = "application/vnd.apache.avro+json";
	const string BytesContentType    = "application/octet-stream";
    /// <param name="dataFormat">The schema data format.</param>
    extension(SchemaDataFormat dataFormat) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the corresponding content type string for a <see cref="SchemaDataFormat"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>The content type string.</returns>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException">Thrown if the <paramref name="dataFormat"/> is not a defined value in the <see cref="SchemaDataFormat"/> enum.</exception>
        public string GetContentType() =>
            dataFormat switch {
                SchemaDataFormat.Json        => JsonContentType,
                SchemaDataFormat.Protobuf    => ProtobufContentType,
                SchemaDataFormat.Avro        => AvroContentType,
                SchemaDataFormat.Bytes       => BytesContentType,
                SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified => BytesContentType,
                _                            => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(dataFormat), dataFormat, null)
            };
    }
    /// <param name="contentType">The content type string. The comparison is case-insensitive.</param>
    extension(string contentType) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the <see cref="SchemaDataFormat"/> enum value corresponding to a content type string.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>The corresponding <see cref="SchemaDataFormat"/> and <see cref="SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified"/> if the content type is not recognized.</returns>
        public SchemaDataFormat GetSchemaDataFormat() {
            Debug.Assert(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentType), "Content type should not be empty");
            return contentType.ToLower() switch {
                JsonContentType     => SchemaDataFormat.Json,
                ProtobufContentType => SchemaDataFormat.Protobuf,
                AvroContentType     => SchemaDataFormat.Avro,
                BytesContentType    => SchemaDataFormat.Bytes,
                _                   => SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified
            };
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Represents a stream category in KurrentDB.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Categories are derived from stream names using a separator character.
/// For example, with separator '-' and position 'first', stream "order-123" has category "order".
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The category extraction behavior can be configured to match your KurrentDB $by_category projection settings.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct StreamCategory {
    /// <summary>
    /// Represents an empty or unset category.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly StreamCategory None = new("");
    internal StreamCategory(string value) => Value = value;
    /// <summary>
    /// The category name value.
    /// </summary>
    public string Value { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the category name as a string.
    /// </summary>
    public override string ToString() => Value;
    /// <summary>
    /// Parses a category from a stream name using the specified options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="streamName">The stream name to extract the category from.</param>
    /// <param name="options">
    /// Options controlling how the category is extracted.
    /// If null, <see cref="CategoryParseOptions.Default"/> is used (separator: '-', position: First).
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="StreamCategory"/> extracted from the stream name.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidCategoryNameException">Thrown when the stream name is null or whitespace.</exception>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Examples with default options (separator: '-', position: First):
    /// <code>
    /// "order-123"           → "order"
    /// "shopping-cart-1"     → "shopping"
    /// "orders"              → "orders"
    /// </code>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Examples with position: Last:
    /// <code>
    /// "shopping-cart-1"     → "shopping-cart"
    /// "user-profile-v2"     → "user-profile"
    /// </code>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static StreamCategory Parse(string? streamName, CategoryParseOptions? options = null) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(streamName))
            InvalidCategoryNameException.Throw("Stream name cannot be null or whitespace.");
        return Parse(streamName.AsSpan(), options);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Parses a category from a stream name span using the specified options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="streamName">The stream name span to extract the category from.</param>
    /// <param name="options">
    /// Options controlling how the category is extracted.
    /// If null, <see cref="CategoryParseOptions.Default"/> is used (separator: '-', position: First).
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="StreamCategory"/> extracted from the stream name.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidCategoryNameException">Thrown when the stream name is empty.</exception>
    public static StreamCategory Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char> streamName, CategoryParseOptions? options = null) {
        if (streamName.IsEmpty)
            InvalidCategoryNameException.Throw("Stream name cannot be empty.");
        var opts = options ?? CategoryParseOptions.Default;
        var separatorIndex = opts.SeparatorPosition == CategorySeparatorPosition.First
            ? streamName.IndexOf(opts.Separator)
            : streamName.LastIndexOf(opts.Separator);
        // No separator found or separator at start - entire name is category
        return separatorIndex <= 0
            ? new(streamName.ToString())
            : new(streamName[..separatorIndex].ToString());
    }
    public static implicit operator StreamCategory(string _) => Parse(_);
    public static implicit operator string(StreamCategory _) => _.ToString();
}
/// <summary>
/// Determines which occurrence of the separator to use when extracting a category from a stream name.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This matches the KurrentDB $by_category projection configuration.
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public enum CategorySeparatorPosition {
    /// <summary>
    /// Use the first occurrence of the separator.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>Example: "account-9E763770-0A8D-456D-AF23" → category "account"</para>
    /// </remarks>
    First,
    /// <summary>
    /// Use the last occurrence of the separator.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>Example: "shopping-cart-1" → category "shopping-cart"</para>
    /// </remarks>
    Last
}
/// <summary>
/// Options for parsing stream categories from stream names.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// These options match the KurrentDB $by_category projection configuration parameters.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// The $by_category projection has two configuration parameters:
/// <list type="bullet">
/// <item><description><b>Position:</b> first or last — determines which occurrence of the separator to use</description></item>
/// <item><description><b>Separator:</b> any single character (default: -)</description></item>
/// </list>
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct CategoryParseOptions() {
    const char DefaultSeparator = '-';
    /// <summary>
    /// Default options: separator '-' with first position.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly CategoryParseOptions Default = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// The separator character used to delimit the category from the rest of the stream name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> <see cref="DefaultSeparator"/> ('-')</para>
    /// <para>
    /// This should match your KurrentDB $by_category projection separator configuration.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public char Separator { get; init; } = DefaultSeparator;
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines which occurrence of the separator to use when extracting the category.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> <see cref="CategorySeparatorPosition.First"/></para>
    /// <para>
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description><b>First:</b> "account-9E763770-0A8D" → category "account"</description></item>
    /// <item><description><b>Last:</b> "shopping-cart-1" → category "shopping-cart"</description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public CategorySeparatorPosition SeparatorPosition { get; init; } = CategorySeparatorPosition.First;
}
/// <summary>
/// Exception thrown when a category name is invalid.
/// </summary>
public sealed class InvalidCategoryNameException(string message, Exception? innerException = null)
    : Exception(message, innerException), IThrowableException<InvalidCategoryNameException> {
    public static InvalidCategoryNameException Create(string message, Exception? innerException) => new(message, innerException);
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent;
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
/// <summary>
/// The exception that is thrown when <see cref="System.Net.EndPoint"/> discovery fails.
/// </summary>
public class DiscoveryException : KurrentException {
	/// <summary>
	/// Constructs a new <see cref="DiscoveryException"/>.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="message"></param>
	/// <param name="innerException"></param>
	[Obsolete]
	public DiscoveryException(string message, Exception? innerException = null) : base(ErrorCode.FromType<DiscoveryException>(), message, innerException) =>
		MaxDiscoverAttempts = 0;
	/// <summary>
	/// Constructs a new <see cref="DiscoveryException"/>.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="maxDiscoverAttempts">The configured number of discovery attempts.</param>
	public DiscoveryException(int maxDiscoverAttempts) : base(ErrorCode.FromType<DiscoveryException>(), $"Failed to discover candidate in {maxDiscoverAttempts} attempts.") =>
		MaxDiscoverAttempts = maxDiscoverAttempts;
	/// <summary>
	/// The configured number of discovery attempts.
	/// </summary>
	public int MaxDiscoverAttempts { get; }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Legacy/RipAndTear/Client/Gossip/Selectors/GossipChannelSelector.cs
````csharp
using System.Net;
using Grpc.Net.Client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
// Thread safe
class GossipChannelSelector : IChannelSelector {
	readonly KurrentDBClientSettings        _settings;
	readonly ChannelCache                   _channels;
	readonly IGossipClient                  _gossipClient;
	readonly ILogger<GossipChannelSelector> _log;
	readonly NodeSelector                   _nodeSelector;
	public GossipChannelSelector(KurrentDBClientSettings settings, ChannelCache channelCache, IGossipClient gossipClient) {
		_settings     = settings;
		_channels     = channelCache;
		_gossipClient = gossipClient;
		_log          = settings.LoggerFactory.CreateLogger<GossipChannelSelector>();
		_nodeSelector = new(_settings.ConnectivitySettings.NodePreference);
	}
	public (GrpcChannel Channel, GrpcChannelOptions Options) SelectEndpointChannel(DnsEndPoint endPoint) =>
		_channels.CreateChannel(endPoint);
	public async Task<(GrpcChannel Channel, GrpcChannelOptions Options)> SelectChannelAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
		var endPoint = await DiscoverAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
		_log.LogInformation("Successfully discovered candidate at {endPoint}.", endPoint);
		return _channels.CreateChannel(endPoint);
	}
	async Task<DnsEndPoint> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
		for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= _settings.ConnectivitySettings.MaxDiscoverAttempts; attempt++) {
			foreach (var kvp in _channels.GetRandomOrderSnapshot()) {
				var endPointToGetGossip = kvp.Key;
				var channelToGetGossip  = kvp.Value;
				try {
					var clusterInfo = await _gossipClient
						.GetAsync(channelToGetGossip, cancellationToken)
						.ConfigureAwait(false);
					var selectedEndpoint = _nodeSelector.SelectNode(clusterInfo);
					// Successfully selected an endpoint using this gossip!
					// We want _channels to contain exactly the nodes in ClusterInfo.
					// nodes no longer in the cluster can be forgotten.
					// new nodes are added so we can use them to get gossip.
					_channels.UpdateCache(clusterInfo.Members.Select(x => x.EndPoint).ToArray());
					return selectedEndpoint;
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					_log.Log(
						GetLogLevelForDiscoveryAttempt(attempt),
						ex,
						"Could not discover candidate from {endPoint}. Attempts remaining: {remainingAttempts}",
						endPointToGetGossip,
						_settings.ConnectivitySettings.MaxDiscoverAttempts - attempt);
				}
			}
			// couldn't select a node from any _channel. reseed the channels.
			_channels.UpdateCache(_settings.ConnectivitySettings.GossipSeeds);
			await Task
				.Delay(_settings.ConnectivitySettings.DiscoveryInterval, cancellationToken)
				.ConfigureAwait(false);
		}
		_log.LogError("Failed to discover candidate in {maxDiscoverAttempts} attempts.",
			_settings.ConnectivitySettings.MaxDiscoverAttempts);
		throw new DiscoveryException(_settings.ConnectivitySettings.MaxDiscoverAttempts);
		LogLevel GetLogLevelForDiscoveryAttempt(int attempt) => attempt switch {
			_ when attempt == _settings.ConnectivitySettings.MaxDiscoverAttempts => LogLevel.Error,
			1                                                                    => LogLevel.Warning,
			_                                                                    => LogLevel.Debug
		};
	}
}
````

````csharp
		_channelCache = channelCache;
		var uri = settings.ConnectivitySettings.Address!;

		_log      = settings.LoggerFactory.CreateLogger<SingleNodeChannelSelector>();

		return _channelCache.CreateChannel(endPoint);
	}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Legacy/RipAndTear/Client/Gossip/ChannelCache.cs
````csharp
using System.Net;
using Grpc.Core;
using Grpc.Net.Client;
using Kurrent.Client.Legacy;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
// Maintains Channels keyed by DnsEndPoint so the channels can be reused.
// Deals with the disposal difference between grpc.net and grpc.core
// Thread safe.
class ChannelCache(KurrentDBClientSettings settings) : IAsyncDisposable {
    readonly Dictionary<DnsEndPoint, (GrpcChannel Channel, GrpcChannelOptions Options)> _channels = new(DnsEndPointEqualityComparer.Instance);
    readonly object _lock   = new();
    readonly Random _random = new(0);
    bool            _disposed;
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        GrpcChannel[] channelsToDispose;
        lock (_lock) {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            channelsToDispose = _channels.Values.Select(x => x.Channel).ToArray();
            _channels.Clear();
        }
        await DisposeChannelsAsync(channelsToDispose).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    public (GrpcChannel Channel, GrpcChannelOptions Options) CreateChannel(DnsEndPoint endPoint) {
        lock (_lock) {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            if (_channels.TryGetValue(endPoint, out var channelInfo))
                return channelInfo;
            var channel = settings.CreateChannel(endPoint, out var options);
            return _channels[endPoint] = (channel, options);
        }
    }
    public KeyValuePair<DnsEndPoint, GrpcChannel>[] GetRandomOrderSnapshot() {
        lock (_lock) {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            return _channels
                .OrderBy(_ => _random.Next())
                .Select(kvp => new KeyValuePair<DnsEndPoint, GrpcChannel>(kvp.Key, kvp.Value.Channel))
                .ToArray();
        }
    }
    // Update the cache to contain channels for exactly these endpoints
    public void UpdateCache(DnsEndPoint[] endPoints) {
        lock (_lock) {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            // Create a HashSet for efficient lookups
            var endPointSet       = new HashSet<DnsEndPoint>(endPoints, DnsEndPointEqualityComparer.Instance);
            var channelsToDispose = new List<GrpcChannel>();
            // Remove entries not in the new set (single pass)
            foreach (var kvp in _channels.Where(kvp => !endPointSet.Contains(kvp.Key))) {
                _channels.Remove(kvp.Key);
                channelsToDispose.Add(kvp.Value.Channel);
            }
            // Dispose removed channels
            if (channelsToDispose.Count > 0)
                _ = DisposeChannelsAsync(channelsToDispose);
            // Add new endpoints (avoiding duplication)
            foreach (var endPoint in endPoints)
                if (!_channels.ContainsKey(endPoint))
                    CreateChannel(endPoint);
        }
    }
    void ThrowIfDisposed() {
        lock (_lock) {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().ToString());
        }
    }
    static Task DisposeChannelsAsync(IEnumerable<GrpcChannel> channels) {
        return Task.WhenAll(channels.Select(channel => DisposeAsync(channel).AsTask()));
        static async ValueTask DisposeAsync(ChannelBase channel) {
            await channel.ShutdownAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            (channel as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
        }
    }
    class DnsEndPointEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DnsEndPoint> {
        public static readonly DnsEndPointEqualityComparer Instance = new();
        public bool Equals(DnsEndPoint? x, DnsEndPoint? y) {
            if (ReferenceEquals(x, y))
                return true;
            if (x is null)
                return false;
            if (y is null)
                return false;
            if (x.GetType() != y.GetType())
                return false;
            return
                string.Equals(x.Host, y.Host, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                x.Port == y.Port;
        }
        public int GetHashCode(DnsEndPoint obj) {
            unchecked {
                return (StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(obj.Host) * 397) ^
                       obj.Port;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Legacy/RipAndTear/Client/Gossip/ChannelFactoryExtensions.cs
````csharp
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using Grpc.Net.Client;
using KurrentDB.Client;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Legacy;
static class ChannelFactoryExtensions {
    const int MaxReceiveMessageLength = 17 * 1024 * 1024; // 17MB
    public static GrpcChannel CreateChannel(this KurrentDBClientSettings settings, DnsEndPoint endPoint, out GrpcChannelOptions options) {
        var address = new UriBuilder {
            Scheme = settings.ConnectivitySettings.Insecure ? Uri.UriSchemeHttp : Uri.UriSchemeHttps,
            Host   = endPoint.Host,
            Port   = endPoint.Port
        }.Uri;
        var httpClient = settings.CreateHttpClient(address);
        options = new GrpcChannelOptions {
            ServiceConfig = settings.RetrySettings.IsEnabled
                ? new() { MethodConfigs = { settings.RetrySettings.GetRetryMethodConfig() } }
                : null,
            HttpClient            = httpClient,
            LoggerFactory         = settings.LoggerFactory,
            Credentials           = settings.ChannelCredentials,
            DisposeHttpClient     = true,
            MaxReceiveMessageSize = MaxReceiveMessageLength
        };
        return GrpcChannel.ForAddress(address, options);
    }
    static HttpClient CreateHttpClient(this KurrentDBClientSettings settings, Uri address) {
        if (settings.ConnectivitySettings.Insecure) {
            //this must be switched on before creation of the HttpMessageHandler
            AppContext.SetSwitch("System.Net.Http.SocketsHttpHandler.Http2UnencryptedSupport", true);
        }
        return new(CreateHandler(settings), disposeHandler: true) {
            BaseAddress           = address,
            Timeout               = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan,
            DefaultRequestVersion = HttpVersion.Version20,
            DefaultVersionPolicy  = HttpVersionPolicy.RequestVersionOrHigher
        };
        static HttpMessageHandler CreateHandler(KurrentDBClientSettings settings) {
            if (settings.CreateHttpMessageHandler is not null)
                return settings.CreateHttpMessageHandler.Invoke();
            var handler = new SocketsHttpHandler {
                KeepAlivePingDelay             = settings.ConnectivitySettings.KeepAliveInterval,
                KeepAlivePingTimeout           = settings.ConnectivitySettings.KeepAliveTimeout,
                EnableMultipleHttp2Connections = true
            };
            if (settings.ConnectivitySettings.Insecure) {
                handler.SslOptions.RemoteCertificateValidationCallback = (_, _, _, _) => true;
                return handler;
            }
            if (settings.ConnectivitySettings.ClientCertificate is not null) {
                handler.SslOptions.ClientCertificates = new X509CertificateCollection {
                    settings.ConnectivitySettings.ClientCertificate
                };
            }
            handler.SslOptions.RemoteCertificateValidationCallback = settings.ConnectivitySettings.TlsVerifyCert switch {
                false => delegate { return true; },
                true when settings.ConnectivitySettings.TlsCaFile is not null => (sender, certificate, chain, errors) => {
                    if (certificate is not X509Certificate2 peerCertificate || chain is null) return false;
                    chain.ChainPolicy.TrustMode = X509ChainTrustMode.CustomRootTrust;
                    chain.ChainPolicy.CustomTrustStore.Add(settings.ConnectivitySettings.TlsCaFile);
                    return chain.Build(peerCertificate);
                },
                _ => null
            };
            return handler;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Net;
using EventStore.Client.Gossip;
using Grpc.Core;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V1;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
class GrpcGossipClient(KurrentDBClientSettings settings) : IGossipClient {
    public async ValueTask<ClusterMessages.ClusterInfo> GetAsync(ChannelBase channel, CancellationToken ct) {
        var client = new Gossip.GossipClient(channel);
        using var call = client.ReadAsync(new Empty(), KurrentDBCallOptions.CreateNonStreaming(settings, ct));
        var result = await call.ResponseAsync.ConfigureAwait(false);
        return new(
            result.Members
                .Select(x =>
                    new ClusterMessages.MemberInfo(
                        Uuid.FromDto(x.InstanceId),
                        (ClusterMessages.VNodeState)x.State,
                        x.IsAlive,
                        new DnsEndPoint(x.HttpEndPoint.Address, (int)x.HttpEndPoint.Port)
                    )
                ).ToArray()
        );
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Legacy/RipAndTear/Client/Gossip/GrpcServerCapabilitiesClient.cs
````csharp
using Grpc.Core;
using ServerFeaturesServiceClient = KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.ServerFeatures.ServerFeatures.ServerFeaturesClient;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
class GrpcServerCapabilitiesClient(KurrentDBClientSettings settings) : IServerCapabilitiesClient {
    public async Task<ServerCapabilities> GetAsync(CallInvoker callInvoker, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        var client = new ServerFeaturesServiceClient(callInvoker);
        using var call = client.GetSupportedMethodsAsync(
            new(),
            KurrentDBCallOptions.CreateNonStreaming(
                settings,
                settings.ConnectivitySettings.GossipTimeout,
                null, cancellationToken
            )
        );
        try {
            var response = await call.ResponseAsync.ConfigureAwait(false);
            var supportsBatchAppend                             = false;
            var supportsPersistentSubscriptionsToAll            = false;
            var supportsPersistentSubscriptionsGetInfo          = false;
            var supportsPersistentSubscriptionsRestartSubsystem = false;
            var supportsPersistentSubscriptionsReplayParked     = false;
            var supportsPersistentSubscriptionsList             = false;
            foreach (var supportedMethod in response.Methods)
                switch (supportedMethod.ServiceName, supportedMethod.MethodName) {
                    case ("event_store.client.streams.streams", "batchappend"):
                        supportsBatchAppend = true;
                        continue;
                    case ("event_store.client.persistent_subscriptions.persistentsubscriptions", "read"):
                        supportsPersistentSubscriptionsToAll = supportedMethod.Features.Contains("all");
                        continue;
                    case ("event_store.client.persistent_subscriptions.persistentsubscriptions", "getinfo"):
                        supportsPersistentSubscriptionsGetInfo = true;
                        continue;
                    case ("event_store.client.persistent_subscriptions.persistentsubscriptions", "restartsubsystem"):
                        supportsPersistentSubscriptionsRestartSubsystem = true;
                        continue;
                    case ("event_store.client.persistent_subscriptions.persistentsubscriptions", "replayparked"):
                        supportsPersistentSubscriptionsReplayParked = true;
                        continue;
                    case ("event_store.client.persistent_subscriptions.persistentsubscriptions", "list"):
                        supportsPersistentSubscriptionsList = true;
                        continue;
                }
            return new(
                response.EventStoreServerVersion,
                supportsBatchAppend,
                supportsPersistentSubscriptionsToAll,
                supportsPersistentSubscriptionsGetInfo,
                supportsPersistentSubscriptionsRestartSubsystem,
                supportsPersistentSubscriptionsReplayParked,
                supportsPersistentSubscriptionsList
            );
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex.GetBaseException() is RpcException { StatusCode: StatusCode.Unimplemented }) {
            return new();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
static class NodePreferenceComparers {
	public static readonly IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState> Leader = new Comparer(state =>
		state switch {
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Leader             => 0,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower           => 1,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyReplica    => 2,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreReadOnlyReplica => 3,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyLeaderless => 4,
			_                                             => int.MaxValue
		});
	public static readonly IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState> Follower = new Comparer(state =>
		state switch {
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower           => 0,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Leader             => 1,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyReplica    => 2,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreReadOnlyReplica => 3,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyLeaderless => 4,
			_                                             => int.MaxValue
		});
	public static readonly IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState> ReadOnlyReplica = new Comparer(state =>
		state switch {
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyReplica    => 0,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreReadOnlyReplica => 1,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyLeaderless => 2,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Leader             => 3,
			ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower           => 4,
			_                                             => int.MaxValue
		});
	public static readonly IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState> None = new Comparer(_ => 0);
	class Comparer : IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState> {
		readonly Func<ClusterMessages.VNodeState, int> _getPriority;
		public Comparer(Func<ClusterMessages.VNodeState, int> getPriority) {
			_getPriority = getPriority;
		}
		public int Compare(ClusterMessages.VNodeState left, ClusterMessages.VNodeState right) =>
			_getPriority(left).CompareTo(_getPriority(right));
	}
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Legacy/RipAndTear/Client/Gossip/NodeSelector.cs
````csharp
using System.Net;
namespace KurrentDB.Client;
// Selects a node to connect to from a ClusterInfo, based on the node preference.
// Deals with endpoints, no grpc here.
// Thread safe.
class NodeSelector(NodePreference nodePreference) {
	static readonly ClusterMessages.VNodeState[] NotAllowedStates = [
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Manager,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ShuttingDown,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Shutdown,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Unknown,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Initializing,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.CatchingUp,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ResigningLeader,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreLeader,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreReplica,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.PreReadOnlyReplica,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Clone,
		ClusterMessages.VNodeState.DiscoverLeader
	];
	readonly Random _random = new(0);
	readonly IComparer<ClusterMessages.VNodeState>? _nodeStateComparer = nodePreference switch {
		NodePreference.Leader          => NodePreferenceComparers.Leader,
		NodePreference.Follower        => NodePreferenceComparers.Follower,
		NodePreference.ReadOnlyReplica => NodePreferenceComparers.ReadOnlyReplica,
		_                              => NodePreferenceComparers.None
	};
	public DnsEndPoint SelectNode(ClusterMessages.ClusterInfo clusterInfo) {
		if (clusterInfo.Members.Length == 0)
			throw new Exception("No nodes in cluster info.");
		lock (_random) {
			var node = clusterInfo.Members
				.Where(IsConnectable)
				.OrderBy(node => node.State, _nodeStateComparer)
				.ThenBy(_ => _random.Next())
				.FirstOrDefault();
			if (node is null)
				throw new Exception("No nodes are in a connectable state.");
			return node.EndPoint;
		}
		static bool IsConnectable(ClusterMessages.MemberInfo node) =>
			node.IsAlive && !NotAllowedStates.Contains(node.State);
	}
}
````
