````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Threading.Channels;
using Grpc.Core;
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Checkpointing;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Messages;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Relay;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams;
using static System.StringComparison;
using static Kurrent.Client.Streams.StreamsClientV1Mapper;
using static KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams.ReadResp.ContentOneofCase;
using Kurrent.Client.Processors.Partitioning;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Checkpoints;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Processing;
using Kurrent.Variant;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using LegacyStreamsServiceClient = KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams.Streams.StreamsClient;
using static KurrentDB.Protocol.V2.Streams.StreamsService;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
public partial class StreamsClient {
    internal async ValueTask<IWorkerSession> StartProcess(ProcessorSettings options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        var cancellator   = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        var request = Requests.CreateSubscriptionRequest(options);
        var session = LegacyServiceClient.Read(request, cancellationToken: stoppingToken);
        Guid subscriptionId;
        try {
            await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            // determine the actual stream state when not found (v1 protocol quirk)
            if (session.ResponseStream.Current?.ContentCase is StreamNotFound) {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                var info = await GetStreamInfo(stream, stoppingToken)
                    .UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                throw info.State switch {
                    StreamState.Missing => new StreamNotFoundException(stream),
                    StreamState.Tombstoned => new StreamTombstonedException(stream),
                    _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Stream '{stream}' reported as not found, but has unexpected state '{info.State}'.")
                };
            }
            subscriptionId = session.ResponseStream.Current?.ContentCase is Confirmation
                ? Guid.Parse(session.ResponseStream.Current!.Confirmation.SubscriptionId)
                : throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected subscription confirmation as the first message from the server.");
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            // handle cancellation gracefully
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Cancelled)
                throw new OperationCanceledException(rex.Message, rex);
            // when stream is tombstoned an exception is thrown for some weird reason
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.FailedPrecondition && rex.Trailers.GetValue("exception") == "stream-deleted") {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                throw new StreamTombstonedException(stream);
            }
            // when a position does not exist (targets a position between records in the same stream)
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Unknown && rex.Message.Contains("InvalidPosition >>", OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                // StatusCode="Unknown", Detail="
                //   Unexpected ReadAllResult: InvalidPosition >>
                //   There is not enough space to read full record (length prefix: 143170). Actual pre-position: 144798632.
                //   Something is seriously wrong in chunk #1-1 (chunk-000001.000000).
                // "
                var position = request.Options.All.Position?.CommitPosition ?? LogPosition.Latest;
                var details  = rex.Message.Split(">>").Last().Trim();
                throw new LogPositionNotFoundException(position, details);
            }
            throw rex.ToException();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            throw ex.ToException();
        }
        // here we go!
        var sessionInfo = new WorkerSessionInfo(
            subscriptionId,
            options.WorkerId,
            options.ProcessorId
        );
        var checkpointStore = new WorkerCheckpointStore(
            processorId: options.ProcessorId,
            workerId: options.WorkerId,
            maxCount: 10,
            client: this,
            time: Time,
            logger: LoggerFactory.CreateLogger<WorkerCheckpointStore>());
        // StartRelay returns channel with unbatched messages
        var channel = StartRelay(session, options, cancellator, stoppingToken);
        // CreateBatchedRelay wraps channel with batching
        var batchedRelay = CreateBatchedRelay(channel, options, stoppingToken);
        return new WorkerSession(sessionInfo, checkpointStore, batchedRelay, options);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Starts a relay that pumps messages from the gRPC stream into a channel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A channel with unbatched raw messages (single Record | CheckpointBarrier).</returns>
    Channel<RawGatewayMessage> StartRelay(
        AsyncServerStreamingCall<ReadResp> session,
        ProcessorSettings options,
        CancellationTokenSource cancellator,
        CancellationToken ct
    ) {
        // Channel holds unbatched raw messages (single Record | CheckpointBarrier)
        var channel = Channel.CreateBounded<RawGatewayMessage>(
            new BoundedChannelOptions(options.BufferCapacity) {
                FullMode     = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait,
                SingleReader = true,
                SingleWriter = true
            }
        );
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        // start pumping messages
        _ = Task.Run(PumpPump, stoppingToken);
        // Return just the channel - batching happens in CreateBatchedRelay
        return channel;
        [AsyncMethodBuilder(typeof(PoolingAsyncValueTaskMethodBuilder))]
        async ValueTask PumpPump() {
            SequenceGenerator sequencer = new();
            try {
                // must continue from the freaking cursor because we had to try to read
                // the first entry to check if the stream existed or if access was granted
                // or if we got a confirmation message
                do {
                    var resp = session.ResponseStream.Current;
                    RawGatewayMessage message;
                    switch (resp?.ContentCase) {
                        case Checkpoint:
                            message = resp.Checkpoint.MapToBarrier(sequencer.FetchNext());
                            break;
                        case CaughtUp:
                            message = resp.CaughtUp.MapToBarrier(sequencer.FetchNext());
                            break;
                        case Event:
                            // Slow path: requires async
                            var record = await resp.Event.MapToRecordAsync(
                                sequencer.FetchNext(),
                                SerializerProvider, MetadataDecoder,
                                SchemaRegistryPolicy.NoRequirements,
                                options.SkipDecoding,
                                stoppingToken
                            ).ConfigureAwait(false);
                            // Calculate partition using PartitionCalculator (simulating server behavior)
                            // The real server would determine partition before sending to worker
                            var partition = PartitionCalculator.Default.For(record.Stream, options.MaxParallelism);
                            // Set partition on the record's FullPosition using `with` expression
                            message = record with {
                                FullPosition = record.FullPosition with {
                                    Partition = Partition.From(partition)
                                }
                            };
                            break;
                        case FellBehind:
                        case None:
                        case FirstStreamPosition:
                        case LastStreamPosition:
                        case LastAllStreamPosition:
                        case null:
                            continue;
                        default:
                            continue; // Skip confirmation or irrelevant, no allocation
                    }
                    // apply client-side filter if present
                    if (message.IsRecord && !options.Subscription.Filter.IsMatch(message.AsRecord))
                        continue;
                    await channel.Writer.WriteAsync(message, stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                } while (await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false));
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            // if we are to use the ShutdownReason.Cancelled path, we must not swallow RpcException cancellations
            // and we must convert them to OperationCanceledExceptions
            catch (RpcException rex) when (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Cancelled) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            // if we are to use the ShutdownReason.Cancelled path, we must not swallow OperationCanceledExceptions
            catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete(ex);
            }
            finally {
                session.Dispose();
                cancellator.Dispose();
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Wraps a raw message channel with batching logic to produce batched GatewayMessages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="channel">The channel with unbatched raw messages.</param>
    /// <param name="options">Processor settings containing batching configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of batched GatewayMessages (Record[] | CheckpointBarrier).</returns>
    IAsyncEnumerable<GatewayMessage> CreateBatchedRelay(
        Channel<RawGatewayMessage> channel,
        ProcessorSettings options,
        CancellationToken ct
    ) {
        return channel.Reader.ReadAllAsync(ct).ReadBatched(
            batchSize: options.Batching.MaxSize,
            timeout: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(options.Batching.Timeout),
            classify: ClassifyRawMessage,
            batchToOutput: static records => (GatewayMessage)records,
            cancellationToken: ct
        );
        static BatchAction<Record, GatewayMessage> ClassifyRawMessage(RawGatewayMessage msg) =>
            msg.IsRecord
                ? BatchAction<Record, GatewayMessage>.Batch(msg.AsRecord)
                : BatchAction<Record, GatewayMessage>.FlushThenYield(msg.AsCheckpointBarrier);
    }
}
/// <remarks>
/// NOTE: This class is kept for reference but is no longer used.
/// Batching now happens in StartRelay via ReadBatched extension on IAsyncEnumerable.
/// WorkerSession now receives IAsyncEnumerable&lt;GatewayMessage&gt; directly from StartRelay.
/// </remarks>
[Obsolete("Batching now happens in StartRelay. WorkerSession receives IAsyncEnumerable<GatewayMessage> directly.")]
record WorkerSessionStream : IAsyncEnumerable<WorkerSessionMessage>, IAsyncDisposable {
    readonly Lazy<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>> _lazyChannel;
    readonly int      _batchSize;
    readonly TimeSpan _timeout;
    long _totalRecordsRead;
    long _totalBatchesRead;
    int  _disposed;
    int  _enumeratorCreated;
    internal WorkerSessionStream(Func<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>> channelFactory, int batchSize, TimeSpan timeout) {
        _lazyChannel = new Lazy<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>>(channelFactory);
        _batchSize   = batchSize;
        _timeout     = timeout;
    }
    internal WorkerSessionStream(Func<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>> channelFactory, int batchSize, long timeout)
        : this(channelFactory, batchSize, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeout)) { }
    Channel<RawGatewayMessage> Channel => _lazyChannel.Value;
    public long TotalRecordsRead => Interlocked.Read(ref _totalRecordsRead);
    public long TotalBatchesRead => Interlocked.Read(ref _totalBatchesRead);
    /// <summary>
    /// The number of items currently queued for processing.
    /// </summary>
    public int QueuedMessages => _lazyChannel.IsValueCreated ? Channel.Reader.Count : 0;
    public virtual async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (!_lazyChannel.IsValueCreated || Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 1, 0) != 0)
            return;
        Channel.Writer.TryComplete();
        // wait for completion but don't propagate exceptions
        // errors should surface through enumeration, not dispose
        try {
            await Channel.Reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch {
            // swallow - exception was already propagated via GetAsyncEnumerator
        }
    }
    // works but needs to be optimized.
    public async IAsyncEnumerator<WorkerSessionMessage> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _disposed, 0, 0) == 1, this);
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _enumeratorCreated, 1, 0) == 1)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Records already enumerated.");
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            yield break;
        var reader = Channel.Reader;
        var buffer = ArrayPool<Record>.Shared.Rent(_batchSize);
        var count  = 0;
        try {
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var start = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
                while (count < _batchSize) {
                    var remainingTime = _timeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(start);
                    if (remainingTime <= TimeSpan.Zero) break;
                    var waitTask = reader.WaitToReadAsync(ct);
                    bool hasData;
                    if (waitTask.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                        hasData = waitTask.Result;
                    else
                        try {
                            hasData = await waitTask.AsTask()
                                .WaitAsync(remainingTime, ct)
                                .ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch (TimeoutException) {
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                            yield break;
                        }
                    if (!hasData) {
                        // channel completed - yield remaining
                        if (count > 0) {
                            yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                            Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                            Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                            // count =  0;
                        }
                        // propagate any exception from channel completion
                        try {
                            await reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                            // ignore cancellation
                        }
                        yield break;
                    }
                    // drain available items
                    // RawGatewayMessage: Index 0 = Record, Index 1 = CheckpointBarrier
                    while (count < _batchSize && reader.TryRead(out var message))
                        if (message.Index == 1) {
                            // CheckpointBarrier - flush pending records, then yield barrier
                            if (count > 0) {
                                yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                                Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                                Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                                count = 0;
                            }
                            yield return (CheckpointBarrier)message.Value;
                        }
                        else
                            buffer[count++] = (Record)message.Value;
                }
                // yield batch on size/timeout
                if (count > 0) {
                    yield return buffer.CopyToArray(count);
                    Interlocked.Increment(ref _totalBatchesRead);
                    Interlocked.Add(ref _totalRecordsRead, count);
                    count =  0;
                }
            }
        }
        finally {
            ArrayPool<Record>.Shared.Return(buffer, true);
        }
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for reading from channels with batching support.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
static class ChannelReaderBatchingExtensions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Reads items from a channel, batching some items while yielding others immediately (after flushing the batch).
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TInput">The type of items in the channel.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TBatch">The type of items that can be batched.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TOutput">The output type (either a batch or a pass-through item).</typeparam>
    /// <param name="reader">The channel reader to read from.</param>
    /// <param name="batchSize">Maximum number of items per batch.</param>
    /// <param name="batchTimeout">Maximum time to wait for a full batch before yielding.</param>
    /// <param name="classify">Classifies each input as batchable or flush-trigger.</param>
    /// <param name="batchToOutput">Converts a batch of items to output.</param>
    /// <param name="ct">Cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns>An async enumerable of batched outputs and pass-through items.</returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Batches are yielded when: batch size is reached, timeout expires, channel closes, or a flush-trigger arrives.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Flush-trigger items cause pending batched items to be yielded first, then the trigger item itself.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// // Batch records, but yield checkpoints immediately
    /// await foreach (var output in channel.Reader.ReadBatched(
    ///     batchSize: 100,
    ///     batchTimeout: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50),
    ///     classify: msg => msg.IsRecord
    ///         ? BatchAction&lt;Record, CheckpointBarrier&gt;.Batch(msg.AsRecord)
    ///         : BatchAction&lt;Record, CheckpointBarrier&gt;.FlushThenYield(msg.AsCheckpointBarrier),
    ///     batchToOutput: records => new RecordBatch(records)))
    /// {
    ///     // output is either RecordBatch or CheckpointBarrier
    /// }
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public static async IAsyncEnumerable<TOutput> ReadBatched<TInput, TBatch, TOutput>(
        this ChannelReader<TInput> reader,
        int batchSize,
        TimeSpan batchTimeout,
        Func<TInput, BatchAction<TBatch, TOutput>> classify,
        Func<TBatch[], TOutput> batchToOutput,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken ct = default
    ) {
        var buffer = ArrayPool<TBatch>.Shared.Rent(batchSize);
        var count  = 0;
        try {
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var batchStart = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
                // Fill batch until: size reached, timeout, or channel done
                while (count < batchSize) {
                    var remaining = batchTimeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(batchStart);
                    if (remaining <= TimeSpan.Zero)
                        break;
                    if (!await WaitForDataAsync(reader, remaining, ct))
                        goto completed;
                    // Drain available items, classifying each
                    while (count < batchSize && reader.TryRead(out var item)) {
                        var action = classify(item);
                        if (action.IsBatchable) {
                            buffer[count++] = action.BatchItem;
                            continue;
                        }
                        // Flush trigger: yield batch first, then the trigger
                        if (count > 0) {
                            yield return batchToOutput(buffer.CopyToArray(count));
                            count = 0;
                        }
                        yield return action.PassThrough;
                    }
                }
                // Yield batch on size/timeout
                if (count > 0) {
                    yield return batchToOutput(buffer.CopyToArray(count));
                    count = 0;
                }
            }
            yield break;
        completed:
            if (count > 0)
                yield return batchToOutput(buffer.CopyToArray(count));
            try { await reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false); }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { /* expected */ }
        }
        finally {
            ArrayPool<TBatch>.Shared.Return(buffer, true);
        }
        yield break;
        static async ValueTask<bool> WaitForDataAsync<T>(ChannelReader<T> reader, TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken ct) {
            var wait = reader.WaitToReadAsync(ct);
            if (wait.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                return wait.Result;
            try {
                return await wait.AsTask().WaitAsync(timeout, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (TimeoutException) {
                return false;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Batches <see cref="Record"/> messages from a channel, yielding control messages immediately.
/// Uses the generic <see cref="ChannelReaderBatchingExtensions.ReadBatched{TInput,TBatch,TOutput}"/> extension.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// NOTE: This class is kept for reference but is no longer used.
/// Batching now happens in StartRelay via ReadBatched extension on IAsyncEnumerable.
/// GatewayMessage now contains Record[] (already batched), not single Record.
/// </remarks>
[Obsolete("Batching now happens in StartRelay. GatewayMessage contains Record[], not single Record.")]
sealed class BatchingRecordStream : IAsyncEnumerable<WorkerSessionMessage>, IAsyncDisposable {
    readonly Lazy<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>> _channel;
    readonly int                              _batchSize;
    readonly TimeSpan                         _batchTimeout;
    int                                       _disposed;
    public BatchingRecordStream(Func<Channel<RawGatewayMessage>> channelFactory, int batchSize, TimeSpan batchTimeout) {
        _channel      = new(channelFactory);
        _batchSize    = batchSize;
        _batchTimeout = batchTimeout;
    }
    Channel<RawGatewayMessage> Channel => _channel.Value;
    public int QueuedMessages => _channel.IsValueCreated ? Channel.Reader.Count : 0;
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (!_channel.IsValueCreated || Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0)
            return;
        Channel.Writer.TryComplete();
        try { await Channel.Reader.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false); }
        catch { /* errors surface through enumeration */ }
    }
    public IAsyncEnumerator<WorkerSessionMessage> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 0) == 1, this);
        // Use the generic batching extension - all complexity is now abstracted
        return Channel.Reader.ReadBatched(
            batchSize: _batchSize,
            batchTimeout: _batchTimeout,
            classify: Classify,
            batchToOutput: static records => (WorkerSessionMessage)records,
            ct: ct
        ).GetAsyncEnumerator(ct);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Classifies raw gateway messages: Records are batched, everything else triggers a flush.
    /// </summary>
    static BatchAction<Record, WorkerSessionMessage> Classify(RawGatewayMessage message) =>
        message.Index switch {
            0 => BatchAction<Record, WorkerSessionMessage>.Batch((Record)message.Value),
            1 => BatchAction<Record, WorkerSessionMessage>.FlushThenYield((CheckpointBarrier)message.Value),
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unknown raw gateway message type: {message.Index}")
        };
}

record WorkerSession : IWorkerSession {
    internal WorkerSession(
        WorkerSessionInfo info,
        WorkerCheckpointStore checkpointStore,
        IAsyncEnumerable<GatewayMessage> relay,
        ProcessorSettings settings
    ) {
        SessionInfo = info;
        SessionId       = info.SessionId;
        WorkerId        = info.WorkerId;
        ProcessorId     = info.ProcessorId;
        CheckpointStore = checkpointStore;
        Relay           = relay;
        Settings        = settings;
        PositionTracker = new PositionTracker();
    }
    IAsyncEnumerable<GatewayMessage> Relay           { get; }
    ProcessorSettings                Settings        { get; }
    WorkerCheckpointStore            CheckpointStore { get; }
    PositionTracker                  PositionTracker { get; }
    CheckpointBarrierInfo LastBarrier    { get; set; } = new CheckpointBarrierInfo();
    CheckpointInfo        LastCheckpoint { get; set; } = new CheckpointInfo();
    public WorkerSessionInfo SessionInfo  { get; }
    public CheckpointState Checkpointing => new() {
        TrackedPositions = PositionTracker.Positions,
        LastBarrier      = LastBarrier,
        LastCheckpoint   = LastCheckpoint
    };
    public Guid   SessionId   { get; }
    public string WorkerId    { get; }
    public string ProcessorId { get; }
    Dictionary<int, PositionTracker> TrackersByPartition { get; } = new();
    // restore checkpoint
    // track position
    // store checkpoint
    public ValueTask TrackAsync(RecordPosition position) {
        TrackersByPartition[position.Partition].Track(position);
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
    public async IAsyncEnumerator<WorkerSessionMessage> GetAsyncEnumerator(CancellationToken ct = default) {
        var workAssigned = AssignWork();
        // Initialize one PositionTracker per assigned partition
        foreach (var partition in workAssigned.Partitions)
            TrackersByPartition.Add(partition, new PositionTracker());
        // Yield WorkAssigned as FIRST message (before any records)
        yield return workAssigned;
        // Pass through batched messages from relay - records are ALREADY batched!
        await foreach (var message in Relay.WithCancellation(ct).ConfigureAwait(false)) {
            // GatewayMessage: Index 0 = WorkAssigned, Index 1 = Record[], Index 2 = CheckpointBarrier
            yield return message.Index switch {
                1 => (Record[])message.Value,          // Record[] pass-through
                2 => (CheckpointBarrier)message.Value, // CheckpointBarrier pass-through
                _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unexpected message type index: {message.Index}")
            };
        }
        yield break;
        WorkAssigned AssignWork() {
            // Use PartitionAssigner to simulate server behavior
            // When multiple workers join, each gets a contiguous subset of partitions
            var assignments = PartitionAssigner.Default.AssignPartitions(
                workerIds: [WorkerId],
                maxParallelism: Settings.MaxParallelism
            );
            var assignedPartitions = assignments[WorkerId];
            return new WorkAssigned(assignedPartitions, PartitionsAssignedReason.Initial);
        }
    }
    public ValueTask SendAsync(WorkerMessage message, CancellationToken ct = default) {
        return message.SwitchAsync(
            async workAccepted => {
                // log stuff
            },
            onCheckpointComplete: async evt => {
                // its not really complete until we send this
                // so i missed something...
                // if we assume that the worker stores its own checkpoints and then just comunicates them here
                // maybe it would make sense, but when assigned different partitions the worker would never  know
                // what would be the positions to start from unless the gateway told it...
                await CheckpointStore
                    .StoreAsync(evt.CheckpointBarrierId, evt.Positions[0], ct)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
            },
            async disconnect => {
                await CheckpointStore
                    .StoreAsync(disconnect.CheckpointBarrierId, disconnect.Positions[0], ct)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
        );
    }
    public ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Authorization mechanism for stream access control.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public enum AuthorizationType {
    /// <summary>
    /// Stream Policy Authorization using fine-grained prefix-based control.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Policies define access rules based on stream name prefixes, allowing centralized
    /// management of permissions for groups of streams.
    /// </remarks>
    StreamPolicy,
    /// <summary>
    /// Access Control Lists using per-stream ACL metadata.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Traditional ACL-based authorization where each stream's metadata contains
    /// access control information for that specific stream.
    /// </remarks>
    Acl
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Default fallback policies for user-created and system streams.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// When no specific prefix rule matches a stream, the default policy rules determine
/// which policy applies based on whether the stream is a user stream or system stream.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// System streams are identified by names starting with the dollar sign ($).
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public record DefaultPolicyRules {
    /// <summary>
    /// Policy name for user-created streams (streams not starting with $).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> "publicDefault"</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> High</para>
    /// <para>This policy applies to all user-created streams that don't match any specific prefix rule.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string UserStreams { get; init; } = "publicDefault";
    /// <summary>
    /// Policy name for system streams (streams starting with $).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> "adminsDefault"</para>
    /// <para><b>Importance:</b> High</para>
    /// <para>This policy applies to all system streams that don't match any specific prefix rule.</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string SystemStreams { get; init; } = "adminsDefault";
    /// <summary>
    /// Standard default rules with public access for user streams and admin-only for system streams.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly DefaultPolicyRules Standard = new();
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Defines read, write, delete permissions and metadata access for streams.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Access policies specify which users and groups can perform specific operations on streams.
/// Users and groups are identified by names or special system roles like $admins, $ops, or $all.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public record StreamAccessPolicy {
    /// <summary>
    /// Users and groups with read permission.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (no access)</para>
    /// <para>Special roles: $all (everyone), $admins (administrators only), $ops (operators only)</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string[] Readers { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Users and groups with write permission.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (no access)</para>
    /// <para>Special roles: $all (everyone), $admins (administrators only), $ops (operators only)</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string[] Writers { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Users and groups with delete permission.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (no access)</para>
    /// <para>Special roles: $all (everyone), $admins (administrators only), $ops (operators only)</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string[] Deleters { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Users and groups with metadata read permission.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (no access)</para>
    /// <para>Special roles: $all (everyone), $admins (administrators only), $ops (operators only)</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string[] MetadataReaders { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Users and groups with metadata write permission.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para><b>Default:</b> Empty array (no access)</para>
    /// <para>Special roles: $all (everyone), $admins (administrators only), $ops (operators only)</para>
    /// </remarks>
    public string[] MetadataWriters { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// Public access policy granting full permissions to all users.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Suitable for public streams where all authenticated users should have full access.
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly StreamAccessPolicy PublicAccess = new() {
        Readers         = ["$all"],
        Writers         = ["$all"],
        Deleters        = ["$all"],
        MetadataReaders = ["$all"],
        MetadataWriters = ["$all"]
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Admin-only access policy restricting all permissions to administrators.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Suitable for system streams or sensitive data requiring administrative access.
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly StreamAccessPolicy AdminsOnly = new() {
        Readers         = ["$admins"],
        Writers         = ["$admins"],
        Deleters        = ["$admins"],
        MetadataReaders = ["$admins"],
        MetadataWriters = ["$admins"]
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Default policy for projection streams (public read, admin write/delete).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Suitable for streams generated by projections where users need read access
    /// but only administrators should modify the streams.
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly StreamAccessPolicy ProjectionsDefault = new() {
        Readers         = ["$all"],
        Writers         = ["$admins"],
        Deleters        = ["$admins"],
        MetadataReaders = ["$all"],
        MetadataWriters = ["$admins"]
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates an access policy granting full permissions to the specified users or groups.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="usersOrGroups">User names or group names to grant full access.</param>
    public static StreamAccessPolicy FullAccess(params string[] usersOrGroups) => new() {
        Readers         = usersOrGroups,
        Writers         = usersOrGroups,
        Deleters        = usersOrGroups,
        MetadataReaders = usersOrGroups,
        MetadataWriters = usersOrGroups
    };
    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Complete stream policy configuration including policy definitions, stream rules, and defaults.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Stream policy configuration defines access control for streams based on their name prefixes.
/// It consists of three parts: named policies, prefix rules, and default rules.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Usage:</b> Create a configuration, validate it, and send to the server using
/// <see cref="UsersClient.ConfigureStreamPolicies"/>.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public record StreamPolicyConfiguration {
    /// <summary>
    /// Named access policies defining permissions for users and groups.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Dictionary mapping policy names to their access definitions. Policy names are referenced
    /// by stream rules and default rules to apply permissions to streams.
    /// </remarks>
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy> StreamPolicies { get; init; }
        = ImmutableDictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy>.Empty;
    /// <summary>
    /// Rules mapping stream prefixes to specific policies.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// These rules are evaluated in order. The first rule whose prefix matches a stream name
    /// determines which policy applies to that stream.
    /// </remarks>
    public IReadOnlyList<StreamPrefixRule> StreamRules { get; init; }
        = ImmutableArray<StreamPrefixRule>.Empty;
    /// <summary>
    /// Default policies for user and system streams.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Applied to streams that don't match any specific prefix rule.
    /// </remarks>
    public DefaultPolicyRules DefaultRules { get; init; } = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard;
    /// <summary>
    /// Pre-configured policy with public user access and admin-only system streams.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This default configuration includes:
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - publicDefault: Full access for all users
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - adminsDefault: Admin-only access for system streams
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - projectionsDefault: Public read, admin write for projection streams
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - Rules for standard projection streams ($et-, $ce-, $bc-, $category-, $streams)
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly StreamPolicyConfiguration Default = new() {
        StreamPolicies = ImmutableDictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy>.Empty
            .Add("publicDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess)
            .Add("adminsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.AdminsOnly)
            .Add("projectionsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.ProjectionsDefault),
        StreamRules = ImmutableArray.Create(
            new StreamPrefixRule("$et-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$ce-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$bc-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$category-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$streams", "projectionsDefault")
        ),
        DefaultRules = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the configuration before sending to the server.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">
    /// Thrown when policy references are invalid (e.g., a rule references a non-existent policy).
    /// </exception>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Validation checks:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item>All stream rules reference existing policies</item>
    /// <item>Default rules reference existing policies</item>
    /// <item>Policy names are not null or empty</item>
    /// </list>
    /// </remarks>
    public void Validate() {
        // Check stream rules reference existing policies
        foreach (var rule in StreamRules) {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rule.Prefix))
                throw new ArgumentException($"Stream rule has empty prefix");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rule.PolicyName))
                throw new ArgumentException($"Stream rule for prefix '{rule.Prefix}' has empty policy name");
            if (!StreamPolicies.ContainsKey(rule.PolicyName))
                throw new ArgumentException($"Stream rule for prefix '{rule.Prefix}' references undefined policy: '{rule.PolicyName}'");
        }
        // Check default rules reference existing policies
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DefaultRules.UserStreams))
            throw new ArgumentException("Default user streams policy name is empty");
        if (!StreamPolicies.ContainsKey(DefaultRules.UserStreams))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Default user streams rule references undefined policy: '{DefaultRules.UserStreams}'");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DefaultRules.SystemStreams))
            throw new ArgumentException("Default system streams policy name is empty");
        if (!StreamPolicies.ContainsKey(DefaultRules.SystemStreams))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Default system streams rule references undefined policy: '{DefaultRules.SystemStreams}'");
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Users/Model/StreamPolicy/StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Fluent builder for constructing complex stream policy configurations.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides a fluent API for building stream policy configurations with validation.
/// Use <see cref="WithDefaults"/> to start with standard policies, or create a new instance
/// for a custom configuration from scratch.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Example:</b>
/// </para>
/// <code>
/// var config = StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder.WithDefaults()
///     .AddPolicy("financePolicy", StreamAccessPolicy.FullAccess("financeTeam"))
///     .AddRule("finance-", "financePolicy")
///     .Build();
/// </code>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public class StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder {
    readonly Dictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy> _policies = [];
    readonly List<StreamPrefixRule>                 _rules    = [];
    DefaultPolicyRules _defaults = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new builder starting with default configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The default configuration includes:
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - publicDefault: Full access for all users
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - adminsDefault: Admin-only access
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - projectionsDefault: Public read, admin write for projection streams
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// - Standard rules for projection streams ($et-, $ce-, $bc-, $category-, $streams)
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder WithDefaults() {
        var builder = new StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder {
            _policies = {
                ["publicDefault"]      = StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess,
                ["adminsDefault"]      = StreamAccessPolicy.AdminsOnly,
                ["projectionsDefault"] = StreamAccessPolicy.ProjectionsDefault
            }
        };
        builder._rules.AddRange([
            new StreamPrefixRule("$et-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$ce-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$bc-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$category-", "projectionsDefault"),
            new StreamPrefixRule("$streams", "projectionsDefault")
        ]);
        return builder;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new empty builder.
    /// </summary>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder() { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds or replaces a named policy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name">Policy name (referenced by rules).</param>
    /// <param name="policy">Access policy defining permissions.</param>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder AddPolicy(string name, StreamAccessPolicy policy) {
        _policies[name] = policy;
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a rule mapping a stream prefix to a policy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="prefix">Stream name prefix (e.g., "finance-", "$et-").</param>
    /// <param name="policyName">Name of the policy to apply (must exist in policies).</param>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder AddRule(string prefix, string policyName) {
        _rules.Add(new StreamPrefixRule(prefix, policyName));
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the default policies for user and system streams.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="userStreamsPolicy">Policy name for user-created streams.</param>
    /// <param name="systemStreamsPolicy">Policy name for system streams.</param>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder WithDefaultRules(string userStreamsPolicy, string systemStreamsPolicy) {
        _defaults = new DefaultPolicyRules {
            UserStreams   = userStreamsPolicy,
            SystemStreams = systemStreamsPolicy
        };
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds and validates the stream policy configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>Validated stream policy configuration.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">
    /// Thrown when configuration is invalid (e.g., rules reference non-existent policies).
    /// </exception>
    /// <remarks>
    /// This method performs validation before returning the configuration.
    /// Use <see cref="StreamPolicyConfiguration.Validate"/> for details on validation rules.
    /// </remarks>
    public StreamPolicyConfiguration Build() {
        var config = new StreamPolicyConfiguration {
            StreamPolicies = _policies.ToImmutableDictionary(),
            StreamRules    = [.._rules],
            DefaultRules   = _defaults
        };
        config.Validate();
        return config;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes a policy by name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name">Policy name to remove.</param>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder RemovePolicy(string name) {
        _policies.Remove(name);
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes all rules matching the specified prefix.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="prefix">Stream prefix to remove rules for.</param>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder RemoveRule(string prefix) {
        _rules.RemoveAll(r => r.Prefix == prefix);
        return this;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Removes all policies and rules.
    /// </summary>
    public StreamPolicyConfigurationBuilder Clear() {
        _policies.Clear();
        _rules.Clear();
        _defaults = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard;
        return this;
    }
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Modules/Users/Model/StreamPolicy/StreamPrefixRule.cs
````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Maps a stream prefix to a named policy.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Stream prefix rules determine which policy applies to streams based on their name prefix.
/// For example, a rule with prefix "finance-" and policy "financePolicy" applies the finance
/// policy to all streams whose names start with "finance-".
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public record StreamPrefixRule {
    /// <summary>
    /// Stream name prefix to match (e.g., "finance-", "$et-", "customer-").
    /// </summary>
    public string Prefix { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Name of the policy to apply to matching streams.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// This must reference a policy defined in <see cref="StreamPolicyConfiguration.StreamPolicies"/>.
    /// </remarks>
    public string PolicyName { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new stream prefix rule.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="prefix">Stream name prefix to match.</param>
    /// <param name="policyName">Name of the policy to apply.</param>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">Thrown when prefix or policyName is null.</exception>
    public StreamPrefixRule(string prefix, string policyName) {
        Prefix     = prefix ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(prefix));
        PolicyName = policyName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(policyName));
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct LoginName {
    LoginName(string value) => Value = value;
    public static readonly LoginName None = new("");
    public string Value { get; }
    public override string ToString() => Value;
    public void ThrowIfInvalid() => ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(Value);
    public static LoginName From(string value) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(value);
        return new(value);
    }
    public static implicit operator LoginName(string _) => From(_);
    public static implicit operator string(LoginName _) => _.ToString();
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
/// <summary>
/// Represents detailed information about a user in KurrentDB.
/// </summary>
public record UserDetails {
    /// <summary>
    /// The user's login name.
    /// </summary>
    public required LoginName LoginName { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The full name of the user.
    /// </summary>
    public required string FullName { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The groups the user is a member of.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Groups { get; init; } = [];
    /// <summary>
    /// The date/time the user was last updated in UTC format.
    /// </summary>
    public DateTimeOffset? DateLastUpdated { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Whether the user is disabled or not.
    /// </summary>
    public bool Disabled { get; init; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the user has any group memberships.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasGroups => Groups.Count > 0;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the user is active (not disabled).
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsActive => !Disabled;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the user has been updated.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasBeenUpdated => DateLastUpdated.HasValue;
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable SwitchExpressionHandlesSomeKnownEnumValuesWithExceptionInDefault
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Grpc.Core;
using Kurrent.Grpc;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Users;
using AsyncStreamReaderExtensions = Kurrent.Grpc.AsyncStreamReaderExtensions;
using UsersServiceClient = KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Users.Users.UsersClient;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Users;
public class UsersClient : ClientModuleBase {
    internal UsersClient(KurrentClient client) : base(client) =>
        ServiceClient = new(client.LegacyCallInvoker);
    UsersServiceClient ServiceClient { get; }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, CreateUserError>> Create(
        LoginName loginName, string fullName, string[] groups, string password,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        try {
            var request = new CreateReq {
                Options = new() {
                    LoginName = loginName,
                    FullName  = fullName,
                    Password  = password,
                    Groups    = { groups }
                }
            };
            await ServiceClient
                .CreateAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, CreateUserError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.AlreadyExists    => new ErrorDetails.AlreadyExists(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, DeleteUserError>> Delete(LoginName loginName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = new DeleteReq { Options = new() { LoginName = loginName } };
            await ServiceClient
                .DeleteAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, DeleteUserError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, DisableUserError>> Disable(LoginName loginName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = new DisableReq { Options = new() { LoginName = loginName } };
            await ServiceClient
                .DisableAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, DisableUserError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, EnableUserError>> Enable(LoginName loginName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = new EnableReq { Options = new() { LoginName = loginName } };
            await ServiceClient
                .EnableAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, EnableUserError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, ChangeUserPasswordError>> ChangePassword(
        LoginName loginName, string currentPassword, string newPassword, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        try {
            var request = new ChangePasswordReq {
                Options = new() {
                    CurrentPassword = currentPassword,
                    NewPassword     = newPassword,
                    LoginName       = loginName
                }
            };
            await ServiceClient
                .ChangePasswordAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, ChangeUserPasswordError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, ResetUserPasswordError>> ResetPassword(
        LoginName loginName, string newPassword, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        try {
            var request = new ResetPasswordReq {
                Options = new() {
                    NewPassword = newPassword,
                    LoginName   = loginName
                }
            };
            // TODO SS: does the user exist? do we want to be explicit about this?
            await ServiceClient
                .ResetPasswordAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Results.Success;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, ResetUserPasswordError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<UserDetails, GetUserError>> GetDetails(LoginName loginName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = new DetailsReq { Options = new() { LoginName = loginName } };
            using var call = ServiceClient.Details(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            var user = await AsyncStreamReaderExtensions.ReadAllAsync(call.ResponseStream, cancellationToken)
                .Select(static resp => new UserDetails {
                    LoginName       = resp.UserDetails.LoginName,
                    FullName        = resp.UserDetails.FullName,
                    Groups          = resp.UserDetails.Groups.ToArray(),
                    Disabled        = resp.UserDetails.Disabled,
                    DateLastUpdated = resp.UserDetails.LastUpdated?.TicksSinceEpoch.FromTicksSinceEpoch()
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            return user ?? Result.Failure<UserDetails, GetUserError>(new ErrorDetails.NotFound());
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<UserDetails, GetUserError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                StatusCode.NotFound         => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<List<UserDetails>, ListAllUsersError>> List(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            using var call = ServiceClient.Details(new DetailsReq(), cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            var users = await AsyncStreamReaderExtensions.ReadAllAsync(call.ResponseStream, cancellationToken)
                .Select(static resp => new UserDetails { // TODO SS: Create a mapper for mapping user details
                    LoginName       = resp.UserDetails.LoginName,
                    FullName        = resp.UserDetails.FullName,
                    Groups          = resp.UserDetails.Groups.ToArray(),
                    Disabled        = resp.UserDetails.Disabled,
                    DateLastUpdated = resp.UserDetails.LastUpdated?.TicksSinceEpoch.FromTicksSinceEpoch()
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            return users;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            return Result.Failure<List<UserDetails>, ListAllUsersError>(rex.StatusCode switch {
                StatusCode.PermissionDenied => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                _                           => throw rex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Enables stream policy authorization for fine-grained access control based on stream prefixes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// When stream policies are enabled, traditional Access Control Lists (ACLs) on stream metadata
    /// are no longer enforced. The server will use policy-based authorization instead.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Default policies are automatically created on first enable, granting public access to user streams
    /// and restricting system streams to administrators.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, EnableStreamPoliciesError>> EnableStreamPolicies(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        using var client = GetBackdoorClient();
        try {
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/streams/$authorization-policy-settings") {
                Content = JsonContent.Create(new { streamAccessPolicyType = "streampolicy" })
            };
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventId", Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventType", "$authorization-policy-changed");
            var response = await client
                .SendAsync(request, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
            return Success.Instance;
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException hex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, EnableStreamPoliciesError>(hex.StatusCode switch {
                HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized or HttpStatusCode.Forbidden => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                HttpStatusCode.BadRequest                               => new ErrorDetails.BadRequest(),
                _                                                       => throw hex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Disables stream policy authorization and reverts to Access Control Lists (ACLs).
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// After disabling, the server will use traditional per-stream ACL metadata
    /// for authorization decisions.
    /// </remarks>
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, DisableStreamPoliciesError>> DisableStreamPolicies(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        using var client = GetBackdoorClient();
        try {
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/streams/$authorization-policy-settings") {
                Content = JsonContent.Create(new { streamAccessPolicyType = "acl" })
            };
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventId", Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventType", "$authorization-policy-changed");
            var response = await client
                .SendAsync(request, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
            return Success.Instance;
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException hex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, DisableStreamPoliciesError>(hex.StatusCode switch {
                HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized or HttpStatusCode.Forbidden => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                HttpStatusCode.BadRequest                               => new ErrorDetails.BadRequest(),
                _                                                       => throw hex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures stream policies, defining access rules for stream prefixes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">Policy configuration including policies, rules, and defaults.</param>
    /// <param name="validate">Whether to validate configuration before sending (default: true).</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This operation replaces the entire policy configuration. To update incrementally,
    /// first retrieve the current configuration with <see cref="GetCurrentStreamPolicy"/>,
    /// modify it, and then configure.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, ConfigureStreamPoliciesError>> ConfigureStreamPolicies(
        StreamPolicyConfiguration configuration,
        bool validate = true,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        if (validate)
            configuration.Validate();
        using var client = GetBackdoorClient();
        try {
            // Map to server schema (note the special JSON property names with $ prefix)
            var serverPayload = new {
                streamPolicies = configuration.StreamPolicies.ToDictionary(
                    kvp => kvp.Key,
                    kvp => new ServerAccessPolicy {
                        Readers         = kvp.Value.Readers,
                        Writers         = kvp.Value.Writers,
                        Deleters        = kvp.Value.Deleters,
                        MetadataReaders = kvp.Value.MetadataReaders,
                        MetadataWriters = kvp.Value.MetadataWriters
                    }
                ),
                streamRules = configuration.StreamRules.Select(r => new {
                    startsWith = r.Prefix,
                    policy     = r.PolicyName
                }),
                defaultStreamRules = new {
                    userStreams   = configuration.DefaultRules.UserStreams,
                    systemStreams = configuration.DefaultRules.SystemStreams
                }
            };
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/streams/$policies") {
                Content = JsonContent.Create(serverPayload, options: PolicySerializationOptions)
            };
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventId", Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            request.Headers.Add("ES-EventType", "$policy-updated");
            var response = await client
                .SendAsync(request, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
            return Success.Instance;
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException hex) {
            return Result.Failure<Success, ConfigureStreamPoliciesError>(hex.StatusCode switch {
                HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized or HttpStatusCode.Forbidden => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                HttpStatusCode.BadRequest                               => new ErrorDetails.BadRequest(),
                _                                                       => throw hex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the currently active stream policy configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Returns the most recent policy event from the $policies stream.
    /// If no policies are configured, returns a <see cref="ErrorDetails.NotFound"/> error.
    /// </remarks>
    public async ValueTask<Result<StreamPolicyConfiguration, GetStreamPoliciesError>> GetCurrentStreamPolicy(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        using var client = GetBackdoorClient();
        try {
            // Read latest event from $policies stream with body embedded
            var response = await client
                .GetFromJsonAsync<ServerPolicyStreamResponse>("/streams/$policies/head/backward/1?embed=body", PolicySerializationOptions, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (response?.Entries == null || response.Entries.Length == 0)
                return Result.Failure<StreamPolicyConfiguration, GetStreamPoliciesError>(new ErrorDetails.NotFound());
            var policyData = response.Entries[0].Data;
            if (policyData == null)
                return Result.Failure<StreamPolicyConfiguration, GetStreamPoliciesError>(new ErrorDetails.NotFound());
            // Map from server schema to client model
            var config = new StreamPolicyConfiguration {
                StreamPolicies = policyData.StreamPolicies.ToImmutableDictionary(
                    kvp => kvp.Key,
                    kvp => new StreamAccessPolicy {
                        Readers         = kvp.Value.Readers,
                        Writers         = kvp.Value.Writers,
                        Deleters        = kvp.Value.Deleters,
                        MetadataReaders = kvp.Value.MetadataReaders,
                        MetadataWriters = kvp.Value.MetadataWriters
                    }
                ),
                StreamRules = policyData.StreamRules.Select(r => new StreamPrefixRule(r.StartsWith, r.Policy)).ToImmutableArray(),
                DefaultRules = new DefaultPolicyRules {
                    UserStreams   = policyData.DefaultStreamRules.UserStreams,
                    SystemStreams = policyData.DefaultStreamRules.SystemStreams
                }
            };
            return config;
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException hex) {
            return Result.Failure<StreamPolicyConfiguration, GetStreamPoliciesError>(hex.StatusCode switch {
                HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized or HttpStatusCode.Forbidden => new ErrorDetails.AccessDenied(),
                HttpStatusCode.NotFound                                 => new ErrorDetails.NotFound(),
                _                                                       => throw hex.WithOriginalCallStack()
            });
        }
    }
    static readonly JsonSerializerOptions PolicySerializationOptions = new() {
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
    };
    // Internal server schema mapping classes
    sealed record ServerAccessPolicy {
        [JsonPropertyName("$r")]
        public string[] Readers { get; init; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("$w")]
        public string[] Writers { get; init; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("$d")]
        public string[] Deleters { get; init; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("$mr")]
        public string[] MetadataReaders { get; init; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("$mw")]
        public string[] MetadataWriters { get; init; } = [];
    }
    sealed record ServerStreamRule {
        [JsonPropertyName("startsWith")]
        public string StartsWith { get; init; } = "";
        [JsonPropertyName("policy")]
        public string Policy { get; init; } = "";
    }
    sealed record ServerDefaultStreamRules {
        [JsonPropertyName("userStreams")]
        public string UserStreams { get; init; } = "";
        [JsonPropertyName("systemStreams")]
        public string SystemStreams { get; init; } = "";
    }
    sealed record ServerPolicyData {
        [JsonPropertyName("streamPolicies")]
        public Dictionary<string, ServerAccessPolicy> StreamPolicies { get; init; } = new();
        [JsonPropertyName("streamRules")]
        public ServerStreamRule[] StreamRules { get; init; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("defaultStreamRules")]
        public ServerDefaultStreamRules DefaultStreamRules { get; init; } = new();
    }
    sealed record ServerPolicyStreamEntry {
        [JsonPropertyName("data")]
        public ServerPolicyData? Data { get; init; }
    }
    sealed record ServerPolicyStreamResponse {
        [JsonPropertyName("entries")]
        public ServerPolicyStreamEntry[]? Entries { get; init; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.Client;
/// <summary>
/// Base class for client modules that provides access to the Kurrent client, logger, and other common functionality.
/// This class is intended to be inherited by specific client modules that interact with KurrentDB.
/// It encapsulates shared functionality such as logging, schema serialization, and metadata decoding.
/// </summary>
public abstract class ClientModuleBase {
    protected ClientModuleBase(KurrentClient client, string? moduleName = null) {
        KurrentClient = client;
        Time          = TimeProvider.System;
        LoggerFactory = client.Options.LoggerFactory;
        Logger        = client.Options.LoggerFactory.CreateLogger(moduleName ?? GetType().Name);
    }
    KurrentClient KurrentClient { get; }
    protected internal TimeProvider   Time          { get; }
    protected internal ILoggerFactory LoggerFactory { get; }
    protected internal ILogger        Logger        { get; }
    protected ISchemaSerializerProvider SerializerProvider => KurrentClient.SerializerProvider;
    protected ServerCapabilities        ServerCapabilities => KurrentClient.LegacyCallInvoker.ServerCapabilities;
    protected MessageTypeMapper         TypeMapper         => KurrentClient.Options.Mapper;
    protected IMetadataDecoder          MetadataDecoder    => KurrentClient.Options.MetadataDecoder;
    protected HttpClient GetBackdoorClient() =>
        KurrentClient.BackdoorClientFactory.GetClient();
}
````

````csharp
using System.Net;
namespace Kurrent.Client;
[PublicAPI]
public class ConnectionOptionsBuilder : OptionsBuilder<ConnectionOptionsBuilder, KurrentClientOptions> {
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder(KurrentClientOptions options) : base(options) { }
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder() : base(new KurrentClientOptions()) { }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionName">The name of the connection.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithConnectionName(string connectionName) {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionName);
        return With(options => options with { ConnectionName = connectionName });
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to direct and configures a single-node connection.
    /// <remarks>
    /// Overrides any existing endpoints and sets the connection scheme to <see cref="KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct"/>.
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="uri">The URI of the server.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithDirectConnection(Uri uri) =>
        WithDirectConnection(uri.Host, uri.Port, uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to direct and configures a single-node connection.
    /// <remarks>
    /// Overrides any existing endpoints and sets the connection scheme to <see cref="KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct"/>.
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="host">The hostname of the server.</param>
    /// <param name="port">The port of the server.</param>
    /// <param name="useTls">Whether to use TLS.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithDirectConnection(string host, int port, bool useTls = true) {
        return With(options => options with {
            ConnectionScheme = KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct,
            Endpoints        = [new DnsEndPoint(host, port)],
            Security         = options.Security with { Transport = useTls ? TransportSecurity.Standard : TransportSecurity.None }
        });
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to discover and configures a gossip endpoint for cluster discovery.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="uri">The URI of the server.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithGossipEndpoint(Uri uri) =>
        WithGossipEndpoint(uri.Host, uri.Port, uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps);
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to discover and configures a gossip endpoint for cluster discovery.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="host">The hostname of the server.</param>
    /// <param name="port">The port of the server.</param>
    /// <param name="useTls">Whether to use TLS.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithGossipEndpoint(string host, int port, bool useTls = true) =>
        WithGossipEndpoint(new DnsEndPoint(host, port));
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to discover and configures a gossip endpoint for cluster discovery.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="endpoint">The DNS endpoint to use for gossip discovery.</param>
    /// <param name="useTls">Whether to use TLS.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithGossipEndpoint(DnsEndPoint endpoint, bool useTls = true) {
        return With(options => options with {
            ConnectionScheme = KurrentConnectionScheme.Discover,
            Endpoints        = options.Endpoints.Concat([endpoint]).ToArray(),
            Security         = options.Security with { Transport = useTls ? TransportSecurity.Standard : TransportSecurity.None }
        });
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the connection scheme to discover and configures multiple gossip endpoints for cluster discovery.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="endpoints">The DNS endpoints to use.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithGossipEndpoint(params DnsEndPoint[] endpoints) {
        return With(options => options with {
            ConnectionScheme = KurrentConnectionScheme.Discover,
            Endpoints        = options.Endpoints.Concat(endpoints).ToArray(),
            Security         = options.Security with { Transport = TransportSecurity.Standard }
        });
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the gossip options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="gossipOptions">The gossip configuration options.</param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>

        With(options => options with { Gossip = gossipOptions });
    /// <summary>

    /// </param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithGossipOptions(Func<KurrentClientGossipOptions, KurrentClientGossipOptions> configure) =>
        With(options => options with { Gossip = configure(options.Gossip) });
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the authentication credentials for the client.
    /// </summary>

    /// The client credentials to use for authentication.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithAuthentication(ClientCredentials credentials) =>
        With(options => options with { Security = options.Security with { Authentication = credentials } });
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the authentication credentials for the client using basic authentication.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="username">
    /// The username for basic authentication.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="password">
    /// The password for basic authentication. Can be null if no password is required.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>The builder instance for method chaining.</returns>
    public ConnectionOptionsBuilder WithBasicAuthentication(string username, string? password) =>
        WithAuthentication(ClientCredentials.Basic(username, password));
````
