````csharp
	public static ValueTask<Result<Success, TError>> ToResultAsync<TError>(
		this ValueTask operation,
		Func<Exception, ValueTask<TError>> errorFactory)
		where TError : IResultError =>
		TryAsync(() => operation, errorFactory);
	public static ValueTask<Result<TValue, TError>> ToResultAsync<TValue, TError>(
		this ValueTask<TValue> operation,
		Func<Exception, TError> errorFactory)
		where TError : IResultError =>
		TryAsync(() => operation, errorFactory);
	public static ValueTask<Result<TValue, TError>> ToResultAsync<TValue, TError>(
		this ValueTask<TValue> operation,
		Func<Exception, ValueTask<TError>> errorFactory)
		where TError : IResultError =>
		TryAsync(() => operation, errorFactory);
	public static Result<TValue, ResultError> ToResult<TValue>(this Func<TValue> operation) =>
		ToResult(operation, ex => (ResultError) ResultError.Create(ex));
	public static Result<Success, ResultError> ToResult(this Action operation) =>
		ToResult<ResultError>(operation, ex => (ResultError) ResultError.Create(ex));
	public static ValueTask<Result<TValue, ResultError>> ToResultAsync<TValue>(this ValueTask<TValue> operation) =>
		ToResultAsync(operation, ex => (ResultError) ResultError.Create(ex));
	public static ValueTask<Result<Success, ResultError>> ToResultAsync(this ValueTask operation) =>
		ToResultAsync(operation, ex => (ResultError) ResultError.Create(ex));
	#endregion
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable CheckNamespace
using System.Collections.Immutable;
namespace Kurrent.Variant;
/// <summary>
/// Specialized variant interface for discriminated union error types where all variants are exceptions.
/// Implements IResultError to enable use as error type in Result&lt;TValue, TError&gt;.
/// </summary>
public interface IVariantException : IVariant, IResultError {
    ErrorCode IResultError.ErrorCode => ErrorCode.FromType(Value.GetType());
    string IResultError.ErrorMessage => ((Exception)Value).Message;
    ImmutableDictionary<string, object?> IResultError.Metadata => ImmutableDictionary<string, object?>.Empty
        .Add(ResultError.ReservedErrorCodeKey, ErrorCode.FromType(Value.GetType()));
    Exception IResultError.GetOrCreateException() => (Exception)Value;
}
````

````csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
namespace Kurrent.Variant.SourceGenerators;
/// <summary>
/// Provides deterministic, collision-resistant file naming for source generators.
/// </summary>
public static class SourceGeneratorFileNaming {
    /// <summary>
    /// Generates a deterministic hint name for source-generated files.
    /// The method automatically extracts generic type arguments from the type symbol if available,
    /// or uses the type's fully qualified name for hash computation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="typeSymbol">The type symbol being generated.</param>
    /// <param name="options">Optional configuration for file naming.</param>
    /// <param name="typeArgs">Optional explicit type arguments. If null, automatically extracted from typeSymbol.</param>
    /// <returns>A hint name suitable for AddSource() that includes a deterministic hash.</returns>
    public static string GetHintName(
        INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol,
        FileNamingOptions? options = null,
        IEnumerable<ITypeSymbol>? typeArgs = null
    ) {
        options ??= FileNamingOptions.Default;
        var hashInput      = GenerateHashInput(typeSymbol, typeArgs?.ToList() ?? []);
        var hash           = ComputeStableHash(hashInput);
        var fileName       = BuildFileName(typeSymbol.Name, hash, options);
        var directoryParts = BuildDirectoryParts(typeSymbol, options);
        return CombinePathParts(directoryParts, fileName, options);
    }
    static string GenerateHashInput(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, List<ITypeSymbol> typeArgs) {
        string s;
        if (typeArgs.Count > 0)
            // Use fully qualified type arguments for hash
            s = string.Join(",", typeArgs.Select(t => t.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat)));
        else if (typeSymbol is { IsGenericType: true, TypeArguments.Length: > 0 })
            // Auto-extract from generic type
            s = string.Join(",", typeSymbol.TypeArguments.Select(t => t.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat)));
        else
            // Use fully qualified type name as fallback
            s = typeSymbol.ToDisplayString(SymbolDisplayFormat.FullyQualifiedFormat);
        return s;
    }
    static string BuildFileName(string typeName, string hash, FileNamingOptions options) {
        var name = options.LowercasePath ? typeName.ToLowerInvariant() : typeName;
        return $"{name}_{hash}.g.cs";
    }
    static List<string> BuildDirectoryParts(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, FileNamingOptions options) {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Prefix) && options.UseFoldersForPrefix) {
            var prefix = ApplyCasing(options.Prefix, options.LowercasePath);
            parts.Add(prefix);
        }
        if (options.UseFoldersForNamespace) {
            var namespaceName  = GetNamespaceName(typeSymbol);
            var casedNamespace = ApplyCasing(namespaceName, options.LowercasePath);
            parts.Add(casedNamespace);
        }
        return parts;
    }
    static string CombinePathParts(List<string> directoryParts, string fileName, FileNamingOptions options) {
        if (directoryParts.Count > 0) {
            var directory = string.Join("/", directoryParts);
            return $"{directory}/{fileName}";
        }
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Prefix) && !options.UseFoldersForPrefix) {
            var prefix = ApplyCasing(options.Prefix!, options.LowercasePath);
            return $"{prefix}_{fileName}";
        }
        return fileName;
    }
    static string GetNamespaceName(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol) =>
        typeSymbol.ContainingNamespace.IsGlobalNamespace
            ? "Global"
            : typeSymbol.ContainingNamespace.ToDisplayString();
    static string ApplyCasing(string value, bool lowercase) => lowercase ? value.ToLowerInvariant() : value;
    static string ComputeStableHash(string input) {
        using var md5  = MD5.Create();
        var hash = md5.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input));
        return BitConverter.ToString(hash).Replace("-", "").Substring(0, 8);
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Configuration options for source generator file naming.
/// </summary>
public sealed class FileNamingOptions {
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the default file naming options.
    /// </summary>
    public static FileNamingOptions Default { get; } = new() {
        UseFoldersForNamespace = true,
        UseFoldersForPrefix    = true,
        LowercasePath          = false,
        Prefix                 = null
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// When true, creates a folder hierarchy for the namespace (e.g., "Kurrent/Client/").
    /// When false, namespace is not included in the path.
    /// Default: true
    /// </summary>
    public bool UseFoldersForNamespace { get; set; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// When true and Prefix is set, the prefix becomes a folder (e.g., "Variants/...").
    /// When false and Prefix is set, the prefix is prepended to the filename (e.g., "Variants_TypeName_HASH.g.cs").
    /// Default: true
    /// </summary>
    public bool UseFoldersForPrefix { get; set; } = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// When true, converts all path components to lowercase.
    /// Default: false
    /// </summary>
    public bool LowercasePath { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Optional prefix for the generated file.
    /// Behavior depends on UseFoldersForPrefix.
    /// Default: null
    /// </summary>
    public string? Prefix { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new instance with flat file naming (no folders).
    /// </summary>
    public static FileNamingOptions Flat => new() {
        UseFoldersForNamespace = false,
        UseFoldersForPrefix    = false
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new instance with lowercase paths.
    /// </summary>
    public static FileNamingOptions Lowercase => new() {
        UseFoldersForNamespace = true,
        UseFoldersForPrefix    = true,
        LowercasePath          = true
    };
}
````

## File: src/Variant.SourceGenerators/Variant.SourceGenerators.csproj
````
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFrameworks>netstandard2.0;</TargetFrameworks>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <IsRoslynComponent>true</IsRoslynComponent>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <RootNamespace>Kurrent.Variant.SourceGenerators</RootNamespace>
    <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>
    <!-- This ensures the project itself is treated as an analyzer package -->
    <DevelopmentDependency>true</DevelopmentDependency>
    <EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>true</EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Roslyn API for writing C# Source Generators -->
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp" PrivateAssets="All" />
    <!-- Analyzers package, often included with CSharp but good to be explicit -->
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers" PrivateAssets="All" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
````

````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Attributes;
using EnumerableAsyncProcessor.Extensions;
using Kurrent.Testing.Sample.HomeAutomation;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks.Benchmarks;
/// <summary>
/// Benchmarks comparing different implementations of ReadBatches for async enumerable batching.
/// Tests throughput with sync fast path (items yield immediately).
/// </summary>
[Config(typeof(BenchmarkConfig))]
public class ReadBatchesBenchmarks {
    [Params(100, 250, 500, 1000)]
    public int BatchSize { get; set; }
    [Params(1000, 5000)]
    public int TotalItems { get; set; }
    static TimeSpan DefaultTimeout => TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100);
    List<IHomeAutomationEvent> _events = null!;
    [GlobalSetup]
    public void Setup() =>
        _events = HomeAutomationDataSet.Default.Events(50_000);
    // Fast path - sync completion (throughput benchmarks)
    IAsyncEnumerable<IHomeAutomationEvent> CreateFastSource() =>
        _events.Take(TotalItems).ToAsyncEnumerable();
    [Benchmark(Baseline = true)]
    public async Task<int> Current_ArrayPoolCollectionsMarshal() {
        var count = 0;
        await foreach (var batch in CreateFastSource().ReadBatches_Current(BatchSize, DefaultTimeout))
            count += batch.Count;
        return count;
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public async Task<int> SimpleListAdd() {
        var count = 0;
        await foreach (var batch in CreateFastSource().ReadBatches_SimpleListAdd(BatchSize, DefaultTimeout))
            count += batch.Count;
        return count;
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public async Task<int> CtsTimeout() {
        var count = 0;
        await foreach (var batch in CreateFastSource().ReadBatches_CtsTimeout(BatchSize, DefaultTimeout))
            count += batch.Count;
        return count;
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public async Task<int> SpreadSyntax() {
        var count = 0;
        await foreach (var batch in CreateFastSource().ReadBatches_SpreadSyntax(BatchSize, DefaultTimeout))
            count += batch.Count;
        return count;
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Implementation Variants
// =============================================================================
static class ReadBatchesImplementations {
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Current Implementation (Baseline)
    //    ArrayPool + CollectionsMarshal.SetCount + WaitAsync timeout
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    public static async IAsyncEnumerable<List<T>> ReadBatches_Current<T>(
        this IAsyncEnumerable<T> source,
        int batchSize,
        TimeSpan timeout,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        var pool   = ArrayPool<T>.Shared;
        var buffer = pool.Rent(batchSize);
        try {
            await using var enumerator = source.GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var count = 0;
                var start = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
                while (count < batchSize) {
                    bool hasNext;
                    try {
                        var moveNext = enumerator.MoveNextAsync();
                        // fast path: synchronous completion avoids task allocation
                        if (moveNext.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                            hasNext = moveNext.Result;
                        else {
                            // slow path: async with remaining timeout
                            var remaining = timeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(start);
                            if (remaining <= TimeSpan.Zero)
                                break; // timeout expired
                            hasNext = await moveNext.AsTask()
                                .WaitAsync(remaining, cancellationToken)
                                .ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (TimeoutException) {
                        break; // batch timeout, yield what we have
                    }
                    if (!hasNext) {
                        // source exhausted
                        if (count > 0)
                            yield return ToListCollectionsMarshal(buffer, count);
                        yield break;
                    }
                    buffer[count++] = enumerator.Current;
                }
                if (count > 0)
                    yield return ToListCollectionsMarshal(buffer, count);
            }
        }
        finally {
            // only clear if T can hold references (avoids clearing value types)
            pool.Return(buffer, clearArray: RuntimeHelpers.IsReferenceOrContainsReferences<T>());
        }
        yield break;
        // Creates a List from a buffer segment using CollectionsMarshal for efficient bulk copy.
        static List<T> ToListCollectionsMarshal(T[] buffer, int count) {
            var list = new List<T>(count);
            CollectionsMarshal.SetCount(list, count);
            buffer.AsSpan(0, count).CopyTo(CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(list));
            return list;
        }
    }
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Simple List.Add Implementation
    //    No ArrayPool, direct List.Add() calls
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    public static async IAsyncEnumerable<List<T>> ReadBatches_SimpleListAdd<T>(
        this IAsyncEnumerable<T> source,
        int batchSize,
        TimeSpan timeout,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        await using var enumerator = source.GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
        while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
            var batch = new List<T>(batchSize);
            var start = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
            while (batch.Count < batchSize) {
                bool hasNext;
                try {
                    var moveNext = enumerator.MoveNextAsync();
                    // fast path: synchronous completion avoids task allocation
                    if (moveNext.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                        hasNext = moveNext.Result;
                    else {
                        // slow path: async with remaining timeout
                        var remaining = timeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(start);
                        if (remaining <= TimeSpan.Zero)
                            break; // timeout expired
                        hasNext = await moveNext.AsTask()
                            .WaitAsync(remaining, cancellationToken)
                            .ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                }
                catch (TimeoutException) {
                    break; // batch timeout, yield what we have
                }
                if (!hasNext) {
                    // source exhausted
                    if (batch.Count > 0)
                        yield return batch;
                    yield break;
                }
                batch.Add(enumerator.Current);
            }
            if (batch.Count > 0)
                yield return batch;
        }
    }
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. CTS-based Timeout Implementation
    //    ArrayPool + CollectionsMarshal, uses CancellationTokenSource.CancelAfter()
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    public static async IAsyncEnumerable<List<T>> ReadBatches_CtsTimeout<T>(
        this IAsyncEnumerable<T> source,
        int batchSize,
        TimeSpan timeout,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        var pool   = ArrayPool<T>.Shared;
        var buffer = pool.Rent(batchSize);
        try {
            await using var enumerator = source.GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var count = 0;
                using var timeoutCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
                timeoutCts.CancelAfter(timeout);
                while (count < batchSize) {
                    bool hasNext;
                    try {
                        var moveNext = enumerator.MoveNextAsync();
                        // fast path: synchronous completion avoids task allocation
                        if (moveNext.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                            hasNext = moveNext.Result;
                        else {
                            // slow path: wait with CTS timeout
                            hasNext = await moveNext.AsTask()
                                .WaitAsync(timeoutCts.Token)
                                .ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (OperationCanceledException) when (timeoutCts.IsCancellationRequested && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                        break; // batch timeout, yield what we have
                    }
                    if (!hasNext) {
                        // source exhausted
                        if (count > 0)
                            yield return ToListCollectionsMarshal(buffer, count);
                        yield break;
                    }
                    buffer[count++] = enumerator.Current;
                }
                if (count > 0)
                    yield return ToListCollectionsMarshal(buffer, count);
            }
        }
        finally {
            // only clear if T can hold references (avoids clearing value types)
            pool.Return(buffer, clearArray: RuntimeHelpers.IsReferenceOrContainsReferences<T>());
        }
        yield break;
        // Creates a List from a buffer segment using CollectionsMarshal for efficient bulk copy.
        static List<T> ToListCollectionsMarshal(T[] buffer, int count) {
            var list = new List<T>(count);
            CollectionsMarshal.SetCount(list, count);
            buffer.AsSpan(0, count).CopyTo(CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(list));
            return list;
        }
    }
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Spread Syntax Implementation
    //    ArrayPool + [..span] collection expression instead of CollectionsMarshal
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    public static async IAsyncEnumerable<List<T>> ReadBatches_SpreadSyntax<T>(
        this IAsyncEnumerable<T> source,
        int batchSize,
        TimeSpan timeout,
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
    ) {
        var pool   = ArrayPool<T>.Shared;
        var buffer = pool.Rent(batchSize);
        try {
            await using var enumerator = source.GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var count = 0;
                var start = TimeProvider.System.GetTimestamp();
                while (count < batchSize) {
                    bool hasNext;
                    try {
                        var moveNext = enumerator.MoveNextAsync();
                        // fast path: synchronous completion avoids task allocation
                        if (moveNext.IsCompletedSuccessfully)
                            hasNext = moveNext.Result;
                        else {
                            // slow path: async with remaining timeout
                            var remaining = timeout - TimeProvider.System.GetElapsedTime(start);
                            if (remaining <= TimeSpan.Zero)
                                break; // timeout expired
                            hasNext = await moveNext.AsTask()
                                .WaitAsync(remaining, cancellationToken)
                                .ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (TimeoutException) {
                        break; // batch timeout, yield what we have
                    }
                    if (!hasNext) {
                        // source exhausted
                        if (count > 0)
                            yield return [..buffer.AsSpan(0, count)];
                        yield break;
                    }
                    buffer[count++] = enumerator.Current;
                }
                if (count > 0)
                    yield return [..buffer.AsSpan(0, count)];
            }
        }
        finally {
            // only clear if T can hold references (avoids clearing value types)
            pool.Return(buffer, clearArray: RuntimeHelpers.IsReferenceOrContainsReferences<T>());
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using BenchmarkDotNet.Attributes;
using Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks.Infrastructure;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks.Benchmarks;
/// <summary>
/// Benchmarks for reading from $all log with different filter configurations.
/// </summary>
[MemoryDiagnoser]
[Config(typeof(BenchmarkConfig))]
public class ReadLogBenchmarks {
    BenchmarkFixture _fixture = null!;
    [Params(10000)]
    public int MessageCount { get; set; }
    [Params(1000, 5000)]
    public int BufferCapacity { get; set; }
    [Params(true, false)]
    public bool SkipDecoding { get; set; }
    [Params(ReadDirection.Forwards, ReadDirection.Backwards)]
    public ReadDirection Direction { get; set; }
    [GlobalSetup]
    public void Setup() {
        _fixture = new BenchmarkFixture();
        _fixture.InitializeAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        _ = _fixture.SeedStream(MessageCount).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }
    [Benchmark(Description = "Read $all forward with limit")]
    public async Task<int> read_log_forward() {
        var options = new ReadOptions {
            Start        = Direction == ReadDirection.Forwards ? LogPosition.Earliest : LogPosition.Latest,
            Direction    = Direction,
            BufferCapacity   = BufferCapacity,
            SkipDecoding = SkipDecoding,
            Heartbeat    = HeartbeatOptions.Disabled,
            MaxRecords   = MessageCount,
        };
        var messages = await _fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadRecords(options)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var count = 0;
            await foreach (var msg in messages) {
                count++;
                if (count >= MessageCount)
                    break;
            }
            return count;
        }
        finally {
            await messages.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    [GlobalCleanup]
    public void Cleanup() {
        _fixture.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using BenchmarkDotNet.Attributes;
using Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks.Infrastructure;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks.Benchmarks;
/// <summary>
/// Benchmarks for reading from a single named stream with various configurations.
/// </summary>
[MemoryDiagnoser]
[Config(typeof(BenchmarkConfig))]
public class ReadStreamBenchmarks {
    BenchmarkFixture _fixture = null!;
    StreamName _stream;
    [Params(100, 1000, 5000, 10000)]
    public int MessageCount { get; set; }
    [Params(1000)]
    public int BufferCapacity { get; set; }
    [Params(true, false)]
    public bool SkipDecoding { get; set; }
    [GlobalSetup]
    public void Setup() {
        _fixture = new BenchmarkFixture();
        _fixture.InitializeAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        _stream = _fixture.SeedStream(MessageCount).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }
    [Benchmark(Baseline = true, Description = "Read stream")]
    public async Task<int> read_stream() {
        var options = new ReadStreamOptions {
            Stream         = _stream,
            BufferCapacity = BufferCapacity,
            SkipDecoding   = SkipDecoding,
            Heartbeat      = HeartbeatOptions.Disabled
        };
        var messages = await _fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadRecords(options)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var count = 0;
            await foreach (var msg in messages)
                count++;
            return count;
        }
        finally {
            await messages.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    [Benchmark(Description = "Read stream with LINQ")]
    public async Task<int> read_stream_with_linq() {
        var options = new ReadStreamOptions {
            Stream       = _stream,
            BufferCapacity   = BufferCapacity,
            SkipDecoding = SkipDecoding,
            Heartbeat    = HeartbeatOptions.Disabled
        };
        var messages = await _fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadRecords(options)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            return await messages
                .Where(m => m.IsRecord)
                .CountAsync()
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally {
            await messages.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    // [Benchmark(Description = "Read stream from $all")]
    public async Task<int> read_stream_from_log() {
        var options = new ReadOptions {
            Start        = LogPosition.Earliest,
            Filter       = RecordFilter.ByStream(_stream),
            BufferCapacity   = BufferCapacity,
            SkipDecoding = SkipDecoding,
            Heartbeat    = HeartbeatOptions.Disabled
        };
        var messages = await _fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadRecords(options)
            .UnwrapAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        try {
            var count = 0;
            await foreach (var msg in messages)
                count++;
            return count;
        }
        finally {
            await messages.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
    [GlobalCleanup]
    public void Cleanup() {
        _fixture.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using BenchmarkDotNet.Columns;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Configs;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Diagnosers;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Exporters;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Jobs;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Reports;
using BenchmarkDotNet.Toolchains.InProcess.Emit;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Benchmarks;
public class BenchmarkConfig : ManualConfig {
    public BenchmarkConfig() {
        AddDiagnoser(MemoryDiagnoser.Default);
        AddColumn(StatisticColumn.P95);
        AddColumn(RankColumn.Arabic);
        // Use InProcess toolchain to avoid rebuild issues with gRPC code generation
        AddJob(Job.Default
            .WithToolchain(InProcessEmitToolchain.Instance)
            .WithWarmupCount(1)
            .WithIterationCount(5));
        AddExporter(MarkdownExporter.GitHub);
        AddExporter(HtmlExporter.Default);
        WithSummaryStyle(SummaryStyle.Default.WithMaxParameterColumnWidth(50));
    }
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable ConvertToConstant.Local

// ReSharper disable ClassNeverInstantiated.Local
using Kurrent.Client.Projections;
using Kurrent.Client.Testing.TUnit;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Projections;
[Category("Projections")]
public class ProjectionsStateTests : KurrentClientTestFixture {
	[Test, TimeoutAfter.TenSeconds]
	public async Task returns_projection_state(CancellationToken ct) {
        var stream = NewStreamName();
		var definition = $$"""
			fromStream('{{stream}}').when({
				"$init": function() { return { Count: 0 }; },
				"$any": function(s, e) { 
				    log(JSON.stringify(e));
				    s.Count++; 
				    return s; 
				}
			})
			.outputState();
			""";
        var projection = ProjectionName.From(stream);
		await AutomaticClient.Projections
			.Create(projection, definition, ct)
			.ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
		await SeedTestMessages(stream, transformMetadata: _ => { }, cancellationToken: ct);
        await Task.Delay(1.Seconds(), ct); // Allow time for the projection to process messages
        await AutomaticClient.Projections
            .GetState<TestProjectionState>(projection, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(
                state => state.Count.ShouldBeGreaterThan(0));
	}
    record TestProjectionState(int Count);
}
````

````csharp
    static readonly string TestDefinition = "fromAll().when({ $init: function (state, ev) { return {}; } });";

			return s; 
		}
	})
	.outputState();
	""";
    public override ValueTask OnSetUp(IServiceCollection services) => CleanUpProjections();
    async ValueTask CleanUpProjections() {
        var projections = await AutomaticClient.Projections
            .ListAsync(new ListProjectionsOptions { Type = ProjectionType.User })
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        await using var processor = projections
            .ForEachAsync(async p => {
                if (p.Status == ProjectionStatus.Stopped)
                    Logger.LogInformation("[CleanUpProjections] Projection {ProjectionName} is already stopped: {ProjectionStatus}", p.Name, p.Status);
                else {
                    try {
                        await AutomaticClient.Projections.DisableAsync(p.Name).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        Logger.LogInformation("[CleanUpProjections] Stopped projection {ProjectionName}", p.Name);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) {
                        Logger.LogWarning(ex, "[CleanUpProjections] Failed to stop projection {ProjectionName}", p.Name);
                    }
                }
                try {
                    await AutomaticClient.Projections.DeleteAsync(p.Name).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    Logger.LogInformation("[CleanUpProjections] Deleted projection {ProjectionName}", p.Name);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) {
                    Logger.LogWarning(ex, "[CleanUpProjections] Failed to delete projection {ProjectionName}", p.Name);
                }
            })
            .ProcessInParallel();
    }

        await AutomaticClient.Projections
            .GetDetails(projection, ct)

                details.Mode.ShouldBe(ProjectionMode.Continuous);
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Integration.Tests/Registry/CheckSchemaCompatibilityTests.cs
````csharp
using Grpc.Core;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using NJsonSchema;
using static Kurrent.Client.Registry.CompatibilityMode;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Registry;
public class CheckSchemaCompatibilityTests : KurrentClientTestFixture {
	const int TestTimeoutMs = 20_000;
	[Test, Timeout(TestTimeoutMs)]
	public async Task backward_mode_incompatible_when_deleting_required_field(CancellationToken ct) {
		var schemaName  = NewSchemaName();
		var v1 = NewJsonSchemaDefinition().AddRequired("email", JsonObjectType.String);
		var v2 = v1.Remove("email");
		var schemaVersion = await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CreateSchema(schemaName, v1.ToJson(), SchemaDataFormat.Json, Backward, Faker.Lorem.Sentences(), [], ct)
			.ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
		await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CheckSchemaCompatibility(schemaVersion.VersionId, v2.ToJson(), SchemaDataFormat.Json, ct)
			.ShouldFailAsync(failure => {
                failure.Case.ShouldBe(CheckSchemaCompatibilityError.CheckSchemaCompatibilityErrorCase.SchemaCompatibilityErrors);
				var errors = failure.AsSchemaCompatibilityErrors.Errors;
				errors.ShouldContain(e => e.Kind == SchemaCompatibilityErrorKind.MissingRequiredProperty);
				errors.ShouldContain(e => e.Details.Contains("Required property in original schema is missing in new schema"));
				errors.ShouldContain(e => e.PropertyPath.Contains("email"));
			});
	}
	[Test, Timeout(TestTimeoutMs)]
	public async Task check_schema_compatibility_fails_when_schema_not_found(CancellationToken ct) {
        var schemaName       = SchemaName.From(NewSchemaName());
        var schemaDefinition = NewJsonSchemaDefinition().ToJson();
        await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CheckSchemaCompatibility(schemaName, schemaDefinition, SchemaDataFormat.Json, ct)
			.ShouldFailAsync(failure =>
                failure.Case.ShouldBe(CheckSchemaCompatibilityError.CheckSchemaCompatibilityErrorCase.NotFound));
	}
	[Test, Timeout(TestTimeoutMs)]
	public async Task check_schema_compatibility_handles_fatal_errors(CancellationToken ct) {
		var v1 = NewJsonSchemaDefinition();
		var result = async () => await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CheckSchemaCompatibility(SchemaName.From("#"), v1.ToJson(), SchemaDataFormat.Json, ct);
		var exception = await result.ShouldThrowAsync<KurrentException>();
		exception.ErrorCode.ShouldBe(nameof(StatusCode.InvalidArgument));
		exception.ErrorData.GetRequired<List<FieldViolation>>("FieldViolations").ShouldSatisfyAllConditions(
			vs => vs.ShouldNotBeEmpty(),
			vs => vs.ShouldHaveSingleItem(),
			vs => vs.ShouldContain(v => v.Field == "SchemaName"),
			vs => vs.ShouldContain(v => v.Description == "Schema name must not be empty and can only contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, dashes, and periods")
		);
	}
	[Test, Timeout(TestTimeoutMs)]
	public async Task check_schema_compatibility_fails_when_data_format_not_matching(CancellationToken ct) {
        var schemaName       = SchemaName.From(NewSchemaName());
        var schemaDefinition = NewJsonSchemaDefinition().ToJson();
		await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CreateSchema(schemaName, schemaDefinition, SchemaDataFormat.Json, ct)
			.ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
		await AutomaticClient.Registry
			.CheckSchemaCompatibility(schemaName, schemaDefinition, SchemaDataFormat.Protobuf, ct)
			.ShouldNotThrowAsync()
			.ShouldFailAsync(failure => {
                failure.Case.ShouldBe(CheckSchemaCompatibilityError.CheckSchemaCompatibilityErrorCase.SchemaCompatibilityErrors);
				var errors = failure.AsSchemaCompatibilityErrors.Errors;
				errors.ShouldContain(e => e.Kind == SchemaCompatibilityErrorKind.DataFormatMismatch);
			});
	}
}
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Integration.Tests/Registry/KurrentClientTestFixture.Helpers.cs
````csharp
// ReSharper disable CheckNamespace
using Google.Protobuf;
using NJsonSchema;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests;
public partial class KurrentClientTestFixture {
	protected static string NewSchemaName() => $"test-schema-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
	protected static JsonSchema NewJsonSchemaDefinition() {
		return JsonSchema.FromJsonAsync(
			"""
			{
			    "type": "object",
			    "properties": {
			        "id": { "type": "string" },
			        "name": { "type": "string" }
			    },
			    "required": ["id"]
			}
			"""
		).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
	}
}
public static class JsonSchemaExtensions {
	public static ByteString ToByteString(this JsonSchema schema) =>
		ByteString.CopyFromUtf8(schema.ToJson());
	static JsonSchema AddField(this JsonSchema schema, string name, JsonObjectType type, object? defaultValue = null, bool? required = false) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		clone.Properties[name] = new JsonSchemaProperty {
			Type = type,
			Default = defaultValue
		};
		switch (required) {
			case true when !clone.RequiredProperties.Contains(name):
				clone.RequiredProperties.Add(name);
				break;
			case false:
				clone.RequiredProperties.Remove(name);
				break;
		}
		return clone;
	}
	public static JsonSchema AddOptional(this JsonSchema schema, string name, JsonObjectType type, object? defaultValue = null) =>
		AddField(schema, name, type, defaultValue, required: false);
	public static JsonSchema AddRequired(this JsonSchema schema, string name, JsonObjectType type, object? defaultValue = null) =>
		AddField(schema, name, type, defaultValue, required: true);
	public static JsonSchema MakeRequired(this JsonSchema schema, string name) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		clone.RequiredProperties.Add(name);
		return clone;
	}
	public static JsonSchema Remove(this JsonSchema schema, string name) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		clone.Properties.Remove(name);
		clone.RequiredProperties.Remove(name);
		return clone;
	}
	public static JsonSchema MakeOptional(this JsonSchema schema, string name) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		clone.RequiredProperties.Remove(name);
		return clone;
	}
	public static JsonSchema ChangeType(this JsonSchema schema, string name, JsonObjectType newType) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		if (!clone.Properties.TryGetValue(name, out var property))
			throw new ArgumentException($"Property '{name}' does not exist in the schema");
		property.Type = newType;
		return clone;
	}
	public static JsonSchema WidenType(this JsonSchema schema, string name, JsonObjectType additionalType) {
		var clone = Clone(schema);
		if (!clone.Properties.TryGetValue(name, out var property))
			throw new ArgumentException($"Property '{name}' does not exist in the schema");
		property.Type |= additionalType;
		return clone;
	}
	static JsonSchema Clone(JsonSchema original) => JsonSchema.FromJsonAsync(original.ToJson()).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
}
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Integration.Tests/Streams/CatchUpSubscriptions/SusbcriptionTests.cs
````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Streams;
[Category("Streams"), Category("Subscription")]
public class SubscriptionTests : KurrentClientTestFixture {
    [Test]
    public async Task subscribes_to_all_streams(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulations = await SeedGameSimulations(50, ct: ct).ToListAsync(cancellationToken: ct);
        var gameEventsCount = simulations.Sum(x => x.Game.GameEvents.Count);
        var streams = simulations.Select(x => x.Game.Stream.Value).ToArray();
        var options = new AllSubscriptionOptions {
            Start             = LogPosition.Earliest,
            Filter            = ReadFilter.FromPrefixes(ReadFilterScope.Stream, streams),
            CancellationToken = ct
        };
        await using var subscription = await AutomaticClient.Streams
            .Subscribe(options)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        var recordsReceived = new List<Record>();
        Heartbeat caughtUp = default;
        await foreach (var msg in subscription) {
            if (msg.IsRecord) {
                recordsReceived.Add(msg.AsRecord);
                continue;
            }
            Logger.LogDebug("Received: {Message}", msg.AsHeartbeat.ToString());
            if (msg.AsHeartbeat.Type == HeartbeatType.CaughtUp) {
                caughtUp = msg.AsHeartbeat;
                break;
            }
        }
        caughtUp.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(0);
        recordsReceived.Count.ShouldBe(gameEventsCount);
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task subscribes_to_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await SeedGame(ct);
        var options = new StreamSubscriptionOptions {
            Stream            = simulation.Game.Stream,
            Start             = StreamRevision.Min,
            CancellationToken = ct
        };
        await using var subscription = await AutomaticClient.Streams
            .Subscribe(options)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        var recordsReceived = new List<Record>();
        Heartbeat caughtUp = default;
        await foreach (var msg in subscription) {
            if (msg.IsRecord) {
                recordsReceived.Add(msg.AsRecord);
                Logger.LogDebug("Received: {Message}", msg.AsRecord.ToString());
                continue;
            }
            Logger.LogDebug("Received: {Message}", msg.AsHeartbeat.ToString());
            if (msg.AsHeartbeat.Type == HeartbeatType.CaughtUp) {
                caughtUp = msg.AsHeartbeat;
                break;
            }
        }
        caughtUp.StreamRevision.ShouldBeEquivalentTo(simulation.Revision);
        recordsReceived.Count.ShouldBe(simulation.Game.GameEvents.Count);
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task stops_gracefully(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await SeedGame(ct);
        var options = new StreamSubscriptionOptions {
            Stream            = simulation.Game.Stream,
            Start             = StreamRevision.Min,
            CancellationToken = ct
        };
        var subscription = await AutomaticClient.Streams
            .Subscribe(options)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        var recordsReceived = new List<Record>();
        await foreach (var msg in subscription) {
            if (!msg.IsRecord) continue;
            recordsReceived.Add(msg.AsRecord);
            Logger.LogDebug("Received: {Message}", msg.AsRecord.ToString());
            break;
        }
        recordsReceived.Count.ShouldBe(1);
        await Should.NotThrowAsync(async () => await subscription.DisposeAsync());
    }
}
````

````csharp
#pragma warning disable CA1822 // Mark members as static
// ReSharper disable CheckNamespace
using Bogus;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using UserDetails = Kurrent.Client.Users.UserDetails;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests;
public partial class KurrentClientTestFixture {
	public async ValueTask<TestUser[]> CreateTestUsers(int count = 3, bool withoutGroups = true) {
		if (count < 1)
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(count), "Count must be greater than zero.");
		var users = Users
			.RuleFor(x => x.Groups, f => withoutGroups ? [] : f.Lorem.Words())
			.Generate(count);
		var results = await users
			.Select(async user => (user, result: await AutomaticClient.Users
				.Create(
					user.LoginName,
					user.FullName,
					user.Groups,
					user.Password
				).ConfigureAwait(false))
			)
			.WhenAll()
			.ConfigureAwait(false);
		foreach (var (user, result) in results)
			if (!result.IsSuccess)
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to create user '{user.LoginName}': {result.Error}");
		return results.Select(x => x.user).ToArray();
	}
	public async ValueTask<TestUser> CreateTestUser(bool withoutGroups = true) {
		var result = await CreateTestUsers(1, withoutGroups);
		return result.First();
	}
}
public class TestUser {
	public UserDetails      Details     { get; set; } = default!;
	public UserCredentials? Credentials { get; set; } = default!;
	public string   LoginName { get; set; } = null!;
	public string   FullName  { get; set; } = null!;
	public string[] Groups    { get; set; } = null!;
	public string   Password  { get; set; } = null!;
	public override string ToString() => $"{LoginName} Credentials({Credentials?.Username ?? "null"})";
}
public sealed class TestUserFaker : Faker<TestUser> {
	internal static TestUserFaker Instance => new();
	TestUserFaker() {
		RuleFor(x => x.LoginName, f => f.Person.UserName);
		RuleFor(x => x.FullName, f => f.Person.FullName);
		RuleFor(x => x.Groups, f => f.Lorem.Words());
		RuleFor(x => x.Password, f => f.Internet.Password());
		RuleFor(x => x.Credentials, (_, user) => new(user.LoginName, user.Password));
		RuleFor(
			x => x.Details, (_, user) => new UserDetails {
				LoginName = user.LoginName,
				FullName  = user.FullName,
				Groups    = user.Groups
			}
		);
	}
	public TestUser WithValidCredentials() => Generate();
	public TestUser WithNoCredentials() =>
		Instance
			.FinishWith((_, x) => x.Credentials = null)
			.Generate();
	public TestUser WithInvalidCredentials(bool wrongLoginName = true, bool wrongPassword = true) =>
		Instance
			.FinishWith((f, x) => x.Credentials = new(
				wrongLoginName ? "wrong-username" : x.LoginName,
				wrongPassword ? "wrong-password" : x.Password))
			.Generate();
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;

[Category("UserManagement")]

public class StreamPolicyTests : KurrentClientTestFixture {

            });

            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();

        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .DisableStreamPolicies()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
    }

        // First enable stream policies
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .EnableStreamPolicies()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Create custom configuration
        var config = new StreamPolicyConfiguration {
            StreamPolicies = ImmutableDictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy>.Empty
                .Add("publicDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess)
                .Add("adminsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.AdminsOnly)
                .Add("projectionsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.ProjectionsDefault)
                .Add("financePolicy", StreamAccessPolicy.FullAccess("financeTeam", "ouro")),
            StreamRules = ImmutableArray.Create(
                new StreamPrefixRule("finance-", "financePolicy"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$et-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$ce-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$bc-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$category-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$streams", "projectionsDefault")
            ),
            DefaultRules = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard
        };
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .ConfigureStreamPolicies(config)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Verify configuration was applied
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .GetCurrentStreamPolicy()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(retrievedConfig => {
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies.ShouldContainKey("financePolicy");
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies["financePolicy"].Readers.ShouldContain("financeTeam");
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies["financePolicy"].Readers.ShouldContain("ouro");
            });
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task get_current_policy_returns_not_found_when_no_policy_exists() {

        await AutomaticClient.Users

            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Try to get policy - should fail with NotFound
        await AutomaticClient.Users

                .Add("publicDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess),

            ),

        );

        var config = new StreamPolicyConfiguration {

            ),

            }

        // Should fail on server side, not client validation

        // Verify it was applied

    [Test]
    public async Task fluent_api_with_stream_access_policy() {
        // First enable stream policies
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .EnableStreamPolicies()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Use fluent API to create custom policy
        var customPolicy = StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess
            .WithWriters("admin", "financeTeam")
            .WithDeleters("admin");
        var config = new StreamPolicyConfiguration {
            StreamPolicies = ImmutableDictionary<string, StreamAccessPolicy>.Empty
                .Add("publicDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.PublicAccess)
                .Add("adminsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.AdminsOnly)
                .Add("projectionsDefault", StreamAccessPolicy.ProjectionsDefault)
                .Add("customPolicy", customPolicy),
            StreamRules = ImmutableArray.Create(
                new StreamPrefixRule("custom-", "customPolicy"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$et-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$ce-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$bc-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$category-", "projectionsDefault"),
                new StreamPrefixRule("$streams", "projectionsDefault")
            ),
            DefaultRules = DefaultPolicyRules.Standard
        };
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .ConfigureStreamPolicies(config)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Verify the fluent configuration
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .GetCurrentStreamPolicy()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(retrievedConfig => {
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies["customPolicy"].Readers.ShouldBe(["$all"]);
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies["customPolicy"].Writers.ShouldBe(["admin", "financeTeam"]);
                retrievedConfig.StreamPolicies["customPolicy"].Deleters.ShouldBe(["admin"]);
            });
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task updates_existing_policy_configuration() {
        // First enable and set initial config
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .EnableStreamPolicies()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var initialConfig = StreamPolicyConfiguration.Default;
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .ConfigureStreamPolicies(initialConfig)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Get current config
        var currentResult = await AutomaticClient.Users
            .GetCurrentStreamPolicy()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Modify and update
        var updatedConfig = currentResult.Value with {
            StreamPolicies = currentResult.Value.StreamPolicies
                .Add("newPolicy", StreamAccessPolicy.FullAccess("newUser")),
            StreamRules = currentResult.Value.StreamRules
                .Add(new StreamPrefixRule("new-", "newPolicy"))
        };
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .ConfigureStreamPolicies(updatedConfig)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // Verify update
        await AutomaticClient.Users
            .GetCurrentStreamPolicy()
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(config => {
                config.StreamPolicies.ShouldContainKey("newPolicy");
                config.StreamRules.ShouldContain(r => r.Prefix == "new-");
            });
    }
}
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Tests/Filters/ExpressionFilter.DuckDbValidationTests.cs
````csharp
using DuckDB.NET.Data;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Filters;
[Category("Filters")]
[Category("DuckDB")]
public class ExpressionFilterDuckDbValidationTests : IDisposable {
    readonly DuckDBConnection _connection;
    public ExpressionFilterDuckDbValidationTests() {
        _connection = new DuckDBConnection("Data Source=:memory:");
        _connection.Open();
        using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
        cmd.CommandText = """
        CREATE TABLE records (
            record_id UUID,
            stream VARCHAR,
            schema_name VARCHAR,
            timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ,
            position BIGINT,
            stream_revision BIGINT,
            properties MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)
        )
        """;
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }
    public void Dispose() {
        _connection.Dispose();
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task validates_expressions_against_duckdb() {
        var expressions = new[] {
            "stream = 'orders'",
            "stream LIKE 'order%'",
            "position > 100",
            "stream IN ('orders', 'payments')",
            "schema_name = 'OrderCreated' AND position >= 0",
            "timestamp >= '2024-01-01'",
            "properties['userId'] IS NOT NULL"
        };
        var failures = new List<string>();
        foreach (var expression in expressions)
            try {
                await using var cmd = _connection.CreateCommand();
                cmd.CommandText = $"EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM records WHERE {expression}";
                await Task.Run(() => cmd.ExecuteNonQuery());
            }
            catch (Exception ex) {
                failures.Add($"{expression}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        failures.ShouldBeEmpty($"DuckDB validation failures:\n{string.Join(Environment.NewLine, failures)}");
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Testing.TUnit;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Filters;
[Category("Filters")]
public class ServerFilterExtractorTests {
    readonly ExpressionFilterParser _parser = new();
    #region Stream Filter Extraction
    public readonly record struct StreamExtractionTestCase(string Description, string Expression, IRecordFilter ExpectedFilter) {
        public override string ToString() => Description;
    }
    public class StreamExtractionTestCases : TestCaseGenerator<StreamExtractionTestCase> {
        // Realistic stream names following KurrentDB convention: {Category}-{Id}
        const string GamesStream    = "Games-D0332EB7480643E481BF3205296958FD";
        const string OrdersStream   = "Orders-A1B2C3D4E5F6789012345678ABCDEF01";
        const string PaymentsStream = "Payments-F9E8D7C6B5A4321098765432FEDCBA98";
        protected override IEnumerable<StreamExtractionTestCase> Data() {
            // Exact stream match - targets specific stream
            yield return new(
                "Exact stream match",
                $"stream = '{GamesStream}'",
                RecordFilter.ByStream(GamesStream)
            );
            // LIKE without wildcards - equivalent to exact match
            yield return new(
                "LIKE exact match (no wildcards)",
                $"stream LIKE '{OrdersStream}'",
                RecordFilter.ByStream(OrdersStream)
            );
            // Multiple streams - reads from $all with filter
            yield return new(
                "Multiple streams (IN)",
                $"stream IN ('{OrdersStream}', '{PaymentsStream}')",
                RecordFilter.ByStreams(OrdersStream, PaymentsStream)
            );
            // Category prefix - common pattern for filtering by aggregate type
            yield return new(
                "Category prefix (Games-%)",
                "stream LIKE 'Games-%'",
                RecordFilter.ByStreamPattern(@"^Games-.*$")
            );
            // Category prefix - Orders
            yield return new(
                "Category prefix (Orders-%)",
                "stream LIKE 'Orders-%'",
                RecordFilter.ByStreamPattern(@"^Orders-.*$")
            );
            // Single char wildcard - matches exactly one character
            yield return new(
                "Single char wildcard",
                "stream LIKE 'Games-_'",
                RecordFilter.ByStreamPattern(@"^Games-.$")
            );
            // Case-insensitive category prefix
            yield return new(
                "Case-insensitive category prefix",
                "stream ILIKE 'GAMES-%'",
                RecordFilter.ByStreamPattern(@"(?i)^GAMES-.*$")
            );
            // Case-insensitive exact match - no target stream (could match multiple variants)
            yield return new(
                "Case-insensitive exact match",
                $"stream ILIKE '{GamesStream}'",
                RecordFilter.ByStreamPattern($"(?i)^{GamesStream}$")
            );
        }
    }
    [Test]
    [StreamExtractionTestCases]
    public void extracts_stream_filter(StreamExtractionTestCase testcase) {
        var expr   = ParseExpression(testcase.Expression);
        var filter = ServerFilterExtractor.Extract(expr);
        filter
            .ShouldBeOfType<StreamFilter>()
            .ShouldBeEquivalentTo(testcase.ExpectedFilter);
    }
    [Test]
    public void extracts_target_stream_from_equality() {
        var expr   = ParseExpression("stream = 'Orders-A1B2C3D4E5F6'");
        var filter = ServerFilterExtractor.Extract(expr);
        filter.ShouldBeOfType<StreamFilter>();
        filter.TargetStream.ShouldBe(StreamName.From("Orders-A1B2C3D4E5F6"));
        filter.Expression.ShouldBe("^Orders-A1B2C3D4E5F6$");
    }

        filter.TargetStream.ShouldBe(StreamName.All);
        filter.ShouldBeOfType<StreamFilter>();
        filter.Expression.ShouldBe("^(Orders-123|Payments-456)$");

        var filter = ServerFilterExtractor.Extract(expr);

    #endregion
    #region Negated Expressions
    [Test]
    public void negated_stream_filter_has_no_server_filter() {
        var expr   = ParseExpression("stream != 'Test-123'");
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Testing.TUnit;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Internal;
public class AsyncEnumerableExtensionsTests {
    [Test]
    [BatchSizeCases]
    public async ValueTask respects_batch_size(BatchSizeCase testCase) {
        var source  = ItemsDataSource(testCase.ItemCount);
        var timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
        var batches = new List<List<int>>();
        await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(testCase.BatchSize, timeout))
            batches.Add(batch);
        batches.Count.ShouldBe(testCase.ExpectedBatchSizes.Length);
        for (var i = 0; i < batches.Count; i++)
            batches[i].Count.ShouldBe(testCase.ExpectedBatchSizes[i]);
    }
    [Test]
    [TimeoutCases]
    public async ValueTask handles_timeout_correctly(TimeoutCase testCase) {
        var source = Enumerable.Range(0, testCase.ItemCount)
            .Select(i => {
                Thread.Sleep(testCase.ItemDelay); // because using task delay breaks tunit test runner...improve later
                return i;
            }
        ).ToAsyncEnumerable();
        var batches = new List<List<int>>();
        await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(testCase.BatchSize, testCase.Timeout))
            batches.Add(batch);
        var totalItems = batches.Sum(b => b.Count);
        totalItems.ShouldBe(testCase.ItemCount);
        if (testCase.ItemDelay > testCase.Timeout) {
            // timeout triggers before batch fills: should have more batches with fewer items
            batches.ShouldAllBe(b => b.Count <= testCase.BatchSize);
            batches.Max(b => b.Count).ShouldBeLessThanOrEqualTo(testCase.BatchSize);
        }
        else {
            // timeout allows full batches: should have at least one full batch
            batches.ShouldContain(b => b.Count == testCase.BatchSize);
        }
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask preserves_item_order_within_batches() {
        var source = ItemsDataSource(25);
        var allItems = new List<int>();
        await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(7, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan))
            allItems.AddRange(batch);
        allItems.ShouldBeInOrder();
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask stops_iteration_when_cancelled() {
        using var cancellator = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var source     = ItemsDataSource(1000);
        var batchCount = 0;
        try {
            await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(10, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), cancellator.Token)) {
                batchCount++;
                if (batchCount >= 3)
                    await cancellator.CancelAsync();
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) {
            // expected when cancelled
        }
        batchCount.ShouldBeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(3);
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask handles_empty_source() {
        var source = AsyncEnumerable.Empty<int>();
        var batches = new List<List<int>>();
        await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(5, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)))
            batches.Add(batch);
        batches.ShouldBeEmpty();
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask handles_single_item_source() {
        var source = new[] { 42 }.ToAsyncEnumerable();
        var batches = new List<List<int>>();
        await foreach (var batch in source.ReadBatches(10, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)))
            batches.Add(batch);
        batches.Count.ShouldBe(1);
        batches[0].ShouldBe([42]);
    }
    static IAsyncEnumerable<int> ItemsDataSource(int count) =>
        Enumerable.Range(0, count).ToAsyncEnumerable();
    public readonly record struct BatchSizeCase(int ItemCount, int BatchSize, int[] ExpectedBatchSizes) {
        public override string ToString() => $"{ItemCount} items, {BatchSize} batch size → [{string.Join(", ", ExpectedBatchSizes)}]";
    }
    public readonly record struct TimeoutCase(int ItemCount, int BatchSize, TimeSpan ItemDelay, TimeSpan Timeout) {
        public override string ToString() => $"{ItemCount} items,  {BatchSize} batch size,  {ItemDelay.TotalMilliseconds}ms delay, {Timeout.TotalMilliseconds}ms timeout";
    }
    public class BatchSizeCases : TestCaseGenerator<BatchSizeCase> {
        protected override IEnumerable<BatchSizeCase> Data() => [
            new(ItemCount: 10, BatchSize: 5, ExpectedBatchSizes: [5, 5]),
            new(ItemCount: 7, BatchSize: 3, ExpectedBatchSizes: [3, 3, 1]),
            new(ItemCount: 3, BatchSize: 10, ExpectedBatchSizes: [3]),
            new(ItemCount: 0, BatchSize: 5, ExpectedBatchSizes: []),
            new(ItemCount: 1, BatchSize: 1, ExpectedBatchSizes: [1]),
            new(ItemCount: 100, BatchSize: 25, ExpectedBatchSizes: [25, 25, 25, 25])
        ];
    }
    public class TimeoutCases : TestCaseGenerator<TimeoutCase> {
        protected override IEnumerable<TimeoutCase> Data() => [
            // timeout allows ~2-3 items before expiring: yields partial batches
            new(
                ItemCount: 30,
                BatchSize: 10,
                ItemDelay: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(10),
                Timeout: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(60)
            ),
            // timeout > total batch time: yields full batches
            new(
                ItemCount: 10,
                BatchSize: 5,
                ItemDelay: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(5),
                Timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)
            ),
            // timeout < item delay: yields small batches (1 item each)
            new(
                ItemCount: 6,
                BatchSize: 2,
                ItemDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
                Timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2)
            )
        ];
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Internal;
public class ConcurrentBidirectionalDictionaryTests : IDisposable {
    readonly ConcurrentBidirectionalDictionary<string, int> _sut = new();
    public void Dispose() => _sut.Dispose();
    [Test]
    public void constructor_with_capacity_and_concurrency_should_initialize_correctly() {
        // Arrange
        var concurrencyLevel = 2;
        var capacity         = 100;
        // Act
        using var sut = new ConcurrentBidirectionalDictionary<string, int>(concurrencyLevel, capacity);
        sut.Add("one", 1);
        // Assert
        sut.Count.ShouldBe(1);
        sut.ContainsKey("one").ShouldBeTrue();
    }
    [Test]
    public void add_single_item_should_succeed_and_be_retrievable() {
        // Arrange
        var key   = "one";
        var value = 1;
        // Act
        _sut.Add(key, value);
        // Assert
        _sut.Count.ShouldBe(1);
        _sut.ContainsKey(key).ShouldBeTrue();
        _sut.ContainsValue(value).ShouldBeTrue();
        _sut.TryGetValue(key, out var retrievedValue).ShouldBeTrue();
        retrievedValue.ShouldBe(value);
        _sut.TryGetKey(value, out var retrievedKey).ShouldBeTrue();
        retrievedKey.ShouldBe(key);
        _sut[key].ShouldBe(value);
        _sut.GetKeyByValue(value).ShouldBe(key);
    }
    [Test]
    public void add_multiple_items_should_succeed_and_be_retrievable() {
        // Arrange & Act
        _sut.Add("one", 1);
        _sut.Add("two", 2);
        _sut.Add("three", 3);
        // Assert
        _sut.Count.ShouldBe(3);
        _sut["one"].ShouldBe(1);
        _sut.GetKeyByValue(1).ShouldBe("one");
        _sut["two"].ShouldBe(2);
        _sut.GetKeyByValue(2).ShouldBe("two");
        _sut["three"].ShouldBe(3);
        _sut.GetKeyByValue(3).ShouldBe("three");
    }
    [Test]
    public void try_add_new_item_should_succeed_and_return_true() {
        // Arrange
        var key   = "one";
        var value = 1;
        // Act
        var result = _sut.TryAdd(key, value);
        // Assert
        result.ShouldBeTrue();

    [Test]
    public void custom_comparers_case_insensitive_should_work_correctly() {
        // Arrange
        using var sutCi = new ConcurrentBidirectionalDictionary<string, string>(
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase,
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase
        );
        // Act & Assert
        sutCi.Add("KeyOne", "ValueOne");
        sutCi.Count.ShouldBe(1);
        // ContainsKey (case-insensitive)
        sutCi.ContainsKey("keyone").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsKey("KEYONE").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsKey("KeyOne").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsKey("KeyTwo").ShouldBeFalse();
        // ContainsValue (case-insensitive)
        sutCi.ContainsValue("valueone").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsValue("VALUEONE").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsValue("ValueOne").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsValue("ValueTwo").ShouldBeFalse();
        // TryGetValue (case-insensitive key)
        sutCi.TryGetValue("KEYONE", out var val).ShouldBeTrue();
        val.ShouldBe("ValueOne");
        // TryGetKey (case-insensitive value)
        sutCi.TryGetKey("VALUEONE", out var key).ShouldBeTrue();
        key.ShouldBe("KeyOne");
        // Indexer Get (case-insensitive key)
        sutCi["keyone"].ShouldBe("ValueOne");
        // GetKeyByValue (case-insensitive value)
        sutCi.GetKeyByValue("valueone").ShouldBe("KeyOne");
        // Add duplicate key (case-insensitive) - should fail
        Should.Throw<ArgumentException>(() => sutCi.Add("keyone", "ValueTwo"));
        // Add duplicate value (case-insensitive) - should fail
        Should.Throw<ArgumentException>(() => sutCi.Add("KeyTwo", "valueone"));
        // Indexer set update (case-insensitive key)
        sutCi["KEYONE"] = "NewValue";
        sutCi.ContainsKey("KeyOne").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.ContainsValue("ValueOne").ShouldBeFalse();
        sutCi.ContainsValue("NewValue").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.GetKeyByValue("newvalue").ShouldBe("KEYONE"); // the value is still uppercase
        // Remove (case-insensitive key)
        sutCi.Remove("keyone").ShouldBeTrue();
        sutCi.Count.ShouldBe(0);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task concurrent_adds_should_maintain_consistency() {
        // Arrange
        var numTasks     = 20;
        var itemsPerTask = 1000;
        var tasks        = new List<Task>();
        // Use the shared SUT instance (_sut)
        // Act
        for (var i = 0; i < numTasks; i++) {
            var taskNum = i;
            tasks.Add(
                Task.Run(() => {
                        for (var j = 0; j < itemsPerTask; j++) {
                            var itemNum = taskNum * itemsPerTask + j;
                            var key     = $"K{itemNum}";
                            var value   = itemNum;
                            _sut.TryAdd(key, value); // Use TryAdd for concurrency
                        }
                    }
                )
            );
        }
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        // Assert
        _sut.Count.ShouldBe(numTasks * itemsPerTask);
        // Verify bidirectional consistency
        for (var i = 0; i < numTasks * itemsPerTask; i++) {
            var key   = $"K{i}";
            var value = i;
            _sut.ContainsKey(key).ShouldBeTrue($"Key {key} should exist");
            _sut.ContainsValue(value).ShouldBeTrue($"Value {value} should exist");
            _sut[key].ShouldBe(value, $"Key {key} should map to {value}");
            _sut.GetKeyByValue(value).ShouldBe(key, $"Value {value} should map to {key}");
        }
    }
    [Test]
    public async Task concurrent_add_remove_update_should_maintain_consistency() {
        // Arrange
        var numWriterTasks    = 10;
        var operationsPerTask = 500;
        var numReaderTasks    = 5;
        var initialItems      = 100;
        var tasks             = new List<Task>();
        var rnd               = new Random();
        // Use shared _sut
        // Pre-populate
        for (var i = 0; i < initialItems; i++) _sut.TryAdd($"Initial{i}", i);
        // Act
        // Writer tasks (Add, Remove, Update via indexer)
        for (var i = 0; i < numWriterTasks; i++) {
            var taskNum = i;
            tasks.Add(
                Task.Run(() => {
                        for (var j = 0; j < operationsPerTask; j++) {
                            var opType  = rnd.Next(3);                // 0: Add, 1: Remove, 2: Update
                            var itemNum = rnd.Next(initialItems * 2); // Target items in a wider range
                            try {
                                // TryAdd
                                if (opType == 0) {
                                    _sut.TryAdd($"Task{taskNum}-{j}", itemNum);
                                }
                                // TryRemove (Key or Value)
                                else if (opType == 1) {
                                    if (rnd.Next(2) == 0)
                                        _sut.Remove($"SomeKey{itemNum}"); // Try removing potential keys
                                    else
                                        _sut.RemoveByValue(itemNum); // Try removing potential values
                                }
                                // Update/Set
                                else {
                                    _sut[$"UpdateKey{itemNum}"] = itemNum + 10000; // Set potentially new or existing keys
                                }
                            }
                            catch (ArgumentException) {
                                /* Expected for some concurrent sets/adds */
                            }
                            catch (KeyNotFoundException) {
                                /* Expected for some concurrent removes */
                            }
                        }
                    }
                )
            );
        }
        // Reader tasks
        for (var i = 0; i < numReaderTasks; i++)
            tasks.Add(
                Task.Run(() => {
                        // More reads
                        for (var j = 0; j < operationsPerTask * 2; j++) {
                            var itemNum = rnd.Next(initialItems * 2);
                            _sut.TryGetValue($"SomeKey{itemNum}", out _);
                            _sut.TryGetKey(itemNum, out _);
                            _sut.ContainsKey($"AnotherKey{itemNum}");
                            _sut.ContainsValue(itemNum);
                            var currentCount = _sut.Count; // Access count
                            foreach (var _ in _sut) { }    // Try enumerating
                        }
                    }
                )
            );
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        // Assert
        // The exact count is non-deterministic, but the internal state MUST be consistent.
        _sut.Count.ShouldBeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0); // Sanity check count
        // *** The CRITICAL Assertion: Verify bidirectional consistency ***
        var forwardCopy = _sut.ToArray(); // Get a snapshot (uses GetEnumerator)
        forwardCopy.Length.ShouldBe(_sut.Count); // Snapshot count should match current count immediately after
        foreach (var (key, value) in forwardCopy) {
            // Check forward lookup consistency
            _sut.TryGetValue(key, out var retrievedValue).ShouldBeTrue($"Key '{key}' from snapshot must exist.");
            retrievedValue.ShouldBe(value, $"Key '{key}' must map to '{value}'.");
            // Check reverse lookup consistency
            _sut.TryGetKey(value, out var retrievedKey).ShouldBeTrue($"Value '{value}' from snapshot must exist.");
            retrievedKey.ShouldBe(key, $"Value '{value}' must map back to '{key}'.");
        }
        // Also verify the reverse dictionary side implicitly agrees on count
        // (Cannot access _reverse directly, but the loop above verifies all _reverse entries)
        // We can explicitly check all _reverse entries via the Values collection if desired:
        var values = _sut.Values.ToList(); // Snapshot values
        values.Count.ShouldBe(_sut.Count);
        foreach (var val in values) {
            _sut.TryGetKey(val, out var key).ShouldBeTrue();
            _sut.ContainsKey(key).ShouldBeTrue(); // Key must still exist
            _sut[key].ShouldBe(val);              // And map back to the value
        }
    }
    static KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> Kvp<TKey, TValue>(TKey key, TValue value) => new(key, value);
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Testing.TUnit;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using static KurrentDB.Client.ClusterMessages.VNodeState;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Legacy;
[Category("Legacy")]
public class NodePreferenceComparerTests {
	public class LeaderTestCases : TestCaseGenerator<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> {
		protected override IEnumerable<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> Data() {
			yield return new(Leader, [Leader, Follower, Follower, ReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(Follower, [Follower, Follower, ReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(ReadOnlyReplica, [ReadOnlyReplica, PreReadOnlyReplica, ReadOnlyLeaderless]);
			yield return new(PreReadOnlyReplica, [PreReadOnlyReplica, ReadOnlyLeaderless]);
			yield return new(ReadOnlyLeaderless, [ReadOnlyLeaderless, DiscoverLeader]);
		}
	}
	[Test, LeaderTestCases]
	public void LeaderTests(NodePreferenceComparerTestCase testCase) {
		var actual = testCase.States
			.OrderBy(state => state, NodePreferenceComparers.Leader)
			.ThenBy(_ => Guid.NewGuid())
            .FirstOrDefault();
		actual.ShouldBe(testCase.Expected);
	}
    public class FollowerTestCases : TestCaseGenerator<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> {
		protected override IEnumerable<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> Data() {
			yield return new(Follower, [Leader, Follower, Follower, ReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(Leader, [Leader, ReadOnlyReplica, ReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(ReadOnlyReplica, [ReadOnlyReplica, PreReadOnlyReplica, ReadOnlyLeaderless]);
			yield return new(PreReadOnlyReplica, [PreReadOnlyReplica, ReadOnlyLeaderless]);
			yield return new(ReadOnlyLeaderless, [ReadOnlyLeaderless, DiscoverLeader]);
		}
	}
    public record struct NodePreferenceComparerTestCase(ClusterMessages.VNodeState Expected, ClusterMessages.VNodeState[] States);
	[Test, FollowerTestCases]
	public void FollowerTests(NodePreferenceComparerTestCase testCase) {
        var actual = testCase.States
			.OrderBy(state => state, NodePreferenceComparers.Follower)
			.ThenBy(_ => Guid.NewGuid())
			.FirstOrDefault();
		actual.ShouldBe(testCase.Expected);
	}
	public class ReadOnlyReplicaTestCases : TestCaseGenerator<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> {
		protected override IEnumerable<NodePreferenceComparerTestCase> Data() {
			yield return new(ReadOnlyReplica, [Leader, Follower, Follower, ReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(PreReadOnlyReplica, [Leader, Follower, Follower, PreReadOnlyReplica]);
			yield return new(ReadOnlyLeaderless, [Leader, Follower, Follower, ReadOnlyLeaderless]);
			yield return new(Leader, [Leader, Follower, Follower]);
			yield return new(Follower, [DiscoverLeader, Follower, Follower]);
		}
	}
	[Test, ReadOnlyReplicaTestCases]
	public void ReadOnlyReplicaTests(NodePreferenceComparerTestCase testCase) {
		var actual = testCase.States
			.OrderBy(state => state, NodePreferenceComparers.ReadOnlyReplica)
			.ThenBy(_ => Guid.NewGuid())
            .FirstOrDefault();
		actual.ShouldBe(testCase.Expected);
	}
}
````

````csharp
using System.Net;
using KurrentDB.Client;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Legacy;
[Category("Legacy")]
public class NodeSelectorTests {
	[Test, Retry(3)]
	public void dead_nodes_are_not_considered() {
		var allowedNodeId = Uuid.NewUuid();
		var allowedNode   = new DnsEndPoint(allowedNodeId.ToString(), 2113);
		var notAllowedNodeId = Uuid.NewUuid();
		var notAllowedNode   = new DnsEndPoint(notAllowedNodeId.ToString(), 2114);
		var settings = new KurrentDBClientSettings {
			ConnectivitySettings = {
				GossipSeeds = [allowedNode, notAllowedNode],
				Insecure       = true
			}
		};
		var sut = new NodeSelector(settings.ConnectivitySettings.NodePreference);
		var selectedNode = sut.SelectNode(
			new(
				[
					new(allowedNodeId, ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower, true, allowedNode),
					new(notAllowedNodeId, ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Leader, false, notAllowedNode)
				]
			)
		);
		selectedNode.Host.ShouldBe(allowedNode.Host);
		selectedNode.Port.ShouldBe(allowedNode.Port);
	}
	[Test]
	[Arguments(NodePreference.Leader, "leader")]
	[Arguments(NodePreference.Follower, "follower2")]
	[Arguments(NodePreference.ReadOnlyReplica, "readOnlyReplica")]
	[Arguments(NodePreference.Random, "any")]
	public void can_prefer(NodePreference nodePreference, string expectedHost) {
		var sut = new NodeSelector(nodePreference);
		var selectedNode = sut.SelectNode(
			new(
				[
					new(Uuid.NewUuid(), ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower, false, new("follower1", 2113)),
					new(Uuid.NewUuid(), ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Leader, true, new("leader", 2113)),
					new(Uuid.NewUuid(), ClusterMessages.VNodeState.Follower, true, new("follower2", 2113)),
					new(Uuid.NewUuid(), ClusterMessages.VNodeState.ReadOnlyReplica, true, new("readOnlyReplica", 2113))
				]
			)
		);
		if (expectedHost == "any")
			return;
		selectedNode.Host.ShouldBe(expectedHost);
	}
}
````
