````csharp
using System.Collections.Immutable;
using TicTacToe;
namespace Kurrent.Variant.Tests.Result;
public readonly record struct GameId(Guid Value);
public record GameStarted(Guid GameId, Player FirstPlayer);
// public record PlayerTurn(Player Player, Position Position, string? MoveDescription = null);
//
// public record GameUpdated(Guid GameId, GameStatus NewStatus, string? UpdateNotes = null);
public record InvalidMoveError(Guid GameId, string Reason, string? StateContext = null) : IResultError {
	public ErrorCode ErrorCode => ErrorCode.From("INVALID_MOVE");
	public string ErrorMessage => Reason;
	public ImmutableDictionary<string, object?> Metadata =>
		ImmutableDictionary<string, object?>.Empty
			.Add("GameId", GameId)
			.Add("StateContext", StateContext ?? "unknown");
	public Exception GetOrCreateException() =>
		new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid move in game {GameId}: {Reason}");
	public void Throw() => throw GetOrCreateException();
}
public record GameEndedError(Guid GameId, GameStatus Status, string? FinalStateContext = null) : IResultError {
	public ErrorCode ErrorCode => ErrorCode.From("GAME_ENDED");
	public string ErrorMessage => $"Game {GameId} has ended with status: {Status}";
	public ImmutableDictionary<string, object?> Metadata =>
		ImmutableDictionary<string, object?>.Empty
			.Add("GameId", GameId)
			.Add("Status", Status.ToString())
			.Add("FinalStateContext", FinalStateContext ?? "unknown");
	public Exception GetOrCreateException() =>
		new InvalidOperationException($"Game {GameId} has ended with status: {Status}");
	public void Throw() => throw GetOrCreateException();
}
public record SimpleError(string Message) : IResultError {
	public ErrorCode ErrorCode => ErrorCode.From("SIMPLE_ERROR");
	public string ErrorMessage => Message;
	public ImmutableDictionary<string, object?> Metadata => ImmutableDictionary<string, object?>.Empty;
	public Exception GetOrCreateException() =>
		new InvalidOperationException(Message);
	public void Throw() => throw GetOrCreateException();
}
````

````csharp
                return new GameId(gameId);
            },

        );

        if (contextValue >= 50)

            result.Error.Reason.ShouldContain($"State {contextValue}");
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable UnusedParameter.Local
using TicTacToe;
namespace Kurrent.Variant.Tests.Result;
public class ResultUnwrapTests {
    Faker Faker { get; } = new();
    [Test]

        var result = Kurrent.Result.Success<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(gameId);

        var value = result.Unwrap();
        // Assert

        var result = Kurrent.Result.Failure<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(error);
        // Act & Assert

        Should.Throw<InvalidOperationException>(() => gameEndedResult.Unwrap());

    [Test]
    public async ValueTask unwrap_async_returns_value_on_success() {
        // Arrange
        var position = new Position(1, 2);
        var resultTask = ValueTask.FromResult(
            Kurrent.Result.Success<Position, InvalidMoveError>(position));
        // Act
        var value = await resultTask.UnwrapAsync();
        // Assert
        value.ShouldBe(position);
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask unwrap_async_throws_exception_on_failure() {
        // Arrange
        var error = new InvalidMoveError(Faker.Random.Guid(), "Async error");
        var resultTask = ValueTask.FromResult(
            Kurrent.Result.Failure<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(error));
        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Should.ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
            async () => await resultTask.UnwrapAsync());
        exception.Message.ShouldContain("Async error");
    }
    [Test]
    public void unwrap_can_be_used_after_successful_pipeline() {
        // Arrange
        var position = new Position(1, 2);
        var result = Kurrent.Result.Success<Position, InvalidMoveError>(position);
        // Act
        var value = result
            .Map(pos => pos.Row)
            .Map(row => row * 2)
            .Unwrap();
        // Assert
        value.ShouldBe(2); // position.Row (1) * 2 = 2
    }
    [Test]
    public void unwrap_throws_at_end_of_failed_pipeline() {
        // Arrange
        var error = new InvalidMoveError(Faker.Random.Guid(), "Pipeline error");
        var result = Kurrent.Result.Failure<Position, InvalidMoveError>(error);
        // Act & Assert
        Should.Throw<InvalidOperationException>(() => result
            .Map(pos => pos.Row)
            .Map(row => row * 2)
            .Unwrap());
    }
    [Test]
    public void unwrap_enables_direct_value_extraction() {
        // Arrange
        var gameId = new GameId(Faker.Random.Guid());
        var result = Kurrent.Result.Success<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(gameId);
        // Act - Direct assignment without pattern matching
        GameId extractedId = result.Unwrap();
        // Assert
        extractedId.ShouldBe(gameId);
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask unwrap_async_can_be_used_after_async_pipeline() {
        // Arrange
        var gameId = new GameId(Faker.Random.Guid());
        var resultTask = ValueTask.FromResult(
            Kurrent.Result.Success<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(gameId));
        // Act
        var value = await resultTask
            .MapAsync(async id => {
                await Task.Delay(1);
                return id.Value.ToString();
            })
            .UnwrapAsync();
        // Assert
        value.ShouldBe(gameId.Value.ToString());
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask unwrap_async_throws_at_end_of_failed_async_pipeline() {
        // Arrange
        var error = new InvalidMoveError(Faker.Random.Guid(), "Async pipeline");
        var resultTask = ValueTask.FromResult(
            Kurrent.Result.Failure<GameId, InvalidMoveError>(error));
        // Act & Assert
        await Should.ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await resultTask
                .MapAsync(async id => {
                    await Task.Delay(1);
                    return id.Value.ToString();
                })
                .UnwrapAsync());
    }
    [Test]
    public void unwrap_vs_match_for_exception_handling() {
        // Arrange
        var successResult = Kurrent.Result.Success<int, SimpleError>(42);
        var failureResult = Kurrent.Result.Failure<int, SimpleError>(new SimpleError("Error"));
        // Act - Match handles both cases without exception
        var matchedSuccess = successResult.Match(
            mapValue: val => val,
            mapError: err => -1);
        var matchedFailure = failureResult.Match(
            mapValue: val => val,
            mapError: err => -1);
        // Act - Unwrap returns value or throws
        var unwrappedSuccess = successResult.Unwrap();
        var unwrapFailureThrows = Should.Throw<InvalidOperationException>(() => failureResult.Unwrap());
        // Assert
        matchedSuccess.ShouldBe(42);
        matchedFailure.ShouldBe(-1);
        unwrappedSuccess.ShouldBe(42);
        unwrapFailureThrows.ShouldNotBeNull();
    }
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable UnusedParameter.Local
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;
using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Text;
namespace Kurrent.Client.SourceGenerators;
[Generator]
[SuppressMessage("MicrosoftCodeAnalysisReleaseTracking", "RS2008:Enable analyzer release tracking")]
public class ValueObjectGenerator : ISourceGenerator {
    const string ValueObjectAttributeKey = "Kurrent.ValueObjectAttribute";
    class ValueObjectSyntaxReceiver : ISyntaxReceiver {
        public List<TypeDeclarationSyntax> CandidateTypes { get; } = [];
        public void OnVisitSyntaxNode(SyntaxNode syntaxNode) {
            // Look for partial classes with attributes
            if (syntaxNode is not TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDeclaration ||
                !typeDeclaration.Modifiers.Any(m => m.IsKind(SyntaxKind.PartialKeyword)) ||
                typeDeclaration.AttributeLists.Count <= 0) return;
            // Only classes
            if (typeDeclaration is ClassDeclarationSyntax or RecordDeclarationSyntax)
                CandidateTypes.Add(typeDeclaration);
            // // Look for partial record structs with attributes
            // if (syntaxNode is not TypeDeclarationSyntax { } typeDeclaration ||
            //     !typeDeclaration.Modifiers.Any(m => m.IsKind(SyntaxKind.PartialKeyword)) ||
            //     !typeDeclaration.Modifiers.Any(m => m.IsKind(SyntaxKind.RecordKeyword)) ||
            //     typeDeclaration.AttributeLists.Count <= 0) return;
            //
            // // Only record structs
            // if (typeDeclaration is RecordDeclarationSyntax)
            //     CandidateTypes.Add(typeDeclaration);
        }
    }
    public void Initialize(GeneratorInitializationContext context) {
        #if DEBUG
        if (!Debugger.IsAttached) Debugger.Launch();
        #endif
        context.RegisterForSyntaxNotifications(() => new ValueObjectSyntaxReceiver());
    }
    public void Execute(GeneratorExecutionContext context) {
        try {
            var compilation = context.Compilation;
            // Get the syntax receiver
            if (context.SyntaxReceiver is not ValueObjectSyntaxReceiver receiver)
                return;
            // Debug: Report that we're starting execution
            ReportDiagnostic(context, Starting);
            // Process candidate types from the syntax receiver
            foreach (var typeDeclaration in receiver.CandidateTypes) {
                var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(typeDeclaration.SyntaxTree);
                if (semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDeclaration) is not { } typeSymbol)
                    continue;
                var (hasAttribute, valueType) = HasValueObjectAttribute(typeSymbol, context);
                if (!hasAttribute || valueType is null)
                    continue;
                ReportDiagnostic(context, FoundTarget, typeSymbol, valueType);
                GenerateAndAddSource(typeSymbol, valueType);
                ReportDiagnostic(context, ImplementationGenerated, typeSymbol);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            ReportDiagnostic(context, Failed, ex.ToString());
        }
        return;
        void GenerateAndAddSource(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, ITypeSymbol valueType) {
            var source = GenerateImplementation(typeSymbol, valueType, context);
            var hintName = SourceGeneratorFileNaming.GetHintName(
                typeSymbol,
                new FileNamingOptions {
                    Prefix                 = "ValueObjects",
                    UseFoldersForPrefix    = true,
                    UseFoldersForNamespace = true,
                    LowercasePath          = false
                },
                [valueType]
            );
            context.AddSource(hintName, SourceText.From(source, Encoding.UTF8));
        }
    }
    #region . Diagnostic Helpers .
    static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor Starting = new(
        "KURRENT_VO_000",
        nameof(ValueObjectGenerator),
        $"[{nameof(ValueObjectGenerator)}] starting",
        "CodeGeneration",
        DiagnosticSeverity.Info,
        isEnabledByDefault: true);
    static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor FoundTarget = new(
        "KURRENT_VO_202",
        nameof(ValueObjectGenerator),
        $"[{nameof(ValueObjectGenerator)}] found type: {{0}} with value type: {{1}}",
        "CodeGeneration",
        DiagnosticSeverity.Info,
        isEnabledByDefault: true);
    static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor Failed = new(
        "KURRENT_VO_500",
        nameof(ValueObjectGenerator),
        $"[{nameof(ValueObjectGenerator)}] failed: {{0}}",
        "Error",
        DiagnosticSeverity.Info,
        isEnabledByDefault: true);
    static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor ImplementationGenerated = new(
        "KURRENT_VO_200",
        nameof(ValueObjectGenerator),
        $"[{nameof(ValueObjectGenerator)}] completed code generation for: {{0}}",
        "CodeGeneration",
        DiagnosticSeverity.Info,
        isEnabledByDefault: true);
    static void ReportDiagnostic(GeneratorExecutionContext context, DiagnosticDescriptor descriptor, params object?[]? messageArgs) {
        var diagnostic = Diagnostic.Create(descriptor, Location.None, messageArgs);
        context.ReportDiagnostic(diagnostic);
    }
    #endregion
    static (bool hasAttribute, ITypeSymbol? valueType) HasValueObjectAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, GeneratorExecutionContext context) {
        var attr = typeSymbol.GetAttributes().Where(attr => {
            if (attr.AttributeClass is not { } classInfo || !classInfo.ToDisplayString().StartsWith(ValueObjectAttributeKey))
                return false;
            ReportDiagnostic(context, FoundTarget, classInfo.ToDisplayString());
            return true;
        }).FirstOrDefault();
        if (attr is null)
            return (false, null);
        // Extract TValue from ValueObjectAttribute<TValue>
        var valueType = attr.AttributeClass?.TypeArguments.FirstOrDefault();
        return (true, valueType);
    }
    // static (bool hasAttribute, ITypeSymbol? valueType) HasValueObjectAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, Compilation compilation) {
    //     var valueObjectAttributeSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName($"{ValueObjectAttributeKey}`1");
    //     if (valueObjectAttributeSymbol is null)
    //         return (false, null);
    //
    //     var attribute = typeSymbol.GetAttributes()
    //         .FirstOrDefault(a =>
    //             a.AttributeClass is { IsGenericType: true } attrClass &&
    //             attrClass.ConstructedFrom.Equals(valueObjectAttributeSymbol, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));
    //
    //     if (attribute is null)
    //         return (false, null);
    //
    //     // Extract TValue from ValueObjectAttribute<TValue>
    //     var valueType = attribute.AttributeClass?.TypeArguments.FirstOrDefault();
    //     return (true, valueType);
    // }
    static string GenerateImplementation(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol, ITypeSymbol valueType, GeneratorExecutionContext context) {
        var (typeName, ns) = GetTypeNameAndNamespace(typeSymbol);
        var valueTypeName = valueType.ToDisplayString();
        var sourceBuilder = new StringBuilder(
            """
            // <auto-generated />
            // Generated by ValueObjectGenerator
            // DO NOT MODIFY - Changes will be overwritten
            #nullable enable
            using System;
            using System.CodeDom.Compiler;
            using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
            using JetBrains.Annotations;
            using Kurrent.Validation;
            {NAMESPACE_DECLARATION}
            {TYPE_DECLARATION}
            """
        );
        sourceBuilder
            .Replace("{NAMESPACE_DECLARATION}", GenerateNamespaceDeclaration(ns))
            .Replace("{TYPE_DECLARATION}", GenerateTypeDeclaration(typeName, valueTypeName));
        return sourceBuilder.ToString();
        static string GenerateNamespaceDeclaration(string ns) => ns != string.Empty ? $"namespace {ns};" : "// Global namespace";
        static string GenerateTypeDeclaration(string typeName, string valueTypeName) {
            var template = """
                [System.Diagnostics.DebuggerDisplay("{GetDebugString()}")]
                [PublicAPI, CompilerGenerated, GeneratedCode("ValueObjectGenerator", "1.0.0")]
                readonly partial record struct {TYPE_NAME} {
                    /// <summary>
                    /// Optional validation hook. Assign in static constructor to enable validation.
                    /// </summary>
                    /// <remarks>
                    /// <para>If null, EnsureValid() returns this instance without validation.</para>
                    /// <para>If assigned, EnsureValid() invokes this delegate and unwraps the result.</para>
                    /// </remarks>
                    static System.Func<{VALUE_TYPE}, Kurrent.Validation.ValidationResult>? OnValidate { get; }
                    /// <summary>The wrapped primitive value.</summary>
                    public {VALUE_TYPE} Value { get; private init; }
                    /// <summary>
                    /// Validates the value without throwing exceptions.
                    /// </summary>
                    public Kurrent.Validation.ValidationResult Validate() => OnValidate?.Invoke(Value) ?? Results.Success;
                    /// <summary>
                    /// Ensures the value is valid according to OnValidate delegate (if assigned) or throws an exception.
                    /// </summary>
                    public {TYPE_NAME} EnsureValid() => Validate().Map(static (state, _) => state, this).Unwrap();
                    /// <summary>
                    /// Creates a {TYPE_NAME} that may be in an invalid state.
                    /// </summary>
                    /// <remarks>
                    /// To ensure the created value is valid, call EnsureValid() after creation.
                    /// </remarks>
                    public static {TYPE_NAME} From({VALUE_TYPE} value) => new() { Value = value };
                    /// <summary>
                    /// Creates a copy of another {TYPE_NAME}.
                    /// </summary>
                    public static {TYPE_NAME} From({TYPE_NAME} other) => new() { Value = other.Value };
                    /// <summary>Gets the display string representation.</summary>
                    string GetDisplayString() => Value.ToString() ?? "";
                    /// <summary>Gets the debug display string.</summary>
                    string GetDebugString() => $"{nameof({TYPE_NAME})}: {GetDisplayString()}";
                    /// <inheritdoc />
                    public override string ToString() => GetDisplayString();
                    /// <summary>Implicitly converts to {VALUE_TYPE}.</summary>
                    public static implicit operator {VALUE_TYPE}({TYPE_NAME} _) => _.Value;
                    /// <summary>Implicitly converts from {VALUE_TYPE}.</summary>
                    public static implicit operator {TYPE_NAME}({VALUE_TYPE} _) => From(_);
                }
                """;
            return template
                .Replace("{TYPE_NAME}", typeName)
                .Replace("{VALUE_TYPE}", valueTypeName);
        }
        static (string Name, string ContainingNamespace) GetTypeNameAndNamespace(INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol) {
            var ns = typeSymbol.ContainingNamespace.IsGlobalNamespace
                ? string.Empty
                : typeSymbol.ContainingNamespace.ToDisplayString();
            return (Name: typeSymbol.Name, ContainingNamespace: ns);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Buffers;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading.Channels;
namespace Kurrent.Client;
static class ChannelExtensions {
    /// <param name="reader">The reader to read data from the channel.</param>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of data in the channel.</typeparam>
    extension<T>(ChannelReader<T> reader) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Reads data from the channel in batches of a specified size up to a given timeout period.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="batchSize">The maximum number of items in a single batch.</param>
        /// <param name="timeout">The maximum duration to wait while gathering a batch.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">A token to observe for cancellation of the batch processing.</param>
        public async IAsyncEnumerable<List<T>> ReadBatches(
            int batchSize, TimeSpan timeout,
            [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default
        ) {
            var buffer = new List<T>(batchSize);
            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                var timerTask = Task.Delay(timeout, cancellationToken);
                while (buffer.Count < batchSize) {
                    var readSignal    = reader.WaitToReadAsync(cancellationToken).AsTask();
                    var completedTask = await Task.WhenAny(readSignal, timerTask).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (completedTask == readSignal && !readSignal.IsCanceled && await readSignal) {
                        while (buffer.Count < batchSize && reader.TryRead(out var item))
                            buffer.Add(item);
                    }
                    else break;
                }
                if (buffer.Count > 0) {
                    yield return [..buffer];
                    buffer.Clear();
                }
                if (reader.Completion.IsCompleted) yield break;
            }
        }
        async IAsyncEnumerable<T[]> ReadBatchesOptimized(int batchSize, TimeSpan timeout, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
            var pool   = ArrayPool<T>.Shared;
            var buffer = pool.Rent(batchSize);
            try {
                while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) {
                    var currentIndex = 0;
                    using var cts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
                    cts.CancelAfter(timeout);
                    while (currentIndex < batchSize && !cts.Token.IsCancellationRequested) {
                        try {
                            if (await reader.WaitToReadAsync(cts.Token))
                                while (currentIndex < batchSize && reader.TryRead(out var item))
                                    buffer[currentIndex++] = item;
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cts.Token.IsCancellationRequested) {
                            break; // Timeout occurred
                        }
                    }
                    if (currentIndex > 0) {
                        var result = new T[currentIndex];
                        Array.Copy(buffer, 0, result, 0, currentIndex);
                        yield return result;
                    }
                    if (reader.Completion.IsCompleted)
                        yield break;
                }
            }
            finally {
                pool.Return(buffer, clearArray: true);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Reflection;
namespace Kurrent.Client;
static class EnumExtensions {
    static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, ConcurrentDictionary<Enum, string>> Cache = new();
    extension<T>(T source) where T : Enum {
        public string Description {
            get {
                // Get or create the value dictionary for this enum type
                var valueCache = Cache.GetOrAdd(typeof(T), _ => new ConcurrentDictionary<Enum, string>());
                // Cast once to avoid multiple boxing operations
                Enum enumValue = source;
                return valueCache.GetOrAdd(enumValue, key => {
                    var fieldInfo = typeof(T).GetField(key.ToString());
                    return fieldInfo is null
                        ? key.ToString()
                        : fieldInfo.GetCustomAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>(false)?.Description ?? key.ToString();
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable SwitchStatementHandlesSomeKnownEnumValuesWithDefault

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
// TODO SS: I don't think that we need to handle anything related with adding schema name/format to metadata anymore.
/// <summary>
/// Provides a base implementation for decoding metadata from serialized byte representations.
/// Serves as an abstraction for specific metadata decoding implementations.
/// </summary>
public abstract class MetadataDecoder : IMetadataDecoder {
    static readonly SchemaName LinkSchemaName = "$>";
    /// <inheritdoc />
    public ValueTask<Metadata> Decode(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes, MetadataDecoderContext context) {
        if (bytes.IsEmpty)
            return new Metadata()
                .AddSchemaNameIfMissing(context.SchemaName)
                .AddSchemaFormatIfMissing(context.SchemaFormat)
                .AsValueTask();
        try {
            if (context.SchemaName == LinkSchemaName)
                return DeserializeLinkMetadata(bytes).AsValueTask();
            return DecodeCore(bytes, context)
                .AddSchemaNameIfMissing(context.SchemaName)
                .AddSchemaFormatIfMissing(context.SchemaFormat)
                .AsValueTask();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not MetadataDecodingException) {
            throw new MetadataDecodingException(GetType(), context, ex);
        }
    }
    static Metadata DeserializeLinkMetadata(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes) {
        // [0] = {DebugViewDictionaryItem<string, JsonValue>} [$v]=1:-1:1:4
        // [1] = {DebugViewDictionaryItem<string, JsonValue>} [$c]=10868
        // [2] = {DebugViewDictionaryItem<string, JsonValue>} [$p]=10868
        // [3] = {DebugViewDictionaryItem<string, JsonValue>} [$causedBy]=373c6630-d8fe-ff2c-16af-e286265e7e98
        var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, JsonValue>>(bytes.Span)!;
        return new Metadata()
            .With(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaName, LinkSchemaName)
            .With(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaFormat, SchemaDataFormat.Json)
            .With("$v", deserialized["$v"].ToString())
            .With("$c", deserialized["$c"].GetValue<long>())
            .With("$p", deserialized["$p"].GetValue<long>())
            .WithIf(_ => deserialized.ContainsKey("$o"), "$o", () => StreamName.From(deserialized["$o"].ToString()))
            .With("$causedBy", deserialized["$causedBy"].GetValue<Guid>());
    }
    protected abstract Metadata DecodeCore(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes, MetadataDecoderContext context);
}
/// <summary>
/// Defines a contract for decoding metadata from serialized byte representations.
/// Implementors of this interface should provide functionality to convert serialized binary data
/// into <see cref="Metadata"/> objects.
/// </summary>
public interface IMetadataDecoder {
    /// <summary>
    /// Decodes metadata from a byte array.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">The serialized metadata bytes.</param>
    /// <param name="context">
    /// The context for decoding metadata, providing additional information such as the originating stream's name,
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>The decoded <see cref="Metadata"/> object.</returns>
    ValueTask<Metadata> Decode(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> bytes, MetadataDecoderContext context);
}
/// <summary>
/// Encapsulates metadata decoding context, providing necessary information to decode metadata.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct MetadataDecoderContext(
    StreamName Stream,
    SchemaName SchemaName,
    SchemaDataFormat SchemaFormat
);
[PublicAPI]
public class MetadataDecodingException(Type decoderType, MetadataDecoderContext decoderContext, Exception innerException)
    : KurrentException(ErrorCode.FromType<MetadataDecodingException>(), ErrorMessage(decoderType, decoderContext, innerException), innerException) {
    public Type                   DecoderType    { get; } = decoderType;
    public MetadataDecoderContext DecoderContext { get; } = decoderContext;
    static string ErrorMessage(Type type, MetadataDecoderContext ctx, Exception ex) =>
        $"Failed to decode '{ctx.SchemaName}' record metadata " +
        $"from '{ctx.Stream}' using instance of '{type.Name}': {ex.Message}";
    [DoesNotReturn, StackTraceHidden]
    public static void Throw(Type decoderType, MetadataDecoderContext decoderContext, Exception innerException) =>
        throw new MetadataDecodingException(decoderType, decoderContext, innerException);
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
[PublicAPI]
public static class MetadataSchemaExtensions {
	extension(Metadata source) {
        // public RecordSchemaInfo GetSchemaInfo() =>
        //     new RecordSchemaInfo {
        //         SchemaName      = metadata.GetSchemaName(),
        //         SchemaFormat    = metadata.GetSchemaFormat(),
        //         SchemaVersionId = metadata.GetSchemaId()
        //     };
        /// <summary>
        /// Extracts schema information from the metadata and removes the related entries.
        /// </summary>
        public RecordSchemaInfo ExtractSchemaInfo() {
            var info = new RecordSchemaInfo {
                SchemaName      = source.GetSchemaName(),
                SchemaFormat    = source.GetSchemaFormat(),
                SchemaVersionId = source.GetSchemaId()
            };
            source.Remove(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaName);
            source.Remove(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaFormat);
            source.Remove(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaId);
            return info;
        }
        public SchemaName GetSchemaName() =>
            source.GetOrDefault(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaName, SchemaName.None);
        public SchemaDataFormat GetSchemaFormat() =>
            source.GetOrDefault(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaFormat, SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified);
        public SchemaVersionId GetSchemaId() =>
            source.GetOrDefault(SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaId, SchemaVersionId.None);
        public Metadata AddSchemaNameIfMissing(SchemaName schemaName) =>
            source.WithIf(x => x.GetSchemaName() == SchemaName.None, SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaName, schemaName);
        public Metadata AddSchemaFormatIfMissing(SchemaDataFormat dataFormat) {
            return dataFormat != SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified
                ? source.WithIf(x => x.GetSchemaFormat() == SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified, SystemMetadataKeys.SchemaFormat, dataFormat)
                : throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(dataFormat), "SchemaFormat cannot be Unspecified when adding to metadata.");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
public class AppendStreamRequestBuilder {
    ExpectedStreamState  _expectedState   = ExpectedStreamState.Any;
    List<AppendRecordBuilder> _messageBuilders = [];
    string _stream = "";
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder ForStream(string stream) {
        _stream = stream;
        return this;
    }
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder ExpectingRevision(StreamRevision expectedRevision) {
        _expectedState = expectedRevision;
        return this;
    }
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder WithRecord(AppendRecord record) =>
        WithRecord(builder => builder.FromRecord(record));
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder WithRecord(Action<AppendRecordBuilder> configureBuilder) {
        var messageBuilder = new AppendRecordBuilder();
        configureBuilder(messageBuilder);
        _messageBuilders.Add(messageBuilder);
        return this;
    }
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder WithRecord(AppendRecordBuilder appendRecordBuilder) {
        _messageBuilders.Add(appendRecordBuilder);
        return this;
    }
    public AppendStreamRequestBuilder WithRecord(object value, SchemaDataFormat dataFormat = SchemaDataFormat.Json, Metadata? metadata = null) =>
        WithRecord(builder => builder.WithValue(value).WithDataFormat(dataFormat).WithMetadata(metadata ?? new Metadata()));
    public int MessageCount => _messageBuilders.Count;
    public AppendStreamRequest Build() {
        var messages = _messageBuilders.Select(x => x.Build());
        var request  = new AppendStreamRequest(_stream, _expectedState, messages);
        return request;
    }
}

        _appendRecord = record;
        return this;

		if (_appendRecord.RecordId == Guid.Empty)
			throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(recordId), "RecordId cannot be empty");
		_appendRecord = _appendRecord with { RecordId = recordId };
		return this;
	}
	public AppendRecordBuilder WithValue(object value) {
        if (value is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(value), "Message value cannot be null");
		_appendRecord = _appendRecord with { Value = value };
		return this;
	}
	public AppendRecordBuilder WithDataFormat(SchemaDataFormat dataFormat) {
		if (dataFormat == SchemaDataFormat.Unspecified)
			throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(dataFormat), "Data format cannot be unspecified");
		if (_appendRecord.Value.IsBytes() && dataFormat != SchemaDataFormat.Bytes)
			throw new ArgumentException($"Data format must be {SchemaDataFormat.Bytes} because the value is a byte array");
		_appendRecord = _appendRecord with {
			DataFormat = dataFormat
		};
		return this;
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using Grpc.Core;
using Kurrent.Client.Legacy;
using KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams;
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams.Checkpoints;
using static Kurrent.Client.Streams.StreamsClientV1Mapper;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
static class LegacyServiceClientExtensions {
    public static async ValueTask<ReadResp?> ReadFirstOrDefault(this KurrentDB.Protocol.V1.Streams.Streams.StreamsClient client, ReadReq request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        using var session = client.Read(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        var isEmpty = !await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return isEmpty || session.ResponseStream.Current is null ? null : session.ResponseStream.Current;
    }
}
public partial class StreamsClient {
    public async ValueTask<Result<StreamInfo, GetStreamInfoError>> GetStreamInfo(StreamName stream, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        // This operation can be greatly optimized by implementing it in the server
        // and as unbelievable as it sounds, the code bellow is the simplest most effective
        // way to get the stream details for the time being.
        // Even with all the permission issues, since the operation should always work...
        // This is just code that is easy to be deleted. That's it, and that's all.
        var metadataRecord = Record.None;
        try {
            var metaStream = stream.Metastream;
            var request    = Requests.CreateReadStreamEdgeRequest(metaStream, ReadDirection.Forwards);
            var response = await LegacyServiceClient
                .ReadFirstOrDefault(request, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            // if the meta-stream is not found, then the stream itself does not exist either
            if (response?.ContentCase is ReadResp.ContentOneofCase.Event)
                metadataRecord = await response.Event
                    .MapToRecordAsync(SequenceId.None, SerializerProvider, MetadataDecoder, SchemaRegistryPolicy.NoRequirements, skipDecoding: false, cancellationToken)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) when (rex.StatusCode is StatusCode.FailedPrecondition && rex.Status.Detail.Contains("is deleted")) {
            return new StreamInfo { State = StreamState.Tombstoned };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return GetStreamInfoError.FromEx(ex);
        }
        var details = StreamInfo.None;
        if (metadataRecord != Record.None) {
            var metadata = (StreamMetadata)metadataRecord.Value!;
            details = new StreamInfo {
                Metadata         = metadata,
                MetadataRevision = metadataRecord.StreamRevision,
                State            = metadata.TruncateBefore == StreamRevision.Max ? StreamState.Deleted : StreamState.Missing
            };
        }
        // at this point if it is not deleted, we have to try to read the stream itself
        // because it might not exist yet.
        if (details.State is StreamState.Deleted)
            return details;
        // now we enrich the stream info with the latest position and revision
        try {
            var request = Requests.CreateReadStreamEdgeRequest(stream, ReadDirection.Backwards);
            var response = await LegacyServiceClient
                .ReadFirstOrDefault(request, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (response is null)
                return details with { State = StreamState.Active };
            // if the stream is not found, we return the details and call it a day
            if (response.ContentCase is ReadResp.ContentOneofCase.StreamNotFound)
                return details;
            if (response.ContentCase is not ReadResp.ContentOneofCase.Event)
                throw new UnreachableException(
                    $"Unexpected content case: {response.ContentCase} " +
                    $"while reading the last record of the stream {stream}"
                );
            var record = await response.Event
                .MapToRecordAsync(SequenceId.None, SerializerProvider, MetadataDecoder, SchemaRegistryPolicy.NoRequirements, skipDecoding: true, cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return details with {
                State                = StreamState.Active,
                LastStreamPosition   = record.Position,
                LastStreamRevision   = record.StreamRevision,
                LastStreamAppendTime = record.Timestamp
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            // no permissions to access the stream itself... sigh...
            // instead of returning what we have cause its ambiguous,
            // we return access denied and invalidate the operation
            return GetStreamInfoError.FromEx(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<LogPosition, DeleteStreamError>> Delete(StreamName stream, StreamRevision revision, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = Requests.CreateDeleteRequest(stream, revision);
            var resp = await LegacyServiceClient
                .DeleteAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return resp.Position.MapToLogPosition();
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) when (rex.IsLegacyError(LegacyErrorCodes.StreamDeleted) || rex.IsLegacyError(LegacyErrorCodes.WrongExpectedVersion)) {
            dynamic error = await GetStreamInfo(stream, cancellationToken).MatchAsync(
                ok => ok.State switch {
                    StreamState.Active     => new StreamRevisionConflictException(nameof(Delete), stream, revision, ok.LastStreamRevision),
                    StreamState.Deleted    => new StreamDeletedException(stream),
                    StreamState.Tombstoned => new StreamTombstonedException(stream),
                    StreamState.Missing    => new StreamNotFoundException(stream)
                },
                ko => ko.AsException
            );
            return Result<LogPosition, DeleteStreamError>.Failure(error);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return DeleteStreamError.FromEx(ex);
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<LogPosition, TombstoneStreamError>> Tombstone(StreamName stream, StreamRevision revision, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        try {
            var request = Requests.CreateTombstoneRequest(stream, revision);
            var resp = await LegacyServiceClient
                .TombstoneAsync(request, cancellationToken: cancellationToken)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return resp?.Position?.MapToLogPosition() ?? LogPosition.Unset;
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) when (rex.IsLegacyError(LegacyErrorCodes.StreamDeleted) || rex.IsLegacyError(LegacyErrorCodes.WrongExpectedVersion)) {
            dynamic error = await GetStreamInfo(stream, cancellationToken).MatchAsync(
                ok => ok.State switch {
                    StreamState.Active     => new StreamRevisionConflictException(nameof(Tombstone), stream, revision, ok.LastStreamRevision),
                    StreamState.Deleted    => new StreamDeletedException(stream),
                    StreamState.Tombstoned => new StreamTombstonedException(stream),
                    StreamState.Missing    => new StreamNotFoundException(stream)
                },
                ko => ko.AsException
            );
            return Result<LogPosition, TombstoneStreamError>.Failure(error);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return TombstoneStreamError.FromEx(ex);
        }
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<StreamRevision, SetStreamMetadataError>> SetStreamMetadata(StreamName stream, StreamMetadata metadata, StreamRevision expectedRevision, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        var req = AppendStreamRequest.New()
            .ForStream(stream.Metastream)
            .ExpectingRevision(expectedRevision)
            .WithRecord(metadata)
            .Build();
        return this.Append(req, cancellationToken)
            .MapErrorAsync(ko => ko.ForwardError<SetStreamMetadataError>())
            .MapAsync(ok => ok.StreamRevision);
    }
    public async ValueTask<Result<Success, TruncateStreamError>> Truncate(StreamName stream, StreamRevision truncateRevision, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThanOrEqual(truncateRevision, StreamRevision.Min);
        try {
            var info = await GetStreamInfo(stream, cancellationToken).UnwrapAsync(); // we can let it flow ;)
            if (info.State is StreamState.Active) {
                var actualRevision = info.LastStreamRevision;
                var maxRevision    = actualRevision + 1; // all existing revisions
                if (truncateRevision > maxRevision)
                    return Result.Failure<Success, TruncateStreamError>(new StreamRevisionConflictException("Truncate revision cannot be greater than the last stream revision plus one."));
            }
            var metadata = new StreamMetadata { TruncateBefore = truncateRevision };
            return await SetStreamMetadata(stream, metadata, info.MetadataRevision, cancellationToken)
                .MapErrorAsync(ko => ko.ForwardError<TruncateStreamError>())
                .MapAsync(Results.Success);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return TruncateStreamError.FromEx(ex);
        }
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<StreamRevision, SetStreamMetadataError>> ConfigureStreamDataRetention(StreamName stream, StreamDataRetentionOptions options, StreamRevision metaStreamRevision, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        var metadata = new StreamMetadata { MaxCount = options.MaxCount, MaxAge = options.MaxAge };
        return SetStreamMetadata(stream, metadata, metaStreamRevision, cancellationToken);
    }
````

````csharp
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">
    /// A cancellation token to observe while waiting for the task to complete.
    /// </param>
    public async ValueTask<Result<Record, InspectRecordError>> InspectRecord(LogPosition position, bool skipDecoding = true, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
        if (position == LogPosition.Unset)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(position), "Log position cannot be Unset.");
        try {
            var request = Requests.CreateInspectRecordRequest(position);
            await using var messages = await ReadCore(request, 1, skipDecoding, RecordFilter.None, cancellationToken)
                .UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            var message = await messages.FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (message == ReadRecordsResult.Irrelevant)
                throw new LogPositionNotFoundException(request.Options.All.Position?.CommitPosition ?? LogPosition.Latest);
            if (message.IsRecord)
                return message.AsRecord;
            return Result<Record, InspectRecordError>.Failure(new LogPositionNotFoundException(position));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return InspectRecordError.FromEx(ex);
        }
        // {
        //     "$v": "3:-1:1:4",
        //     "$c": 12961,
        //     "$p": 12961,
        //     "$o": "TicTacToe-bad03a1c87c6",
        //     "$causedBy": "0197d630-9297-7000-9806-85795845c414"
        // }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the first or last record from a stream.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="stream">
    /// The name of the stream to read from.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="direction">
    /// The direction in which to read the stream edge. Use <see cref="ReadDirection.Forwards"/> to read the first record, or <see cref="ReadDirection.Backwards"/> to read the last record.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="skipDecoding">
    /// If true, the record's data and metadata will not be deserialized.
    /// </param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">
    /// A cancellation token to observe while waiting for the task to complete.
    /// </param>
    public async ValueTask<Result<Record, ReadError>> ReadStreamEdge(StreamName stream, ReadDirection direction, bool skipDecoding, CancellationToken cancellationToken) {
        if (stream == StreamName.None)
            throw new ArgumentException("Stream name cannot be None", nameof(stream));
        if (stream == StreamName.All)
            throw new ArgumentException("Stream name cannot be `$all`", nameof(stream));
        try {
            var request = Requests.CreateReadStreamEdgeRequest(stream, direction);
            await using var messages = await ReadCore(request, 1, skipDecoding, RecordFilter.None, cancellationToken)
                .UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            var message = await messages.FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (message.IsRecord)
                return message.AsRecord;
            return Result<Record, ReadError>.Failure(new UnreachableException($"No record found at the specified stream edge: {stream} ({direction})"));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            return ReadError.FromEx(ex);
        }
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadRecords(ReadOptions options) {
        var request = Requests.CreateReadLogRequest(options);
        return ReadCore(
            request, options.BufferCapacity,
            options.SkipDecoding, options.Filter,
            options.CancellationToken
        );
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadRecords(ReadStreamOptions options) {
        var request = Requests.CreateReadStreamRequest(options);
        return ReadCore(
            request, options.BufferCapacity,
            options.SkipDecoding, options.Filter,
            options.CancellationToken
        );
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<RecordBatchStream, ReadError>> ReadBatches(
        ReadOptions options, int batchSize, TimeSpan batchTimeout
    ) {
        var request = Requests.CreateReadLogRequest(options);
        return ReadBatchCore(
            request, options.BufferCapacity,
            options.SkipDecoding, options.Filter,
            batchSize, batchTimeout,
            options.CancellationToken
        );
    }
    public ValueTask<Result<RecordBatchStream, ReadError>> ReadBatches(
        ReadStreamOptions options, int batchSize, TimeSpan batchTimeout
    ) {
        var request = Requests.CreateReadStreamRequest(options);
        return ReadBatchCore(
            request, options.BufferCapacity,
            options.SkipDecoding, options.Filter,
            batchSize, batchTimeout,
            options.CancellationToken
        );
    }
    async ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadCore(
        ReadReq request, int bufferCapacity, bool skipDecoding,
        IRecordFilter filter, CancellationToken cancellationToken
    ) {
        var cancellator   = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        var session = LegacyServiceClient.Read(request, cancellationToken: stoppingToken);
        try {
            await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            // determine the actual stream state when not found (v1 protocol quirk)
            if (session.ResponseStream.Current?.ContentCase is StreamNotFound) {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                var info = await GetStreamInfo(stream, stoppingToken)
                    .UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                throw info.State switch {
                    StreamState.Missing    => new StreamNotFoundException(stream),
                    StreamState.Deleted    => new StreamDeletedException(stream), // we cant read it yet we can subscribe to it
                    StreamState.Tombstoned => new StreamTombstonedException(stream),
                    _                      => throw new UnreachableException($"Stream '{stream}' reported as not found, but has unexpected state '{info.State}'.")
                };
            }
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            // handle cancellation gracefully
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Cancelled)
                return ReadError.FromEx(new OperationCanceledException(rex.Message, rex));
            // when stream is tombstoned an exception is thrown for some weird reason
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.FailedPrecondition && rex.Trailers.GetValue("exception") == "stream-deleted") {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                return ReadError.FromEx(new StreamTombstonedException(stream));
            }
            // when a position does not exist (targets a position between records in the same stream)
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Unknown && rex.Message.Contains("InvalidPosition >>", OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                var position = request.Options.All.Position?.CommitPosition ?? LogPosition.Latest;
                var details  = rex.Message.Split(">>").Last().Trim();
                return ReadError.FromEx(new LogPositionNotFoundException(position, details));
            }
            return ReadError.FromEx(rex);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            return ReadError.FromEx(ex);
        }
        var channelFactory = new Func<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>>(
            () => StartMessageRelay(session, bufferCapacity, skipDecoding, filter, cancellator));
        return new RecordStream(channelFactory);
    }
    async ValueTask<Result<RecordBatchStream, ReadError>> ReadBatchCore(
        ReadReq request, int bufferCapacity, bool skipDecoding,
        IRecordFilter filter, int batchSize, TimeSpan batchTimeout,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken
    ) {
        var cancellator   = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        var session = LegacyServiceClient.Read(request, cancellationToken: stoppingToken);
        try {
            await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            // determine the actual stream state when not found (v1 protocol quirk)
            if (session.ResponseStream.Current?.ContentCase is StreamNotFound) {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                var info = await GetStreamInfo(stream, stoppingToken)
                    .UnwrapAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                throw info.State switch {
                    StreamState.Missing    => new StreamNotFoundException(stream),
                    StreamState.Deleted    => new StreamDeletedException(stream),
                    StreamState.Tombstoned => new StreamTombstonedException(stream),
                    _                      => throw new UnreachableException($"Stream '{stream}' reported as not found, but has unexpected state '{info.State}'.")
                };
            }
        }
        catch (RpcException rex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Cancelled)
                return ReadError.FromEx(new OperationCanceledException(rex.Message, rex));
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.FailedPrecondition && rex.Trailers.GetValue("exception") == "stream-deleted") {
                StreamName stream = request.Options.Stream.StreamIdentifier.StreamName.ToStringUtf8();
                return ReadError.FromEx(new StreamTombstonedException(stream));
            }
            if (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Unknown && rex.Message.Contains("InvalidPosition >>", OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                var position = request.Options.All.Position?.CommitPosition ?? LogPosition.Latest;
                var details  = rex.Message.Split(">>").Last().Trim();
                return ReadError.FromEx(new LogPositionNotFoundException(position, details));
            }
            return ReadError.FromEx(rex);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            cancellator.Dispose();
            return ReadError.FromEx(ex);
        }
        var channelFactory = new Func<Channel<ReadRecordsResult>>(
            () => StartMessageRelay(session, bufferCapacity, skipDecoding, filter, cancellator));
        return new RecordBatchStream(channelFactory, batchSize, batchTimeout);
    }
    Channel<ReadRecordsResult> StartMessageRelay(
        AsyncServerStreamingCall<ReadResp> session, int bufferCapacity,
        bool skipDecoding, IRecordFilter filter, CancellationTokenSource cancellator
    ) {
        var channel = Channel.CreateBounded<ReadRecordsResult>(
            new BoundedChannelOptions(bufferCapacity) {
                FullMode     = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait,
                SingleReader = true,
                SingleWriter = true
            }
        );
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        // start pumping messages
        _ = Task.Run(PumpMessages, stoppingToken);
        return channel;
        [AsyncMethodBuilder(typeof(PoolingAsyncValueTaskMethodBuilder))]
        async ValueTask PumpMessages() {
            SequenceGenerator sequencer = new();
            try {
                // must continue from the cursor because we had to try to read
                // the first entry to check if the stream existed or if access was granted
                do {
                    var resp = session.ResponseStream.Current;
                    ReadRecordsResult result;
                    switch (resp?.ContentCase) {
                        case Checkpoint:
                            result = resp.Checkpoint.MapToHeartbeat(sequencer.FetchNext());
                            break;
                        case CaughtUp:
                            result = resp.CaughtUp.MapToHeartbeat(sequencer.FetchNext());
                            break;
                        case FellBehind:
                            result = resp.FellBehind.MapToHeartbeat(sequencer.FetchNext());
                            break;
                        case Event:
                            result = await resp.Event.MapToRecordAsync(
                                sequencer.FetchNext(),
                                SerializerProvider, MetadataDecoder,
                                SchemaRegistryPolicy.NoRequirements,
                                skipDecoding, stoppingToken
                            ).ConfigureAwait(false);
                            break;
                        default:
                            continue; // Skip irrelevant, no allocation
                    }
                    // apply client-side filter if present
                    if (result.IsRecord && !filter.IsMatch(result))
                        continue;
                    // write to channel - backpressure via bounded channel
                    await channel.Writer.WriteAsync(result, stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                } while (await session.ResponseStream.MoveNext(stoppingToken).ConfigureAwait(false));
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            catch (RpcException rex) when (rex.StatusCode == StatusCode.Cancelled) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) {
                channel.Writer.TryComplete(ex);
            }
            finally {
                session.Dispose();
                cancellator.Dispose();
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
/// <summary>

    PartitionsAssignedException,
````

````csharp
            client.InspectRecord(position, true, cancellationToken);
        #region . Read Log .
        public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadRecords(Func<ReadOptions, ReadOptions>? configure = null) {
            var options = new ReadOptions();
            options = configure?.Invoke(options) ?? options;
            return client.ReadRecords(options);
        }

            client.ReadRecords(options => options with { Start = start, CancellationToken = cancellationToken });
        #endregion

        public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadStreamRecords(Func<ReadStreamOptions, ReadStreamOptions>? configure = null) {
            var options = new ReadStreamOptions();
            options = configure?.Invoke(options) ?? options;
            return client.ReadRecords(options);
        }
        public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadStreamRecords(StreamName stream, StreamRevision start, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
            client.ReadStreamRecords(options => options with { Stream = stream, Start = start, CancellationToken = cancellationToken });
        public ValueTask<Result<RecordStream, ReadError>> ReadStreamRecords(StreamName stream, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
            client.ReadStreamRecords(options => options with { Stream = stream, CancellationToken = cancellationToken });
        public ValueTask<Result<Record, ReadError>> ReadFirstStreamRecord(StreamName stream, bool skipDecoding, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            client.ReadStreamEdge(stream, ReadDirection.Forwards, skipDecoding, cancellationToken);

            client.ReadStreamEdge(stream, ReadDirection.Backwards, skipDecoding, cancellationToken);
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using SchemaDataFormat = Kurrent.Client.Streams.SchemaDataFormat;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization;
[PublicAPI]
public class SchemaManager(RegistryClient schemaRegistryClient, ISchemaExporter schemaExporter, MessageTypeMapper typeMapper) {
    RegistryClient    SchemaRegistryClient { get; } = schemaRegistryClient;
    ISchemaExporter   SchemaExporter       { get; } = schemaExporter;
    MessageTypeMapper TypeMapper           { get; } = typeMapper;
	ConcurrentDictionary<Type, List<SchemaVersionDescriptor>> CompatibleVersions { get; } = new();
	#region . Serialize .
	public async ValueTask<(SchemaName SchemaName, SchemaVersionId SchemaVersionId)> RegisterOrValidateSchema(Type messageType, ResolvedSchemaRegistryPolicy policy, CancellationToken ct) {
		if (policy is { AutoRegisterSchemas: true, DataFormat: SchemaDataFormat.Json })
			return await HandleServerRegistration(messageType, policy, ct);
		if (policy is { ValidateSchemas: true, DataFormat: SchemaDataFormat.Json })
			return await HandleServerValidation(messageType, policy, ct);
		return HandleLocalRegistration(messageType, policy);
	}
	async ValueTask<(SchemaName SchemaName, SchemaVersionId SchemaVersionId)> HandleServerRegistration(Type messageType,  ResolvedSchemaRegistryPolicy policy, CancellationToken ct) {
		var mapped = TypeMapper.TryGetSchemaName(messageType, out var schemaName);
		if (!mapped)
			schemaName = policy.GetSchemaName(messageType);
		var versionInfo = await TryRegisterSchema(schemaName, messageType, policy.DataFormat, ct)
			.ConfigureAwait(false);
		if (!mapped)
			TypeMapper.TryMap(schemaName, messageType);
		return (schemaName, versionInfo.VersionId);
	}
	async ValueTask<(SchemaName schemaName, SchemaVersionId lastSchemaVersionId)> HandleServerValidation(Type messageType, ResolvedSchemaRegistryPolicy policy, CancellationToken ct) {
		var mapped = TypeMapper.TryGetSchemaName(messageType, out var schemaName);
		if (!mapped)
			schemaName = policy.GetSchemaName(messageType);
		var lastSchemaVersionId = await EnsureSchemaCompatibility(schemaName, messageType, policy.DataFormat, ct)
			.ConfigureAwait(false);
		if (!mapped)
			TypeMapper.TryMap(schemaName, messageType);
		return (schemaName, lastSchemaVersionId);
	}
	(SchemaName schemaName, SchemaVersionId lastSchemaVersionId) HandleLocalRegistration(Type messageType, ResolvedSchemaRegistryPolicy policy) {
		if (policy.AutoMapMessages) {
			var mapped = TypeMapper.TryGetSchemaName(messageType, out var schemaName);
			if (!mapped) {
				schemaName = policy.GetSchemaName(messageType);
				TypeMapper.TryMap(schemaName, messageType);
			}
			return (schemaName, SchemaVersionId.None);
		}
		else if (TypeMapper.TryGetSchemaName(messageType, out var schemaName))
			return (schemaName, SchemaVersionId.None);
		else
			throw new AutoRegistrationDisabledException(policy.DataFormat, messageType);
	}
	#endregion
	#region . Deserialize .
	public async ValueTask<(Type MessageType, SchemaVersionId SchemaVersionId)> ValidateAndEnsureSchemaCompatibility(RecordSchemaInfo schemaInfo, ResolvedSchemaRegistryPolicy policy, CancellationToken ct) {
        var messageType = TypeMapper.GetOrResolveMessageType(schemaInfo.SchemaName);
		if (!policy.ValidateSchemas)
			return (messageType, SchemaVersionId.None);
		if (schemaInfo.HasSchemaId) {
			await EnsureSchemaCompatibility(schemaInfo.SchemaVersionId, messageType, schemaInfo.SchemaFormat, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
			// it was already set so we don't need to do anything and dont return the version id
			return (messageType, SchemaVersionId.None);
		}
		// fallback behaviour for backwards compatibility
		var lastSchemaVersionId = await EnsureSchemaCompatibility(schemaInfo.SchemaName, messageType, schemaInfo.SchemaFormat, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
		return (messageType, lastSchemaVersionId);
	}
	#endregion

		// 	onSuccess: schemaVersionId => {
		// 		// its impossible to update because we start by checking the cache
		// 		CompatibleVersions.TryAdd(messageType, [new SchemaVersionDescriptor(schemaVersionId, 0)]);
		// 		return schemaVersionId;
		// 	},
		// 	onError: error => throw new SchemaValidationException(
		// 		dataFormat, schemaName, messageType,
		// 		error.AsSchemaCompatibilityErrors.Errors
		// 	)
		// );
	}
}
/// <summary>
/// Exception thrown when a schema validation fails.
/// </summary>
public class SchemaValidationException(SchemaDataFormat dataFormat, SchemaIdentifier schemaIdentifier, Type messageType, IReadOnlyList<SchemaCompatibilityError> validationErrors)
	: KurrentException(ErrorCode.FromType<SchemaValidationException>(), ErrorMessage(messageType, schemaIdentifier, validationErrors)) {
	public SchemaDataFormat                        DataFormat       { get; } = dataFormat;
	public Type                                    MessageType      { get; } = messageType;
	public SchemaIdentifier                        SchemaIdentifier { get; } = schemaIdentifier;
	public IReadOnlyList<SchemaCompatibilityError> ValidationErrors { get; } = validationErrors;
	static string ErrorMessage(Type messageType, SchemaIdentifier schemaIdentifier, IReadOnlyList<SchemaCompatibilityError> validationErrors) {
		var schemaIdentifierText = schemaIdentifier.Match(
			schemaName => $"schema '{schemaName}'",
			schemaVersionId => $"schema version '{schemaVersionId}'"
		);
		return $"Schema validation failed for message type '{messageType.FullName}' with {schemaIdentifierText}."
		     + $"Found {validationErrors.Count} errors:{Environment.NewLine}{string.Join(Environment.NewLine, validationErrors.Select(error => $" - {error}"))}";
	}
}
/// <summary>
/// Exception thrown when a schema cannot be found in the registry.
/// </summary>
public class SchemaNotFoundException(SchemaIdentifier schemaIdentifier) : KurrentException(ErrorCode.FromType<SchemaNotFoundException>(), ErrorMessage(schemaIdentifier)) {
	public SchemaIdentifier SchemaIdentifier { get; } = schemaIdentifier;
	static string ErrorMessage(SchemaIdentifier schemaIdentifier) =>
		schemaIdentifier.Match(
			schemaName      => $"Schema '{schemaName}' was not found in the registry.",
			schemaVersionId => $"Schema version '{schemaVersionId}' was not found in the registry."
		);
}
````

## File: src/KurrentDB.Client/Kurrent.Client/Schema/Serialization/SchemaSerializerBase.cs
````csharp
#pragma warning disable CS1998 // Async method lacks 'await' operators and will run synchronously
using System.Diagnostics;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization;
public record SchemaSerializerOptions {
	/// <summary>
	/// Configuration options for schema registration, validation, and type mapping behaviors.
	/// </summary>
	public SchemaRegistrationOptions SchemaRegistration { get; init; } = new SchemaRegistrationOptions();
	/// <summary>
	/// Specifies whether only schemas explicitly mapped to a .NET type should be consumed during
	/// deserialization.
	/// When <c>true</c>, only schemas with mapped .NET types will be processed during deserialization.
	/// </summary>
	public bool ConsumeMappedOnly { get; set; } = true;
}
public abstract class SchemaSerializerBase(SchemaSerializerOptions options, SchemaManager schemaManager) : ISchemaSerializer {
	SchemaSerializerOptions Options       { get; } = options;
	SchemaManager           SchemaManager { get; } = schemaManager;
	public abstract SchemaDataFormat DataFormat { get; }
	async ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> ISchemaSerializer.Serialize(object? value, SchemaSerializationContext context) {
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		// these debug asserts ensure the required info is set during the development process
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Debug.Assert(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context.Stream) || context.RecordSchema.HasSchemaName, "Stream name is missing in the context");
		Debug.Assert(context.RecordSchema.SchemaFormat == DataFormat, "Schema format does not match the serializer data format");
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		if (value is null)
			return ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty;
		var policy = context.SchemaRegistryPolicy
			.Resolve(Options.SchemaRegistration, context.Stream)
			.EnsureDataFormatCompliance(DataFormat);
		var messageType = value.GetType();
		try {
			var result = await SchemaManager
				.RegisterOrValidateSchema(messageType, policy, context.CancellationToken)
				.ConfigureAwait(false);
            context.RecordSchema = result.SchemaVersionId == SchemaVersionId.None
                ? context.RecordSchema with {
                    SchemaName   = result.SchemaName,
                    SchemaFormat = DataFormat
                }
                : context.RecordSchema with {
                    SchemaName      = result.SchemaName,
                    SchemaFormat    = DataFormat,
                    SchemaVersionId = result.SchemaVersionId
                };
            return Serialize(value);
		}
		catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not SchemaSerializationException) {
			throw new SchemaSerializationFailedException(DataFormat, messageType,  ex);
		}
	}
	async ValueTask<object?> ISchemaSerializer.Deserialize(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, SchemaSerializationContext context) {
        var schemaInfo = context.RecordSchema;
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		// these debug asserts ensure the required info is set during the development process
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Debug.Assert(schemaInfo.HasSchemaName, "Schema name is missing in the context");
		Debug.Assert(schemaInfo.HasSchemaFormat, "Schema format is missing in the context");
		Debug.Assert(schemaInfo.SchemaFormat == DataFormat, "Schema format does not match the serializer data format");
		// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		if (data.IsEmpty)
			return null;
		try {
			var policy = context.SchemaRegistryPolicy
				.Resolve(Options.SchemaRegistration, context.Stream)
				.EnsureDataFormatCompliance(DataFormat);
			var result = await SchemaManager
				.ValidateAndEnsureSchemaCompatibility(schemaInfo, policy, context.CancellationToken)
				.ConfigureAwait(false);
            // set the schema version id if missing
            if(result.SchemaVersionId != SchemaVersionId.None)
                context.RecordSchema = context.RecordSchema with {
                    SchemaVersionId = result.SchemaVersionId
                };
			return Deserialize(data, result.MessageType);
		}
		catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not SchemaSerializationException) {
			throw new SchemaDeserializationFailedException(DataFormat, schemaInfo.SchemaName,  ex);
		}
	}
	/// <summary>
	/// Serializes the given object to a byte array representation.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="value">The object to be serialized. Can be null.</param>
	/// <returns>A read-only memory containing the serialized byte array of the object.</returns>
	protected abstract ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Serialize(object? value);
	/// <summary>
	/// Deserializes the given byte array representation to an object of the specified type.
	/// </summary>
	/// <param name="data">The memory segment containing the serialized byte array of the object.</param>
	/// <param name="resolvedType">The target type to which the byte array should be deserialized.</param>
	/// <returns>The deserialized object of the specified type.</returns>
	protected abstract object Deserialize(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data, Type resolvedType);
}
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Legacy;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization.Bytes;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization.Json;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema.Serialization.Protobuf;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
namespace Kurrent.Client;
[PublicAPI]
public class KurrentClient : IAsyncDisposable {
    public static KurrentClientOptionsBuilder New => new KurrentClientOptionsBuilder();
    public KurrentClient(KurrentClientOptions options) {
	    options.EnsureOptionsAreValid();
	    Options = options;
        LegacyCallInvoker     = new KurrentDBLegacyCallInvoker(options);
        BackdoorClientFactory = new KurrentBackdoorClientFactory(LegacyCallInvoker, options);
        var schemaManager = new SchemaManager(
	        new RegistryClient(this),
	        NJsonSchemaExporter.Instance,
	        options.Mapper);
        SerializerProvider = new SchemaSerializerProvider([
	        new BytesPassthroughSerializer(),
	        new JsonSchemaSerializer(new() { SchemaRegistration = SchemaRegistrationOptions.AutoMap }, schemaManager),
	        new ProtobufSchemaSerializer(new() { SchemaRegistration = SchemaRegistrationOptions.AutoMap }, schemaManager)
        ]);
        Registry                = new RegistryClient(this);
        Streams                 = new StreamsClient(this);
        // Admin                   = new AdminClient(this);
        // PersistentSubscriptions = new PersistentSubscriptionsClient(this);
        // Projections             = new ProjectionsClient(this);
        // Users                   = new UsersClient(this);
        // Connectors              = new ConnectorsClient(this);
    }
    internal bool Shared { get; init; }
    internal KurrentClientOptions         Options               { get; }
    internal KurrentDBLegacyCallInvoker   LegacyCallInvoker     { get; }
    internal KurrentBackdoorClientFactory BackdoorClientFactory { get; }
    internal ISchemaSerializerProvider    SerializerProvider    { get; }
    public StreamsClient                 Streams                 { get; }
    public RegistryClient                Registry                { get; }
    // public UsersClient                   Users                   { get; }
    // public PersistentSubscriptionsClient PersistentSubscriptions { get; }
    // public AdminClient                   Admin                   { get; }
    // public ProjectionsClient             Projections             { get; }
    // public ConnectorsClient              Connectors              { get; }
	// internal async Task<ServerFeatures> ForceRefresh(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) {
	// 	await LegacyCallInvoker.ForceRefresh(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
	//
	// 	return new ServerFeatures {
	// 		Version = LegacyCallInvoker.ServerCapabilities.Version
	// 	};
	// }
	public virtual async ValueTask DisposeAsync() {
        if (Shared) return;
        BackdoorClientFactory.Dispose();
        await LegacyCallInvoker
            .DisposeAsync()
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    public static KurrentClient Create(KurrentClientOptions? options = null) =>
        new(options ?? new KurrentClientOptions());
    public static KurrentClient Create(string connectionString) =>
        Create(KurrentConnectionString.Parse(connectionString).ToClientOptions());
}
````

````csharp
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Delete(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(

    }

        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Delete(simulation.Stream, simulation.StreamRevision, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(position =>
                position.ShouldBeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(simulation.Position));
    }
    [Test]

        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Delete(simulation.Stream, badRevision, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(error =>

            .Delete(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(error =>
                error.Case.ShouldBe(DeleteStreamError.DeleteStreamErrorCase.StreamNotFoundException));
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask fails_to_delete_stream_with_stream_deleted_error_when_stream_was_deleted(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Delete(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Delete(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(error =>
                error.Case.ShouldBe(DeleteStreamError.DeleteStreamErrorCase.StreamDeletedException));
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask fails_to_delete_stream_with_stream_tombstoned_error_when_stream_was_tombstoned(CancellationToken ct) {

        await Fixture.Client.Streams
````

````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
using Kurrent.Client.Registry;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;

using Kurrent.Client.Tests.Tools;
using Kurrent.Testing.Shouldly;
using Kurrent.Testing.TUnit;
using Serilog;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Streams;
[Category("Streams")]
[Category("Read")]
[Category("Integration")]
public class ReadTests {
    [ClassDataSource<KurrentClientTestFixture>(Shared = SharedType.PerTestSession)]
    public required KurrentClientTestFixture Fixture { get; [UsedImplicitly] init; }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask reads_log(CancellationToken ct) {
        // var home = HomeAutomationDataSet.Default.Home();
        // var stream = StreamName.From($"{nameof(SmartHomeActivity)}-{home.Id}");
        using var cancellator = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        var stoppingToken = cancellator.Token;
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(10, stoppingToken);
        var options = new ReadOptions {
            Start             = LogPosition.Earliest,
            Filter            = RecordFilter.ByExpression($"stream = '{simulation.Stream}'"),
            // Filter            = RecordFilter.ByStream(simulation.Stream),
            SkipDecoding      = true,
            Heartbeat         = HeartbeatOptions.Threshold(100),
            CancellationToken = stoppingToken
        };
        await using var messages = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadRecords(options)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var records = new List<Record>();
        await foreach (var msg in messages.WithCancellation(stoppingToken)) {
            msg.Switch(
                record => {
                    records.Add(record);
                    Log.Information(
                        "Record {RecordId} {SchemaName} @ {Position}",
                        record.Id, record.Schema.SchemaName, record.Position
                    );
                    if (record.Position >= simulation.Position)
                        // ReSharper disable once AccessToDisposedClosure
                        cancellator.Cancel();
                },
                heartbeat => Log.Information("Heartbeat {HeartbeatType} @ {Position}", heartbeat.Type, heartbeat.Position)
            );
        }
        records.Count.ShouldBe(simulation.Records.Count);
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask reads_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        var now = Fixture.Time.GetUtcNow();
        await using var messages = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var records = await messages
            .Where(msg => msg.IsRecord)
            .Select(msg => msg.AsRecord)
            .ToListAsync(ct);
        records.Count.ShouldBe(simulation.Records.Count);
        for (var i = 0; i < records.Count; i++) {
            var record   = records[i];
            var iotEvent = simulation.Records[i];
            record.Stream.ShouldBe(simulation.Stream);
            record.StreamRevision.ShouldBeEquivalentTo(StreamRevision.From(i));
            record.Position.ShouldBeLessThanOrEqualTo(simulation.Position);
            record.Schema.SchemaName.Value.ShouldNotBeEmpty();
            record.Schema.SchemaFormat.ShouldBe(iotEvent.DataFormat);
            record.Schema.SchemaVersionId.ShouldBe(SchemaVersionId.None);
            record.Value.ShouldBeEquivalentTo(iotEvent.Value);
            record.ValueType.ShouldBe(iotEvent.Value.GetType());
            record.Timestamp.ShouldNotBeInRange(now.DateTime, Fixture.Time.GetUtcNow().DateTime);
            record.Metadata.Stringify().ShouldBeEquivalentTo(iotEvent.Metadata.Stringify());
        }
    }
    [Test]
    [Arguments(1)]
    [Arguments(2)]
    [Arguments(3)]
    [Arguments(5)]
    [Arguments(6)]
    [Arguments(7)]
````
