````csharp
    public async ValueTask gracefully_stops_reading_and_flushes_queue_when_read_token_is_cancelled(int records, CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(records, ct);
        using var cancellator = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        await using var messages = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, cancellator.Token)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var cancelOn = simulation.Records.Count / 2 + simulation.Records.Count % 2;
        await foreach (var _ in messages)
            if (--cancelOn == 0 && !cancellator.IsCancellationRequested)
                await cancellator.CancelAsync();
        messages.QueuedMessages.ShouldBe(0, "Should have flushed all messages on cancellation");
        cancellator.IsCancellationRequested.ShouldBeTrue();
    }
    [Test]
    [Arguments(1)]
    [Arguments(2)]

    [Arguments(5)]
    [Arguments(6)]

    [Arguments(10)]

    public async ValueTask gracefully_stops_reading_without_flushing_queue_when_enumerable_token_is_cancelled(int records, CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(records, ct);
        await using RecordStream messages = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var cancelOn = simulation.Records.Count / 2 + simulation.Records.Count % 2;
        using var cancellator = new CancellationTokenSource();
        await foreach (var _ in messages.WithCancellation(cancellator.Token)) {
            if (--cancelOn == 0)
                cancellator.Cancel();
            else
                await Task.Delay(25); // simulate some processing time
        }
        messages.QueuedMessages.ShouldBeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(
            cancelOn, "Should not queue more than one message before cancellation"
        );
        cancellator.Token.IsCancellationRequested.ShouldBeTrue();
        cancellator.IsCancellationRequested.ShouldBeTrue();

        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Tombstone(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(err => err.Value.ShouldBeOfType<StreamTombstonedException>());
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask fails_with_stream_not_found_error_when_stream_does_not_exist(CancellationToken ct) {
        var activity = HomeAutomationTestData.SimulateHomeActivity();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(activity.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(err => err.Value.ShouldBeOfType<StreamNotFoundException>());
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Kurrent.Testing.OpenTelemetry;
[PublicAPI]
public static class OtelTestContextExtensions {
    extension(TestContext? context) {
        public void ConfigureOtel(OtelServiceMetadata metadata) {
            context?.StateBag.Items["OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES"] = metadata.GetResourceAttributes();
            context?.StateBag.Items["OTEL_SERVICE_NAME"]        = metadata.ServiceName; // not really necessary, but follows the convention
        }
        public OtelServiceMetadata GetOtelServiceMetadata() =>
            context is not null && context.StateBag.Items.TryGetValue("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", out var value) && value is string resourceAttributes
                ? OtelServiceMetadata.Parse(resourceAttributes)
                : OtelServiceMetadata.None;
        public void SetOtelServiceName(string serviceName) => ConfigureOtel(context, new OtelServiceMetadata(serviceName));
    }
}
````

````csharp
// Copyright (c) Kurrent, Inc and/or licensed to Kurrent, Inc under one or more agreements.
// Kurrent, Inc licenses this file to you under the Kurrent License v1 (see LICENSE.md).
// ReSharper disable UnusedParameter.Local
using Bogus;
namespace Kurrent.Testing.Sample.HomeAutomation;
public class HomeAutomationDataSet : DataSet {
    public static readonly HomeAutomationDataSet Default = new();
    public HomeAutomationDataSet(string locale = "en") : base(locale) =>
        Faker = new Faker(locale);
    public HomeAutomationDataSet(Faker faker) : base(faker.Locale) =>
        Faker = faker;
    Faker Faker { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate a random home with optional configuration parameters
    /// </summary>
    public SmartHome Home(int? rooms = null, int? devicesPerRoom = null, params DeviceType[] deviceTypes) {
        rooms          ??= Faker.Random.Number(2, 4);
        devicesPerRoom ??= Faker.Random.Number(3, 7);
        return GenerateCustomHome(rooms, devicesPerRoom, deviceTypes);
    }
    public List<SmartHome> Homes(int? count = null, int? averageNumberOfRooms = null, int? averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom = null, params DeviceType[] deviceTypes) {
        count ??= Faker.Random.Number(3, 7);
        averageNumberOfRooms = averageNumberOfRooms is null
            ? Faker.Random.Number(2, 4)
            : Faker.Random.Number(Math.Max(1, averageNumberOfRooms.Value - 2), averageNumberOfRooms.Value + 2);
        averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom = averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom is null
            ? Faker.Random.Number(3, 7)
            : Faker.Random.Number(Math.Max(1, averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom.Value - 2), averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom.Value + 2);
        return Enumerable.Range(0, count.Value)
            .Select(_ => GenerateCustomHome(averageNumberOfRooms, averageNumberOfDevicesPerRoom, deviceTypes))
            .ToList();
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate a collection of devices with optional parameters
    /// </summary>
    public List<Device> Devices(int? count = null, DeviceType[]? types = null, List<Room>? rooms = null) {
        // Use provided rooms or generate default ones
        var targetRooms = rooms ?? GenerateDefaultRooms();
        var deviceCount = count ?? Faker.Random.Number(5, 15);
        var tempHome = new SmartHome {
            Id        = Faker.Random.AlphaNumeric(6).ToLower(),
            Name      = "Temp Home",
            Rooms     = targetRooms,
            Devices   = [], // Empty for now
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        if (types is null || types.Length == 0) {
            // Use standard device collection faker
            var deviceFaker = new HomeDeviceCollectionFaker(tempHome, deviceCount);
            return deviceFaker.Generate();
        }
        // Generate devices with specific types
        return GenerateTypedDevices(targetRooms, deviceCount, types);
        List<Room> GenerateDefaultRooms() {
            var roomFaker = new RoomFaker();
            return new List<Room> {
                new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Living Room", RoomType.LivingRoom),
                new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Kitchen", RoomType.Kitchen),
                new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Master Bedroom", RoomType.Bedroom)
            }.Concat(roomFaker.Generate(Faker.Random.Number(2, 4))).ToList();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate devices specifically for given rooms
    /// </summary>
    public List<Device> Devices(List<Room> rooms, int? devicesPerRoom = null) {
        var devicesPerRoomCount = devicesPerRoom ?? Faker.Random.Number(1, 3);
        var totalDevices        = rooms.Count * devicesPerRoomCount;
        return Devices(totalDevices, rooms: rooms);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate events for specific devices
    /// </summary>
    public List<IHomeAutomationEvent> Events(List<Device> devices, int count, long? startTime = null, int maxIntervalMinutes = 30) {
        if (devices.Count == 0) return [];
        var events    = new List<IHomeAutomationEvent>();
        var timestamp = startTime ?? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(-1).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            timestamp += Faker.Random.Number(1, maxIntervalMinutes) * 60000L;
            var device   = Faker.PickRandom(devices);
            var evt = GenerateEventForDevice(device, timestamp);
            if (evt is not null) {
                events.Add(evt);
                // Generate correlated events
                var correlatedEvents = GenerateCorrelatedEvents(device, timestamp, devices, Faker);
                events.AddRange(correlatedEvents);
            }
        }
        return events;
        static IHomeAutomationEvent? GenerateEventForDevice(Device device, long timestamp) {
            return device switch {
                Thermostat thermostat         => new TemperatureReadingFaker(thermostat, timestamp).Generate(),
                MotionSensor motionSensor     => new MotionDetectedFaker(motionSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                SmartLight smartLight         => new LightStateChangedFaker(smartLight, timestamp).Generate(),
                DoorLock doorLock             => new DoorStateChangedFaker(doorLock, timestamp).Generate(),
                SmokeDetector smokeDetector   => new SmokeDetectedFaker(smokeDetector, timestamp).Generate(),
                HumiditySensor humiditySensor => new HumidityReadingFaker(humiditySensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                WindowSensor windowSensor     => new WindowStateChangedFaker(windowSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                WaterSensor waterSensor       => new WaterLeakDetectedFaker(waterSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                _                             => null // Skip unsupported device types
            };
        }
        static IEnumerable<IHomeAutomationEvent> GenerateCorrelatedEvents(Device device, long timestamp, List<Device> availableDevices, Faker faker) {
            // Motion sensor correlation: trigger lights in the same room
            if (device is MotionSensor motionSensor && faker.Random.Bool(0.3f)) {
                var lightsInSameRoom = availableDevices
                    .OfType<SmartLight>()
                    .Where(light => light.Room.RoomId == motionSensor.Room.RoomId)
                    .Take(1);
                foreach (var light in lightsInSameRoom) {
                    var correlatedTimestamp = timestamp + faker.Random.Long(2000L, 10000L);
                    yield return new LightStateChangedFaker(light, correlatedTimestamp).Generate();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate events for specific devices forever
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<IHomeAutomationEvent> Events() {
        var devices = Devices(Faker.Random.Number(2, 4));
        var timestamp = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(-1).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
        while (true) {
            timestamp += Faker.Random.Number(1, 30) * 60000L;
            var device = Faker.PickRandom(devices);
            var evt    = GenerateEventForDevice(device, timestamp)!;
            yield return evt;
        }
        static IHomeAutomationEvent? GenerateEventForDevice(Device device, long timestamp) {
            return device switch {
                Thermostat thermostat         => new TemperatureReadingFaker(thermostat, timestamp).Generate(),
                MotionSensor motionSensor     => new MotionDetectedFaker(motionSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                SmartLight smartLight         => new LightStateChangedFaker(smartLight, timestamp).Generate(),
                DoorLock doorLock             => new DoorStateChangedFaker(doorLock, timestamp).Generate(),
                SmokeDetector smokeDetector   => new SmokeDetectedFaker(smokeDetector, timestamp).Generate(),
                HumiditySensor humiditySensor => new HumidityReadingFaker(humiditySensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                WindowSensor windowSensor     => new WindowStateChangedFaker(windowSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                WaterSensor waterSensor       => new WaterLeakDetectedFaker(waterSensor, timestamp).Generate(),
                _                             => null // Skip unsupported device types
            };
        }
        // ReSharper disable once IteratorNeverReturns
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate events for a home's devices
    /// </summary>
    public List<IHomeAutomationEvent> Events(SmartHome home, int count, long? startTime = null, int maxIntervalMinutes = 30) =>
        Events(home.Devices, count, startTime, maxIntervalMinutes);
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate random events for a new home
    /// </summary>
    public List<IHomeAutomationEvent> Events(int count, long? startTime = null, int maxIntervalMinutes = 30) =>
        Events(Home(), count, startTime, maxIntervalMinutes);
    SmartHome GenerateCustomHome(int? rooms, int? devicesPerRoom, params DeviceType[] deviceTypes) {
        var roomCount          = rooms ?? Faker.Random.Number(3, 8);
        var deviceCountPerRoom = devicesPerRoom ?? Faker.Random.Number(1, 3);
        // Generate home properties
        var homeId = Faker.Random.AlphaNumeric(6).ToLower();
        var homeName = Faker.PickRandom(
            $"{Faker.Name.LastName()} Family Home",
            $"{Faker.Name.LastName()} Residence",
            $"{Faker.Address.StreetName()} House",
            $"{Faker.Address.StreetName()} Villa",
            $"{Faker.Address.City()} Apartment {Faker.Random.Number(1, 50)}"
        );
        // Generate rooms
        var roomFaker = new RoomFaker();
        var homeRooms = roomFaker.Generate(roomCount);
        // Generate devices
        var totalDevices = roomCount * deviceCountPerRoom;
        var devices = deviceTypes.Length == 0
            ? Devices(totalDevices, rooms: homeRooms)
            : GenerateTypedDevices(homeRooms, totalDevices, deviceTypes);
        return new SmartHome {
            Id        = homeId,
            Name      = homeName,
            Rooms     = homeRooms,
            Devices   = devices,
            CreatedAt = Faker.Date.Between(DateTime.UtcNow.AddYears(-2), DateTime.UtcNow.AddMonths(-1))
        };
    }
    List<Device> GenerateTypedDevices(List<Room> rooms, int totalDevices, DeviceType[] allowedTypes) {
        var devices = new List<Device>();
        var homeId  = Faker.Random.AlphaNumeric(6).ToLower();
        for (var i = 0; i < totalDevices; i++) {
            var room       = Faker.PickRandom(rooms);
            var deviceType = Faker.PickRandom(allowedTypes);
            var deviceFaker = new DeviceFaker(room, deviceType, homeId);
            devices.Add(deviceFaker.Generate());
        }
        return devices;
    }
}
````

````csharp
// ReSharper disable CheckNamespace
using Google.Rpc;
using Google.Rpc.Exceptions;
using Grpc.Core;
using Kurrent.Client.Errors;
using Kurrent.Rpc;
using Kurrent.Variant;
using Status = Google.Rpc.Status;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;
[KurrentOperationError(ServerError.LeaderForwardingTimeout)]
public partial class LeaderForwardingTimeoutException;
[KurrentOperationError(ServerError.ServerNotReady)]
public partial class ServerNotReadyException;
[KurrentOperationError(ServerError.ServerOverloaded)]
public partial class ServerOverloadedException;
[KurrentOperationError(ServerError.NotLeaderNode)]
public partial class NotLeaderNodeException {
    public NodeInfo CurrentLeader { get; private set; } = NodeInfo.None;
    public void AfterParseRpcStatus(Status status, NotLeaderNodeException self) {
        var details = status.GetDetail<NotLeaderNodeErrorDetails>()!;
        self.CurrentLeader = NodeInfo.From(
            details.CurrentLeader.Host,
            details.CurrentLeader.Port,
            details.CurrentLeader.NodeId);
    }
}
delegate dynamic? OperationExceptionParser(Status status, ErrorInfo? errorInfo);
static class ExceptionExtensions {
    static readonly OperationExceptionParser[] GoogleParsers = [
        static (s, e) => CancelledException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => UnknownException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => InvalidArgumentException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => DeadlineExceededException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => NotFoundException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => AlreadyExistsException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => PermissionDeniedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => UnauthenticatedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => ResourceExhaustedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => FailedPreconditionException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => AbortedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => OutOfRangeException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => UnimplementedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => InternalException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => UnavailableException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => DataLossException.From(s, e)
    ];
    static readonly OperationExceptionParser[] ServerParsers = [
        static (s, e) => LeaderForwardingTimeoutException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => ServerNotReadyException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => ServerOverloadedException.From(s, e),
        static (s, e) => NotLeaderNodeException.From(s, e)
    ];
    extension(Exception ex) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Dangerously converts an Exception into a variant error result by trying to parse it using the provided parsers,
        /// followed by the built-in server and standard google parsers.
        /// </summary>
        public TError ToExceptionalErrorResult<TError>(params OperationExceptionParser[] parsers) where TError : class, IVariantException {
            // pass through KurrentException as is (just in case)
            if (ex is KurrentException kex)
                return (dynamic)kex;
            // fast fail for non-RpcException
            if (ex is not RpcException rex)
                return (dynamic)ex;
            // extract status and error info
            var status    = rex.GetRpcStatus();
            var errorInfo = status?.GetDetail<ErrorInfo>();
            // create status fallback
            status ??= new Status {
                Code    = (int)rex.StatusCode,
                Message = rex.Message
            };
            // try to parse using the provided parsers, then server parsers, then google parsers
            // and finally fallback to the original exception
            return parsers
                .Concat(ServerParsers)
                .Concat(GoogleParsers)
                .Select(parse => parse(status, errorInfo))
                .SkipWhile(result => result is null)
                .DefaultIfEmpty(ex)
                .Select(ex => (TError)ex!)
                .First();
        }
        public Exception ToException(params OperationExceptionParser[] parsers) {
            // pass through KurrentException as is (just in case)
            if (ex is KurrentException kex)
                return kex;
            // fast fail for non-RpcException
            if (ex is not RpcException rex)
                return ex;
            // extract status and error info
            var status    = rex.GetRpcStatus();
            var errorInfo = status?.GetDetail<ErrorInfo>();
            // create status fallback
            status ??= new Status {
                Code    = (int)rex.StatusCode,
                Message = rex.Message
            };
            // try to parse using the provided parsers, then server parsers, then google parsers
            // and finally fallback to the original exception
            return parsers
                .Concat(ServerParsers)
                .Concat(GoogleParsers)
                .Select(parse => parse(status, errorInfo))
                .SkipWhile(result => result is null)
                .DefaultIfEmpty(ex)
                .Select(ex => (Exception)ex!)
                .First();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
/// <summary>
/// Represents the name of a stream in KurrentDB.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public readonly record struct StreamName {
    /// <summary>
    /// Represents an uninitialized or empty stream name.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly StreamName None = new("", StreamCategory.None, Partition.Any);
    /// <summary>
    /// A stream containing all events in the KurrentDB transaction file.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly StreamName All = new(AllStream, StreamCategory.None, Partition.Any);
    /// <summary>
    /// The prefix character for system streams.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly char SystemStreamPrefix = '$';
    /// <summary>
    /// The separator character for stream partitions.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Stream partitions are denoted by appending a '!' followed by the partition number.
    /// For example, "orders!1" represents partition 1 of the "orders" stream.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// The '!' character was chosen because it is:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description>URL safe (RFC 3986 sub-delimiter)</description></item>
    /// <item><description>Regex safe (no special meaning)</description></item>
    /// <item><description>URN safe (allowed in namespace-specific string)</description></item>
    /// <item><description>Easy to type</description></item>
    /// <item><description>Unlikely to appear naturally in stream names</description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly char PartitionSeparator = '!';
    /// <summary>
    /// The default separator character for stream categories.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// This is the default separator used by the KurrentDB $by_category projection.
    /// For configurable category parsing, use <see cref="CategoryParseOptions"/>.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static readonly char CategorySeparator = CategoryParseOptions.Default.Separator;
    /// <summary>
    /// A stream containing all events in the KurrentDB transaction file.
    /// </summary>
    public const string AllStream = "$all";
    /// <summary>
    /// A stream containing links pointing to each stream in the KurrentDB.
    /// </summary>
    public const string StreamsStream = "$streams";
    /// <summary>
    /// A stream containing system settings.
    /// </summary>
    public const string SettingsStream = "$settings";
    /// <summary>
    /// A stream containing statistics.
    /// </summary>
    public const string StatsStreamPrefix = "$stats";
    /// <summary>
    /// Metastreams are special streams that store metadata about the main stream.
    /// </summary>
    public const string MetastreamPrefix = "$$";
    /// <summary>
    /// Prefix for custom index streams.
    /// </summary>
    public const string IndexStreamsPrefix = "$idx";
    StreamName(string value, StreamCategory category, Partition partition, string partitionKeyValue = "") {
        Value        = value;
        StreamCategory = category;
        Partition    = partition;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// The underlying string value of the stream.
    /// </summary>
    public string Value { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether the stream name is unset (i.e., equals <see cref="None"/>).
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsUnset => this == None;
    /// <summary>
    /// The category of the stream if applicable.
    /// </summary>
    public StreamCategory StreamCategory { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The stream partition if applicable.
    /// </summary>
    public Partition Partition { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The metastream associated with this stream.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Metastreams are special streams that store metadata about the main stream. They are typically prefixed with "$$".
    ///<para/>
    /// If this stream is in fact a metastream, it returns itself.
    /// </remarks>
    public StreamName Metastream =>
        IsMetastream ? this : new StreamName(MetastreamPrefix + Value, StreamCategory, Partition);
    public bool IsMetastream => Value.StartsWith(MetastreamPrefix);
    public bool IsSystemStream => Value.StartsWith(SystemStreamPrefix);
    public bool IsIndex => Value.StartsWith(IndexStreamsPrefix);
    public bool IsAllStream => Value == AllStream;
    public bool IsStreamsStream => Value == StreamsStream;
    public bool IsSettingsStream => Value == SettingsStream;
    public bool IsStatsStream => Value.StartsWith(StatsStreamPrefix);
    public override string ToString() => Value;
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="StreamName"/> from a string value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The stream name string to parse.</param>
    /// <param name="categoryOptions">
    /// Options for category extraction. If null, <see cref="CategoryParseOptions.Default"/> is used.
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="StreamName"/> with extracted category and partition information.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidStreamNameException">
    /// Thrown when the stream name is null/whitespace, contains multiple partition separators,
    /// has an invalid partition number, or is empty before the partition separator.
    /// </exception>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Parsing rules:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description>The partition is always after the '!' character (if present)</description></item>
    /// <item><description>The category is extracted based on <paramref name="categoryOptions"/> (separator and position)</description></item>
    /// <item><description>The stream name can contain any characters except multiple '!' separators</description></item>
    /// <item><description>Both partition and category are optional</description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Examples with default options (separator: '-', position: First):
    /// <code>
    /// "orders-123!1"       => (Value: "orders-123!1", Category: "orders", Partition: 1)
    /// "orders/portugal!1"  => (Value: "orders/portugal!1", Category: "orders/portugal", Partition: 1)
    /// "orders!1"           => (Value: "orders!1", Category: "orders", Partition: 1)
    /// "orders-123"         => (Value: "orders-123", Category: "orders", Partition: Any)
    /// "orders"             => (Value: "orders", Category: "orders", Partition: Any)
    /// "users-GUID!4"       => (Value: "users-GUID!4", Category: "users", Partition: 4)
    /// </code>
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Examples with position: Last:
    /// <code>
    /// "shopping-cart-1"    => (Value: "shopping-cart-1", Category: "shopping-cart", Partition: Any)
    /// "user-profile-v2!3"  => (Value: "user-profile-v2!3", Category: "user-profile", Partition: 3)
    /// </code>
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public static StreamName From(string? value, CategoryParseOptions? categoryOptions = null) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            InvalidStreamNameException.Throw("Stream name cannot be null or whitespace.");
        var span           = value.AsSpan();
        var partitionIndex = span.LastIndexOf(PartitionSeparator);
        if (partitionIndex >= 0 && span.IndexOf(PartitionSeparator) != partitionIndex)
            InvalidStreamNameException.Throw(
                $"Stream name contains multiple partition separators ('!'). " +
                $"Partition can only be specified once at the end (e.g., 'orders!1'): '{value}'.");
        Partition          partition;
        ReadOnlySpan<char> streamSpan;
        if (partitionIndex >= 0) {
            var partitionSpan = span[(partitionIndex + 1)..];
            if (!int.TryParse(partitionSpan, out var partitionNumber))
                InvalidStreamNameException.Throw(
                    $"Partition must be a valid number. " +
                    $"Use the '!' separator followed by a numeric partition value (e.g., 'orders!1'): '{value}'.");
            partition  = Partition.From(partitionNumber);
            streamSpan = span[..partitionIndex];
            if (streamSpan.IsEmpty)
                InvalidStreamNameException.Throw($"Stream name cannot be empty before the partition separator ('!'): '{value}'.");
        }
        else {
            partition  = Partition.Any;
            streamSpan = span;
        }
        // Extract category using configurable options
        var category = StreamCategory.Parse(streamSpan, categoryOptions);
        return new(value, category, partition);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a string to a <see cref="StreamName"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator StreamName(string stream) => From(stream);
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a <see cref="StreamName"/> to its string representation.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator string(StreamName stream) => stream.ToString();
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a <see cref="StreamName"/> to its <see cref="StreamCategory"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator StreamCategory(StreamName stream) => stream.StreamCategory;
    /// <summary>
    /// Implicitly converts a <see cref="StreamName"/> to its <see cref="Partition"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static implicit operator Partition(StreamName stream) => stream.Partition;
}
public sealed class InvalidStreamNameException(string message, Exception? innerException = null)
    : Exception(message, innerException), IThrowableException<InvalidStreamNameException> {
    public static InvalidStreamNameException Create(string message, Exception? innerException) => new(message, innerException);
}
public interface IThrowableException<out TSelf> where TSelf : Exception, IThrowableException<TSelf> {
    static abstract TSelf Create(string message, Exception? innerException = null);
}
public static class ThrowableExceptionExtensions {
    extension<T>(IThrowableException<T>) where T : Exception, IThrowableException<T> {
        [DoesNotReturn, StackTraceHidden]
        public static void Throw(string message, Exception? innerException = null) =>
            throw T.Create(message, innerException);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Google.Rpc;

namespace Kurrent.Client.Exceptions;

public partial class StreamAlreadyExistsException;

public partial class StreamDeletedException {
    public StreamDeletedException(StreamName stream)
        : this(Format(ErrorMessages.StreamDeletedException, stream)) { }
}
[KurrentOperationError(StreamsError.StreamTombstoned)]
public partial class StreamTombstonedException {
    public StreamTombstonedException(StreamName stream)
        : this(Format(ErrorMessages.StreamTombstonedException, stream)) { }

[KurrentOperationError(StreamsError.StreamRevisionConflict)]
public partial class StreamRevisionConflictException {
    public StreamRevision ExpectedRevision { get; private set; } = StreamRevision.Unset;
    public StreamRevision ActualRevision   { get; private set; } = StreamRevision.Unset;
    public StreamRevisionConflictException(string operationName, StreamName stream, StreamRevision expectedRevision, StreamRevision actualRevision)
        : this(Format(ErrorMessages.StreamRevisionConflictException, operationName, stream, expectedRevision, actualRevision)) {
        ExpectedRevision = expectedRevision;
        ActualRevision   = actualRevision;
    }
    public void AfterParseRpcStatus(Status status, StreamRevisionConflictException self) {
        var details = status.GetDetail<StreamRevisionConflictErrorDetails>()!;
        self.ExpectedRevision = details.ExpectedRevision;
        self.ActualRevision   = details.ActualRevision;
    }
}
[KurrentOperationError(StreamsError.MaxAppendRecordSizeExceeded)]
public partial class MaxAppendRecordSizeExceededException {
    public Guid RecordId         { get; private set; }
    public int  RecordActualSize { get; private set; }
    public int  RecordMaxSize    { get; private set; }
    public void AfterParseRpcStatus(Status status, MaxAppendRecordSizeExceededException self) {
        var details = status.GetDetail<AppendRecordSizeExceededErrorDetails>()!;
        self.RecordId         = Guid.Parse(details.RecordId);
        self.RecordActualSize = details.Size;
        self.RecordMaxSize    = details.MaxSize;
    }
}

    public int TransactionActualSize { get; private set; }

        self.TransactionActualSize = details.Size;
        self.TransactionMaxSize    = details.MaxSize;
    }
````

````csharp
using Ductus.FluentDocker.Builders;
using Ductus.FluentDocker.Model.Builders;
using Kurrent.Testing.Containers.FluentDocker;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using TUnit.Core.Interfaces;
using static System.StringComparer;
namespace Kurrent.Testing.Containers.KurrentDB;
[PublicAPI]
public class KurrentDBTestContainer : TestContainer, IAsyncInitializer, IAsyncDisposable {
    public const int    DefaultPort     = 2113;
    public const string DefaultUsername = "admin";
    public const string DefaultPassword = "changeit";
    static string DefaultImage => "docker.kurrent.io/kurrent-latest/kurrentdb:latest";
    public KurrentDBTestContainer(Dictionary<string, string?> settings) : base(DefaultImage) {
        ActiveConfiguration = KurrentDBConfiguration.FromContext(settings).ToDictionary();
        IsSecure = ActiveConfiguration.TryGetValue("KURRENTDB_INSECURE", out var value) && value == "false";
        // TODO SS: these connection strings need a cleanup
        if (IsSecure) {
            AuthenticatedConnectionString = "kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113/?tls=true&tlsVerifyCert=false";
            AnonymousConnectionString     = "kurrentdb://localhost:2113/?tls=true&tlsVerifyCert=false";
        }
        else {
            AuthenticatedConnectionString = "kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113/?tls=false";
            AnonymousConnectionString     = "kurrentdb://localhost:2113/?tls=false";
        }
    }
    public KurrentDBTestContainer() : this(KurrentDBConfiguration.Insecure.ToDictionary()) { }
    public Dictionary<string, string?> ActiveConfiguration { get; }
    public string AuthenticatedConnectionString { get; }
    public string AnonymousConnectionString     { get; }
    public bool IsSecure { get; }
    protected override ContainerBuilder ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder) {
        var healthCheckCommand = IsSecure
            ? "curl -u admin:changeit --cacert /etc/kurrentdb/certs/ca/ca.crt https://localhost:2113/health/live"
            : "curl -o - -I http://admin:changeit@localhost:2113/health/live";
        if (IsSecure) {
            var certsPath = Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, "certs");
            CheckCertificates(certsPath); builder = builder.MountVolume(certsPath, "/etc/kurrentdb/certs", MountType.ReadOnly);
        }
        return builder
            //.UseNetwork(Network)
            .WithPublicEndpointResolver()
            .WithEnvironment(ActiveConfiguration)
            .ExposePort(DefaultPort, DefaultPort)
            .KeepContainer().KeepRunning().ReuseIfExists()
            .WaitUntilReadyWithConstantBackoff(1_000, 60, service => {
                var output = service.ExecuteCommand(healthCheckCommand);
                if (!output.Success) throw new Exception(output.Error);
            });
        static void CheckCertificates(string certificatePath) {
            var certificateFiles = new[] {
                Path.Combine("ca", "ca.crt"),
                Path.Combine("ca", "ca.key"),
                Path.Combine("node", "node.crt"),
                Path.Combine("node", "node.key")
            }.Select(path => Path.Combine(certificatePath, path));
            foreach (var file in certificateFiles)
                if (!File.Exists(file))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"Could not locate the certificates file {file} needed to run KurrentDB. Please run the 'gencert' tool at the root of the repository."
                    );
        }
    }
    public async Task InitializeAsync() => await Start().ConfigureAwait(false);
}

public static class KurrentDBConfiguration {
    /// <summary>
    /// Default insecure configuration for KurrentDB.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> Insecure = new Dictionary<string, string?> {
        ["KURRENTDB_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT"]           = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_OPTIONS"]      = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_MEM_DB"]                     = "false",
        ["KURRENTDB_DISABLE_LOG_FILE"]           = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_LOG_LEVEL"]                  = "Debug",
        ["KURRENTDB_ENABLE_ATOM_PUB_OVER_HTTP"]  = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_RUN_PROJECTIONS"]            = "All",
        ["KURRENTDB_START_STANDARD_PROJECTIONS"] = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_NODE_PORT"]                  = "2113",
        ["KURRENTDB_INSECURE"]                   = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_USER_CERTIFICATES__ENABLED"] = "false",
        ["OTEL_LOG_LEVEL"]                           = "debug",
        // TODO: Need License key environment variable
        // ["KURRENTDB__OPENTELEMETRY__LOGS__ENABLED"]  = "true",
        // ["KURRENTDB__OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"] = "http://localhost:4317",
        // ["KURRENTDB__OPENTELEMETRY__LOGS__ENABLED"]  = "true",
        // ["KURRENTDB__OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"] = "http://host.docker.internal:4317",
        // ["OPENTELEMETRY__LOGS__ENABLED"]             = "true",
        // ["OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"]            = "http://host.docker.internal:4317",
        // ["KURRENTDB_OPENTELEMETRY__LOGS__ENABLED"]   = "true",
        // ["KURRENTDB_OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"]  = "http://host.docker.internal:4317",
        // ["KURRENTDB_OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"] = "http://localhost:4317",
        // ["KURRENTDB_OPENTELEMETRY__OTLP__ENDPOINT"] = "http://host.docker.internal:4317",
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Default secure configuration for KurrentDB.
    /// This configuration is used when TLS is enabled and user certificates are required.
    /// It includes settings for trusted root certificates and node certificates.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> Secure = new Dictionary<string, string?>(Insecure) {
        ["KURRENTDB_INSECURE"]                       = "false",
        ["KURRENTDB_USER_CERTIFICATES__ENABLED"]     = "true",
        ["KURRENTDB_TRUSTED_ROOT_CERTIFICATES_PATH"] = "/etc/kurrentdb/certs/ca",
        ["KURRENTDB_CERTIFICATE_FILE"]               = "/etc/kurrentdb/certs/node/node.crt",
        ["KURRENTDB_CERTIFICATE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE"]   = "/etc/kurrentdb/certs/node/node.key",
    };
    /// <summary>
    /// Combines the default insecure configuration with any overrides specified in the current execution context configuration.
    /// </summary>
    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> FromContext(Dictionary<string, string?>? baseConfiguration = null) {
        var fromContext = TestkitExecutionContext.Configuration.AsEnumerable()
            .Where(x => x.Key.StartsWith("KURRENTDB_"))
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Value))
            .OrderBy(x => x.Key)
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Value);
        return (baseConfiguration ?? Insecure)
            .Concat(fromContext).GroupBy(x => x.Key)
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Last().Value, OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Streams;
//TODO SS: remove duplication with ByStream/ByStreams and BySchema/BySchemas methods in StreamFilter/SchemaFilter. ByStream should receive multiple streams and BySchema multiple schemas.
/// <summary>
/// Factory methods for creating record filters.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public static class RecordFilter {
    /// <summary>
    /// A filter that matches all records.
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly IRecordFilter None = new EmptyFilter();
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches a specific stream exactly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="stream">The stream name to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByStream(StreamName stream) => new StreamFilter(stream);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches streams by prefix patterns.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="prefixes">The stream name prefixes to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByStreamPrefix(params string[] prefixes) => new StreamFilter(prefixes, exactMatch: false);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches stream categories.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="categories">The stream category names to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByCategory(params string[] categories) => new StreamFilter(categories, exactMatch: false);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches any of the specified stream names exactly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="streams">The stream names to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByStreams(params string[] streams) => new StreamFilter(streams, exactMatch: true);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches a specific schema (event type) exactly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema name to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter BySchema(string schema) => new SchemaFilter(schema);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches schemas by prefix patterns.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="prefixes">The schema name prefixes to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter BySchemaPrefix(params string[] prefixes) => new SchemaFilter(prefixes, exactMatch: false);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter that matches any of the specified schema names exactly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="schemas">The schema names to match.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter BySchemas(params string[] schemas) => new SchemaFilter(schemas, exactMatch: true);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a filter from a DuckDB-compatible expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="expression">A filter expression (e.g., "stream = 'orders' AND props.ammount > 100").</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByExpression(string expression) => new ExpressionFilter(expression);
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a stream filter from a raw regex pattern.
    /// Use standard regex syntax for modifiers (e.g., (?i) for case-insensitive).
    /// TargetStream is automatically derived for case-sensitive exact match patterns.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pattern">The regex pattern to match stream names.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter ByStreamPattern(string pattern) =>
        new StreamFilter(new Regex(pattern, RegexOptions.Compiled));
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a schema filter from a raw regex pattern.
    /// Use standard regex syntax for modifiers (e.g., (?i) for case-insensitive).
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pattern">The regex pattern to match schema names.</param>
    public static IRecordFilter BySchemaPattern(string pattern) =>
        new SchemaFilter(new Regex(pattern, RegexOptions.Compiled));
}
/// <summary>
/// Defines a filter for matching records during read operations.
/// </summary>
[PublicAPI]
public interface IRecordFilter {
    /// <summary>
    /// Evaluates whether the specified record matches this filter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="record">The record to evaluate.</param>
    bool IsMatch(Record record);
    /// <summary>
    /// The target stream for stream-specific read operations that defaults to the $all stream.
    /// </summary>
    StreamName TargetStream => StreamName.AllStream;
    /// <summary>
    /// The original filter expression.
    /// </summary>
    string Expression { get; }
}
````

````csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Net;
using Grpc.Core.Interceptors;
using Kurrent.Client.Schema;
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using KurrentDB.Client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using static System.StringComparer;
using static System.TimeSpan;
#pragma warning disable CS8524 // The switch expression does not handle some values of its input type (it is not exhaustive) involving an unnamed enum value.
namespace Kurrent.Client;
/// <summary>
/// Configuration options for the Kurrent client.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// <para>
/// Provides comprehensive configuration for the Kurrent client, including connection settings,
/// security options, resilience strategies, and extensibility points.
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[PublicAPI]
public record KurrentClientOptions : OptionsBase<KurrentClientOptions, KurrentClientOptionsValidator> {
    public static KurrentClientOptionsBuilder Build => new();
    public static KurrentClientOptions Parse(string connectionString) =>
        KurrentConnectionString.Parse(connectionString).ToClientOptions();
    public KurrentClientOptionsBuilder GetBuilder() => new(this);
    public static readonly string DefaultConnectionString = "kurrentdb://admin:changeit@localhost:2113?tls=false&tlsVerifyCert=false";
    /// <summary>
    /// When options were created from a connection string, this property holds
    /// the connection string used to connect to the KurrentDB cluster.
    /// </summary>
    public string OriginalConnectionString { get; internal init; } = "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Indicates whether the original connection string was provided.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasOriginalConnectionString => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OriginalConnectionString);
    /// <summary>
	/// The name of the connection.
	/// </summary>
	/// <remarks>
	/// <para>
	/// A unique identifier for the connection, used in logging and diagnostics.
	/// </para>
	/// <para>
	/// Defaults to a randomly generated GUID-based name if not specified.
	/// </para>
	/// </remarks>
	public string ConnectionName { get; init; } = $"conn-{Guid.NewGuid()}";
    /// <summary>
    /// The URI scheme used for HTTP connections, based on the security settings.
    /// </summary>
    public string HttpUriScheme => Security.Transport.IsEnabled ? Uri.UriSchemeHttps : Uri.UriSchemeHttp;
    /// <summary>
    /// The URI scheme used for the connection, based on the connection scheme.
    /// It can be either "kurrentdb" or "kurrentdb+discover".
    /// </summary>
    public string ConnectionUriScheme => ConnectionScheme.Description;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scheme used by the resolver for establishing connections to the cluster.
    /// It can be either "kurrentdb" for single-node connections or "kurrentdb+discover" for multi-node clusters with discovery.
    /// </summary>
    public KurrentConnectionScheme ConnectionScheme { get; init; } = KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the address of the KurrentDB cluster based on the connection scheme and endpoints.
    /// </summary>
    public Uri Address {
        get {
            if (ConnectionScheme == KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct && Endpoints.Length == 1) {
                var directEndpoint = Endpoints[0];
                return new UriBuilder(HttpUriScheme, directEndpoint.Host, directEndpoint.Port).Uri;
            }
            // If we're using discovery, we don't have a direct address
            // we already validated that we must have endpoints
            return new Uri($"{KurrentConnectionScheme.Discover.Description}://{Guid.NewGuid()}");
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// List of <see cref="DnsEndPoint"/>s used to seed gossip.
    /// </summary>
    public DnsEndPoint[] Endpoints { get; init; } = [new DnsEndPoint("localhost", 2113)];
    /// <summary>
    /// Represents the configuration options for gossip-based discovery in the KurrentDB cluster.
    /// This property provides settings such as discovery intervals, timeouts, and preferences
    /// for selecting nodes during communication in the cluster.
    /// </summary>
    public KurrentClientGossipOptions Gossip { get; init; } = KurrentClientGossipOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security configuration for the client connection.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Controls transport security (TLS) and authentication credentials.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Provides comprehensive security options for the connection, including
    /// transport layer security and client authentication.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    /// <example>
    /// <code>
    /// var options = new KurrentClientOptions {
    ///     Security = KurrentClientSecurityOptions.MutualTls(
    ///         clientCertPath: "/path/to/client.crt",
    ///         clientKeyPath: "/path/to/client.key",
    ///         rootCaPath: "/path/to/ca.crt"
    ///     )
    /// };
    /// </code>
    /// </example>
    public KurrentClientSecurityOptions Security { get; init; } = KurrentClientSecurityOptions.Default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Configuration for resilience strategies, including retries, hedging, and jitter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Controls how the client handles transient failures and recovery strategies.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentClientResilienceOptions Resilience { get; init; } = KurrentClientResilienceOptions.NoResilience;
    /// <summary>
    /// Schema configuration options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// Controls how the client handles event schemas and versioning.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public KurrentClientSchemaOptions Schema { get; init; } = KurrentClientSchemaOptions.FullValidation;
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides a mechanism for mapping message types to their corresponding schemas.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// The mapper is used to associate specific message types with their schemas in the schema registry.
    /// This ensures that the correct schema is used when producing or consuming messages.
    /// </remarks>
    public MessageTypeMapper Mapper { get; init; } = new();
	/// <summary>
	/// An optional list of <see cref="Interceptor"/>s to use.
	/// </summary>
	/// <remarks>
	/// <para>
	/// Interceptors allow for inspection and modification of gRPC calls.
	/// </para>
	/// <para>
	/// Common uses include logging, metrics collection, and authentication.
	/// </para>
	/// </remarks>
	public IReadOnlyList<Interceptor> Interceptors { get; init; } = [];
	/// <summary>
	/// Metadata decoder for processing event metadata.
	/// </summary>
	/// <remarks>
	/// <para>
	/// Responsible for decoding metadata attached to events.
	/// </para>
	/// </remarks>
	public MetadataDecoder MetadataDecoder { get; init; } = new DefaultMetadataDecoder();
    /// <summary>
    /// An optional <see cref="ILoggerFactory"/> to use.
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
    /// <para>
    /// The logger factory used to create loggers for the client.
    /// </para>
    /// <para>
    /// Defaults to <see cref="NullLoggerFactory.Instance"/> if not specified.
    /// </para>
    /// </remarks>
    public ILoggerFactory LoggerFactory { get; init; } = NullLoggerFactory.Instance;
    public override string ToString() => this.GenerateConnectionString();
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new <see cref="KurrentClientOptions"/> instance from configuration.
    /// <remarks>
    /// The configuration is built automatically from standard sources including
    /// appsettings.json files and environment variables.
    /// </remarks>
    /// </summary>
    public static KurrentClientOptions FromConfiguration(string prefix = "kurrent:client") {
        var environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") ?? "Development";
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", true)
            .AddJsonFile($"appsettings.{environment}.json", true)                    // Accept default naming convention
            .AddJsonFile($"appsettings.{environment.ToLowerInvariant()}.json", true) // Linux is case-sensitive
            .AddEnvironmentVariables()
            .Build();
        // given the complexity of mapping configuration to options,
        // we might not be able to bind directly in all cases. So we try to bind first,
        // and if that fails, we fall back to default options.
        // this is because our Options are in fact settings that can be provided partially.
        // by this I mean that certain properties are complex types and implementations
        // that need to be constructed properly
        var options = configuration.Get<KurrentClientOptions>() ?? new KurrentClientOptions();
        return options;
    }
}
static class KurrentDBConnectionStringExtensions {
    static T GetParameterValue<T>(Dictionary<string, string> source, string key, T defaultValue) =>
        !source.TryGetValue(key, out var strValue) ? defaultValue : (T)Convert.ChangeType(strValue, typeof(T));
    static string? GetParameterValue(Dictionary<string, string> source, string key, string? defaultValue) =>
        !source.TryGetValue(key, out var value) ? defaultValue : value;
    static bool GetParameterValue(Dictionary<string, string> source, string key, bool defaultValue) =>
        !source.TryGetValue(key, out var strValue) ? defaultValue : bool.TryParse(strValue, out var value) ? value : defaultValue;
    /// <param name="source">The V1 connection string configuration to convert</param>
    extension(KurrentConnectionString source) {
        /// <summary>
        /// Converts a V1 connection string configuration to a V2 client options instance.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>A new KurrentClientOptions instance configured based on the connection string</returns>
        /// <remarks>
        /// <para>
        /// This method enables seamless migration from V1 to V2 of the KurrentDB client by
        /// preserving connection settings and security configuration across versions.
        /// </para>
        /// <para>
        /// All resilience settings from the connection string are mapped to the equivalent
        /// resilience options in the V2 client.
        /// </para>
        /// </remarks>
        public KurrentClientOptions ToClientOptions() {
            var connectionName = GetParameterValue<string>(source.Options, "ConnectionName", $"conn-{Guid.NewGuid():D}");
            var schemeType = KurrentConnectionString.DiscoverySchemes.Contains(source.Scheme, OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? KurrentConnectionScheme.Discover
                : KurrentConnectionScheme.Direct;
            var options =  new KurrentClientOptions {
                ConnectionName           = connectionName,
                ConnectionScheme         = schemeType,
                Endpoints                = source.Hosts,
                Security                 = ConfigureSecurityOptions(),
                Resilience               = ConfigureResilienceOptions(),
                Gossip                   = ConfigureGossipOptions(),
                OriginalConnectionString = source.ConnectionString
            };
            return options;
            KurrentClientSecurityOptions ConfigureSecurityOptions() {
                return new() {
                    Transport      = ConfigureTransportSecurity(),
                    Authentication = ConfigureAuthentication()
                };
                TransportSecurity ConfigureTransportSecurity() {
                    var useTls        = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "Tls", true);
                    var tlsVerifyCert = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "TlsVerifyCert", true);
                    var tlsCaFile     = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "TlsCaFile", null);
                    return !useTls
                        ? TransportSecurity.None
                        : tlsCaFile is not null
                            ? TransportSecurity.Certificate(tlsCaFile)
                            : tlsVerifyCert
                                ? TransportSecurity.Standard
                                : TransportSecurity.Insecure;
                }
                ClientCredentials ConfigureAuthentication() {
                    var userCertFile = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "UserCertFile", null);
                    var userKeyFile  = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "UserKeyFile", null);
                    return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(userCertFile) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(userKeyFile)
                        ? ClientCredentials.Certificate(userCertFile, userKeyFile)
                        : source.UserInfo is not null
                            ? ClientCredentials.Basic(source.UserInfo.Value.User, source.UserInfo.Value.Password)
                            : ClientCredentials.None;
                }
            }
            KurrentClientResilienceOptions ConfigureResilienceOptions() {
                var keepAliveIntervalMs = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "KeepAliveInterval", 60000);
                var keepAliveTimeoutMs  = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "KeepAliveTimeout", 30000);
                var defaultDeadlineMs   = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "DefaultDeadline", 30000);
                var keepAliveInterval = keepAliveIntervalMs == -1 ? Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan : FromMilliseconds(keepAliveIntervalMs);
                var keepAliveTimeout  = keepAliveTimeoutMs  == -1 ? Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan : FromMilliseconds(keepAliveTimeoutMs);
                var deadline          = defaultDeadlineMs   == -1 ? Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan : FromMilliseconds(defaultDeadlineMs);
                return new() {
                    KeepAliveInterval = keepAliveInterval,
                    KeepAliveTimeout  = keepAliveTimeout,
                    Deadline          = deadline
                };
            }
            KurrentClientGossipOptions ConfigureGossipOptions() {
                var maxDiscoverAttempts = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "MaxDiscoverAttempts", 10);
                var discoveryInterval   = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "DiscoveryInterval", 100);
                var gossipTimeout       = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "GossipTimeout", 5000);
                var nodePreference      = GetParameterValue(source.Options, "NodePreference", NodePreference.Random);
                return new() {
                    MaxDiscoverAttempts = maxDiscoverAttempts,
                    DiscoveryInterval   = FromMilliseconds(discoveryInterval),
                    Timeout             = FromMilliseconds(gossipTimeout),
                    ReadPreference      = nodePreference
                };
            }
        }
    }
}
/// <summary>
/// Represents the connection scheme used by the Kurrent client.
/// </summary>
public enum KurrentConnectionScheme {
    /// <summary>Direct connection to a single node</summary>
    [Description("kurrentdb")]
    Direct,
    /// <summary>Cluster connection with discovery via gossip protocol</summary>
    [Description("kurrentdb+discover")]
    Discover
}
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Integration.Tests/Streams/Append/AppendTests.cs
````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Client.Tests.Fixtures;
using Kurrent.Client.Tests.Tools;
using Kurrent.Testing.Shouldly;
using Kurrent.Testing.TUnit;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Streams;
[Category("Streams")]
[Category("Integration")]
public class AppendTests {
    [ClassDataSource<KurrentClientTestFixture>(Shared = SharedType.PerTestSession)]
    public required KurrentClientTestFixture Fixture { get; [UsedImplicitly] init; }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask appends_to_single_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = HomeAutomationTestData.SimulateHomeActivity();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .AppendSession([simulation],ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(success => {
                success.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
                var appendStreamSuccess = success[0];
                appendStreamSuccess.Stream.ShouldBe(simulation.Stream);
                appendStreamSuccess.StreamRevision.ShouldBe(simulation.Messages.Count() - 1);
                appendStreamSuccess.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
                appendStreamSuccess.Position.ShouldBeEquivalentTo(success.Position);
            });
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask creates_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = HomeAutomationTestData.SimulateHomeActivity();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Append(simulation, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(success => {
                success.Stream.ShouldBe(simulation.Stream);
                success.StreamRevision.ShouldBe(simulation.Messages.Count() - 1);
                success.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
            });
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask appends_to_existing_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var smartHomeActivity = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        // create stream
        var result = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Append(smartHomeActivity.Stream, ExpectedStreamState.NoStream, smartHomeActivity.Records.Take(3), ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        // append to existing stream
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Append(smartHomeActivity.Stream, result.StreamRevision, smartHomeActivity.Records.Skip(3), ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(success => {
                success.Stream.ShouldBe(smartHomeActivity.Stream);
                success.StreamRevision.ShouldBe(smartHomeActivity.Records.Count() - 1);
                success.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
            });
    }
    public class AppendToStreamInAnyState : TestCaseGenerator<ExpectedStreamState> {
        protected override IEnumerable<ExpectedStreamState> Data() => [
            ExpectedStreamState.NoStream,
            ExpectedStreamState.StreamExists
        ];
    }
    [Test, AppendToStreamInAnyState]
    public async Task appends_to_stream_in_any_state(ExpectedStreamState expectedStreamState, CancellationToken ct) {
        var smartHomeActivity = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        if (ExpectedStreamState.NoStream == expectedStreamState) {
            var expectedRevision = StreamRevision.From(smartHomeActivity.Records.Count() - 1);
            // should create the stream
            await Fixture.Client.Streams
                .Append(smartHomeActivity.Stream, ExpectedStreamState.Any, smartHomeActivity.Records, ct)
                .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync(success => {
                    success.Stream.ShouldBe(smartHomeActivity.Stream);
                    success.StreamRevision.ShouldBe(expectedRevision);
                    success.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
                });
        }
        else if(ExpectedStreamState.StreamExists == expectedStreamState) {
            // create stream
            await Fixture.Client.Streams
                .Append(smartHomeActivity.Stream, ExpectedStreamState.NoStream, smartHomeActivity.Records.Take(3), ct)
                .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
            // append to existing stream
            await Fixture.Client.Streams
                .Append(smartHomeActivity.Stream, ExpectedStreamState.StreamExists, smartHomeActivity.Records.Skip(3), ct)
                .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        }
    }
    public class CreatesMultipleStreamsTransactionallyState : TestCaseGenerator<int> {
        protected override IEnumerable<int> Data() => [
            2, 5, 6, 8, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50, 100
        ];
    }
    [Test, CreatesMultipleStreamsTransactionallyState]
    public async Task creates_multiple_streams_transactionally(int streams, CancellationToken ct) {
        var activity = HomeAutomationTestData.SimulateHousingComplexActivity();
        var requests = activity
            .Select(act => act.AppendRequest)
            .ToList();
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .AppendSession(requests, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowAsync()
            // .InspectErrorAsync(failure => {
            //     failure. .Count.ShouldBeGreaterThan(0);
            //     Should.NotThrow(() => failures..FirstOrDefault().Error.Throw());
            // })
            .InspectAsync(success => {
                success.Count.ShouldBe(requests.Count);
                for (var i = 0; i < requests.Count; i++) {
                    var request = requests[i];
                    var result  = success[i];
                    var expectedRevision = StreamRevision.From(request.Messages.Count() - 1);
                    result.Stream.ShouldBe(request.Stream);
                    result.StreamRevision.ShouldBe(expectedRevision);
                    result.Position.ShouldBeGreaterThan(LogPosition.Earliest);
                }
            });
    }
}
````

## File: test/Kurrent.Client.Integration.Tests/Streams/Management/TruncateTests.cs
````csharp
using Kurrent.Client.Streams;
using Kurrent.Client.Tests.Fixtures;
using Kurrent.Client.Tests.Tools;
using Kurrent.Testing.Shouldly;
namespace Kurrent.Client.Tests.Streams;
[Category("Streams")]
[Category("Truncate")]
[Category("Integration")]
public class TruncateTests {
    [ClassDataSource<KurrentClientTestFixture>(Shared = SharedType.PerTestSession)]
    public required KurrentClientTestFixture Fixture { get; [UsedImplicitly] init; }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask truncates_stream_at_revision(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        await  Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Truncate(simulation.Stream, simulation.StreamRevision, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var messages = await  Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var count = await messages.CountAsync(ct);
        count.ShouldBe(1, "Stream should contain only the truncation marker message");
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask truncates_full_stream(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        var revision = simulation.StreamRevision + 1; // all messages
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Truncate(simulation.Stream, revision, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var messages = await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .ReadStreamRecords(simulation.Stream, ct)
            .ShouldNotThrowOrFailAsync();
        var count = await messages.CountAsync(ct);
        count.ShouldBe(0, "Stream should be empty after truncation");
    }
    [Test]
    public async ValueTask returns_revision_conflict_error_when_revision_is_not_matched(CancellationToken ct) {
        var simulation = await Fixture.SeedSmartHomeActivity(ct);
        var badRevision = simulation.StreamRevision + 99;
        await Fixture.Client.Streams
            .Truncate(simulation.Stream, badRevision, ct)
            .ShouldFailAsync(error =>
                error.Case.ShouldBe(TruncateStreamError.TruncateStreamErrorCase.StreamRevisionConflictException));
    }
}
````
